Enigma Multiplayer PR Review Diff

Generated 2026-02-15 03:23:06. Base: upstream/master (f9ef4a39) → Working tree (HEAD 6914b4b6). Diff hash: 1d46b5b32c9c.
How to use: Grouped by path. Each file begins with a narrative (Description, Where used, What changed vs upstream) followed by a red/green diff. Per-hunk notes are intentionally not embedded here; long-lived explanations are kept as code comments instead.

Extension proposals (not applied)

Scope note: The multiplayer branch already includes substantial restructuring (transport facade, explicit session state, centralized config, UI split files) to keep review and maintenance tractable. The items below are intentionally deferred because they add tooling or cross-language coordination not required for the initial multiplayer PR.
4) In-process integration tests with a fake transport
  • What it is: A deterministic harness that instantiates a host and N clients in-process and drives the multiplayer session with a fake transport that can simulate packet loss/reordering/latency without real sockets.
  • Why it helps: Multiplayer bugs are often timing-sensitive. A fake transport would allow CI to cover join/start/restart/resync/peer-leave reliably and prevent regressions that are otherwise hard to reproduce.
  • Why it is deferred: It adds a non-trivial test framework surface (fake transport, scripted ticking, fixtures) that maintainers may want to evaluate after the core feature set lands.
5) Single source of truth for Internet lobby protocol schema
  • What it is: Share an explicit schema between the C++ client and tools/internet_lobby_server.py so request/response formats cannot drift silently (today: a custom binary UDP lobby protocol implemented in both C++ and Python).
  • Why it helps: Internet mode spans two languages and a separately deployed service. A shared schema reduces compatibility breakage and simplifies future API extensions (capability negotiation, versioned endpoints).
  • Why it is deferred: Schema tooling/codegen increases build and deployment complexity. The initial PR keeps the server implementation intentionally minimal and dependency-light.

A Dockerfile

Description
  • Minimal container image to run the Internet lobby server plus UDP and TCP relays.
Where it is used
  • Used for easy deployment to a public VM/container host for Internet multiplayer testing.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Adds a combined lobby+relay container setup.
  • Exposes and documents ports: 12347/udp lobby, 12348/udp UDP relay, 12349/tcp TCP relay.
diff --git a/Dockerfile b/Dockerfile
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..9ddd5cc2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Dockerfile
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
1FROM debian:bookworm-slim
2
3RUN apt-get update && \
4 apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
5 bash \
6 build-essential \
7 ca-certificates \
8 libenet-dev \
9 python3 && \
10 rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
11
12WORKDIR /opt/enigma
13COPY tools/internet_lobby_server.py tools/relay_server.cc tools/tcp_relay_server.cc tools/docker-entrypoint.sh tools/
14
15RUN g++ -std=c++14 tools/relay_server.cc -lenet -o /usr/local/bin/enigma-relay
16RUN g++ -std=c++14 tools/tcp_relay_server.cc -o /usr/local/bin/enigma-tcp-relay
17
18COPY tools/docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/enigma-entrypoint
19RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/enigma-entrypoint
20
21# 12347/udp: Internet lobby server (room coordination)
22# 12348/udp: UDP relay (ENet) for gameplay transport fallback
23# 12349/tcp: TCP relay for networks that block UDP
24EXPOSE 12347/udp 12348/udp 12349/tcp
25
26ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/enigma-entrypoint"]

3741/* -------------------- Value implementation -------------------- */

43namespace {

45// Parse floating point numbers in a locale-independent way.
46//
47// XML level data and most config values are written with '.' as decimal separator.
48// Using locale-dependent atof() can truncate at '.' when LC_NUMERIC uses ',' which
49// would cause cross-platform desyncs in multiplayer (and wrong values in general).
50double parse_double_classic_locale(const char *s) {
51 if (!s)
52 return 0.0;
53
54 // Keep legacy "%<int>" escape behavior consistent with Value::operator int().
55 if (s[0] == '%')
56 return static_cast<double>(std::strtol(&(s[1]), NULL, 0));
57
58 std::string tmp(s);
59 // If the value looks like it uses ',' as decimal separator, normalize to '.'
60 // before parsing under the classic locale.
61 if (tmp.find('.') == std::string::npos && tmp.find(',') != std::string::npos) {
62 for (char &ch : tmp) {
63 if (ch == ',')
64 ch = '.';
65 }
66 }
67
68 std::istringstream iss(tmp);
69 iss.imbue(std::locale::classic());
70 double out = 0.0;
71 iss >> out;
72 return out;
73}
74
75} // namespace
76

4078 }

255293 case STRING:

294 return parse_double_classic_locale(val.str);
257295 default:
258296 return 0.0;

312 void Actor::move_screen() {
313 // Optional render-only smoothing to hide abrupt actor teleports caused by
314 // multiplayer resyncs. This does not affect simulation state.
315 if (!multiplayer::IsActive() || !options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugSmoothRender")) {
316 m_actorinfo.render_pos = m_actorinfo.pos;
317 m_actorinfo.render_initialized = true;
318 m_sprite.move(m_actorinfo.pos);
319 return;
320 }
321 if (!m_actorinfo.render_initialized) {
322 m_actorinfo.render_pos = m_actorinfo.pos;
323 m_actorinfo.render_initialized = true;
324 } else {
325 const ecl::V2 delta = m_actorinfo.pos - m_actorinfo.render_pos;
326 if (length(delta) > 5.0) {
327 // Too far off: snap to avoid visibly drifting through walls.
328 m_actorinfo.render_pos = m_actorinfo.pos;
329 } else {
330 const double dt = RenderFrameDtime();
331 const double tau = 0.05; // seconds
332 double alpha = 1.0;
333 if (dt > 0.0 && tau > 0.0)
334 alpha = 1.0 - std::exp(-dt / tau);
335 if (alpha < 0.0)
336 alpha = 0.0;
337 if (alpha > 1.0)
338 alpha = 1.0;
339 m_actorinfo.render_pos += delta * alpha;
340 }
341 }
342 m_sprite.move(m_actorinfo.render_pos);
343 }

M src/client.cc

Description
  • Main client state machine (menus, starting levels, in-game loop).
Where it is used
  • Central runtime entry for menu transitions and gameplay state transitions.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Adds multiplayer-specific client states and integrates the multiplayer session tick into the game loop.
  • Implements deferred level start (waiting-for-peers screen) without breaking level intro/transition text.
  • Hardens gameplay mouse control across focus loss/regain: restores input grab/relative mode and re-hides the custom cursor to avoid accidental "wizard cursor" behavior.
  • Shows an in-game wait dialog when lockstep stalls (missing inputs), with a countdown and a Leave action that aborts the session for everyone.
  • Mitigates buffered-input side effects during stalls/pauses by flushing mouse motion and draining pending local input, then restoring/re-centering gameplay mouse control when resuming.

Description
  • Simple floor types implementation.
Where it is used
  • Used by many levels.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Keeps upstream/master single-player `fl_yinyang` semantics (floor is keyed to the current player), while making multiplayer `fl_yinyang` behave by ball affinity (color/owner parity) so cloned black/white marbles interact with yin/yang mechanics as expected.
diff --git a/src/floors/SimpleFloors.cc b/src/floors/SimpleFloors.cc

168169 ecl::V2 YinyangFloor::process_mouseforce (Actor *a, ecl::V2 force) {
169 if (player::CurrentPlayer() == state)
170 // Single-player semantics:
171 // - `fl_yinyang` is keyed to the *current player* (changed by it_yinyang).
172 // Any ball on the active yin/yang floor responds to mouseforce.
173 //
174 // Multiplayer semantics:
175 // - The "current player" toggle is not meaningful.
176 // - Extra players can "clone" authored black/white marbles; those clones should
177 // still behave like black/white for yin/yang mechanics even if controllers
178 // were redistributed to different session players.
179 if (!input::IsNetworked()) {
180 (void)a;
181 if (player::CurrentPlayer() == state)
182 return getAdhesion() * force;
183 return ecl::V2();
184 }
185
186 int affinity = -1;
187
188 // Prefer explicit actor color when available: BLACK/YIN is 0, WHITE/YANG is 1.
189 if (Value c = a->getAttr("color")) {
190 int ci = static_cast<int>(c);
191 if (ci == YIN || ci == YANG)
192 affinity = ci;
193 }
194
195 // Fallback: in multiplayer, owner is a player index; parity matches yin/yang grouping.
196 if (affinity < 0) {
197 if (Value o = a->getAttr("owner")) {
198 int oi = static_cast<int>(o);
199 if (oi >= 0)
200 affinity = (oi & 1);
201 }
202 }
203
204 // Last-resort fallback: infer the controlling player from a single-bit controllers mask.
205 if (affinity < 0) {
206 int ctr = a->get_controllers();
207 if (ctr != 0) {
208 unsigned mask = static_cast<unsigned>(ctr);
209 unsigned idx = 0;
210 while ((mask & 1u) == 0u) {
211 mask >>= 1u;
212 ++idx;
213 if (idx >= 31)
214 break;
215 }
216 affinity = static_cast<int>(idx & 1u);
217 }
218 }
219
220 if (affinity == state)
170221 return getAdhesion() * force;
171222 else
172223 return ecl::V2();

198 add(players_title, Rect(margin, players_title_y, left_w, title_h));
199 add(players_list, Rect(margin, players_list_y, left_w, players_list_h));
200 add(info_label, Rect(margin, info_y, left_w, info_h));
201 info_area_default = Rect(margin, info_y, left_w, info_h);
202
203 int y = form_y;
204 add(room_label, Rect(form_x, y, left_w, line_h));
205 y += line_h;
206 add(room_field, Rect(form_x, y, field_w, field_h));
207 y += field_h + 4;
208 players_label->set_area(Rect(-10000, -10000, left_w, line_h));
209 players_field->set_area(Rect(-10000, -10000, field_w, field_h));
210 internet_buttons = new HList();
211 internet_buttons->set_spacing(10);
212 internet_buttons->set_alignment(HALIGN_CENTER, VALIGN_TOP);
213 internet_buttons->set_default_size((vminfo.width < 640) ? 90 : 120,
214 (vminfo.width < 640) ? 25 : 35);
215 internet_buttons->add_back(create_room_button);
216 internet_buttons->add_back(join_room_button);
217 add(internet_buttons, Rect(form_x, y, field_w, internet_buttons_h));
218
219 internet_leave_buttons = new HList();
220 internet_leave_buttons->set_spacing(10);
221 internet_leave_buttons->set_alignment(HALIGN_CENTER, VALIGN_TOP);
222 internet_leave_buttons->set_default_size((vminfo.width < 640) ? 90 : 120,
223 button_h);
224 internet_leave_buttons->add_back(leave_room_button);
225 add(internet_leave_buttons, Rect(form_x, y, field_w, internet_buttons_h));
226 internet_buttons_x = form_x;
227 internet_buttons_y = y;
228
229 restore_session_state();
230 set_internet_mode(internet_mode);
231 if (internet_mode && internet_in_room) {
232 // Force an immediate poll on the first tick after reopening so the room state
233 // and player list refresh right away.
234 internet_poll_timer = 0.2;
235 }
236
237 rebuild_index();
238 refresh_selection();
239}
240
241MultiplayerMenu::~MultiplayerMenu() {
242 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
243 store_session_state();
244 // If the host started a session but never entered the game (for example
245 // while waiting for peers to connect), ensure we don't keep listening in
246 // the background after leaving the menu.
247 multiplayer::Shutdown();
248 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
249 if (!previous_index_name.empty()) {
250 if (lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(previous_index_name)) {
251 lev::Index *ind = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
252 if (ind)
253 ind->setCurrentPosition(previous_index_pos);
254 }
255 }
256}

38void MultiplayerMenu::handle_level_activated() {
39 if (host_waiting_for_peers) {
40 show_info(_("Waiting for other players to connect..."));
41 return;
42 }
43 refresh_selection();
44 if (internet_mode) {
45 if (!internet_in_room) {
46 show_info(_("Create or join a room to start."));
47 return;
48 }
49 if (!internet_is_host) {
50 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
51 return;
52 }
53 if (desired_players() < 2) {
54 show_info(_("Need at least two players to start."));
55 return;
56 }
57
58 // Ensure the start message fully qualifies the level across packs.
59 if (selected_pack_name.empty())
60 select_pack_for_level(selected_level_id);
61 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
62 selected_level_id, desired_players(), selected_pack_name, filter_min_players);
63 std::string error;
64 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
65 std::string room = current_room_code();
66 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
67 if (!multiplayer::InternetStartRoom(mp_menu::resolved_lobby_server(server, servers),
68 room, start, error)) {
69 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to start room.") : error);
70 return;
71 }
72 start_host_and_enter_game(start, false);
73 return;
74 }
75
76 if (!multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig().enable_direct) {
77 show_info(_("Enable Direct Connect for LAN mode."));
78 return;
79 }
80 if (desired_players() < 2) {
81 show_info(_("Need at least two players to start."));
82 return;
83 }
84 if (!can_start()) {
85 show_info(_("Need matching players to start."));
86 return;
87 }
88 if (selected_pack_name.empty())
89 select_pack_for_level(selected_level_id);
90 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
91 selected_level_id, desired_players(), selected_pack_name, filter_min_players);
92 start_host_and_enter_game(start, true);
93}
94
95void MultiplayerMenu::handle_level_pack() {
96 if (internet_mode && internet_in_room && !internet_is_host) {
97 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
98 return;
99 }
100 if (!selected_pack_name.empty())
101 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(selected_pack_name);
102 LevelPackMenu menu(true);
103 menu.manage();
104 lev::Index *current = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
105 if (current) {
106 selected_pack_name = current->getName();
107 previous_index_name = selected_pack_name;
108 previous_index_pos = current->getCurrentPosition();
109 }
110 if (!lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName()))
111 return;
112 rebuild_index();
113 refresh_selection();
114 invalidate_all();
115}
116
117void MultiplayerMenu::handle_filter() {
118 if (internet_mode && internet_in_room && !internet_is_host) {
119 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
120 return;
121 }
122 unsigned players = desired_players();
123 if (filter_min_players >= players)
124 filter_min_players = 1;
125 else
126 filter_min_players += 1;
127 update_filter_button();
128 rebuild_index();
129 refresh_selection();
130 invalidate_all();
131}
132
133void MultiplayerMenu::handle_mode_toggle() {
134 set_internet_mode(!internet_mode);
135 rebuild_index();
136 refresh_selection();
137 invalidate_all();
138}
139
140void MultiplayerMenu::handle_create_room() {
141 const std::string server_warning =
142 _("Set lobby and relay server IP in Options/Multiplayer.");
143 if (current_room_code().empty()) {
144 show_info(_("please choose room code"));
145 return;
146 }
147 unsigned players = desired_players();
148 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
149 std::string room_code = current_room_code();
150 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
151 if (servers.lobby.empty()) {
152 show_info(server_warning);
153 return;
154 }
155 multiplayer::SetRelayServer(servers.udp_relay);
156 multiplayer::SetTcpRelayServer(servers.tcp_relay);
157 if (selected_pack_name.empty())
158 select_pack_for_level(selected_level_id);
159 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
160 selected_level_id, players, selected_pack_name, filter_min_players);
161 std::string error;
162 if (!multiplayer::InternetCreateRoom(servers.lobby, room_code, start, error)) {
163 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to create room.") : error);
164 return;
165 }
166 internet_room_code = room_code;
167 internet_room_peers.clear();
168 multiplayer::LobbyPeer self;
169 self.id = start.host_id;
170 self.name = multiplayer::LobbyLocalName();
171 self.is_self = true;
172 internet_room_peers.push_back(self);
173 internet_start = start;
174 internet_start_valid = true;
175 internet_in_room = true;
176 internet_is_host = true;
177 internet_connecting = false;
178 internet_player_count = 1;
179 update_internet_layout();
180 show_info(_("Room created. Click a level to start."));
181}
182
183void MultiplayerMenu::handle_join_room() {
184 const std::string server_warning =
185 _("Set lobby and relay server IP in Options/Multiplayer.");
186 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
187 std::string room = current_room_code();
188 if (room.empty()) {
189 show_info(_("please choose room code"));
190 return;
191 }
192 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
193 if (servers.lobby.empty()) {
194 show_info(server_warning);
195 return;
196 }
197 multiplayer::SetRelayServer(servers.udp_relay);
198 multiplayer::SetTcpRelayServer(servers.tcp_relay);
199 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
200 std::string host_ip;
201 std::string error;
202 unsigned player_count = 0;
203 std::vector<multiplayer::LobbyPeer> peers;
204 if (!multiplayer::InternetJoinRoom(servers.lobby, room, start, host_ip, player_count,
205 peers, error)) {
206 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to join room.") : error);
207 return;
208 }
209 internet_room_code = room;
210 internet_room_peers = peers;
211 internet_in_room = true;
212 internet_is_host = false;
213 internet_connecting = false;
214 if (!internet_room_peers.empty())
215 internet_player_count = static_cast<unsigned>(internet_room_peers.size());
216 else
217 internet_player_count = player_count > 0 ? player_count : 1;
218 update_internet_layout();
219 internet_poll_timer = 0.0;
220 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
221}
222
223void MultiplayerMenu::handle_leave_room() {
224 leave_current_internet_room();
225 if (multiplayer::IsActive())
226 multiplayer::Shutdown();
227 host_waiting_for_peers = false;
228 show_info(_("Left room."));
229}
230
231void MultiplayerMenu::on_action(gui::Widget *w) {
232 if (w == levelwidget) {
233 handle_level_activated();
234 return;
235 }
236 if (w == levelpack_button) {
237 handle_level_pack();
238 return;
239 }
240 if (w == filter_button) {
241 handle_filter();
242 return;
243 }
244 if (w == mode_button) {
245 handle_mode_toggle();
246 return;
247 }
248 if (w == create_room_button) {
249 handle_create_room();
250 return;
251 }
252 if (w == join_room_button) {
253 handle_join_room();
254 return;
255 }
256 if (w == leave_room_button) {
257 handle_leave_room();
258 return;
259 }
260 if (w == back_button) {
261 if (multiplayer::IsActive())
262 multiplayer::Shutdown();
263 host_waiting_for_peers = false;
264 Menu::quit();
265 }
266}

47lev::VolatileIndex *ensure_lobby_index() {
48 if (s_lobby_index != nullptr)
49 return s_lobby_index;
50 std::vector<std::string> empty;
51 s_lobby_index = new lev::VolatileIndex("Multiplayer Lobby", "Network Levels", "Multiplayer",
52 empty, INDEX_DEFAULT_PACK_LOCATION);
53 lev::Index::registerIndex(s_lobby_index);
54 return s_lobby_index;
55}
56
57lev::Index *find_pack_for_level_id(const std::string &level_id, lev::Index *lobby_index) {
58 std::vector<std::string> groups = lev::Index::getGroupNames();
59 for (const auto &group : groups) {
60 std::vector<lev::Index *> *indices = lev::Index::getGroup(group);
61 if (!indices)
62 continue;
63 for (auto *index : *indices) {
64 if (!index || index == lobby_index)
65 continue;
66 if (index->hasNormLevelPath(level_id))
67 return index;
68 }
69 }
70 return nullptr;
71}
72
73InternetServers resolve_internet_servers(const std::string &server) {
74 static_cast<void>(server);
75 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
76 return multiplayer::ResolveInternetServers(cfg);
77}
78
79std::string multiplayer_server_host_from_options() {
80 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
81 return cfg.server_host.empty() ? std::string("CHANGEME") : cfg.server_host;
82}
83
84bool proxy_player_info(lev::Proxy *proxy, unsigned &players, bool &optimized) {
85 if (!proxy)
86 return false;
87 try {
88 proxy->loadMetadata(true);
89 } catch (XLevelLoading &) {
90 return false;
91 }
92 bool network = proxy->hasNetworkMode();
93 bool single = proxy->hasSingleMode();
94 if (!network && !single)
95 return false;
96 optimized = network;
97 players = network ? proxy->getNetworkPlayers() : 1;
98 if (players < 1)
99 players = 1;
100 return true;
101}
102
103std::string no_level_message(unsigned min_players, unsigned desired_players) {
104 if (min_players == desired_players) {
105 return ecl::strf(_("No %u player levels are in this level pack"), desired_players);
106 }
107 return ecl::strf(_("No %u-%u player levels are in this level pack"), min_players,
108 desired_players);
109}
110
111std::string resolved_lobby_server(const std::string &server, const InternetServers &servers) {
112 return servers.lobby.empty() ? server : servers.lobby;
113}

What changed vs upstream/master
  • Implements level filtering and deterministic ordering for multiplayer selection.
  • Improves Internet lobby UX: full-width status/info panel when not showing host level selection, avoids clipped status text/buttons at low resolutions, and renders Internet member names from lobby data.

49void MultiplayerMenu::rebuild_index() {
50 if (!lobby_index)
51 return;
52 std::string keep = selected_level_id;
53 lobby_index->clear();
54 unsigned desired_players_count = desired_players();
55 unsigned min_players = filter_min_players;
56 if (min_players < 1)
57 min_players = 1;
58 if (min_players > desired_players_count)
59 min_players = desired_players_count;
60
61 lev::Index *pack_index = nullptr;
62 if (!selected_pack_name.empty())
63 pack_index = lev::Index::findIndex(selected_pack_name);
64 if (!pack_index)
65 pack_index = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
66 if (!pack_index) {
67 info_label->set_text(mp_menu::no_level_message(min_players, desired_players_count));
68 info_ttl = -1.0;
69 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName());
70 levelwidget->syncFromIndexMgr();
71 return;
72 }
73
74 std::vector<lev::Proxy *> proxies;
75 if (pack_index) {
76 proxies.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(pack_index->size()));
77 for (int i = 0; i < pack_index->size(); ++i) {
78 if (lev::Proxy *proxy = pack_index->getProxy(i))
79 proxies.push_back(proxy);
80 }
81 }
82
83 std::vector<lev::Proxy *> filtered;
84 filtered.reserve(proxies.size());
85 lev::RatingManager *ratings = lev::RatingManager::instance();
86 for (auto *proxy : proxies) {
87 unsigned players = 0;
88 bool optimized = false;
89 if (!mp_menu::proxy_player_info(proxy, players, optimized))
90 continue;
91 if (players > desired_players_count)
92 continue;
93 if (players < min_players)
94 continue;
95 filtered.push_back(proxy);
96 }
97
98 std::sort(filtered.begin(), filtered.end(),
99 [ratings](lev::Proxy *a, lev::Proxy *b) {
100 short da = ratings ? ratings->getDifficulty(a) : 0;
101 short db = ratings ? ratings->getDifficulty(b) : 0;
102 if (da != db)
103 return da < db;
104 std::string ta = a->getTitle();
105 std::string tb = b->getTitle();
106 if (ta != tb)
107 return ta < tb;
108 return a->getNormLevelPath() < b->getNormLevelPath();
109 });
110
111 for (auto *proxy : filtered)
112 lobby_index->appendProxy(proxy);
113
114 if (lobby_index->size() == 0)
115 selected_level_id.clear();
116
117 if (filtered.empty()) {
118 info_label->set_text(mp_menu::no_level_message(min_players, desired_players_count));
119 info_ttl = -1.0;
120 } else if (info_ttl < 0.0) {
121 info_label->set_text("");
122 info_ttl = 0.0;
123 }
124
125 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName());
126 if (!keep.empty())
127 set_level_by_id(keep);
128 levelwidget->syncFromIndexMgr();
129}

172void MultiplayerMenu::set_internet_mode(bool enabled) {
173 // Switching modes should never leave a join attempt running in the background,
174 // otherwise the lobby tick can keep polling a stale connect attempt.
175 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
176 lan_join_in_progress = false;
177 internet_join_in_progress = false;
178 if (!enabled && internet_in_room)
179 leave_current_internet_room();
180 internet_mode = enabled;
181 update_mode_button();
182 update_internet_layout();
183 if (internet_mode) {
184 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
185 return;
186 }
187
188 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
189 if (!cfg.enable_direct) {
190 info_label->set_text(_("Enable Direct Connect for LAN mode."));
191 info_ttl = -1.0;
192 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
193 return;
194 }
195
196 if (info_ttl < 0.0) {
197 info_label->set_text("");
198 info_ttl = 0.0;
199 }
200 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
201}

203void MultiplayerMenu::update_internet_layout() {
204 const std::string server_warning =
205 _("Set lobby and relay server IP in Options/Multiplayer.");
206 const std::string waiting_create = _("Create or join a room.");
207 const std::string waiting_connecting = _("Connecting...");
208 const std::string waiting_host = _("Waiting for host...");
209 int offscreen = -10000;
210 int x = internet_mode ? internet_form_x : offscreen;
211 int y = internet_mode ? internet_form_y : offscreen;
212 bool show_levels = internet_mode && internet_in_room && internet_is_host;
213 std::string waiting_text;
214 if (!internet_mode) {
215 room_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
216 room_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
217 players_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
218 players_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
219 internet_buttons->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen,
220 internet_buttons->get_w(),
221 internet_buttons->get_h()));
222 internet_leave_buttons->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen,
223 internet_leave_buttons->get_w(),
224 internet_leave_buttons->get_h()));
225 levelwidget->set_area(level_area);
226 waiting_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
227 info_label->set_area(info_area_default);
228 invalidate_all();
229 return;
230 }
231 if (show_levels) {
232 levelwidget->set_area(level_area);
233 waiting_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
234 info_label->set_area(info_area_default);
235 } else {
236 levelwidget->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen, level_area.w, level_area.h));
237 if (!internet_in_room)
238 waiting_text = waiting_create;
239 else if (internet_connecting)
240 waiting_text = waiting_connecting;
241 else
242 waiting_text = waiting_host;
243 waiting_label->set_text(waiting_text);
244 waiting_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
245 int info_w = (level_area.x + level_area.w) - info_area_default.x;
246 info_label->set_area(Rect(info_area_default.x, info_area_default.y,
247 info_w, info_area_default.h));
248 }
249 room_label->move(x, y);
250 room_field->move(x, y + room_label->get_h());
251 players_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
252 players_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
253 int compact_buttons_w = info_area_default.w;
254 int expanded_buttons_w = (level_area.x + level_area.w) - info_area_default.x;
255 int buttons_w = show_levels ? compact_buttons_w : expanded_buttons_w;
256 int buttons_h = internet_buttons->get_h();
257 int leave_w = show_levels ? compact_buttons_w : expanded_buttons_w;
258 int leave_h = internet_leave_buttons->get_h();
259 internet_buttons->set_area(Rect(internet_in_room ? offscreen : internet_buttons_x,
260 internet_in_room ? offscreen : internet_buttons_y,
261 buttons_w, buttons_h));
262 internet_leave_buttons->set_area(Rect(internet_in_room ? internet_buttons_x : offscreen,
263 internet_in_room ? internet_buttons_y : offscreen,
264 leave_w, leave_h));
265 bool lock_fields = internet_in_room;
266 room_field->set_locked(lock_fields);
267 std::string current_info = info_label->getText();
268 bool has_status_message = (current_info == waiting_create ||
269 current_info == waiting_connecting ||
270 current_info == waiting_host);
271 if (!internet_in_room) {
272 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
273 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
274 if (servers.lobby.empty()) {
275 info_label->set_text(server_warning);
276 info_ttl = -1.0;
277 } else if (current_info == server_warning) {
278 info_label->set_text("");
279 info_ttl = 0.0;
280 }
281 }
282 if (!show_levels && !waiting_text.empty()) {
283 current_info = info_label->getText();
284 bool has_persistent_info = (info_ttl < 0.0 && current_info != server_warning);
285 if (current_info != server_warning &&
286 !has_persistent_info && (info_ttl <= 0.0 || has_status_message ||
287 current_info.empty())) {
288 info_label->set_text(waiting_text);
289 if (info_ttl > 0.0)
290 info_ttl = 0.0;
291 }
292 } else if (show_levels) {
293 current_info = info_label->getText();
294 if (current_info == waiting_create ||
295 current_info == waiting_connecting ||
296 current_info == waiting_host) {
297 info_label->set_text("");
298 if (info_ttl <= 0.0)
299 info_ttl = 0.0;
300 }
301 }
302 create_room_button->set_text(N_("Create Room"));
303 invalidate_all();
304}

306unsigned MultiplayerMenu::desired_players() const {
307 if (!internet_mode)
308 return multiplayer::LobbySize() == 0 ? 1 : multiplayer::LobbySize();
309 if (internet_in_room && internet_player_count > 0)
310 return internet_player_count;
311 unsigned players = 0;
312 if (parse_players_field(players))
313 return players;
314 return 2;
315}

317bool MultiplayerMenu::parse_players_field(unsigned &players) const {
318 if (!players_field)
319 return false;
320 std::string text = players_field->getText();
321 if (text.empty())
322 return false;
323 char *end = nullptr;
324 long value = std::strtol(text.c_str(), &end, 10);
325 if (!end || *end != '\0')
326 return false;
327 if (value < 1)
328 value = 1;
329 if (value > static_cast<long>(input::kMaxPlayers))
330 value = input::kMaxPlayers;
331 players = static_cast<unsigned>(value);
332 return true;
333}
334
335void MultiplayerMenu::update_players() {
336 std::vector<multiplayer::LobbyPeer> peers;
337 if (internet_mode) {
338 peers = internet_room_peers;
339 if (peers.empty()) {
340 unsigned count = internet_player_count > 0 ? internet_player_count : 1;
341 multiplayer::LobbyPeer self;
342 self.name = multiplayer::LobbyLocalName();
343 self.is_self = true;
344 peers.push_back(self);
345 for (unsigned i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
346 multiplayer::LobbyPeer peer;
347 peer.name = ecl::strf(_("Player %u"), static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1));
348 peer.is_self = false;
349 peers.push_back(peer);
350 }
351 } else {
352 for (size_t i = 0; i < peers.size(); ++i) {
353 if (peers[i].name.empty()) {
354 if (peers[i].is_self)
355 peers[i].name = multiplayer::LobbyLocalName();
356 else
357 peers[i].name = ecl::strf(_("Player %u"), static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1));
358 }
359 }
360 }
361 } else {
362 peers = multiplayer::LobbyPeers();
363 if (peers.empty()) {
364 multiplayer::LobbyPeer self;
365 self.name = multiplayer::LobbyLocalName();
366 self.is_self = true;
367 peers.push_back(self);
368 }
369 std::sort(peers.begin(), peers.end(),
370 [](const multiplayer::LobbyPeer &a, const multiplayer::LobbyPeer &b) {
371 if (a.is_self != b.is_self)
372 return a.is_self;
373 return a.name < b.name;
374 });
375 }
376 for (size_t i = 0; i < player_labels.size(); ++i) {
377 if (i < peers.size()) {
378 std::string label = peers[i].name;
379 if (peers[i].is_self) {
380 label += " (you)";
381 }
382 player_labels[i]->set_text(label);
383 } else {
384 player_labels[i]->set_text("");
385 }
386 }
387}

389bool MultiplayerMenu::can_start() const {

391 return false;

395 return false;

397 return desired_players() >= required_players();
398 if (!multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig().enable_direct)
399 return false;
400 return multiplayer::LobbySize() >= required_players();

56void MultiplayerMenu::leave_current_internet_room() {
57 // Leaving should cancel any in-progress join attempt (it can keep retrying for a
58 // while via timeouts even though the UI is already back in the lobby).
59 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
60 internet_join_in_progress = false;
61 lan_join_in_progress = false;
62
63 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
64 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
65 std::string error;
66 std::string room = !internet_room_code.empty() ? internet_room_code : current_room_code();
67 if (!multiplayer::InternetLeaveRoom(mp_menu::resolved_lobby_server(server, servers),
68 room, error)) {
69 // Best-effort: even if the leave packet did not get an ACK, we still leave locally.
70 // The server will eventually expire stale rooms, and the user can re-join if needed.
71 if (!error.empty())
72 show_info(error);
73 }
74 clear_internet_room_state();
75 update_internet_layout();
76}

78void MultiplayerMenu::show_transport_info(int transport_kind) {
79 switch (static_cast<multiplayer::TransportKind>(transport_kind)) {
80 case multiplayer::TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
81 show_info(_("Using TCP relay (higher latency)."));
82 break;
83 case multiplayer::TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
84 show_info(_("Using UDP relay."));
85 break;
86 case multiplayer::TransportKind::DIRECT:
87 show_info(_("Using direct connection."));
88 break;
89 default:
90 break;

103void MultiplayerMenu::apply_start_selection(const multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
104 filter_min_players = start.filter_optimized;
105 update_filter_button();
106 selected_level_id = start.level_id;
107 if (!start.pack_name.empty()) {
108 selected_pack_name = start.pack_name;
109 // Ensure the pack index is active/known before rebuilding the filtered lobby index.
110 // This mirrors what the host did when selecting the pack via LevelPackMenu.
111 if (!lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(selected_pack_name)) {
112 // If pack selection fails (different installation, renamed pack), fall back to
113 // best-effort lookup by level id. This keeps LAN play usable even when the
114 // pack name differs across machines.
115 select_pack_for_level(start.level_id);
116 if (!selected_pack_name.empty())
117 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(selected_pack_name);
118 }
119 } else {
120 // Backward compat with older peers/servers: best-effort lookup by level id.
121 select_pack_for_level(start.level_id);
122 }
123 rebuild_index();
124}

131bool MultiplayerMenu::start_host_and_enter_game(const multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart &start,
132 bool broadcast_start) {
133 if (!multiplayer::StartHostSession(start)) {
134 show_info(_("Failed to start multiplayer session."));
135 return false;
136 }
137 if (broadcast_start) {
138 // Start listening before broadcasting the start message to avoid a race
139 // where clients attempt to connect before the host socket is bound.
140 multiplayer::LobbyBroadcastStart(start);
141 }
142 host_pending_start = start;
143 host_pending_expected = std::max<unsigned>(1, start.expected_players);
144 host_waiting_for_peers = (host_pending_expected > 1);
145 if (!host_waiting_for_peers) {
146 enter_game_from_lobby();
147 return true;
148 }
149 show_info(_("Waiting for other players to connect..."));
150 return true;
151}
152
153void MultiplayerMenu::tick_host_waiting_for_peers(double dtime) {
154 if (!host_waiting_for_peers)
155 return;
156
157 // Pump the multiplayer transport while still in the lobby UI. This allows
158 // clients to connect and reach READY (after switching packs / loading).
159 multiplayer::Tick(dtime);
160
161 // Wait until the session runtime reports that start should no longer be
162 // deferred. For hosts this means: all expected peers connected + READY.
163 if (multiplayer::ShouldDeferStart())
164 return;
165
166 host_waiting_for_peers = false;
167 // Ensure the host loads exactly the level that was announced in the lobby start
168 // message. The lobby UI can rebuild indices while waiting, which can change the
169 // current selection; enforce the pending start selection right before StartGame().
170 apply_start_selection(host_pending_start);
171 set_level_by_id(host_pending_start.level_id);
172 enter_game_from_lobby();
173}

175bool MultiplayerMenu::begin_client_join(const multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart &start,
176 const std::vector<std::string> &host_ips) {
177 if (!set_level_by_id(start.level_id)) {
178 show_info(_("Selected level not available."));
179 return false;
180 }
181 if (!multiplayer::BeginClientJoin(start, host_ips)) {
182 return false;
183 }
184 return true;
185}

187multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus MultiplayerMenu::poll_client_join_and_maybe_enter_game() {
188 multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus status = multiplayer::PollClientJoin();
189 if (status == multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED) {
190 show_transport_info(static_cast<int>(multiplayer::ActiveTransport()));
191 enter_game_from_lobby();
192 }
193 return status;

196void MultiplayerMenu::tick(double dtime) {

201 else

203
204 update_players();
205 refresh_selection();
206
207 if (info_ttl > 0.0) {
208 info_ttl -= dtime;
209 if (info_ttl <= 0.0)
210 info_label->set_text("");
211 }

214void MultiplayerMenu::tick_lan_mode(double dtime) {
215 multiplayer::LobbyTick(dtime);
216 unsigned lobby_size = multiplayer::LobbySize();
217 if (lobby_size != last_lobby_size) {
218 last_lobby_size = lobby_size;
219 rebuild_index();
220 refresh_selection();
221 invalidate_all();
222 }
223
224 if (lan_join_in_progress) {
225 multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus st = poll_client_join_and_maybe_enter_game();
226 if (st == multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED) {
227 show_info(_("Failed to join host. LAN play requires direct UDP connectivity."));
228 lan_last_join_failed = true;
229 lan_join_in_progress = false;
230 } else if (st == multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED) {
231 lan_join_in_progress = false;
232 }
233 }
234
235 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
236 std::vector<std::string> host_ips;
237 if (!multiplayer::LobbyPollStart(start, host_ips))
238 return;
239
240 if (start.session_id != lan_last_join_session_id) {
241 lan_last_join_session_id = start.session_id;
242 lan_last_join_failed = false;
243 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
244 lan_join_in_progress = false;
245 }
246 if (lan_last_join_failed)
247 return;
248
249 apply_start_selection(start);
250 lan_join_start = start;
251 lan_join_host_ip = host_ips.empty() ? std::string() : host_ips[0];
252 if (!begin_client_join(start, host_ips)) {
253 show_info(_("Failed to join host. LAN play requires direct UDP connectivity."));
254 lan_last_join_failed = true;
255 lan_join_in_progress = false;
256 } else {
257 lan_join_in_progress = true;
258 }
259 refresh_selection();
260}
261
262void MultiplayerMenu::tick_internet_mode(double dtime) {
263 if (internet_join_in_progress) {
264 multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus st = poll_client_join_and_maybe_enter_game();
265 if (st == multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED) {
266 show_info(_("Failed to join host."));
267 internet_last_join_failed = true;
268 internet_join_in_progress = false;
269 set_internet_connecting(false);
270 } else if (st == multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED) {
271 internet_join_in_progress = false;
272 set_internet_connecting(false);
273 }
274 }
275
276 if (!internet_in_room) {
277 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
278 internet_join_in_progress = false;
279 return;
280 }
281
282 internet_poll_timer += dtime;
283 if (internet_poll_timer < 0.2)
284 return;
285 internet_poll_timer = 0.0;
286
287 std::string server = mp_menu::multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
288 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
289 mp_menu::InternetServers servers = mp_menu::resolve_internet_servers(server);
290 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
291 std::string host_ip;
292 std::string error;
293 bool started = false;
294 unsigned player_count = 0;
295 std::vector<multiplayer::LobbyPeer> peers;
296 if (!multiplayer::InternetPollRoom(mp_menu::resolved_lobby_server(server, servers), room,
297 start, host_ip, started, player_count, peers, error)) {
298 if (!error.empty() && error != "waiting") {
299 if (error == "Room not found.") {
300 clear_internet_room_state();
301 update_internet_layout();
302 invalidate_all();
303 show_info(_("Room closed by host."));
304 } else {
305 show_info(error);
306 }
307 }
308 return;
309 }
310
311 bool peers_changed = false;
312 if (peers.size() != internet_room_peers.size()) {
313 peers_changed = true;
314 } else {
315 for (size_t i = 0; i < peers.size(); ++i) {
316 if (peers[i].id != internet_room_peers[i].id ||
317 peers[i].name != internet_room_peers[i].name ||
318 peers[i].is_self != internet_room_peers[i].is_self) {
319 peers_changed = true;
320 break;
321 }
322 }
323 }
324 if (peers_changed)
325 internet_room_peers = peers;
326 unsigned effective_count = player_count;
327 if (!internet_room_peers.empty())
328 effective_count = static_cast<unsigned>(internet_room_peers.size());
329 if (effective_count > 0 && effective_count != internet_player_count) {
330 internet_player_count = effective_count;
331 update_players();
332 invalidate_all();
333 } else if (peers_changed) {
334 update_players();
335 invalidate_all();
336 }
337 if (!started) {
338 internet_last_join_session_id = 0;
339 internet_last_join_failed = false;
340 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
341 internet_join_in_progress = false;
342 set_internet_connecting(false);
343 return;
344 }
345 if (internet_is_host)
346 return;
347
348 if (start.session_id != internet_last_join_session_id) {
349 internet_last_join_session_id = start.session_id;
350 internet_last_join_failed = false;
351 multiplayer::CancelClientJoin();
352 internet_join_in_progress = false;
353 set_internet_connecting(false);
354 }
355 if (internet_last_join_failed)
356 return;
357
358 apply_start_selection(start);
359 if (!internet_join_in_progress) {
360 set_internet_connecting(true);
361 internet_join_start = start;
362 internet_join_host_ip = host_ip;
363 std::vector<std::string> host_ips;
364 if (!host_ip.empty())
365 host_ips.push_back(host_ip);
366 if (!begin_client_join(start, host_ips)) {
367 show_info(_("Failed to join host."));
368 internet_last_join_failed = true;
369 internet_join_in_progress = false;
370 set_internet_connecting(false);
371 } else {
372 internet_join_in_progress = true;
373 }
374 }
375 refresh_selection();
376}

379} // namespace enigma

33std::string format_text(const std::string &message, int seconds_left) {

36 text += "\n";

44MultiplayerWaitMenu::MultiplayerWaitMenu()
45 : message_("Waiting for player...") {
46 const VMInfo *vminfo = video_engine->GetInfo();
47 const int vshrink = vminfo->width < 640 ? 1 : 0;
48 leave_button_ = new gui::StaticTextButton(N_("Leave"), this);
49 add(leave_button_,
50 Rect(vminfo->width - (vshrink ? 85 : 170),
51 vminfo->height - (vshrink ? 30 : 60),
52 vshrink ? 75 : 150, vshrink ? 42 : 40));
53 update_text_cache();
54}
55
56void MultiplayerWaitMenu::SetMessage(std::string message) {
57 message_ = std::move(message);
58 update_text_cache();
59}
60
61void MultiplayerWaitMenu::SetCountdownSeconds(int seconds) {
62 if (seconds < 0)
63 seconds = 0;
64 if (countdown_seconds_ == seconds)
65 return;
66 countdown_seconds_ = seconds;
67 update_text_cache();
68}
69
70bool MultiplayerWaitMenu::on_event(const SDL_Event &e) {
71 if (e.type == SDL_KEYDOWN && e.key.keysym.sym == SDLK_ESCAPE) {
72 // Swallow ESC: leaving this screen should be an explicit action.
73 return true;
74 }
75 return false;
76}
77
78void MultiplayerWaitMenu::on_action(gui::Widget *w) {
79 if (w == leave_button_) {
80 leave_requested_ = true;
81 Menu::quit();
82 }
83}
84
85void MultiplayerWaitMenu::update_text_cache() {
86 text_cache_ = format_text(message_, countdown_seconds_);
87 invalidate_all();
88}
89
90void MultiplayerWaitMenu::draw_background(ecl::GC &gc) {
91 blit(gc, 0, 0, enigma::GetImage("menu_bg", ".jpg"));
92 Font *f = enigma::GetFont("menufont");
93
94 std::vector<std::string> lines;
95 ecl::split_copy(text_cache_, '\n', back_inserter(lines));
96 int x = 60;
97 int y = 60;
98 int yskip = 25;
99 const VMInfo *vminfo = video_engine->GetInfo();
100 int width = vminfo->width - 120;
101 for (unsigned i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
102 std::vector<std::string> subLines = ecl::breakToLines(f, lines[i], " ", width);
103 for (auto it = subLines.begin(); it != subLines.end(); it++) {
104 f->render(gc, x, y, *it);
105 y += yskip;
106 }
107 }
108}

1527 void OptionsMenu::apply_mp_debug_preset(int preset_id)
1528 {
1529 // Keep this explicit: presets directly set MultiplayerDebug* values so
1530 // users can inspect/modify them in Debug/Debug2 afterwards.
1531 struct Preset {
1532 bool zerofill = false;
1533 bool rollback = false;
1534 bool remote_local_ball = false;
1535 int tick_ms = 10;
1536 int input_delay_legacy_ticks = 4;
1537 int predict_mouse_ticks = 0;
1538 int host_resync_stride = 50;
1539 int host_world_stride = 50;
1540 };
1541 Preset p;
1542 switch (preset_id) {
1543 case 1: // mediocre
1544 p.zerofill = true;
1545 p.rollback = true;
1546 p.remote_local_ball = false;
1547 p.tick_ms = 20;
1548 p.input_delay_legacy_ticks = 8;
1549 p.predict_mouse_ticks = 2;
1550 p.host_resync_stride = 25;
1551 p.host_world_stride = 25;
1552 break;
1553 case 2: // bad
1554 p.zerofill = true;
1555 p.rollback = true;
1556 p.remote_local_ball = true;
1557 p.tick_ms = 50;
1558 p.input_delay_legacy_ticks = 16;
1559 p.predict_mouse_ticks = 5;
1560 p.host_resync_stride = 10;
1561 p.host_world_stride = 10;
1562 break;
1563 default: // good
1564 p.zerofill = false;
1565 p.rollback = false;
1566 p.remote_local_ball = false;
1567 p.tick_ms = 10;
1568 p.input_delay_legacy_ticks = 4;
1569 p.predict_mouse_ticks = 0;
1570 p.host_resync_stride = 50;
1571 p.host_world_stride = 50;
1572 break;
1573 }
1574
1575 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugSmoothRender", true);
1576 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugZeroFillInputs", p.zerofill);
1577 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugRollbackEnabled", p.rollback);
1578 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall", p.remote_local_ball);
1579
1580 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugTickLengthMs", p.tick_ms);
1581 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugInputDelayTicks", p.input_delay_legacy_ticks);
1582 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugPredictMissingMouseTicks", p.predict_mouse_ticks);
1583 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastResyncStrideTicks", p.host_resync_stride);
1584 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastWorldStateStrideTicks", p.host_world_stride);
1585 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugRollbackKeepTicks", 200);
1586
1587 // Keep netsim off in presets (testers can enable it explicitly).
1588 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimEnabled", false);
1589 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimAll", false);
1590 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDelayMs", 0);
1591 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimJitterMs", 0);
1592 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDropPct", 0);
1593 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDupPct", 0);
1594
1595 // Conservative: ensure transport debug toggles don't surprise.
1596 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugForceRelay", false);
1597 app.prefs->setProperty("MultiplayerDebugBindLocal", false);
1598
1599 invalidate_all();
1600 }

20bool g_networked = false;

31bool env_bool_numeric(const char *name) {
32 const char *value = std::getenv(name);
33 if (!value || !*value)
34 return false;
35 char *end = nullptr;
36 long v = std::strtol(value, &end, 10);
37 if (end == value)
38 return false;
39 return v != 0;
40}
41
42unsigned env_uint(const char *name, unsigned minv, unsigned maxv) {
43 const char *value = std::getenv(name);
44 if (!value || !*value)
45 return 0;
46 char *end = nullptr;
47 unsigned long v = std::strtoul(value, &end, 10);
48 if (end == value)
49 return 0;
50 if (v < minv)
51 v = minv;
52 if (v > maxv)
53 v = maxv;
54 return static_cast<unsigned>(v);
55}

67void Reset() {
68 g_current_tick = 0;
69 g_queue.clear();
70 g_networked = false;
71 g_zerofill_missing_inputs = false;
72 g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks = 0;
73 g_expected_players = 1;
74 g_tick_timestep = 0.01;
75 for (auto &pending : g_local_pending)
76 pending = PlayerInput();
77 for (auto &entry : g_last_consumed)
78 entry = PlayerInput();
79 g_missing_streak.fill(0);
80}
81
82void SetNetworked(bool enabled) {
83 g_networked = enabled;
84 bool zerofill = false;
85 if (const char *env = std::getenv("ENIGMA_MP_ZEROFILL_INPUTS")) {
86 (void)env;
87 zerofill = env_bool_numeric("ENIGMA_MP_ZEROFILL_INPUTS");
88 } else {
89 zerofill = options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugZeroFillInputs");
90 }
91 g_zerofill_missing_inputs = enabled && zerofill;
92 // When the lockstep does not stall on missing inputs, allow predicting missing
93 // mouse-force inputs by holding the last consumed value for a few ticks.
94 // This reduces visible stutter for a player on a lossy connection, without
95 // repeating discrete actions like rotate/activate.
96 g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks =
97 (enabled && g_zerofill_missing_inputs)
98 ? (std::getenv("ENIGMA_MP_PREDICT_MISSING_MOUSE_TICKS")
99 ? env_uint("ENIGMA_MP_PREDICT_MISSING_MOUSE_TICKS", 0, 20)
100 : static_cast<unsigned>(options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugPredictMissingMouseTicks")))
101 : 0;
102}
103
104bool IsNetworked() {
105 return g_networked;
106}
107
108bool ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled() {
109 return g_networked && g_zerofill_missing_inputs;
110}

112double TickTimestep() {
113 return g_tick_timestep;
114}

116void SetTickTimestep(double seconds) {
117 // Keep within a sane range; the engine expects a small fixed timestep.
118 if (seconds < 0.005)
119 seconds = 0.005;
120 if (seconds > 0.050)
121 seconds = 0.050;
122 g_tick_timestep = seconds;
123}
124
125void SetExpectedPlayers(unsigned count) {
126 g_expected_players = count;
127}
128
129unsigned ExpectedPlayers() {
130 return g_expected_players;
131}
132
133uint32_t CurrentTick() {
134 return g_current_tick;
135}
136
137void SubmitMouseForce(unsigned player, const ecl::V2 &force) {
138 if (!valid_player(player))
139 return;
140 g_local_pending[player].mouse_force += force;
141}
142
143void SubmitRotateInventory(unsigned player, int dir) {
144 if (!valid_player(player))
145 return;
146 g_local_pending[player].rotate_steps += dir;
147}
148
149void SubmitActivateItem(unsigned player) {
150 if (!valid_player(player))
151 return;
152 g_local_pending[player].activate_count += 1;
153}
154
155PlayerInput DrainLocalPending(unsigned player) {
156 if (!valid_player(player))
157 return empty_input();
158 PlayerInput pending = g_local_pending[player];
159 g_local_pending[player] = PlayerInput();
160 return pending;
161}
162
163void EnqueueInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player, const PlayerInput &input) {
164 if (!valid_player(player))
165 return;
166 TickInputs &slot = g_queue[tick];
167 // In multiplayer each (tick, player) should be treated as a single input
168 // sample. When transport redundancy is used (re-sending a few ticks),
169 // duplicates must not accumulate.
170 slot.inputs[player] = input;
171 slot.present.set(player);
172}
173
174bool HasInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player) {
175 if (!valid_player(player))
176 return false;
177 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
178 if (it == g_queue.end())
179 return false;
180 return it->second.present.test(player);
181}
182
183bool PeekInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player, PlayerInput &out) {
184 if (!valid_player(player))
185 return false;
186 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
187 if (it == g_queue.end())
188 return false;
189 if (!it->second.present.test(player))
190 return false;
191 out = it->second.inputs[player];
192 return true;
193}
194
195bool CanAdvanceTick() {
196 if (!g_networked)
197 return true;
198 if (g_expected_players == 0)
199 return false;
200 if (g_zerofill_missing_inputs)
201 return true;
202 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_expected_players; ++player) {
203 if (!HasInput(g_current_tick, player))
204 return false;
205 }
206 return true;
207}
208
209PlayerInput ConsumeInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player) {
210 if (!valid_player(player))
211 return empty_input();
212 if (!g_networked)
213 return DrainLocalPending(player);
214 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
215 if (it == g_queue.end() || !it->second.present.test(player)) {
216 if (!g_zerofill_missing_inputs)
217 return empty_input();
218 PlayerInput predicted;
219 // Only predict continuous mouse force, never repeat discrete actions.
220 predicted.rotate_steps = 0;
221 predicted.activate_count = 0;
222 if (g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks == 0) {
223 predicted.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0, 0);
224 } else {
225 unsigned streak = g_missing_streak[player] + 1;
226 g_missing_streak[player] = streak;
227 float factor = 0.0f;
228 if (streak <= g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks) {
229 // Linear decay to zero over N missing ticks.
230 factor = static_cast<float>(g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks - (streak - 1)) /
231 static_cast<float>(g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks);
232 }
233 predicted.mouse_force = g_last_consumed[player].mouse_force * factor;
234 }
235 return predicted;
236 }
237 PlayerInput input = it->second.inputs[player];
238 it->second.inputs[player] = PlayerInput();
239 it->second.present.reset(player);
240 if (it->second.present.none())
241 g_queue.erase(it);
242 g_last_consumed[player] = input;
243 g_missing_streak[player] = 0;
244 return input;
245}
246
247void AdvanceTick() {
248 ++g_current_tick;
249}
250
251bool GetLastConsumed(unsigned player, PlayerInput &out) {
252 if (!valid_player(player))
253 return false;
254 out = g_last_consumed[player];
255 return true;
256}
257
258Snapshot CaptureSnapshot() {
259 Snapshot snap;
260 snap.networked = g_networked;
261 snap.zerofill_missing_inputs = g_zerofill_missing_inputs;
262 snap.predict_missing_mouse_ticks = g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks;
263 snap.expected_players = g_expected_players;
264 snap.current_tick = g_current_tick;
265 snap.local_pending = g_local_pending;
266 snap.last_consumed = g_last_consumed;
267 snap.missing_streak = g_missing_streak;
268 snap.queue.clear();
269 snap.queue.reserve(g_queue.size());
270 for (const auto &kv : g_queue) {
271 TickInputsSnapshot e;
272 e.tick = kv.first;
273 e.inputs = kv.second.inputs;
274 e.present = kv.second.present;
275 snap.queue.push_back(e);
276 }
277 return snap;
278}
279
280void RestoreSnapshot(const Snapshot &snap) {
281 // `local_pending` is fed by real-time SDL events (mouse/keys) and is not part of
282 // deterministic per-tick simulation state. When rollback restores an old snapshot,
283 // overwriting `local_pending` would effectively "eat" recent user input on that
284 // machine (especially the host), making marbles appear unresponsive.
285 const auto live_local_pending = g_local_pending;
286 g_networked = snap.networked;
287 g_zerofill_missing_inputs = snap.zerofill_missing_inputs;
288 g_predict_missing_mouse_ticks = snap.predict_missing_mouse_ticks;
289 g_expected_players = snap.expected_players;
290 g_current_tick = snap.current_tick;
291 g_local_pending = live_local_pending;
292 g_last_consumed = snap.last_consumed;
293 g_missing_streak = snap.missing_streak;
294 g_queue.clear();
295 for (const auto &e : snap.queue) {
296 TickInputs &slot = g_queue[e.tick];
297 slot.inputs = e.inputs;
298 slot.present = e.present;
299 }
300}
301
302} // namespace input
303} // namespace enigma

A src/multiplayer_ball_assignment.hh

Description
  • Helpers for mapping steerable actors (balls/marbles) to session players.
  • Encapsulates deterministic distribution: add extra balls when players > balls, redistribute balls when balls > players (meditation levels).
Where it is used
  • Used by `src/multiplayer_extra_players.cc` to compute owner/controller assignments consistently across peers.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New multiplayer logic enabling non-optimized maps to be playable by larger groups.
  • Introduces deterministic round-robin assignment so all instances derive the same per-player ball ownership.

22/* -------------------- Multiplayer ball assignment -------------------- */
23/*
24 * Helpers for deterministic ball-to-player assignment.
25 *
26 * Used by the "more balls than players" path (meditation-like levels) to split
27 * authored actors across controllers while keeping the level's rubberbands and
28 * other connections intact.
29 */
30
31#include <cstddef>
32#include <vector>
33
34namespace enigma {
35namespace multiplayer {
36namespace internal {
37
38// Returns a per-ball assignment to players, distributing balls as evenly as
39// possible in a deterministic round-robin order.
40//
41// The caller decides whether redistribution is appropriate (e.g. only when the
42// authored level provides enough balls for all players in a color-group).
43inline std::vector<unsigned> distribute_balls_round_robin(size_t ball_count,
44 const std::vector<unsigned> &players) {
45 std::vector<unsigned> out;
46 out.reserve(ball_count);
47 if (players.empty()) {
48 for (size_t i = 0; i < ball_count; ++i)
49 out.push_back(0);
50 return out;
51 }
52 for (size_t i = 0; i < ball_count; ++i)
53 out.push_back(players[i % players.size()]);
54 return out;
55}
56
57} // namespace internal
58} // namespace multiplayer
59} // namespace enigma
60
61#endif // MULTIPLAYER_BALL_ASSIGNMENT_HH_INCLUDED

25/* -------------------- Multiplayer config -------------------- */
26/*
27 * Centralized load/validation for multiplayer configuration.
28 *
29 * This is shared between UI and runtime to keep behavior consistent across
30 * LAN and Internet play, and to make env overrides (debug helpers) explicit.
31 */
32
33namespace enigma {
34namespace multiplayer {
35
36namespace {
37
38bool force_relay_enabled() {
39 const char *env = std::getenv("ENIGMA_MP_FORCE_RELAY");
40 if (env && *env)
41 return true;
42 return options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugForceRelay");
43}
44
45std::uint16_t clamp_port(int value, std::uint16_t fallback) {
46 if (value > 0 && value <= 65535)
47 return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
48 return fallback;
49}
50
51std::string sanitize_host_only(const std::string &raw) {
52 std::string host = raw;
53 if (host.empty())
54 host = "CHANGEME";
55 // Backwards-compat: if the saved config still contains host:port, strip the port.
56 std::string::size_type port_sep = host.rfind(':');
57 if (port_sep != std::string::npos)
58 host = host.substr(0, port_sep);
59 if (host == "localhost" || host == "::1")
60 host = "127.0.0.1";
61 if (host.empty())
62 host = "CHANGEME";
63 return host;
64}
65
66} // namespace
67
68MultiplayerConfig LoadMultiplayerConfig() {
69 MultiplayerConfig cfg;
70 cfg.server_host = sanitize_host_only(options::GetString("MultiplayerLobbyServer"));
71 cfg.lobby_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetLobbyPort"), 12347);
72 cfg.udp_relay_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetUdpRelayPort"), 12348);
73 cfg.tcp_relay_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetTcpRelayPort"), 12349);
74 cfg.enable_direct = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableDirect");
75 cfg.enable_udp_relay = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableUdpRelay");
76 cfg.enable_tcp_relay = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableTcpRelay");
77 cfg.force_relay = force_relay_enabled();
78 return cfg;
79}
80
81InternetServers ResolveInternetServers(const MultiplayerConfig &cfg) {
82 InternetServers out;
83 if (cfg.server_host.empty() || cfg.server_host == "CHANGEME")
84 return out;
85 out.lobby = cfg.server_host + ":" + std::to_string(cfg.lobby_port);
86 out.udp_relay = cfg.server_host + ":" + std::to_string(cfg.udp_relay_port);
87 out.tcp_relay = cfg.server_host + ":" + std::to_string(cfg.tcp_relay_port);
88 return out;
89}

88void debug_log(const char *fmt, ...) {
89 if (!debug_enabled())
90 return;
91
92#ifdef WIN32
93 // GUI-subsystem binaries often have no attached console, so stderr can be
94 // discarded. When ENIGMA_MP_DEBUG is enabled, also write to a temp log file
95 // so Windows builds remain debuggable.
96 static FILE *log_file = nullptr;
97 static bool log_file_init = false;
98 if (!log_file_init) {
99 log_file_init = true;
100 const char *tmp = std::getenv("TEMP");
101 if (!tmp || !*tmp)
102 tmp = std::getenv("TMP");
103 if (!tmp || !*tmp)
104 tmp = ".";
105 char path[1024] = {0};
106 std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/enigma-mp-%d.log", tmp, _getpid());
107 log_file = std::fopen(path, "a");
108 }
109#endif
110
111 // Prefix every log line with stable session context so host/client logs
112 // can be correlated even when per-level tick counters reset.
113 static uint64_t seq = 0;
114 seq += 1;
115 const unsigned sid = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.session_id);
116 const unsigned rid = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.restart_id);
117 const unsigned epoch = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.input_epoch);
118 const unsigned lp = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.local_player);
119 const int is_host = g_session.host ? 1 : 0;
120 const char *via = transport_kind_name(g_session.active_transport);
121
122 va_list args;
123 va_start(args, fmt);
124 std::fprintf(stderr, "mp[%llu sid=%u rid=%u epoch=%u host=%d p=%u via=%s] ",
125 static_cast<unsigned long long>(seq), sid, rid, epoch, is_host, lp, via);
126 std::vfprintf(stderr, fmt, args);
127 std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");
128 std::fflush(stderr);
129
130#ifdef WIN32
131 if (log_file) {
132 va_list args2;
133 va_copy(args2, args);
134 std::fprintf(log_file, "mp[%llu sid=%u rid=%u epoch=%u host=%d p=%u via=%s] ",
135 static_cast<unsigned long long>(seq), sid, rid, epoch, is_host, lp, via);
136 std::vfprintf(log_file, fmt, args2);
137 std::fprintf(log_file, "\n");
138 std::fflush(log_file);
139 va_end(args2);
140 }
141#endif
142
143 va_end(args);
144}

146std::string address_to_ip_string(const ENetAddress &addr) {
147 // Always prefer a numeric IPv4 address here. LAN multiplayer uses this
148 // address for direct connects; reverse DNS / hostnames can fail to resolve
149 // (notably on Windows).
150 in_addr ia;
151 ia.s_addr = addr.host; // ENet stores host in network byte order.
152#ifdef WIN32
153 const char *s = inet_ntoa(ia);
154 return s ? std::string(s) : std::string();
155#else
156 char buf[INET_ADDRSTRLEN] = {0};
157 if (!inet_ntop(AF_INET, &ia, buf, sizeof(buf)))
158 return std::string();
159 return std::string(buf);
160#endif
161}

32/* -------------------- Multiplayer ENet socket -------------------- */
33/*
34 * ENet API compatibility wrappers.
35 *
36 * System ENet and vendored ENet differ in some low-level APIs across versions.
37 * Multiplayer uses these wrappers to compile and behave consistently.
38 */
39
40namespace enigma {
41namespace multiplayer {
42namespace internal {
43
44ENetSocket enet_socket_create_compat(ENetSocketType type) {
45#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
46 return enet_socket_create(type);
47#else
48 return enet_socket_create(type, nullptr);
49#endif
50}
51
52void tune_enet_socket(ENetSocket socket, bool broadcast) {
53 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
54 return;
55
56 int opt = 1;
57#ifdef WIN32
58 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
59 if (broadcast)
60 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
61 u_long mode = 1;
62 ioctlsocket(socket, FIONBIO, &mode);
63#else
64 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
65 if (broadcast)
66 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &opt, sizeof(opt));
67
68 // Force non-blocking behavior across ENet variants. We never want UI/game
69 // loops to block on a recvfrom()/sendto().
70 int flags = fcntl(socket, F_GETFL, 0);
71 if (flags != -1)
72 (void)fcntl(socket, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
73#endif
74
75 // Increase buffers a bit to reduce packet loss under load.
76 int buf_sz = 1 << 20; // 1 MiB
77#ifdef WIN32
78 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&buf_sz), sizeof(buf_sz));
79 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&buf_sz), sizeof(buf_sz));
80#else
81 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &buf_sz, sizeof(buf_sz));
82 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &buf_sz, sizeof(buf_sz));
83#endif
84}
85
86bool bind_lobby_socket(ENetSocket socket, Uint16 port) {
87 int opt = 1;
88#ifdef WIN32
89 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
90#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
91 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
92#endif
93 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
94 u_long mode = 1;
95 ioctlsocket(socket, FIONBIO, &mode);
96#else
97 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
98#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
99 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, &opt, sizeof(opt));
100#endif
101 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &opt, sizeof(opt));
102
103 // Make the lobby socket non-blocking. Some ENet builds do not set this by
104 // default, and a blocking recvfrom() would stall the UI loop.
105 int flags = fcntl(socket, F_GETFL, 0);
106 if (flags != -1) {
107 (void)fcntl(socket, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
108 }
109#endif
110
111 sockaddr_in sin;
112 ::memset(&sin, 0, sizeof(sin));
113 sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
114 sin.sin_port = ENET_HOST_TO_NET_16(port);
115 sin.sin_addr.s_addr = ENET_HOST_ANY;
116 bool ok = bind(socket, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&sin), sizeof(sin)) == 0;
117 if (ok) {
118 // Make sure socket behaves consistently across ENet builds.
119 tune_enet_socket(socket, true);
120 }
121 return ok;
122}
123
124} // namespace internal
125} // namespace multiplayer
126} // namespace enigma

38/* -------------------- Multiplayer extra players -------------------- */
39/*
40 * Extra-player support for "non-optimized" levels.
41 *
42 * When a level was authored for N players but the lobby has M > N players, the
43 * session either spawns additional actors (M > N) or redistributes authored
44 * steerable actors (N > M) depending on the level's ball layout.

51unsigned compute_level_players() {

54 if (!proxy)
55 return players;
56 try {
57 proxy->loadMetadata(true);
58 } catch (XLevelLoading &) {
59 return players;
60 }
61 if (proxy->hasNetworkMode())
62 return proxy->getNetworkPlayers();
63 if (proxy->hasSingleMode())
64 return 1;
65 return players;

76bool controller_single_bit_index(int controllers, unsigned &out_index) {
77 if (controllers <= 0)
78 return false;
79 unsigned mask = static_cast<unsigned>(controllers);
80 if ((mask & (mask - 1)) != 0)
81 return false;
82 unsigned idx = 0;
83 while ((mask & 1u) == 0u) {
84 mask >>= 1u;
85 idx += 1u;
86 }
87 out_index = idx;
88 return true;
89}

110bool is_passable_for_sight(const GridPos &pos) {
111 if (!IsInsideLevel(pos))
112 return false;
113 Floor *floor = GetFloor(pos);
114 if (!floor)
115 return false;
116 const std::string kind = floor->getKind();
117 if (kind == "fl_abyss" || kind == "fl_water" || kind == "fl_space" ||
118 kind == "fl_space_force") {
119 return false;
120 }
121 if (GetStone(pos) != nullptr)
122 return false;
123 if (GetItem(pos) != nullptr)
124 return false;
125 return true;

128bool is_free_floor(const GridPos &pos) {

135 if (kind == "fl_abyss" || kind == "fl_water" || kind == "fl_space" ||
136 kind == "fl_space_force") {
137 return false;
138 }
139 if (GetStone(pos) != nullptr)
140 return false;
141 if (GetItem(pos) != nullptr)
142 return false;
143 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
144 GetActorsInsideField(pos, actors);
145 if (!actors.empty())

162bool has_clear_sight(const GridPos &from, const GridPos &to) {
163 int x0 = from.x;
164 int y0 = from.y;
165 int x1 = to.x;
166 int y1 = to.y;
167 int dx = std::abs(x1 - x0);
168 int dy = std::abs(y1 - y0);
169 int sx = (x0 < x1) ? 1 : -1;
170 int sy = (y0 < y1) ? 1 : -1;
171 int err = dx - dy;
172
173 int x = x0;
174 int y = y0;
175 while (true) {
176 if (!(x == x0 && y == y0) && !(x == x1 && y == y1)) {
177 if (!is_passable_for_sight(GridPos(x, y)))
178 return false;
179 }
180 if (x == x1 && y == y1)
181 break;
182 int e2 = 2 * err;
183 if (e2 > -dy) {
184 err -= dy;
185 x += sx;
186 }
187 if (e2 < dx) {
188 err += dx;
189 y += sy;
190 }
191 }
192 return true;
193}
194
195bool find_clear_floor_near_base(const GridPos &base_pos, GridPos &out_pos) {
196 int tiles_x = 0;
197 int tiles_y = 0;
198 int origin_x = 0;
199 int origin_y = 0;
200 if (!screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y))
201 return false;
202 int best_dist = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();
203 bool found = false;
204 for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
205 for (int y = origin_y; y < origin_y + tiles_y; ++y) {
206 for (int x = origin_x; x < origin_x + tiles_x; ++x) {
207 GridPos pos(x, y);
208 if (pass == 0) {
209 if (!is_safe_floor(pos))
210 continue;
211 } else {
212 if (!is_free_floor(pos))
213 continue;
214 }
215 if (!has_clear_sight(base_pos, pos))
216 continue;
217 int dx = x - base_pos.x;
218 int dy = y - base_pos.y;
219 int dist = dx * dx + dy * dy;
220 if (dist < best_dist) {
221 best_dist = dist;
222 out_pos = pos;
223 found = true;
224 }
225 }
226 }
227 if (found)
228 return true;
229 }
230 return false;
231}
232
233bool find_random_free_tile(const GridPos &base_pos, GridPos &out_pos) {
234 int tiles_x = 0;
235 int tiles_y = 0;
236 int origin_x = 0;
237 int origin_y = 0;
238 std::vector<GridPos> free_tiles;
239 if (screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y)) {
240 for (int y = origin_y; y < origin_y + tiles_y; ++y) {
241 for (int x = origin_x; x < origin_x + tiles_x; ++x) {
242 GridPos pos(x, y);
243 if (is_free_floor(pos))
244 free_tiles.push_back(pos);
245 }
246 }
247 if (!free_tiles.empty()) {
248 int idx = enigma::IntegerRand(0, static_cast<int>(free_tiles.size() - 1), true);
249 out_pos = free_tiles[static_cast<size_t>(idx)];
250 return true;
251 }
252 }
253 free_tiles.clear();
254 int width = Width();
255 int height = Height();
256 for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
257 for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
258 GridPos pos(x, y);
259 if (is_free_floor(pos))
260 free_tiles.push_back(pos);
261 }
262 }
263 if (free_tiles.empty())
264 return false;
265 int idx = enigma::IntegerRand(0, static_cast<int>(free_tiles.size() - 1), true);
266 out_pos = free_tiles[static_cast<size_t>(idx)];
267 return true;
268}

270template <class Sender>
271void for_each_existing_placement(Sender send) {
272 if (!g_session.host)
273 return;
274 if (g_session.expected_players <= g_session.level_players || g_session.level_players == 0)
275 return;
276 if (g_session.placement_received.size() < g_session.expected_players)
277 return;
278 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
279 // Only players that actually required placement during this level should get
280 // placement packets. Players that don't require placement are marked
281 // placement_received=true so the host can start immediately, but that does
282 // not mean we have a meaningful placement to broadcast.
283 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
284 continue;
285 if (!g_session.placement_received[player])
286 continue;
287 Actor *actor = player::GetMainActor(player);
288 if (!actor)
289 continue;
290 GridPos pos = actor->get_gridpos();
291 protocol::PlacementPacket msg;
292 msg.restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
293 msg.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player);
294 msg.x = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.x);
295 msg.y = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.y);
296 send(msg);
297 }
298}

300void send_placement_to_peer(ENetPeer *peer, const protocol::PlacementPacket &msg) {
301 if (!peer)
302 return;
303 ecl::Buffer buf;
304 protocol::encode_place(buf, msg);
305 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
306 enet_peer_send(peer, 0, packet);
307}

311bool is_valid_placement(const GridPos &pos, unsigned player) {
312 if (!is_free_floor(pos))
313 return false;
314 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
315 return true;
316 unsigned base_player = player % g_session.level_players;
317 Actor *base_actor = player::GetMainActor(base_player);
318 if (!base_actor)
319 return true;
320 int tiles_x = 0;
321 int tiles_y = 0;
322 int origin_x = 0;
323 int origin_y = 0;
324 GridPos base_pos(base_actor->get_startpos());
325 if (!screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y))
326 return true;
327 if (pos.x < origin_x || pos.x >= origin_x + tiles_x)
328 return false;
329 if (pos.y < origin_y || pos.y >= origin_y + tiles_y)
330 return false;
331 return true;
332}
