375void send_placement_to_host(const GridPos &pos) {
376 if (!g_session.active)
377 return;
378 protocol::PlacementPacket msg;
379 msg.restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
380 msg.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
381 msg.x = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.x);
382 msg.y = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.y);
383 if (g_session.host) {
384 if (placement_required_for_player(msg.player) && is_valid_placement(pos, msg.player)) {
385 apply_placement(msg.player, pos);
386 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > msg.player)
387 g_session.placement_received[msg.player] = true;
388 broadcast_placement(msg);
389 }
390 return;
391 }
392 ecl::Buffer buf;
393 protocol::encode_place(buf, msg);
394 g_transport.ClientSend(buf);
395}
396
397void auto_place_extra_players() {
398 if (!g_session.host)
399 return;
400 if (g_session.level_players == 0)
401 return;
402 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
403 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
404 continue;
405 unsigned base_index = player % g_session.level_players;
406 Actor *base_actor = player::GetMainActor(base_index);
407 if (!base_actor)
408 continue;
409 GridPos base_pos(base_actor->get_startpos());
410 GridPos pos;
411 bool found = find_clear_floor_near_base(base_pos, pos);
412 if (!found)
413 found = find_random_free_tile(base_pos, pos);
414 if (!found)
415 continue;
416 protocol::PlacementPacket msg;
417 msg.restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
418 msg.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player);
419 msg.x = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.x);
420 msg.y = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.y);
421 apply_placement(player, pos);
422 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > player)
423 g_session.placement_received[player] = true;
424 broadcast_placement(msg);
425 }
426}
427
428void add_extra_actors(unsigned level_players, unsigned expected_players) {
429 g_session.needs_placement.clear();
430 if (expected_players > 0)
431 g_session.needs_placement.assign(expected_players, false);
432 if (level_players == 0 || expected_players <= level_players)
433 return;
434 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
435 GetActors(actors);
436 if (debug_enabled())
437 debug_log("mp extra actors: level_players=%u expected=%u actors=%zu", level_players,
438 expected_players, actors.size());
439
440 rebalance_authored_multi_ball_levels(level_players, expected_players);
441
442 // Track which session players already control a steerable actor after
443 // redistribution, to avoid spawning unnecessary duplicates.
444 std::vector<bool> has_actor(expected_players, false);
445 for (auto *actor : actors) {
446 if (!actor || !actor->isSteerable())
447 continue;
448 int controllers = actor->get_controllers();
449 unsigned owner = 0;
450 if (!controller_single_bit_index(controllers, owner))
451 continue;
452 if (owner >= expected_players)
453 continue;
454 has_actor[owner] = true;
455 }
456
457 std::vector<Actor *> base(level_players, nullptr);
458 std::vector<Actor *> fallback(level_players, nullptr);
459 Actor *any_actor = nullptr;
460
461 for (auto *actor : actors) {
462 if (!any_actor && actor->isSteerable())
463 any_actor = actor;
464 unsigned owner = 0;
465 bool has_owner = false;
466 if (Value owner_val = actor->getAttr("owner")) {
467 int owner_int = owner_val;
468 if (owner_int >= 0 && owner_int < static_cast<int>(level_players)) {
469 owner = static_cast<unsigned>(owner_int);
470 has_owner = true;
471 }
472 }
473 if (!has_owner) {
474 unsigned ctrl_owner = 0;
475 if (controller_single_bit_index(actor->get_controllers(), ctrl_owner) &&
476 ctrl_owner < level_players) {
477 owner = ctrl_owner;
478 has_owner = true;
479 }
480 }
481 if (!has_owner)
482 continue;
483 if (!fallback[owner])
484 fallback[owner] = actor;
485 if (!base[owner]) {
486 int controllers = actor->get_controllers();
487 if ((controllers & (1 << owner)) != 0 && actor->isSteerable())
488 base[owner] = actor;
489 }
490 }
491
492 for (unsigned i = 0; i < level_players; ++i) {
493 if (!base[i])
494 base[i] = fallback[i];
495 }
496
497 if (!any_actor) {
498 for (auto *candidate : base) {
499 if (candidate) {
500 any_actor = candidate;
501 break;
502 }
503 }
504 }
505
506 for (unsigned player = level_players; player < expected_players; ++player) {
507 if (player < has_actor.size() && has_actor[player])
508 continue;
509 unsigned base_index = (level_players > 0) ? (player % level_players) : 0;
510 Actor *base_actor = base_index < base.size() ? base[base_index] : nullptr;
511 if (!base_actor)
512 base_actor = any_actor;
513 if (!base_actor)
514 continue;
515 Actor *extra = MakeActor(base_actor->getKind().c_str());
516 if (!extra)
517 continue;
518 extra->setAttr("owner", Value(static_cast<int>(player)));
519 extra->setAttr("controllers", Value(static_cast<int>(1 << player)));
520 extra->setAttr("essential", Value(0));
521 Value color = base_actor->getAttr("color");
522 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
523 extra->setAttr("color", color);
524 ecl::V2 pos = base_actor->get_pos();
525 AddActor(pos[0], pos[1], extra);
526 if (player < g_session.needs_placement.size())
527 g_session.needs_placement[player] = true;
528 }
529
530 if (debug_enabled()) {
531 unsigned have = 0;
532 for (bool v : has_actor)
533 if (v)
534 have += 1;
535 unsigned need_place = 0;
536 for (bool v : g_session.needs_placement)
537 if (v)
538 need_place += 1;
539 debug_log("mp extra actors: assigned=%u spawned=%u needs_placement=%u", have,
540 (expected_players > have) ? (expected_players - have) : 0, need_place);
541 }
542}
543
544void rebalance_authored_multi_ball_levels(unsigned level_players, unsigned expected_players) {
545 if (level_players == 0 || expected_players <= level_players)
546 return;
547 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
548 GetActors(actors);
549
550 // Redistribution pass: some authored levels (e.g. meditation) give one player
551 // multiple steerable actors. If there are enough such actors, distribute them
552 // evenly across all session players that share the same color group
553 // (player % level_players), instead of spawning new duplicates.
554 std::vector<std::vector<Actor *>> candidates(level_players);
555 for (auto *actor : actors) {
556 if (!actor || !actor->isSteerable())
557 continue;
558
559 // For singleplayer-authored levels, treat all steerable, player-controlled
560 // actors as belonging to the single base group. Some compatibility modes
561 // and conversions (notably Per.Oxyd meditation pearls) may leave "owner"
562 // unset or set to a non-zero value, but the level intent is still
563 // "controlled by the (single) current player".
564 if (level_players == 1) {
565 if (actor->get_controllers() == 0) {
566 Value owner_val = actor->getAttr("owner");
567 Value color_val = actor->getAttr("color");
568 if (!owner_val && !color_val)
569 continue;
570 }
571 candidates[0].push_back(actor);
572 continue;
573 }
574
575 bool found_base = false;
576 unsigned base = 0;
577
578 // Prefer the authored owner if present. This covers many singleplayer
579 // multi-ball levels where the engine default sets controllers=CTRL_YINYANG
580 // (e.g. pearls), but the level intent is still "owned by player 0".
581 if (Value owner_val = actor->getAttr("owner")) {
582 int owner_int = owner_val;
583 if (owner_int >= 0 && owner_int < static_cast<int>(level_players)) {
584 base = static_cast<unsigned>(owner_int);
585 found_base = true;
586 }
587 }
588
589 // Fallback: single-controller actors that don't declare an owner.
590 if (!found_base) {
591 unsigned ctrl_base = 0;
592 if (controller_single_bit_index(actor->get_controllers(), ctrl_base) &&
593 ctrl_base < level_players) {
594 base = ctrl_base;
595 found_base = true;
596 }
597 }
598
599 // Legacy singleplayer actors sometimes leave owner unset but still default to
600 // controllers=CTRL_YINYANG (e.g. pearls created via old API mappings). In
601 // singleplayer metadata those are still effectively "owned by player 0".
602 if (!found_base && level_players == 1) {
603 if ((actor->get_controllers() & 1) != 0) {
604 base = 0;
605 found_base = true;
606 }
607 }
608
609 if (!found_base)
610 continue;
611 candidates[base].push_back(actor);
612 }
613
614 for (unsigned base = 0; base < level_players; ++base) {
615 // Ensure redistribution is deterministic across platforms/builds.
616 // Actor insertion order can differ subtly depending on loader/compat paths,
617 // so sort by a stable key before assigning controllers.
618 std::sort(candidates[base].begin(), candidates[base].end(),
619 [](const Actor *a, const Actor *b) {
620 if (a == b)
621 return false;
622 const ecl::V2 &pa = a->get_pos();
623 const ecl::V2 &pb = b->get_pos();
624 auto qa0 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(pa[0] * 1000.0));
625 auto qa1 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(pa[1] * 1000.0));
626 auto qb0 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(pb[0] * 1000.0));
627 auto qb1 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(pb[1] * 1000.0));
628 if (qa1 != qb1)
629 return qa1 < qb1;
630 if (qa0 != qb0)
631 return qa0 < qb0;
632 const ecl::V2 &va = a->get_vel();
633 const ecl::V2 &vb = b->get_vel();
634 auto qva0 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(va[0] * 1000.0));
635 auto qva1 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(va[1] * 1000.0));
636 auto qvb0 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(vb[0] * 1000.0));
637 auto qvb1 = static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(vb[1] * 1000.0));
638 if (qva1 != qvb1)
639 return qva1 < qvb1;
640 if (qva0 != qvb0)
641 return qva0 < qvb0;
642 int kind_cmp = a->getKind().compare(b->getKind());
643 if (kind_cmp != 0)
644 return kind_cmp < 0;
645 int ca = a->get_controllers();
646 int cb = b->get_controllers();
647 if (ca != cb)
648 return ca < cb;
649 Value oa = a->getAttr("owner");
650 Value ob = b->getAttr("owner");
651 int oai = oa ? static_cast<int>(oa) : -1;
652 int obi = ob ? static_cast<int>(ob) : -1;
653 if (oai != obi)
654 return oai < obi;
655 Value cola = a->getAttr("color");
656 Value colb = b->getAttr("color");
657 int cai = cola ? static_cast<int>(cola) : -1;
658 int cbi = colb ? static_cast<int>(colb) : -1;
659 if (cai != cbi)
660 return cai < cbi;
661 // If everything matches, the order does not matter: the actors are
662 // indistinguishable at our digest precision, and redistribution by
663 // position/velocity already yields the same per-player multiset.
664 return false;
665 });
666
667 std::vector<unsigned> group;
668 for (unsigned p = base; p < expected_players; p += level_players)
669 group.push_back(p);
670 if (group.size() <= 1)
671 continue;
672 if (candidates[base].size() < group.size())
673 continue; // Not enough authored balls; keep legacy duplication behavior.
674 if (debug_enabled())
675 debug_log("mp rebalance: base=%u candidates=%zu group=%zu", base, candidates[base].size(),
676 group.size());
677 std::vector<unsigned> assignment =
678 distribute_balls_round_robin(candidates[base].size(), group);
679 for (size_t i = 0; i < candidates[base].size(); ++i) {
680 Actor *a = candidates[base][i];
681 unsigned target = assignment[i];
682 a->setAttr("owner", Value(static_cast<int>(target)));
683 a->setAttr("controllers", Value(static_cast<int>(1 << target)));
684 }
685 }
686}

48constexpr Uint16 kLobbyPort = 12346;
49constexpr Uint16 kGamePort = 12345;
50constexpr Uint16 kInternetLobbyPort = 12347;
51constexpr double kAnnounceInterval = 0.5;
52// Drop peers from the LAN lobby after a short absence of announces. Keep this
53// tolerant enough for WiFi/VM broadcast loss so the UI doesn't flicker.
54constexpr double kPeerTimeout = 5.0;
55constexpr uint32_t kInputDelay = 4;
56// TCP relay adds latency and jitter compared to direct/UDP. Use a larger input
57// delay to reduce "missing input" situations that otherwise force frequent
58// resyncs (or eventually a restart prompt).
59constexpr uint32_t kInputDelayTcpRelay = 10;
60constexpr uint32_t kMaxInputLead = 32;
61// UI/debug override for input delay is expressed in legacy (10ms) ticks.
62// This is intentionally larger than kMaxInputLead (which caps extra lead from
63// clock drift) so experiments can cover high-latency links.
64constexpr uint32_t kMaxInputDelayLegacyTicks = 200;
65// Each NET_INPUT_BUNDLE covers a short sequential range of ticks and includes a
66// resend back-window. A larger back-window improves robustness on high-jitter /
67// lossy links so the host can still receive late client input ticks.
68constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleBackTicksDirect = 12;
69constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleBackTicksUdpRelay = 24;
70constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleBackTicksTcpRelay = 12;
71constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleMaxCountDirect = 32;
72constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleMaxCountUdpRelay = 48;
73constexpr uint32_t kInputBundleMaxCountTcpRelay = 32;
74// Keep local input history long enough to cover the largest resend back-window.
75constexpr uint32_t kInputHistoryKeepTicks = 256;
76constexpr double kInputTimestep = 0.01;
77constexpr Uint32 kJoinTimeoutMs = 15000;
78// Allow extra time for direct connect handshakes while the host is still
79// transitioning/loading the level and not pumping ENet yet (common on slower
80// machines / VMs). ENet server replies are application-driven.
81// Direct ENet connect can be slow to fail on some networks. For Internet play we
82// prefer a fast fallback to relays, while LAN play can tolerate a longer window
83// (clients may still be switching packs / loading after receiving START).
84constexpr Uint32 kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan = 12000;
85constexpr Uint32 kDirectConnectTimeoutMsInternet = 1200;
86constexpr double kSyncInterval = 0.5;
87constexpr double kResyncCooldown = 1.0;
88// If a resync request is in-flight for too long (packet loss, transport stall),
89// clear the in-flight flag so we can retry. Without this, a single lost resync
90// response can permanently disable recovery.
91constexpr double kResyncInflightTimeout = 2.5;
92// When aborting a session, keep the transport alive briefly so reliable abort
93// packets have a chance to reach peers (avoids prolonged desync spam on clients
94// if the host shuts down immediately).
95constexpr double kAbortDeliveryGrace = 0.25;
96// Legacy: client-side "no payload" disconnect timeout used to abort quickly
97// when the host vanished without sending a reliable abort. We now handle
98// transport stalls via a UI countdown and explicit abort request.
99[[maybe_unused]] constexpr double kClientNoPayloadDisconnectTimeout = 2.0;
100// Require at least N consecutive mismatch observations before triggering a resync
101// request. This reduces "jumpy mode" when a single late/out-of-order sync sample
102// briefly disagrees but the world would converge again naturally.
103constexpr unsigned kDesyncStreakForResync = 2;
104// Actor checksum mismatches can be caused by platform drift. Only trigger a
105// resync from actor checksums when the mismatch persists for multiple sync
106// intervals.
107constexpr unsigned kActorDesyncStreakForResync = 6;
108constexpr unsigned kResyncMaxAttempts = 3;
109constexpr size_t kChecksumHistory = 512;
110// Position drift tolerance (in tile units) for sync packets. The simulation is
111// not bit-identical across platforms, especially in physics-heavy levels (e.g.
112// rubberbands/meditation pearls). Keep this loose enough to avoid constant
113// resync churn, while still catching meaningful divergence.

198 // ignore duplicates/out-of-order load notifications.
199 Uint32 load_id = 0;
200 Uint32 last_load_id = 0;

217 std::unordered_map<Uint32, bool> tcp_relay_ready;
218 // Host-side player id allocation.
219 //
220 // We deliberately do not assume that direct connects succeed bidirectionally:
221 // on some LAN/VM setups the host can observe an ENet CONNECT event while the
222 // client never receives WELCOME. To allow retries (and to avoid getting
223 // stuck forever in "waiting for players"), we allocate player ids from a
224 // reusable pool and can replace unready peers during the pre-start phase.
225 std::vector<bool> player_in_use;

227 uint32_t next_send_tick = 0;
228 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, input::PlayerInput> local_history;
229 // Tracks late (clamped) mouse samples so out-of-order delivery doesn't cause
230 // "random kicks" by overwriting a newer sample with an older one.
231 std::array<bool, input::kMaxPlayers> late_mouse_valid = {};
232 std::array<uint32_t, input::kMaxPlayers> late_mouse_applied_tick = {};
233 std::array<uint32_t, input::kMaxPlayers> late_mouse_src_tick = {};
234 uint32_t input_clock_tick = 0;
235 double input_clock_accu = 0.0;
236 bool input_clock_frozen = false;
237 double sync_timer = 0.0;

239 uint32_t last_host_world_state_broadcast_tick = UINT32_MAX;
240 bool desync_reported = false;
241 bool paused = false;
242 std::vector<bool> menu_open;
243 // Time since last received transport payload (reset on any packet).
244 double no_payload_timer = 0.0;
245 // Local abort grace window to deliver NET_ABORT reliably.
246 bool abort_pending = false;
247 double abort_timer = 0.0;
248 std::string abort_message;
249 // Session lifecycle phase for start/restart transitions.
250 //
251 // Invariants:
252 // - WAITING_FOR_START: level is loaded or loading; server may call Msg_StartGame() which will be deferred.
253 // - WAITING_FOR_READY: server requested start; host waits for all peers to be ready (and placements if needed).
254 // - READY_TO_START: start conditions are satisfied; Msg_StartGame() must not be deferred anymore.
255 // - RUNNING: game is running (until the next restart/next-level resets the phase).
256 enum class Phase {
257 WAITING_FOR_START = 0,
258 WAITING_FOR_READY = 1,
259 READY_TO_START = 2,
260 RUNNING = 3
261 };

281 std::vector<std::vector<Uint32>> auto_detect_rtts_ms;
282 std::vector<Uint32> auto_detect_sent;
283 std::vector<Uint32> auto_detect_recv;
284 bool has_pending_sync = false;
285 protocol::SyncPacket pending_sync;

306 bool resync_inflight = false;

310 unsigned resync_attempts = 0;

312 unsigned actor_desync_streak = 0;
313 unsigned world_only_desync_streak = 0;

318 // over an existing authored actor do not need placement.
319 std::vector<bool> needs_placement;
320 int last_defer_start_log = -1;

A src/multiplayer_internet_lobby.cc

Description
  • Internet lobby client (custom UDP protocol) used to manage rooms and discover session endpoints.
Where it is used
  • Used by multiplayer lobby in Internet mode.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Adds Internet room create/join/leave and peer discovery via lobby service.
  • Tracks the active Internet room for lifecycle cleanup, propagates member display names in join/poll flows, and performs best-effort room leave on shutdown.

81bool parse_member_peers(ecl::Buffer &response, std::vector<LobbyPeer> &peers,
82 const std::string &self_id) {
83 peers.clear();
84 if (response.get_rpos() >= static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size()))
85 return true;
86 Uint8 count = 0;
87 if (!(response >> count))
88 return false;
89 peers.reserve(count);
90 for (Uint8 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
91 std::string id;
92 std::string name;
93 if (!(response >> id >> name))
94 return false;
95 LobbyPeer peer;
96 peer.id = id;
97 peer.name = name.empty() ? "Player" : name;
98 peer.level_id.clear();
99 peer.address.clear();
100 peer.is_self = (id == self_id);
101 peers.push_back(peer);
102 }
103 return true;
104}
105
106void cancel_pending_poll() {
107 if (g_pending_poll.socket != ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
108 enet_socket_destroy(g_pending_poll.socket);
109 g_pending_poll.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
110 }
111 g_pending_poll.active = false;
112 g_pending_poll.server.clear();
113 g_pending_poll.room_code.clear();
114 g_pending_poll.start_ticks = 0;
115 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = 0;
116}

118bool internet_exchange(const std::string &server, const ecl::Buffer &request,
119 ecl::Buffer &response, std::string &error) {
120 std::string host;
121 Uint16 port = 0;
122 if (!parse_host_port(server, host, port)) {
123 error = "Invalid server address.";
124 return false;
125 }
126
127 ENetAddress addr;
128 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
129 error = "Failed to resolve server.";
130 return false;
131 }
132 addr.port = port;
133
134 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
135 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
136 error = "Failed to open socket.";
137 return false;
138 }
139 ENetBuffer eb;
140 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
141 eb.dataLength = request.size();
142 if (enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1) <= 0) {
143 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
144 error = "Failed to send request.";
145 return false;
146 }
147
148 char data[1024];
149 ENetBuffer rb;
150 rb.data = data;
151 rb.dataLength = sizeof(data);
152 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
153 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start < 1500) {
154 enet_uint32 condition = ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE;
155 enet_socket_wait(socket, &condition, 50);
156 if ((condition & ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE) == 0)
157 continue;
158 ENetAddress src;
159 int received = enet_socket_receive(socket, &src, &rb, 1);
160 if (received > 0) {
161 response.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
162 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
163 return true;
164 }
165 }
166
167 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
168 error = "No response from server.";
169 return false;
170}
171
172bool internet_poll_start(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
173 std::string &error) {
174 cancel_pending_poll();
175
176 std::string host;
177 Uint16 port = 0;
178 if (!parse_host_port(server, host, port)) {
179 error = "Invalid server address.";
180 return false;
181 }
182
183 ENetAddress addr;
184 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
185 error = "Failed to resolve server.";
186 return false;
187 }
188 addr.port = port;
189
190 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
191 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
192 error = "Failed to open socket.";
193 return false;
194 }
195
196 ecl::Buffer request;
197 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_POLL)
198 << room_code;
199
200 ENetBuffer eb;
201 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
202 eb.dataLength = request.size();
203 if (enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1) <= 0) {
204 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
205 error = "Failed to send request.";
206 return false;
207 }
208
209 g_pending_poll.active = true;
210 g_pending_poll.server = server;
211 g_pending_poll.room_code = room_code;
212 g_pending_poll.addr = addr;
213 g_pending_poll.socket = socket;
214 g_pending_poll.start_ticks = SDL_GetTicks();
215 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = g_pending_poll.start_ticks;
216 return true;
217}
218
219bool internet_poll_pump(ecl::Buffer &response, std::string &error) {
220 if (!g_pending_poll.active || g_pending_poll.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
221 error = "waiting";
222 return false;
223 }
224
225 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
226
227 // Resend once in case the datagram was dropped.
228 if (now - g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks > 500 && now - g_pending_poll.start_ticks < 1200) {
229 ecl::Buffer request;
230 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_POLL)
231 << g_pending_poll.room_code;
232 ENetBuffer eb;
233 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
234 eb.dataLength = request.size();
235 enet_socket_send(g_pending_poll.socket, &g_pending_poll.addr, &eb, 1);
236 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = now;
237 }
238
239 char data[1024];
240 ENetBuffer rb;
241 rb.data = data;
242 rb.dataLength = sizeof(data);
243
244 enet_uint32 condition = ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE;
245 enet_socket_wait(g_pending_poll.socket, &condition, 0);
246 if ((condition & ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE) != 0) {
247 ENetAddress src;
248 int received = enet_socket_receive(g_pending_poll.socket, &src, &rb, 1);
249 if (received > 0) {
250 response.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
251 cancel_pending_poll();
252 return true;
253 }
254 }
255
256 if (now - g_pending_poll.start_ticks > 1500) {
257 cancel_pending_poll();
258 error = "No response from server.";
259 return false;
260 }
261
262 error = "waiting";
263 return false;
264}

268bool InternetCreateRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
269 const protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &error) {
270 ensure_lobby_identity();
271 ecl::Buffer request;
272 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_CREATE)
273 << room_code << Uint32(start.session_id) << Uint32(start.seed)
274 << Uint8(start.expected_players) << Uint16(start.host_port)
275 << Uint8(start.filter_optimized) << start.level_id << start.host_id << start.pack_name
276 // Optional extension: host display name for room member lists.
277 << g_lobby.local_name;
278
279 ecl::Buffer response;
280 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
281 return false;
282
283 Uint32 magic = 0;
284 Uint8 version = 0;
285 Uint8 type = 0;
286 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
287 return false;
288 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
289 return false;
290 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
291 std::string msg;
292 response >> msg;
293 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
294 return false;
295 }
296 if (type != INET_CREATE_OK)
297 return false;
298 std::string host_ip;
299 std::string server_room;
300 if (!(response >> server_room >> host_ip))
301 return false;
302 (void)host_ip;
303 track_room(server, server_room.empty() ? room_code : server_room);
304 return true;
305}
306
307bool InternetJoinRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
308 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
309 unsigned &player_count, std::vector<LobbyPeer> &peers,
310 std::string &error) {
311 ensure_lobby_identity();
312 player_count = 0;
313 peers.clear();
314 ecl::Buffer request;
315 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_JOIN)
316 << room_code << g_lobby.local_id
317 // Optional extension: joining member display name.
318 << g_lobby.local_name;
319
320 ecl::Buffer response;
321 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
322 return false;
323
324 Uint32 magic = 0;
325 Uint8 version = 0;
326 Uint8 type = 0;
327 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
328 return false;
329 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
330 return false;
331 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
332 std::string msg;
333 response >> msg;
334 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
335 return false;
336 }
337 if (type != INET_JOIN_OK)
338 return false;
339 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
340 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
341 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
342 return false;
343 // Optional fields for newer servers:
344 // - player_count (u8)
345 // - pack_name (string)
346 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
347 Uint8 count = 0;
348 if (response >> count)
349 player_count = count;
350 }
351 start.pack_name.clear();
352 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
353 if (!(response >> start.pack_name))
354 return false;
355 }
356 if (!parse_member_peers(response, peers, g_lobby.local_id))
357 return false;
358 if (!peers.empty())
359 player_count = static_cast<unsigned>(peers.size());
360 track_room(server, room_code);
361 return true;
362}
363
364bool InternetStartRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
365 const protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &error) {
366 ensure_lobby_identity();
367 ecl::Buffer request;
368 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_START)
369 << room_code << Uint32(start.session_id) << Uint32(start.seed)
370 << Uint8(start.expected_players) << Uint16(start.host_port)
371 << Uint8(start.filter_optimized) << start.level_id << start.host_id << start.pack_name
372 // Optional extension: host display name for room member lists.
373 << g_lobby.local_name;
374
375 ecl::Buffer response;
376 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
377 return false;
378
379 Uint32 magic = 0;
380 Uint8 version = 0;
381 Uint8 type = 0;
382 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
383 return false;
384 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
385 return false;
386 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
387 std::string msg;
388 response >> msg;
389 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
390 return false;
391 }
392 if (type != INET_START_OK)
393 return false;
394 return true;
395}
396
397bool InternetPollRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
398 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
399 bool &started, unsigned &player_count,
400 std::vector<LobbyPeer> &peers, std::string &error) {
401 ensure_lobby_identity();
402 started = false;
403 player_count = 0;
404 peers.clear();
405 ecl::Buffer response;
406 if (!g_pending_poll.active || g_pending_poll.server != server
407 || g_pending_poll.room_code != room_code) {
408 if (!internet_poll_start(server, room_code, error))
409 return false;
410 }
411 if (!internet_poll_pump(response, error))
412 return false;
413
414 Uint32 magic = 0;
415 Uint8 version = 0;
416 Uint8 type = 0;
417 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
418 return false;
419 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
420 return false;
421 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
422 std::string msg;
423 response >> msg;
424 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
425 return false;
426 }
427 if (type != INET_POLL_OK)
428 return false;
429 Uint8 started_flag = 0;
430 Uint8 count = 0;
431 if (!(response >> started_flag >> count))
432 return false;
433 started = (started_flag != 0);
434 player_count = count;
435 if (started) {
436 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
437 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
438 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
439 return false;
440 start.pack_name.clear();
441 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
442 // Pack name may be appended after host_ip.
443 if (!(response >> start.pack_name))
444 return false;
445 }
446 }
447 if (!parse_member_peers(response, peers, g_lobby.local_id))
448 return false;
449 if (!peers.empty())
450 player_count = static_cast<unsigned>(peers.size());
451 return true;
452}
453
454bool InternetLeaveRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
455 std::string &error) {
456 ensure_lobby_identity();
457 // If we are leaving, drop any pending poll to avoid keeping an extra socket
458 // around and to prevent late responses from touching UI state.
459 cancel_pending_poll();
460 ecl::Buffer request;
461 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_LEAVE)
462 << room_code << g_lobby.local_id;
463
464 ecl::Buffer response;
465 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
466 return false;
467
468 Uint32 magic = 0;
469 Uint8 version = 0;
470 Uint8 type = 0;
471 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
472 return false;
473 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
474 return false;
475 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
476 std::string msg;
477 response >> msg;
478 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
479 return false;
480 }
481 if (g_tracked_room.active && g_tracked_room.server == server
482 && g_tracked_room.room_code == room_code) {
483 clear_tracked_room();
484 }
485 return true;
486}
487
488void InternetLeaveTrackedRoomOnShutdown() {
489 if (!g_tracked_room.active || g_tracked_room.server.empty()
490 || g_tracked_room.room_code.empty()) {
491 return;
492 }
493 ensure_lobby_identity();
494 cancel_pending_poll();
495
496 std::string host;
497 Uint16 port = 0;
498 if (!parse_host_port(g_tracked_room.server, host, port)) {
499 clear_tracked_room();
500 return;
501 }
502
503 ENetAddress addr;
504 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
505 clear_tracked_room();
506 return;
507 }
508 addr.port = port;
509
510 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
511 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
512 clear_tracked_room();
513 return;
514 }
515
516 // Best-effort shutdown cleanup: send LEAVE without waiting for a reply so
517 // quitting does not block on network timeouts.
518 ecl::Buffer request;
519 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_LEAVE)
520 << g_tracked_room.room_code << g_lobby.local_id;
521 ENetBuffer eb;
522 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
523 eb.dataLength = request.size();
524 enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
525 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
526
527 clear_tracked_room();
528}

A src/multiplayer_lan_lobby.cc

Description
  • LAN lobby discovery and peer list management (broadcast-based).
Where it is used
  • Used by multiplayer lobby in LAN mode.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Enables LAN peer discovery and joining without a central server.
  • Broadcast `LobbyStart` now includes best-effort local IPv4 candidates; clients try multiple addresses to cope with VMs and multi-NIC setups.
  • Keeps lobby identity available for Internet-room operations even when LAN discovery is not actively running.

60std::vector<std::string> local_ipv4_addresses() {
61 std::vector<std::string> out;
62#ifdef WIN32
63 // Best-effort: enumerate addresses via hostname resolution. This does not
64 // require extra link flags (unlike GetAdaptersAddresses()) and is good
65 // enough to provide additional candidates beyond the UDP sender IP.
66 char hostname[256];
67 hostname[0] = '\0';
68 if (gethostname(hostname, sizeof(hostname)) != 0)
69 return out;
70
71 addrinfo hints;
72 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
73 hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
74 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_DGRAM;
75
76 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
77 if (getaddrinfo(hostname, nullptr, &hints, &res) != 0)
78 return out;
79 for (addrinfo *ai = res; ai; ai = ai->ai_next) {
80 if (!ai->ai_addr || ai->ai_family != AF_INET)
81 continue;
82 sockaddr_in *sin = reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in *>(ai->ai_addr);
83 char buf[INET_ADDRSTRLEN] = {0};
84 if (!inet_ntop(AF_INET, &sin->sin_addr, buf, sizeof(buf)))
85 continue;
86 std::string ip(buf);
87 if (ip.empty())
88 continue;
89 // Filter loopback.
90 if (ip.rfind("127.", 0) == 0)
91 continue;
92 if (std::find(out.begin(), out.end(), ip) == out.end())
93 out.push_back(ip);
94 }
95 freeaddrinfo(res);
96 return out;
97#else
98 ifaddrs *ifas = nullptr;
99 if (getifaddrs(&ifas) != 0)
100 return out;
101 for (ifaddrs *ifa = ifas; ifa; ifa = ifa->ifa_next) {
102 if (!ifa->ifa_addr || ifa->ifa_addr->sa_family != AF_INET)
103 continue;
104 // Skip down interfaces and loopback.
105 if ((ifa->ifa_flags & IFF_UP) == 0)
106 continue;
107 if ((ifa->ifa_flags & IFF_LOOPBACK) != 0)
108 continue;
109 sockaddr_in *sin = reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in *>(ifa->ifa_addr);
110 char buf[INET_ADDRSTRLEN] = {0};
111 if (!inet_ntop(AF_INET, &sin->sin_addr, buf, sizeof(buf)))
112 continue;
113 std::string ip(buf);
114 if (ip.empty())
115 continue;
116 if (std::find(out.begin(), out.end(), ip) == out.end())
117 out.push_back(ip);
118 }
119 freeifaddrs(ifas);
120 return out;
121#endif
122}

124std::string encode_hex(const char *data, size_t len) {
125 static const char *hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
126 std::string out;
127 out.reserve(len * 2);
128 for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
129 unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(data[i]);
130 out.push_back(hex[(c >> 4) & 0xF]);
131 out.push_back(hex[c & 0xF]);
132 }
133 return out;
134}
135
136bool decode_hex(const std::string &text, ecl::Buffer &out) {
137 if (text.empty() || (text.size() % 2) != 0)
138 return false;
139 out.clear();
140 for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); i += 2) {
141 char hi = text[i];
142 char lo = text[i + 1];
143 auto hexval = [](char c) -> int {
144 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
145 return c - '0';
146 if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
147 return 10 + (c - 'A');
148 if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
149 return 10 + (c - 'a');
150 return -1;
151 };
152 int h = hexval(hi);
153 int l = hexval(lo);
154 if (h < 0 || l < 0)
155 return false;
156 char byte = static_cast<char>((h << 4) | l);
157 out.write(byte);
158 }
159 return true;
160}

162void send_lobby_announce() {
163 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
164 return;
165 // Username can change in Options; refresh before broadcasting.
166 ensure_lobby_identity();
167 protocol::LobbyAnnounce msg;
168 msg.id = g_lobby.local_id;
169 msg.name = g_lobby.local_name;
170 msg.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
171 // Best-effort: include the currently selected pack for easier debugging/UI.
172 lev::Index *cur = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
173 msg.pack_name = cur ? cur->getName() : "";
174 msg.player_count = static_cast<Uint8>(g_lobby.peers.size() + 1);
175
176 ecl::Buffer buf;
177 protocol::encode_lobby_announce(buf, msg);
178
179 ENetBuffer eb;
180 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
181 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
182
183 ENetAddress addr;
184 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
185 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
186 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
187}
188
189void send_lobby_announce_to(const ENetAddress &dst) {
190 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
191 return;
192 // Username can change in Options; refresh before sending.
193 ensure_lobby_identity();
194
195 protocol::LobbyAnnounce msg;
196 msg.id = g_lobby.local_id;
197 msg.name = g_lobby.local_name;
198 msg.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
199 lev::Index *cur = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
200 msg.pack_name = cur ? cur->getName() : "";
201 msg.player_count = static_cast<Uint8>(g_lobby.peers.size() + 1);
202
203 ecl::Buffer buf;
204 protocol::encode_lobby_announce(buf, msg);
205
206 ENetAddress addr = dst;
207 addr.port = kLobbyPort; // announces are always listened for on the lobby port
208 ENetBuffer eb;
209 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
210 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
211 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
212}
213
214void poll_lobby_socket() {
215 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
216 return;
217 ENetAddress src;
218 char data[512];
219 ENetBuffer buffer;
220 buffer.data = data;
221 buffer.dataLength = sizeof(data);
222
223 while (true) {
224 int received = enet_socket_receive(g_lobby.socket, &src, &buffer, 1);
225 if (received <= 0)
226 break;
227
228 std::string ip = address_to_ip_string(src);
229 if (ip.empty())
230 continue;
231
232 ecl::Buffer buf;
233 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
234 protocol::LobbyAnnounce announce;
235 if (protocol::decode_lobby_announce(buf, announce)) {
236 if (announce.id == g_lobby.local_id)
237 continue;
238 // Some networks deliver broadcasts asymmetrically (or filter
239 // broadcast but allow unicast). If we heard a peer's announce,
240 // send a direct unicast announce back once so they can discover us
241 // even if they didn't receive our broadcast.
242 bool newly_seen = g_lobby.peers.find(announce.id) == g_lobby.peers.end();
243 LobbyPeerEntry &entry = g_lobby.peers[announce.id];
244 entry.peer.id = announce.id;
245 entry.peer.name = announce.name;
246 entry.peer.level_id = announce.level_id;
247 entry.peer.address = ip;
248 entry.peer.is_self = false;
249 entry.addr = src;
250 entry.addr.port = kLobbyPort;
251 entry.last_seen = g_lobby.time;
252 if (newly_seen) {
253 debug_log("mp lobby: saw peer id=%s name=%s ip=%s (announce-back)",
254 announce.id.c_str(), announce.name.c_str(), ip.c_str());
255 send_lobby_announce_to(src);
256 }
257 continue;
258 }
259
260 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
261 protocol::LobbyStart start;
262 if (protocol::decode_lobby_start(buf, start)) {
263 if (start.host_id == g_lobby.local_id)
264 continue;
265 if (g_session.active)
266 continue;
267 if (start.session_id == g_lobby.last_session_id)
268 continue;
269 g_lobby.pending_start = start;
270 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.clear();
271
272 // Prefer the START sender address first: it's the address that just
273 // delivered the packet to us, so it is usually the most routable for
274 // a direct connect (notably across VMs / NAT).
275 auto it = g_lobby.peers.find(start.host_id);
276 if (!ip.empty())
277 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.push_back(ip);
278 // Next, add any host-provided IP candidates.
279 for (const std::string &hip : start.host_ips) {
280 if (hip.empty())
281 continue;
282 if (std::find(g_lobby.pending_host_ips.begin(), g_lobby.pending_host_ips.end(),
283 hip) == g_lobby.pending_host_ips.end()) {
284 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.push_back(hip);
285 }
286 }
287 if (it != g_lobby.peers.end()) {
288 const std::string &announce_ip = it->second.peer.address;
289 if (!announce_ip.empty() &&
290 (g_lobby.pending_host_ips.empty() || g_lobby.pending_host_ips[0] != announce_ip)) {
291 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.push_back(announce_ip);
292 }
293 }
294
295 if (debug_enabled()) {
296 std::string hosts;
297 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_lobby.pending_host_ips.size(); ++i) {
298 if (i)
299 hosts += ",";
300 hosts += g_lobby.pending_host_ips[i];
301 }
302 debug_log("mp lobby: start received session=%u pack=%s level_id=%s host_id=%s port=%u hosts=%s",
303 static_cast<unsigned>(start.session_id),
304 start.pack_name.c_str(),
305 start.level_id.c_str(),
306 start.host_id.c_str(),
307 static_cast<unsigned>(start.host_port),
308 hosts.c_str());
309 }
310 g_lobby.has_pending_start = true;
311 g_lobby.last_session_id = start.session_id;
312 }
313 }
314}

316void cleanup_lobby_peers() {
317 for (auto it = g_lobby.peers.begin(); it != g_lobby.peers.end();) {
318 if (g_lobby.time - it->second.last_seen > kPeerTimeout)
319 it = g_lobby.peers.erase(it);
320 else
321 ++it;
322 }
323}
324
325void send_unicast_announces() {
326 // Broadcast delivery can be flaky or asymmetric (notably across VMs). Once we
327 // know a peer's unicast address, also send announces directly to keep LAN
328 // discovery stable.
329 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
330 return;
331 for (auto &kv : g_lobby.peers) {
332 LobbyPeerEntry &entry = kv.second;
333 if (entry.addr.host == 0)
334 continue;
335 if (g_lobby.time - entry.last_unicast_sent < kAnnounceInterval)
336 continue;
337 send_lobby_announce_to(entry.addr);
338 entry.last_unicast_sent = g_lobby.time;
339 }
340}

344void LobbyStart() {
345 if (g_lobby.active)
346 return;
347 if (!LoadMultiplayerConfig().enable_direct) {
348 // LAN mode has no relay. If direct connect is disabled, don't join the
349 // broadcast lobby (prevents confusing half-working LAN behavior).
350 debug_log("mp lobby: not starting (direct connect disabled)");
351 return;
352 }
353 g_lobby.active = true;
354 // Keep a stable lobby identity across LobbyStop/LobbyStart cycles.
355 // Internet mode uses the same identity for room membership; if the id changes,
356 // LEAVE requests may not remove the original member entry on the lobby server.
357 ensure_lobby_identity();
358 g_lobby.time = 0.0;
359 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
360 g_lobby.peers.clear();
361 g_lobby.has_pending_start = false;
362 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.clear();
363 g_lobby.last_session_id = 0;
364
365 g_lobby.socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
366 if (g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
367 debug_log("mp lobby: socket create failed");
368 g_lobby.active = false;
369 return;
370 }
371 if (!bind_lobby_socket(g_lobby.socket, kLobbyPort)) {
372 debug_log("mp lobby: bind failed port=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort));
373 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
374 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
375 g_lobby.active = false;
376 return;
377 }
378 debug_log("mp lobby: started port=%u id=%s name=%s",
379 static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort),
380 g_lobby.local_id.c_str(),
381 g_lobby.local_name.c_str());
382 send_lobby_announce();
383}

385void LobbyStop() {
386 if (!g_lobby.active)
387 return;
388 if (g_lobby.socket != ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
389 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
390 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
391 }
392 g_lobby.active = false;
393 g_lobby.peers.clear();
394}

396void LobbyTick(double dtime) {
397 if (!g_lobby.active)
398 return;
399 g_lobby.time += dtime;

402 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
403 send_lobby_announce();
404 send_unicast_announces();
405 }
406 poll_lobby_socket();
407 cleanup_lobby_peers();
408}

465protocol::LobbyStart BuildStartMessage(const std::string &level_id, unsigned expected_players,
466 const std::string &pack_name, unsigned filter_min_players) {
467 // Internet mode can call this helper without starting the LAN lobby first.
468 // Ensure identity exists so `host_id` is never empty (required for room leave).
469 ensure_lobby_identity();
470 protocol::LobbyStart start;
471 std::random_device rd;
472 Uint32 seed = static_cast<Uint32>(rd() ^ SDL_GetTicks());
473 Uint32 session_id = static_cast<Uint32>((rd() << 16) ^ SDL_GetTicks());
474 start.session_id = session_id;
475 start.level_id = level_id;
476 start.pack_name = pack_name;
477 // Include a best-effort list of local IPv4s to help multi-homed peers find
478 // a working direct-connect route (VMs, VPNs, multiple NICs).
479 start.host_ips = local_ipv4_addresses();
480 start.seed = seed;
481 start.expected_players = static_cast<Uint8>(expected_players);
482 start.host_port = kGamePort;
483 start.host_id = g_lobby.local_id;
484 if (filter_min_players < 1)
485 filter_min_players = 1;
486 if (filter_min_players > expected_players)
487 filter_min_players = expected_players;
488 start.filter_optimized = static_cast<Uint8>(filter_min_players);
489 return start;
490}
491
492void LobbyBroadcastStart(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
493 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
494 return;
495 ecl::Buffer buf;
496 protocol::encode_lobby_start(buf, start);
497
498 ENetBuffer eb;
499 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
500 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
501
502 // Broadcast for the "normal" LAN case.
503 ENetAddress addr;
504 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
505 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
506 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
507
508 // Some networks deliver broadcasts asymmetrically (notably across VMs). If we
509 // already know peers' unicast addresses, also send the start message directly.
510 for (const auto &kv : g_lobby.peers) {
511 const LobbyPeerEntry &entry = kv.second;
512 if (entry.addr.host == 0)
513 continue;
514 ENetAddress dst = entry.addr;
515 dst.port = kLobbyPort;
516 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &dst, &eb, 1);
517 }
518}
519
520std::string EncodeStartToken(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
521 ecl::Buffer buf;
522 // Keep tokens stable and avoid embedding local interface IPs.
523 protocol::LobbyStart tmp = start;
524 tmp.host_ips.clear();
525 protocol::encode_lobby_start(buf, tmp);
526 return encode_hex(buf.data(), buf.size());
527}
528
529bool DecodeStartToken(const std::string &token, protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
530 ecl::Buffer buf;
531 if (!decode_hex(token, buf))
532 return false;
533 return protocol::decode_lobby_start(buf, start);
534}

A src/multiplayer_protocol.hh

Description
  • Binary protocol definitions for gameplay session packets (inputs, sync, control messages).
Where it is used
  • Used by host/client session code across all gameplay transports.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New protocol header for multiplayer gameplay networking.
  • Extends LAN `LobbyStart` with optional `host_ips` candidates to improve direct-connect success on multi-homed hosts (VMs/VPNs).
  • Adds host-authoritative level transitions via `NET_LOAD_LEVEL` (pack + normalized level id).
  • Adds host-authoritative world-state snapshots (`NET_WORLD_STATE`) and client requests (`NET_WORLD_STATE_REQUEST`) for repairing world divergence.
  • Adds host-to-client settings synchronization (`NET_DEBUG_OPTIONS`) plus `NET_PING`/`NET_PONG` for host-side connectivity probing.
  • Scopes READY/START to the current session+level by carrying `session_id`, `epoch`, and `load_id` (prevents stale packets unblocking the wrong level).

23enum NetMessageType : Uint8 {
24 NET_WELCOME = 1,
25 NET_INPUT = 2,
26 NET_SYNC = 3,
27 NET_READY = 4,
28 NET_START = 5,
29 NET_RESTART = 6,
30 NET_RESYNC_REQUEST = 7,
31 NET_RESYNC_STATE = 8,
32 NET_PLACE = 9,
33 NET_PAUSE = 10,
34 NET_MENU = 11,
35 NET_ABORT = 12,
36 // Host -> clients: instruct clients to load a fully-qualified level.
37 // Used for level transitions (advance to next level) to avoid relying on
38 // each client advancing locally (which can diverge across level packs).
39 NET_LOAD_LEVEL = 13,
40 // Unreliable, redundant input transport: sends a short range of sequential
41 // per-tick inputs (including a few repeats) to reduce lockstep stalls under
42 // packet loss/jitter.
43 NET_INPUT_BUNDLE = 14,
44 // Host -> clients: authoritative world state snapshot (grid object states).
45 NET_WORLD_STATE = 15,
46 // Client -> host: request an authoritative world state snapshot.
47 NET_WORLD_STATE_REQUEST = 16,
48 // Host -> clients: host-selected debug/session settings (authoritative for the session).
49 NET_DEBUG_OPTIONS = 17,
50 // Host <-> clients: lightweight RTT probe for auto-detecting connectivity.
51 NET_PING = 18,
52 NET_PONG = 19
53 };

227inline void encode_lobby_announce(ecl::Buffer &buf, const LobbyAnnounce &msg) {
228 buf << kLobbyMagic << kLobbyVersion << Uint8(LOBBY_ANNOUNCE)
229 << msg.id << msg.name << msg.level_id << Uint8(msg.player_count) << msg.pack_name;

232inline bool decode_lobby_announce(ecl::Buffer &buf, LobbyAnnounce &msg) {
233 Uint32 magic = 0;
234 Uint8 version = 0;
235 Uint8 type = 0;
236 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> type))
237 return false;
238 if (magic != kLobbyMagic || type != LOBBY_ANNOUNCE)
239 return false;
240 Uint8 count = 0;
241 if (version != kLobbyVersion)
242 return false;
243 if (!(buf >> msg.id >> msg.name >> msg.level_id >> count))
244 return false;
245 msg.player_count = count;
246 msg.pack_name.clear();
247 if (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
248 if (!(buf >> msg.pack_name))
249 return false;
250 }
251 return true;
252}

254inline void encode_lobby_start(ecl::Buffer &buf, const LobbyStart &msg) {
255 buf << kLobbyMagic << kLobbyVersion << Uint8(LOBBY_START)
256 << Uint32(msg.session_id) << msg.level_id << Uint32(msg.seed)
257 << Uint8(msg.expected_players) << Uint16(msg.host_port) << msg.host_id
258 << Uint8(msg.filter_optimized) << msg.pack_name;
259 // Optional extension: additional host IP candidates. Older decoders ignore
260 // trailing bytes, so extending the payload keeps LAN interop with older builds.
261 Uint8 count = static_cast<Uint8>(std::min<size_t>(msg.host_ips.size(), 255));
262 buf << count;
263 for (Uint8 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
264 buf << msg.host_ips[i];
265}
266
267inline void encode_world_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, const WorldStatePacket &msg) {
268 buf << Uint8(NET_WORLD_STATE) << Uint32(msg.epoch) << Uint32(msg.tick)
269 << Uint16(msg.width) << Uint16(msg.height);
270 const Uint32 count = static_cast<Uint32>(msg.floor_state.size());
271 buf << count;
272 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
273 buf << Uint16(msg.floor_state[i]);
274 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
275 buf << Uint16(msg.stone_state[i]);
276 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
277 buf << Uint16(msg.item_state[i]);
278 // Optional extension: movable stone positions.
279 Uint16 mcount = static_cast<Uint16>(std::min<size_t>(msg.movable_stones.size(), 0xFFFF));
280 buf << mcount;
281 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < mcount; ++i) {
282 const auto &e = msg.movable_stones[i];
283 buf << Uint32(e.object_id) << Uint16(e.x) << Uint16(e.y);
284 }
285 // Optional extension v1: authoritative kinds.
286 const bool have_kinds =
287 (msg.floor_kind.size() == count && msg.stone_kind.size() == count && msg.item_kind.size() == count &&
288 !msg.kind_dict.empty());
289 if (have_kinds) {
290 buf << Uint8(1);
291 Uint16 dict_count = static_cast<Uint16>(std::min<size_t>(msg.kind_dict.size(), 0xFFFF));
292 buf << dict_count;
293 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < dict_count; ++i)
294 buf << msg.kind_dict[i];
295 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
296 buf << Uint16(msg.floor_kind[i]);
297 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
298 buf << Uint16(msg.stone_kind[i]);
299 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
300 buf << Uint16(msg.item_kind[i]);
301 }
302 // Optional extension v2: authoritative oxyd colors.
303 if (!msg.oxyd_colors.empty()) {
304 buf << Uint8(2);
305 Uint16 ccount = static_cast<Uint16>(std::min<size_t>(msg.oxyd_colors.size(), 0xFFFF));
306 buf << ccount;
307 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < ccount; ++i) {
308 const auto &e = msg.oxyd_colors[i];
309 buf << Uint16(e.x) << Uint16(e.y) << Uint16(e.color_raw);
310 }
311 }
312}
313
314inline bool decode_world_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, WorldStatePacket &msg) {
315 Uint8 type = 0;
316 Uint32 epoch = 0;
317 Uint32 tick = 0;
318 Uint16 w = 0;
319 Uint16 h = 0;
320 Uint32 count = 0;
321 if (!(buf >> type >> epoch >> tick >> w >> h >> count))
322 return false;
323 if (type != NET_WORLD_STATE)
324 return false;
325 if (w == 0 || h == 0)
326 return false;
327 const Uint32 expected = static_cast<Uint32>(w) * static_cast<Uint32>(h);
328 if (count != expected)
329 return false;
330 msg.epoch = epoch;
331 msg.tick = tick;
332 msg.width = w;
333 msg.height = h;
334 msg.floor_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
335 msg.stone_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
336 msg.item_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
337 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
338 Uint16 v = 0;
339 if (!(buf >> v))
340 return false;
341 msg.floor_state[i] = v;
342 }
343 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
344 Uint16 v = 0;
345 if (!(buf >> v))
346 return false;
347 msg.stone_state[i] = v;
348 }
349 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
350 Uint16 v = 0;
351 if (!(buf >> v))
352 return false;
353 msg.item_state[i] = v;
354 }
355 msg.movable_stones.clear();
356 // Optional extension: movable stone positions.
357 if (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
358 Uint16 mcount = 0;
359 if (!(buf >> mcount))
360 return false;
361 msg.movable_stones.reserve(mcount);
362 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < mcount; ++i) {
363 WorldStatePacket::MovableStone e;
364 if (!(buf >> e.object_id >> e.x >> e.y))
365 return false;
366 msg.movable_stones.push_back(e);
367 }
368 }
369 msg.oxyd_colors.clear();
370 msg.kind_dict.clear();
371 msg.floor_kind.clear();
372 msg.stone_kind.clear();
373 msg.item_kind.clear();
374 // Optional extensions: kinds (v1) and oxyd colors (v2). Older decoders ignore trailing bytes.
375 // Newer decoders support multiple extension blocks in sequence.
376 while (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
377 const size_t rpos = static_cast<size_t>(buf.get_rpos());
378 const size_t sz = static_cast<size_t>(buf.size());
379 if (rpos >= sz)
380 break;
381 const Uint8 ext = static_cast<Uint8>(buf.data()[rpos]);
382 if (ext == 1) {
383 Uint8 consumed_ext = 0;
384 Uint16 dict_count = 0;
385 if (!(buf >> consumed_ext >> dict_count))
386 return false;
387 msg.kind_dict.reserve(dict_count);
388 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < dict_count; ++i) {
389 std::string k;
390 if (!(buf >> k))
391 return false;
392 msg.kind_dict.push_back(k);
393 }
394 msg.floor_kind.assign(count, 0);
395 msg.stone_kind.assign(count, 0);
396 msg.item_kind.assign(count, 0);
397 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
398 Uint16 v = 0;
399 if (!(buf >> v))
400 return false;
401 msg.floor_kind[i] = v;
402 }
403 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
404 Uint16 v = 0;
405 if (!(buf >> v))
406 return false;
407 msg.stone_kind[i] = v;
408 }
409 for (Uint32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
410 Uint16 v = 0;
411 if (!(buf >> v))
412 return false;
413 msg.item_kind[i] = v;
414 }
415 continue;
416 }
417 if (ext == 2) {
418 Uint8 consumed_ext = 0;
419 Uint16 ccount = 0;
420 if (!(buf >> consumed_ext >> ccount))
421 return false;
422 msg.oxyd_colors.reserve(ccount);
423 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < ccount; ++i) {
424 WorldStatePacket::OxydColor e;
425 if (!(buf >> e.x >> e.y >> e.color_raw))
426 return false;
427 msg.oxyd_colors.push_back(e);
428 }
429 continue;
430 }
431 // Unknown extension marker: ignore remaining bytes for forward compatibility.
432 break;
433 }
434 return true;
435}

580inline void encode_input_bundle(ecl::Buffer &buf, const InputBundlePacket &msg) {
581 Uint8 count = static_cast<Uint8>(msg.entries.size());
582 buf << Uint8(NET_INPUT_BUNDLE) << Uint32(msg.epoch) << Uint32(msg.first_tick) << Uint8(msg.player)
583 << Uint8(count);
584 for (const auto &e : msg.entries) {
585 buf << float(e.mouse_x) << float(e.mouse_y)
586 << Uint16(static_cast<uint16_t>(e.rotate_steps)) << Uint8(e.activate_count);
587 }
588}

590inline bool decode_input_bundle(ecl::Buffer &buf, InputBundlePacket &msg) {
591 Uint8 type = 0;
592 Uint32 epoch = 0;
593 Uint32 first_tick = 0;
594 Uint8 player = 0;
595 Uint8 count = 0;
596 if (!(buf >> type))
597 return false;
598 if (type != NET_INPUT_BUNDLE)
599 return false;
600 if (!(buf >> epoch >> first_tick >> player >> count))
601 return false;
602 msg.epoch = epoch;
603 msg.first_tick = first_tick;
604 msg.player = player;
605 msg.entries.clear();
606 msg.entries.reserve(count);
607 for (Uint8 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
608 float mx = 0.0f;
609 float my = 0.0f;
610 Uint16 rotate_raw = 0;
611 Uint8 activate = 0;
612 if (!(buf >> mx >> my >> rotate_raw >> activate))
613 return false;
614 InputBundleEntry e;
615 e.mouse_x = mx;
616 e.mouse_y = my;
617 e.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(rotate_raw);
618 e.activate_count = activate;
619 msg.entries.push_back(e);
620 }
621 return true;
622}

630 inline bool decode_welcome(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint8 &player_id, Uint8 &expected_players, Uint32 &seed,
631 Uint16 *tick_ms = nullptr) {

633 if (!(buf >> type))

638 return false;

641 Uint16 ms = 0;

644 if (tick_ms)

646 } else if (tick_ms) {
647 *tick_ms = 0;
648 }

652inline void encode_sync(ecl::Buffer &buf, const SyncPacket &msg) {

654 << float(msg.p0_x) << float(msg.p0_y) << float(msg.p1_x) << float(msg.p1_y)
655 << Uint64(msg.world_checksum) << Uint64(msg.actor_checksum)
656 << Uint64(msg.grid_kind_checksum) << Uint64(msg.grid_state_checksum);

659inline bool decode_sync(ecl::Buffer &buf, SyncPacket &msg) {
660 Uint8 type = 0;
661 Uint32 epoch = 0;
662 Uint32 tick = 0;
663 Uint32 random_state = 0;
664 float p0_x = 0.0f;
665 float p0_y = 0.0f;
666 float p1_x = 0.0f;
667 float p1_y = 0.0f;
668 Uint64 world_checksum = 0;
669 Uint64 actor_checksum = 0;
670 Uint64 grid_kind_checksum = 0;
671 Uint64 grid_state_checksum = 0;
672 if (!(buf >> type))
673 return false;
674 if (type != NET_SYNC)
675 return false;
676 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick >> random_state >> p0_x >> p0_y >> p1_x >> p1_y >> world_checksum >>
677 actor_checksum))
678 return false;
679 msg.epoch = epoch;
680 msg.tick = tick;
681 msg.random_state = random_state;
682 msg.p0_x = p0_x;
683 msg.p0_y = p0_y;
684 msg.p1_x = p1_x;
685 msg.p1_y = p1_y;
686 msg.world_checksum = world_checksum;
687 msg.actor_checksum = actor_checksum;
688 // Optional extension: grid checksums.
689 if (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
690 if (!(buf >> grid_kind_checksum >> grid_state_checksum))
691 return false;
692 msg.grid_kind_checksum = grid_kind_checksum;
693 msg.grid_state_checksum = grid_state_checksum;
694 } else {
695 msg.grid_kind_checksum = 0;
696 msg.grid_state_checksum = 0;
697 }
698 return true;
699}

722 buf << Uint8(NET_RESYNC_STATE) << Uint32(msg.epoch) << Uint32(msg.tick) << Uint32(msg.random_state)
723 << Uint16(count);

726 << float(actor.x) << float(actor.y) << float(actor.vx) << float(actor.vy)
727 << Uint32(actor.controllers) << Uint16(actor.color) << Uint32(actor.name_hash);

731inline bool decode_resync_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, ResyncState &msg) {
732 Uint8 type = 0;
733 Uint32 epoch = 0;
734 Uint32 tick = 0;
735 Uint32 random_state = 0;
736 Uint16 count = 0;
737 if (!(buf >> type))
738 return false;
739 if (type != NET_RESYNC_STATE)
740 return false;
741 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick >> random_state >> count))
742 return false;
743 msg.epoch = epoch;
744 msg.tick = tick;
745 msg.random_state = random_state;
746 msg.actors.clear();
747 msg.actors.reserve(count);
748 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
749 ResyncActorState actor;
750 Uint32 object_id = 0;
751 Uint16 actor_id = 0;
752 Uint16 owner = 0;
753 float x = 0.0f;
754 float y = 0.0f;
755 float vx = 0.0f;
756 float vy = 0.0f;
757 Uint32 controllers = 0;
758 Uint16 color = 0xFFFF;
759 Uint32 name_hash = 0;
760 if (!(buf >> object_id >> actor_id >> owner >> x >> y >> vx >> vy >> controllers >> color >>
761 name_hash))
762 return false;
763 actor.object_id = object_id;
764 actor.actor_id = actor_id;
765 actor.owner = owner;
766 actor.x = x;
767 actor.y = y;
768 actor.vx = vx;
769 actor.vy = vy;
770 actor.controllers = controllers;
771 actor.color = color;
772 actor.name_hash = name_hash;
773 msg.actors.push_back(actor);
774 }
775 return true;
776}

21/* -------------------- Multiplayer relay codec -------------------- */
22/*
23 * Relay message encoding/decoding.
24 *
25 * Shared between UDP relay and TCP relay to keep message framing identical.
26 */
27
28namespace enigma {
29namespace multiplayer {
30namespace internal {
31
32void encode_relay_header(ecl::Buffer &buf, RelayMessageType type, Uint32 session_id,
33 Uint32 client_id) {
34 buf << Uint32(kRelayMagic) << Uint8(kRelayVersion) << Uint8(type)
35 << Uint32(session_id) << Uint32(client_id);
36}
37
38bool decode_relay_header(const char *data, size_t len, RelayMessageType &type,
39 Uint32 &session_id, Uint32 &client_id,
40 const char *&payload, size_t &payload_len) {
41 ecl::Buffer buf;
42 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
43 Uint32 magic = 0;
44 Uint8 version = 0;
45 Uint8 raw_type = 0;
46 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> raw_type >> session_id >> client_id))
47 return false;
48 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
49 return false;
50 type = static_cast<RelayMessageType>(raw_type);
51 size_t offset = static_cast<size_t>(buf.get_rpos());
52 if (offset > len)
53 return false;
54 payload = data + offset;
55 payload_len = len - offset;
56 return true;
57}
58
59} // namespace internal
60} // namespace multiplayer
61} // namespace enigma

26uint32_t stable_name_hash(Actor *actor) {
27 if (!actor)
28 return 0;
29 Value name = actor->getAttr("name");
30 if (name.getType() != Value::STRING)
31 return 0;
32 const std::string &s = name.get_string();
33 if (s.empty())
34 return 0;
35 // FNV-1a 32-bit (keep in sync with multiplayer_session_sync.cc).
36 uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
37 for (unsigned char c : s) {
38 h ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(c);
39 h *= 16777619u;
40 }
41 return h ? h : 1u;
42}

66bool equal_input(const input::PlayerInput &a, const input::PlayerInput &b) {
67 return a.mouse_force[0] == b.mouse_force[0] && a.mouse_force[1] == b.mouse_force[1] &&

71int keep_ticks() {
72 int keep = options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugRollbackKeepTicks");
73 if (keep <= 0)
74 keep = 200;
75 // Rollback must cover (1) the input delay we stamp into the future, plus
76 // (2) the resend back-window for input bundles, plus a small jitter margin.
77 // Otherwise the host will frequently receive client inputs "too late to replay",
78 // simulate with zero inputs, and the client will snap back on resync.
79 int min_keep = 0;
80 if (input::IsNetworked() && input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled()) {
81 const uint32_t delay = internal::g_session.input_delay ? internal::g_session.input_delay : internal::kInputDelay;
82 uint32_t back = internal::kInputBundleBackTicksDirect;
83 switch (internal::g_session.active_transport) {
84 case TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
85 back = internal::kInputBundleBackTicksUdpRelay;
86 break;
87 case TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
88 back = internal::kInputBundleBackTicksTcpRelay;
89 break;
90 case TransportKind::DIRECT:
91 default:
92 back = internal::kInputBundleBackTicksDirect;
93 break;
94 }
95 min_keep = static_cast<int>(delay + back + 10);
96 }
97 if (min_keep > 0 && keep < min_keep)
98 keep = min_keep;
99 if (keep > 5000)
100 keep = 5000;
101 return keep;
102}
103
104bool should_enable() {
105 if (!multiplayer::IsActive())
106 return false;
107 if (!input::IsNetworked())
108 return false;
109 // In an authoritative-host model the host must remain monotonic (no rewinding).
110 // Only clients use rollback/replay for resync reconciliation.
111 if (internal::g_session.host)
112 return false;
113 if (!input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled())
114 return false;
115 if (!options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRollbackEnabled"))
116 return false;
117 return true;
118}

120const Frame *find_frame_ptr(uint32_t tick) {
121 for (auto it = g_frames.rbegin(); it != g_frames.rend(); ++it) {
122 if (it->tick == tick)
123 return &(*it);
124 if (it->tick < tick)
125 break;
126 }
127 return nullptr;
128}
129
130void prune_history() {
131 const int keep = keep_ticks();
132 if (keep <= 0)
133 return;
134 uint32_t prune_before = 0;
135 if (g_max_history_tick > static_cast<uint32_t>(keep))
136 prune_before = g_max_history_tick - static_cast<uint32_t>(keep);
137 for (auto it = g_history.begin(); it != g_history.end();) {
138 if (it->first < prune_before)
139 it = g_history.erase(it);
140 else
141 ++it;
142 }
143}
144
145void prune_frames() {
146 const int keep = keep_ticks();
147 if (keep <= 0)
148 return;
149 while (g_frames.size() > static_cast<size_t>(keep))
150 g_frames.pop_front();
151}

153void inject_inputs(uint32_t from_tick, uint32_t to_tick) {
154 const unsigned players = input::ExpectedPlayers();
155 for (uint32_t tick = from_tick; tick < to_tick; ++tick) {
156 auto it = g_history.find(tick);
157 if (it == g_history.end())
158 continue;
159 for (unsigned player = 0; player < players && player < input::kMaxPlayers; ++player) {
160 if (!it->second.present.test(player))
161 continue;
162 input::EnqueueInput(tick, player, it->second.inputs[player]);
163 }
164 }
165}
166
167void store_frame(uint32_t tick, sim_snapshot::Snapshot &&snap) {
168 // Keep frames unique by tick so lookups are stable even after replay.
169 for (auto it = g_frames.rbegin(); it != g_frames.rend(); ++it) {
170 if (it->tick == tick) {
171 it->snap = std::move(snap);
172 return;
173 }
174 if (it->tick < tick)
175 break;
176 }
177 Frame f;
178 f.tick = tick;
179 f.snap = std::move(snap);
180 g_frames.push_back(std::move(f));
181 prune_frames();
182}
183
184bool find_frame(uint32_t tick, Frame &out) {
185 for (auto it = g_frames.rbegin(); it != g_frames.rend(); ++it) {
186 if (it->tick == tick) {
187 out = *it; // copy snapshot (vectors)
188 return true;
189 }
190 if (it->tick < tick)
191 break;
192 }
193 return false;
194}
195
196bool oldest_frame_tick(uint32_t &out) {
197 if (g_frames.empty())
198 return false;
199 out = g_frames.front().tick;
200 return true;
201}

234bool TryQueueReconcileResyncState(const protocol::ResyncState &state) {
235 if (!should_enable())
236 return false;
237 if (internal::g_session.host)
238 return false;
239 if (g_replaying)
240 return false;
241 if (state.epoch != internal::g_session.input_epoch)
242 return false;
243 if (!internal::g_session.local_player_known ||
244 internal::g_session.local_player >= internal::g_session.expected_players) {
245 return false;
246 }
247
248 const uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
249 if (state.tick > local_tick)
250 return false;
251
252 const Frame *f = find_frame_ptr(state.tick);
253 if (!f)
254 return false;
255
256 Actor *local_actor = player::GetMainActor(internal::g_session.local_player);
257 if (!local_actor)
258 return false;
259 const int local_id = local_actor->getId();
260
261 const sim_snapshot::ActorSnapshot *pred = nullptr;
262 for (const auto &a : f->snap.actors) {
263 if (a.object_id == local_id) {
264 pred = &a;
265 break;
266 }
267 }
268 if (!pred)
269 return false;
270
271 const float pred_x = static_cast<float>(pred->info.pos[0]);
272 const float pred_y = static_cast<float>(pred->info.pos[1]);
273
274 const protocol::ResyncActorState *auth = nullptr;
275 const char *auth_match = nullptr;
276 // Pass 1: match by object_id (best fidelity, but can diverge across peers).
277 for (const auto &a : state.actors) {
278 if (static_cast<int>(a.object_id) == local_id) {
279 auth = &a;
280 auth_match = "object_id";
281 break;
282 }
283 }
284 // Pass 2: match by (kind, stable name hash) when available (more robust).
285 if (!auth) {
286 const uint32_t nh = stable_name_hash(local_actor);
287 if (nh) {
288 const uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(local_actor));
289 const protocol::ResyncActorState *best = nullptr;
290 double best_d2 = 0.0;
291 for (const auto &a : state.actors) {
292 if (a.name_hash != nh || a.actor_id != kind)
293 continue;
294 const double dx = static_cast<double>(pred_x) - static_cast<double>(a.x);
295 const double dy = static_cast<double>(pred_y) - static_cast<double>(a.y);
296 const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
297 if (!best || d2 < best_d2) {
298 best = &a;
299 best_d2 = d2;
300 }
301 }
302 auth = best;
303 if (auth)
304 auth_match = "name";
305 }
306 }
307 // Pass 3: match by (kind, owner) (fallback for unnamed multi-actor levels).
308 if (!auth) {
309 const uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(local_actor));
310 const int owner = static_cast<int>(internal::g_session.local_player);
311 const protocol::ResyncActorState *best = nullptr;
312 double best_d2 = 0.0;
313 for (const auto &a : state.actors) {
314 if (a.actor_id != kind)
315 continue;
316 int a_owner = (a.owner == 0xFFFF) ? -1 : static_cast<int>(a.owner);
317 if (a_owner != owner)
318 continue;
319 const double dx = static_cast<double>(pred_x) - static_cast<double>(a.x);
320 const double dy = static_cast<double>(pred_y) - static_cast<double>(a.y);
321 const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
322 if (!best || d2 < best_d2) {
323 best = &a;
324 best_d2 = d2;
325 }
326 }
327 auth = best;
328 if (auth)
329 auth_match = "owner";
330 }
331 // Pass 4: match by kind only.
332 if (!auth) {
333 const uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(local_actor));
334 const protocol::ResyncActorState *best = nullptr;
335 double best_d2 = 0.0;
336 for (const auto &a : state.actors) {
337 if (a.actor_id != kind)
338 continue;
339 const double dx = static_cast<double>(pred_x) - static_cast<double>(a.x);
340 const double dy = static_cast<double>(pred_y) - static_cast<double>(a.y);
341 const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
342 if (!best || d2 < best_d2) {
343 best = &a;
344 best_d2 = d2;
345 }
346 }
347 auth = best;
348 if (auth)
349 auth_match = "kind";
350 }
351 if (!auth)
352 return false;
353
354 const float dx = pred_x - auth->x;
355 const float dy = pred_y - auth->y;
356 const float d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
357 const float err = static_cast<float>(std::sqrt(d2));
358
359 // Auto-tune input delay for this client when we observe large authoritative
360 // corrections for the locally controlled actor. This reduces late/missing
361 // inputs at the host (and thus visible "kicks" and rubber-banding), at the
362 // cost of higher input latency. Only increases during a session.
363 {
364 const uint32_t now = input::CurrentTick();
365 const uint32_t min_bump_interval_ticks = 100; // ~1s at 10ms/tick.
366 const uint32_t min_tick = 50; // ignore early join noise.
367 const uint32_t max_delay = std::min<uint32_t>(internal::kMaxInputLead, 30u);
368 if (now > min_tick && err >= 0.75f && internal::g_session.input_delay < max_delay &&
369 (g_last_auto_delay_bump_tick == 0 ||
370 now - g_last_auto_delay_bump_tick >= min_bump_interval_ticks)) {
371 uint32_t step = (err >= 1.5f) ? 2u : 1u;
372 uint32_t old = internal::g_session.input_delay;
373 uint32_t next = old + step;
374 if (next > max_delay)
375 next = max_delay;
376 if (next != old) {
377 internal::g_session.input_delay = next;
378 g_last_auto_delay_bump_tick = now;
379 internal::debug_log("mp auto input delay bump: %u -> %u (err=%.3f)",
380 static_cast<unsigned>(old),
381 static_cast<unsigned>(next),
382 static_cast<double>(err));
383 }
384 }
385 }
386
387 // Only pay the cost of rollback+replay when the local prediction at that tick
388 // meaningfully differs from the authoritative snapshot.
389 if (d2 < (0.25f * 0.25f))
390 return false;
391
392 // Coalesce: keep the newest queued authoritative snapshot.
393 if (!g_pending_resync || state.tick >= g_pending_resync_state.tick) {
394 g_pending_resync_state = state;
395 g_pending_resync = true;
396 }
397 internal::debug_log("mp resync reconcile queued: tick=%u match=%s err=%.3f",
398 static_cast<unsigned>(state.tick),
399 auth_match ? auth_match : "unknown",
400 static_cast<double>(err));
401 return true;
402}
403
404void RecordInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player, const input::PlayerInput &pi) {
405 if (!should_enable())
406 return;
407 if (g_replaying)
408 return;
409 if (player >= input::kMaxPlayers)
410 return;
411
412 HistoryTick &slot = g_history[tick];
413 const bool had = slot.present.test(player);
414 const input::PlayerInput prev = slot.inputs[player];
415 slot.inputs[player] = pi;
416 slot.present.set(player);
417
418 if (tick > g_max_history_tick)
419 g_max_history_tick = tick;
420 prune_history();
421
422 const uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
423 if (tick >= current_tick)
424 return;
425
426 (void)had;
427 (void)prev;
428 // Do not roll back on late inputs: under lossy/jittery links this causes the
429 // host (and clients) to constantly rewrite history and "jump around". Instead,
430 // reconcile only when authoritative snapshots arrive (g_pending_resync).
431}
432
433void OnBeforeSimTick(uint32_t tick) {
434 if (!should_enable())
435 return;
436 if (g_replaying)
437 return;
438 if (tick == g_last_snapshot_tick)
439 return;
440
441 store_frame(tick, sim_snapshot::Capture());
442 g_last_snapshot_tick = tick;
443}
444
445void MaybeRollback(double timestep) {
446 if (!should_enable())
447 return;
448 if (g_replaying)
449 return;
450 if (g_pending_tick == UINT32_MAX && !g_pending_resync)
451 return;
452
453 const uint32_t target_tick = input::CurrentTick();
454 uint32_t rollback_tick = g_pending_tick;
455 bool apply_authoritative = false;
456 protocol::ResyncState authoritative;
457 if (g_pending_resync) {
458 if (rollback_tick == UINT32_MAX || g_pending_resync_state.tick <= rollback_tick) {
459 rollback_tick = g_pending_resync_state.tick;
460 authoritative = g_pending_resync_state;
461 apply_authoritative = true;
462 }
463 }
464 if (rollback_tick == UINT32_MAX)
465 return;
466 if (rollback_tick >= target_tick) {
467 if (rollback_tick == g_pending_tick)
468 g_pending_tick = UINT32_MAX;
469 if (apply_authoritative)
470 g_pending_resync = false;
471 return;
472 }
473
474 Frame frame;
475 if (!find_frame(rollback_tick, frame)) {
476 uint32_t oldest = 0;
477 if (!oldest_frame_tick(oldest)) {
478 g_pending_tick = UINT32_MAX;
479 g_pending_resync = false;
480 return;
481 }
482 if (rollback_tick < oldest)
483 rollback_tick = oldest;
484 if (!find_frame(rollback_tick, frame)) {
485 g_pending_tick = UINT32_MAX;
486 g_pending_resync = false;
487 return;
488 }
489 }
490
491 // Clear pending first: replay may trigger further late inputs.
492 if (rollback_tick == g_pending_tick)
493 g_pending_tick = UINT32_MAX;
494 if (apply_authoritative)
495 g_pending_resync = false;
496
497 internal::debug_log("mp rollback: from tick=%u to tick=%u", rollback_tick, target_tick);
498
499 g_replaying = true;
500 sim_snapshot::Restore(frame.snap);
501
502 if (apply_authoritative) {
503 // Apply the authoritative host snapshot at the rollback tick, then replay
504 // locally known inputs forward to "now".
505 internal::apply_resync_state(authoritative);
506 }
507
508 // After restoring, re-inject the best-known inputs (including those that
509 // arrived after the snapshot was taken).
510 inject_inputs(rollback_tick, target_tick);
511
512 // Replay forward to the original tick.
513 while (input::CurrentTick() < target_tick) {
514 const uint32_t t = input::CurrentTick();
515 store_frame(t, sim_snapshot::Capture());
516 g_last_snapshot_tick = t;
517
518 // Mirror the main loop order used by the test driver and typical gameplay:
519 // advance model animations (and their callbacks) before the next sim tick.
520 // This matters because some objects (e.g. balls) still couple gameplay state
521 // transitions to animation callbacks.
522 display::Tick(timestep);
523 server::SimulateOneTick(timestep);
524 }
525
526 g_replaying = false;
527}
528
529} // namespace rollback
530} // namespace multiplayer
531} // namespace enigma

68bool SessionShouldDeferStart() {
69 if (!g_session.active)
70 return false;
71 // For hosts, "ready" means that all expected peers have connected and reported READY
72 // (and that any extra-actor placement is complete). This must gate simulation start,
73 // otherwise the host can run ahead while a client is still switching packs / loading.
74 bool can_start = false;
75 if (g_session.host) {
76 if (g_session.expected_players <= 1)
77 can_start = true;
78 else
79 can_start = host_ready_to_start();
80 } else {
81 can_start = (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START ||
82 g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::RUNNING);
83 }
84 if (debug_enabled()) {
85 int v = can_start ? 0 : 1;
86 if (g_session.last_defer_start_log != v) {
87 debug_log("mp should defer start: %d", v);
88 g_session.last_defer_start_log = v;
89 }
90 }
91 return !can_start;
92}
93
94void SessionNotifyStartRequested() {
95 if (!g_session.active)
96 return;
97 if (debug_enabled())
98 debug_log("mp notify start requested (host=%d local=%u expected=%u)", g_session.host ? 1 : 0,
99 g_session.local_player, g_session.expected_players);
100 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING)
101 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY;
102 // READY must mean "the level is fully initialized and the client is waiting
103 // for NET_START". During level loading, server::PrepareLevel() sets
104 // sv_waiting_for_clients early, so Msg_StartGame() can be invoked before the
105 // world is initialized; guard against sending READY too early.
106 if (!g_session.host && server::WorldInitialized && local_can_send_ready() &&
107 !g_session.local_ready_sent) {
108 send_ready_to_host();
109 g_session.local_ready_sent = true;
110 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
111 }
112}
113
114void SessionNotifyRestart(bool level_restart) {
115 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.host)
116 return;
117 // If someone had the multiplayer ESC menu open, force-unpause before restarting.
118 if (g_session.paused) {
119 g_session.paused = false;
120 if (!g_session.menu_open.empty())
121 std::fill(g_session.menu_open.begin(), g_session.menu_open.end(), false);
122 server::Msg_Pause(false);
123 send_pause_to_peers(false);
124 }
125 g_session.restart_id += 1;
126 g_session.last_restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
127 send_restart_to_peers(level_restart);
128}
129
130void SessionNotifyLoadLevel(const std::string &pack_name, const std::string &level_id) {
131 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.host)
132 return;
133 g_session.load_id += 1;
134 g_session.level_pack_name = pack_name;
135 g_session.level_id = level_id;
136 if (debug_enabled())
137 debug_log("mp host: load level id=%u pack=%s level_id=%s",
138 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.load_id),
139 pack_name.c_str(), level_id.c_str());

175void debug_dump_steerable_actors(const char *tag) {
176 if (!debug_enabled())
177 return;
178 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
179 GetActors(actors);
180 unsigned dumped = 0;
181 for (auto *a : actors) {
182 if (!a || !a->isSteerable())
183 continue;
184 if (dumped >= 32) {
185 debug_log("mp actors(%s): ... (truncated)", tag);
186 return;
187 }
188 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
189 Value color = a->getAttr("color");
190 debug_log("mp actor(%s): kind=%s pos=(%.2f,%.2f) ctrl=%d owner=%s color=%s", tag,
191 a->getKind().c_str(), a->get_pos()[0], a->get_pos()[1], a->get_controllers(),
192 owner ? owner.to_string().c_str() : "nil",
193 color ? color.to_string().c_str() : "nil");
194 dumped += 1;
195 }
196 if (dumped == 0)
197 debug_log("mp actors(%s): none steerable", tag);
198}
