279void SessionSetupExtraPlayerStartPositions() {
280 if (!g_session.active)
281 return;
282 if (g_session.level_players == 0)
283 g_session.level_players = compute_level_players();
284 if (g_session.level_players < 1)
285 g_session.level_players = 1;
286
287 // Some levels run Lua/setup logic during WorldInitLevel that can overwrite
288 // controllers/owner for steerable actors (notably meditation pearls). Run a
289 // post-init rebalance to ensure authored multi-ball levels are distributed
290 // across session players as intended.
291 rebalance_authored_multi_ball_levels(g_session.level_players, g_session.expected_players);
292
293 g_session.placement_received.clear();
294 if (g_session.expected_players > 0) {
295 g_session.placement_received.resize(g_session.expected_players, false);
296 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
297 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
298 g_session.placement_received[player] = true;
299 }
300 }
301 auto_place_extra_players();
302
303 // Some levels have no valid placement tiles (or no meaningful base actor to place near),
304 // so auto placement can fail and leave the host waiting forever. We intentionally do not
305 // try to "solve" such esoteric levels: instead, fail open and start the session. The extra
306 // actors remain at their deterministic initial spawn position, which is consistent across
307 // peers as long as level loading is deterministic.
308 if (g_session.host && g_session.expected_players > g_session.level_players &&
309 g_session.level_players > 0) {
310 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players;
311 ++player) {
312 if (player < g_session.placement_received.size() && !g_session.placement_received[player]) {
313 if (debug_enabled())
314 debug_log("mp extra actors: placement failed for player=%u; starting anyway",
315 player);
316 g_session.placement_received[player] = true;
317 }
318 }
319 }
320 debug_dump_steerable_actors("post-place");
321}

378namespace {
379
380Uint32 percentile_ms(std::vector<Uint32> samples, double p) {
381 if (samples.empty())
382 return 0;
383 if (p <= 0.0)
384 p = 0.0;
385 if (p >= 1.0)
386 p = 1.0;
387 std::sort(samples.begin(), samples.end());
388 const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(std::floor(p * static_cast<double>(samples.size() - 1)));
389 return samples[idx];
390}

392int classify_connectivity_preset(Uint32 worst_p90_ms) {
393 // Thresholds are conservative: we prefer a slower but stable experience.
394 if (worst_p90_ms <= 70)
395 return 0; // good
396 if (worst_p90_ms <= 180)
397 return 1; // mediocre
398 return 2; // bad
399}

401void apply_connectivity_preset_to_options(int preset_id) {
402 // Keep in sync with the UI presets (OptionsMenu::apply_mp_debug_preset()).
403 bool zerofill = false;
404 bool rollback = false;
405 bool remote_local_ball = false;
406 int tick_ms = 10;
407 int input_delay_legacy_ticks = 4;
408 int predict_mouse_ticks = 0;
409 int host_resync_stride = 50;
410 int host_world_stride = 50;
411
412 if (preset_id == 1) { // mediocre
413 zerofill = true;
414 rollback = true;
415 remote_local_ball = false;
416 tick_ms = 20;
417 input_delay_legacy_ticks = 8;
418 predict_mouse_ticks = 2;
419 host_resync_stride = 25;
420 host_world_stride = 25;
421 } else if (preset_id == 2) { // bad
422 zerofill = true;
423 rollback = true;
424 remote_local_ball = true;
425 tick_ms = 50;
426 input_delay_legacy_ticks = 16;
427 predict_mouse_ticks = 5;
428 host_resync_stride = 10;
429 host_world_stride = 10;
430 }
431
432 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugSmoothRender", true);
433 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugZeroFillInputs", zerofill);
434 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugRollbackEnabled", rollback);
435 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall", remote_local_ball);
436
437 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugTickLengthMs", static_cast<double>(tick_ms));
438 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugInputDelayTicks", static_cast<double>(input_delay_legacy_ticks));
439 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugPredictMissingMouseTicks", static_cast<double>(predict_mouse_ticks));
440 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastResyncStrideTicks", static_cast<double>(host_resync_stride));
441 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastWorldStateStrideTicks", static_cast<double>(host_world_stride));
442 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugRollbackKeepTicks", 200.0);
443
444 // Ensure the host session uses the chosen tick immediately (before NET_START).
445 g_session.tick_ms = static_cast<Uint16>(tick_ms);
446 input::SetTickTimestep(static_cast<double>(g_session.tick_ms) / 1000.0);
447}

449void host_send_ping_to_remote(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, Uint32 relay_client_id, Uint32 ping_id) {
450 protocol::PingPacket msg;
451 msg.ping_id = ping_id;
452 ecl::Buffer payload;
453 protocol::encode_ping(payload, msg);
454 if (source == HostSource::DIRECT) {
455 g_transport.HostSendDirectUnreliable(peer, payload);
456 return;
457 }
458 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
459 g_transport.HostSendUdpRelay(relay_client_id, payload);
460 return;
461 }
462 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
463 g_transport.HostSendTcpRelay(relay_client_id, payload);
464 return;
465 }
466}
467
468void start_host_auto_detect_connectivity() {
469 g_session.auto_detect_active = true;
470 g_session.auto_detect_done = false;
471 g_session.auto_detect_selected_preset = -1;
472 g_session.auto_detect_next_ping_id = 1;
473 const Uint32 now_ms = SDL_GetTicks();
474 g_session.auto_detect_next_send_ms = now_ms;
475 g_session.auto_detect_end_ms = now_ms + 1200; // ~12 pings @ 100ms
476
477 const size_t n = g_session.expected_players;
478 g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms.assign(n, std::unordered_map<Uint32, Uint32>());
479 g_session.auto_detect_rtts_ms.assign(n, std::vector<Uint32>());
480 g_session.auto_detect_sent.assign(n, 0);
481 g_session.auto_detect_recv.assign(n, 0);
482}
483
484bool tick_host_auto_detect_connectivity() {
485 if (!g_session.auto_detect_active)
486 return true;
487 const Uint32 now_ms = SDL_GetTicks();
488
489 if (now_ms >= g_session.auto_detect_next_send_ms && now_ms < g_session.auto_detect_end_ms) {
490 // Send one ping per remote player.
491 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
492 ENetPeer *peer = entry.first;
493 const unsigned player_id = entry.second;
494 if (player_id >= g_session.expected_players)
495 continue;
496 const Uint32 ping_id = g_session.auto_detect_next_ping_id++;
497 g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms[player_id][ping_id] = now_ms;
498 g_session.auto_detect_sent[player_id] += 1;
499 host_send_ping_to_remote(HostSource::DIRECT, peer, 0, ping_id);
500 }
501 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
502 const Uint32 client_id = entry.first;
503 const unsigned player_id = entry.second;
504 if (player_id >= g_session.expected_players)
505 continue;
506 const Uint32 ping_id = g_session.auto_detect_next_ping_id++;
507 g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms[player_id][ping_id] = now_ms;
508 g_session.auto_detect_sent[player_id] += 1;
509 host_send_ping_to_remote(HostSource::UDP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id, ping_id);
510 }
511 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
512 const Uint32 client_id = entry.first;
513 const unsigned player_id = entry.second;
514 if (player_id >= g_session.expected_players)
515 continue;
516 const Uint32 ping_id = g_session.auto_detect_next_ping_id++;
517 g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms[player_id][ping_id] = now_ms;
518 g_session.auto_detect_sent[player_id] += 1;
519 host_send_ping_to_remote(HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id, ping_id);
520 }
521 g_transport.Flush();
522 g_session.auto_detect_next_send_ms = now_ms + 100;
523 }
524
525 if (now_ms < g_session.auto_detect_end_ms)
526 return false;
527
528 // Finish: classify based on worst p90 RTT across remotes.
529 Uint32 worst_p90 = 0;
530 for (unsigned player = 1; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
531 Uint32 p90 = percentile_ms(g_session.auto_detect_rtts_ms[player], 0.90);
532 // If we got no responses, treat as extremely bad.
533 if (g_session.auto_detect_rtts_ms[player].empty())
534 p90 = 10000;
535 if (p90 > worst_p90)
536 worst_p90 = p90;
537 }
538 const int preset = classify_connectivity_preset(worst_p90);
539 g_session.auto_detect_selected_preset = preset;
540 g_session.auto_detect_active = false;
541 g_session.auto_detect_done = true;
542 debug_log("mp auto-detect: worst_p90_rtt_ms=%u preset=%d", static_cast<unsigned>(worst_p90), preset);
543 return true;
544}

546void tick_advance_input_clock(double dtime) {
547 g_session.input_clock_accu += dtime;
548 if (g_session.input_clock_accu > 1.0)
549 g_session.input_clock_accu = 1.0;
550 const double step = input::TickTimestep();
551 while (g_session.input_clock_accu >= step) {
552 g_session.input_clock_accu -= step;
553 g_session.input_clock_tick += 1;
554 }
555}

557void tick_apply_pending_sync() {
558 if (!g_session.has_pending_sync)
559 return;
560 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
561 if (local_tick == g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
562 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
563 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
564 handle_sync_current(sync);
565 } else if (local_tick > g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
566 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
567 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
568 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample))
569 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
570 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
571 }
572}

621void tick_debug_report_missing_input() {
622 if (!debug_enabled() || !g_session.local_player_known || !input::IsNetworked())
623 return;
624 static uint32_t last_missing_tick = UINT32_MAX;
625 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
626 if (tick == last_missing_tick)
627 return;
628 bool missing = false;
629 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
630 if (!input::HasInput(tick, player)) {
631 debug_log("mp missing input: tick=%u player=%u", tick, player);
632 missing = true;
633 }
634 }
635 if (missing)
636 last_missing_tick = tick;
637}
638
639void tick_update_start_phase() {
640 if (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY && g_session.host) {
641 if (!host_ready_to_start()) {
642 // Robustness: keep re-announcing the current level load while waiting for READY.
643 // This covers packet loss and ensures clients can satisfy the "must have seen
644 // NET_LOAD_LEVEL before READY" invariant.
645 if (has_remote_peers() && g_session.load_id != 0 && !g_session.level_id.empty()) {
646 g_session.load_announce_timer += input::TickTimestep();
647 if (g_session.load_announce_timer >= 1.0) {
648 send_load_level_to_peers(g_session.level_pack_name, g_session.level_id);
649 g_session.load_announce_timer = 0.0;
650 }
651 }
652 if (debug_enabled()) {
653 static Uint32 last_sid = 0;
654 static Uint32 last_epoch = 0;
655 static Uint32 last_load = 0;
656 static double wait_accu = 0.0;
657 if (g_session.session_id != last_sid || g_session.input_epoch != last_epoch ||
658 g_session.load_id != last_load) {
659 last_sid = g_session.session_id;
660 last_epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
661 last_load = g_session.load_id;
662 wait_accu = 0.0;
663 }
664 wait_accu += input::TickTimestep();
665 if (wait_accu >= 2.0) {
666 wait_accu = 0.0;
667 unsigned direct = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.peer_players.size());
668 unsigned udp = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.relay_players.size());
669 unsigned tcp = static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.tcp_relay_players.size());
670 debug_log("mp host: waiting for ready (session=%u epoch=%u load=%u expected=%u have=%u direct=%u udp=%u tcp=%u)",
671 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.session_id),
672 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.input_epoch),
673 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.load_id),
674 g_session.expected_players,
675 direct + udp + tcp + 1,
676 direct, udp, tcp);
677 if (g_session.expected_players > 1) {
678 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
679 auto it = g_session.peer_ready.find(entry.first);
680 if (it == g_session.peer_ready.end() || !it->second)
681 debug_log("mp host: missing ready (direct peer=%p player=%u)",
682 static_cast<void *>(entry.first), entry.second);
683 }
684 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
685 auto it = g_session.relay_ready.find(entry.first);
686 if (it == g_session.relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
687 debug_log("mp host: missing ready (udp relay client=%u player=%u)",
688 static_cast<unsigned>(entry.first), entry.second);
689 }
690 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
691 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_ready.find(entry.first);
692 if (it == g_session.tcp_relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
693 debug_log("mp host: missing ready (tcp relay client=%u player=%u)",
694 static_cast<unsigned>(entry.first), entry.second);
695 }
696 }
697 if (g_session.expected_players > g_session.level_players && g_session.level_players > 0) {
698 if (g_session.placement_received.size() < g_session.expected_players) {
699 debug_log("mp host: missing placements (vector size=%u expected=%u)",
700 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.placement_received.size()),
701 g_session.expected_players);
702 } else {
703 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
704 if (!g_session.placement_received[player])
705 debug_log("mp host: missing placement player=%u", player);
706 }
707 }
708 }
709 }
710 }
711 return;
712 }
713 g_session.load_announce_timer = 0.0;
714 if (debug_enabled())
715 debug_log("mp host: start allowed");
716
717 // Ensure all peers use the same host-selected debug/session settings before NET_START.
718 // If auto-detect is enabled, override the host's manual settings with the chosen preset.
719 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerAutoDetectConnectivity") && g_session.expected_players > 1) {
720 if (!g_session.auto_detect_done && !g_session.auto_detect_active)
721 start_host_auto_detect_connectivity();
722 if (!tick_host_auto_detect_connectivity())
723 return;
724 if (g_session.auto_detect_selected_preset >= 0)
725 apply_connectivity_preset_to_options(g_session.auto_detect_selected_preset);
726 }
727 SessionBroadcastDebugOptions();
728
729 g_session.input_epoch += 1;
730 g_session.debug_state_dumped = false;
731 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
732 send_start_to_peers();
733 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START;
734 }
735
736 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START)
737 return;
738 server::Msg_StartGame();
739 // Msg_StartGame can still be deferred (e.g. host has not observed connected peers yet).
740 // Only transition to RUNNING once the session logic says we can actually start.
741 if (SessionShouldDeferStart())
742 return;
743 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::RUNNING;
744}

746void tick_host_periodic_sync(double dtime) {
747 if (!g_session.host)
748 return;
749 g_session.sync_timer += dtime;
750 if (g_session.sync_timer < kSyncInterval)
751 return;
752 g_session.sync_timer = 0.0;
753 send_sync_to_peers();
754}
755
756void tick_host_broadcast_resync() {
757 if (!g_session.host || !has_remote_peers())
758 return;
759 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING)
760 return;
761 int legacy_stride = options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastResyncStrideTicks");
762 int stride = legacy_stride;
763 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall")) {
764 // Remote-control mode relies on frequent authoritative actor snapshots.
765 // Force a per-tick resync broadcast so the local ball stays responsive.
766 stride = 1;
767 }
768 if (legacy_stride > 0) {
769 // Keep debug UX stable across tick sizes: interpret stride as 10ms ticks.
770 const double tick_s = input::TickTimestep();
771 const double legacy_s = 0.01;
772 if (tick_s > 0.0) {
773 const double desired_s = static_cast<double>(legacy_stride) * legacy_s;
774 stride = static_cast<int>(std::lround(desired_s / tick_s));
775 if (stride < 1)
776 stride = 1;
777 }
778 }
779 if (stride <= 0)
780 return;
781 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
782 if (tick == g_session.last_host_resync_broadcast_tick)
783 return;
784 if (stride < 1)
785 stride = 1;
786 if ((tick % static_cast<uint32_t>(stride)) != 0)
787 return;
788 g_session.last_host_resync_broadcast_tick = tick;
789 broadcast_resync_state_unreliable();
790}
791

794 return;

796 return;
797 int legacy_stride = options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastWorldStateStrideTicks");
798 int stride = legacy_stride;
799 if (legacy_stride > 0) {
800 // Keep debug UX stable across tick sizes: interpret stride as 10ms ticks.
801 const double tick_s = input::TickTimestep();
802 const double legacy_s = 0.01;

804 const double desired_s = static_cast<double>(legacy_stride) * legacy_s;
805 stride = static_cast<int>(std::lround(desired_s / tick_s));
806 if (stride < 1)
807 stride = 1;
808 }
809 }
810 if (stride <= 0)
811 return;
812 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
813 if (tick == g_session.last_host_world_state_broadcast_tick)
814 return;
815 if (stride < 1)
816 stride = 1;
817 if ((tick % static_cast<uint32_t>(stride)) != 0)

823void shutdown_enet_host_state() {
824 if (g_session.relay_peer) {
825 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.relay_peer, 0);
826 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
827 }
828 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
829 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
830 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
831 }
832
833 if (!g_session.host_handle)
834 return;
835 if (g_session.host) {
836 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players)
837 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.first, 0);
838 } else if (g_session.server_peer) {
839 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.server_peer, 0);
840 }
841 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
842 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
843 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
844}

848void SessionTick(double dtime) {
849 if (!g_session.active)
850 return;
851 if (g_session.abort_pending) {
852 process_network_events();
853 tick_abort_grace(dtime);
854 return;
855 }
856 // While paused we still need to pump the network (for unpause / disconnect),
857 // but we must not advance the input clock or emit inputs.
858 if (g_session.paused) {
859 process_network_events();
860 return;
861 }
862 g_session.no_payload_timer += dtime;
863 if (!g_session.input_clock_frozen)
864 tick_advance_input_clock(dtime);
865 process_network_events();
866 if (!g_session.active)
867 return;
868 if (g_session.paused)
869 return;
870 if (g_session.abort_pending)
871 return;
872 tick_apply_pending_sync();
873 record_checksum_sample();
874 tick_update_resync_cooldown(dtime);
875 tick_update_world_state_cooldown(dtime);
876 tick_update_resync_inflight_timeout(dtime);
877 tick_send_periodic_ready(dtime);
878 tick_debug_report_missing_input();
879 tick_update_start_phase();
880 send_local_inputs();
881 tick_host_periodic_sync(dtime);
882 tick_host_broadcast_resync();
883 tick_host_broadcast_world_state();
884}
885
886void SessionShutdown() {
887 if (!g_session.active)
888 return;
889 if (debug_enabled()) {
890 const auto &t = g_session.telemetry;
891 debug_log("mp telemetry: sync_current=%llu sync_sample=%llu "
892 "mismatch(pos=%llu rand=%llu actor=%llu world=%llu) "
893 "classified(diag_only=%llu rng_only=%llu soft_candidate=%llu) "
894 "rng_fixed=%llu resync(req=%llu resp=%llu applied=%llu timeout=%llu giveup=%llu)",
895 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.sync_current_total),
896 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.sync_sample_total),
897 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_pos),
898 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_rand),
899 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_actor),
900 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_world),
901 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_diagnostic_only),
902 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_rng_only),
903 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate),
904 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.rng_resync_applied),
905 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_requests_sent),
906 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_responses_recv),
907 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_applied),
908 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_inflight_timeouts),
909 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_giveups));
910 }
911 shutdown_enet_host_state();
912 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
913 g_session = SessionState();
914 input::Reset();
915}

A src/multiplayer_session_start.cc

Description
  • Session start/join handshake logic (host and client) over the selected transport.
Where it is used
  • Used when starting a level from the multiplayer lobby.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Implements deterministic start sequencing and readiness gating across peers.
  • Improves diagnostics and robustness of joins: logs ENet connect events and ignores WELCOME packets that don't match the expected session seed (guards against late/stale packets).
  • Uses ENet-version-compatible address logging paths so the same code builds with both vendored ENet 1.0 and system ENet 1.3.
  • When ENet >= 1.3 is available, configures peer timeout to tolerate transient outages and align with the in-game stall wait dialog.

52 * Session start/join handshakes.

54 * Builds the transport connection (direct or relay) and initializes the
55 * deterministic runtime state before unpausing the simulation.

62namespace {
63constexpr double kLegacyTickSeconds = 0.01; // historical tick duration (10ms)
64
65Uint16 read_tick_ms_override() {
66 int ms = options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugTickLengthMs");
67 if (ms <= 0)
68 ms = 10;
69 if (ms < 5)
70 ms = 5;
71 if (ms > 50)
72 ms = 50;
73 return static_cast<Uint16>(ms);
74}
75
76uint32_t legacy_ticks_to_current_delay_ticks(uint32_t legacy_ticks, double tick_seconds) {
77 if (legacy_ticks == 0)
78 return 0;
79 if (tick_seconds <= 0.0)
80 return legacy_ticks;
81 // Delay is safety-critical: round up so we don't accidentally under-delay.
82 const double desired_s = static_cast<double>(legacy_ticks) * kLegacyTickSeconds;
83 uint32_t ticks = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::ceil(desired_s / tick_seconds));
84 if (ticks < 1)
85 ticks = 1;
86 return ticks;
87}
88} // namespace

90void configure_input_session(unsigned expected_players) {
91 // Tick duration must match across peers; it is negotiated by the host and
92 // stored on g_session.tick_ms (clients receive it in WELCOME).
93 Uint16 tick_ms = g_session.tick_ms ? g_session.tick_ms : read_tick_ms_override();
94 g_session.tick_ms = tick_ms;
95 const double tick_seconds = static_cast<double>(tick_ms) / 1000.0;
96
97 // The input stream is stamped for a future tick (input delay). A larger
98 // delay reduces the odds that a peer reaches a tick before receiving the
99 // other players' inputs for that tick.
100 // NOTE: These debug options historically assumed 10ms ticks. Now that tick
101 // duration is configurable, keep the UX stable by interpreting the values
102 // as "legacy ticks" and converting to current ticks.
103 uint32_t legacy_delay =
104 (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) ? kInputDelayTcpRelay : kInputDelay;
105 int delay_override = options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugInputDelayTicks");
106 if (delay_override > 0) {
107 if (delay_override > static_cast<int>(kMaxInputDelayLegacyTicks))
108 delay_override = static_cast<int>(kMaxInputDelayLegacyTicks);
109 legacy_delay = static_cast<uint32_t>(delay_override);
110 }
111 g_session.input_delay = legacy_ticks_to_current_delay_ticks(legacy_delay, tick_seconds);
112 // Current-tick delay still needs a hard cap to avoid pathological enqueue sizes.
113 if (g_session.input_delay > 1024)
114 g_session.input_delay = 1024;
115 if (debug_enabled())
116 debug_log("mp input delay=%u (legacy=%u) transport=%s tick_ms=%u",
117 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.input_delay),
118 static_cast<unsigned>(legacy_delay),
119 transport_name(g_session.active_transport),
120 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.tick_ms));
121 input::Reset();
122 input::SetTickTimestep(static_cast<double>(tick_ms) / 1000.0);
123 input::SetNetworked(true);
124 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
125 for (uint32_t tick = 0; tick < g_session.input_delay; ++tick) {
126 for (unsigned player = 0; player < expected_players; ++player) {
127 input::EnqueueInput(tick, player, input::PlayerInput());
128 }
129 }
130 g_session.next_local_tick = g_session.input_delay;
131 g_session.next_send_tick = 0;
132 g_session.local_history.clear();
133 g_session.late_mouse_valid.fill(false);
134 g_session.late_mouse_applied_tick.fill(0);
135 g_session.late_mouse_src_tick.fill(0);
136 g_session.input_clock_tick = input::CurrentTick();
137 g_session.input_clock_accu = 0.0;
138 g_session.last_host_resync_broadcast_tick = UINT32_MAX;
139 g_session.last_host_world_state_broadcast_tick = UINT32_MAX;
140 g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick = 0;
141}

206bool is_numeric_private_ipv4(const std::string &host) {
207 unsigned a = 0, b = 0, c = 0, d = 0;
208 if (std::sscanf(host.c_str(), "%u.%u.%u.%u", &a, &b, &c, &d) != 4)
209 return false;
210 if (a > 255 || b > 255 || c > 255 || d > 255)
211 return false;
212 return (a == 10) ||
213 (a == 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
214 (a == 192 && b == 168) ||
215 (a == 127) ||
216 (a == 169 && b == 254);
217}
218
219bool should_bind_local_interface_for_enet(const std::string &host) {
220 // Binding a UDP socket to a specific local interface can improve behavior on
221 // multi-homed machines (VPNs), but it can also break in VM/NAT setups where
222 // the OS/network stack rewrites or routes differently than our probe expects.
223 // Default: do not bind for LAN/private targets; allow opting in via env var.
224 if (std::getenv("ENIGMA_MP_BIND_LOCAL") != nullptr ||
225 options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugBindLocal"))
226 return true;
227
228 auto ends_with = [](const std::string &s, const char *suffix) -> bool {
229 size_t n = std::strlen(suffix);
230 if (s.size() < n)
231 return false;
232 return s.compare(s.size() - n, n, suffix) == 0;
233 };
234
235 if (host == "localhost" || ends_with(host, ".local") || ends_with(host, ".localdomain"))
236 return false;
237 if (is_numeric_private_ipv4(host))
238 return false;
239 return true;
240}
241
242bool probe_local_bind_ipv4_for_remote(const std::string &remote_host, Uint16 remote_port,
243 std::string &out_local_ip) {
244 out_local_ip.clear();
245 if (remote_host.empty() || remote_port == 0)
246 return false;
247
248 addrinfo hints;
249 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
250 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_DGRAM;
251 hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
252
253 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
254 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(remote_port));
255 if (getaddrinfo(remote_host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
256 return false;
257
258 bool ok = false;
259 for (addrinfo *ai = res; ai; ai = ai->ai_next) {
260 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
261 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
262 continue;
263 if (::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen)) != 0) {
264 tcp_close(s);
265 continue;
266 }
267
268 sockaddr_in local_addr;
269 ::memset(&local_addr, 0, sizeof(local_addr));
270#ifdef WIN32
271 int addr_len = static_cast<int>(sizeof(local_addr));
272#else
273 socklen_t addr_len = static_cast<socklen_t>(sizeof(local_addr));
274#endif
275 if (getsockname(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&local_addr), &addr_len) == 0) {
276 char ipbuf[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
277 ipbuf[0] = '\0';
278 if (inet_ntop(AF_INET, &local_addr.sin_addr, ipbuf, sizeof(ipbuf)) != nullptr) {
279 out_local_ip = ipbuf;
280 ok = !out_local_ip.empty();
281 }
282 }
283 tcp_close(s);
284 if (ok)
285 break;
286 }
287
288 freeaddrinfo(res);
289 return ok;
290}

292void join_clear_network_state() {
293 if (g_session.host_handle) {
294 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
295 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
296 }
297 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
298 // Host-side relay state is not used for client joins.
299 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
300 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
301 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
302 }
303 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
304 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
305 g_session.tcp_relay_rx.clear();
306 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len = 0;
307
308 if (g_join.tcp_addrs) {
309 freeaddrinfo(g_join.tcp_addrs);
310 g_join.tcp_addrs = nullptr;
311 }
312 g_join.tcp_next = nullptr;
313}

323
324bool join_begin_enet_attempt(const std::string &host, Uint16 port, bool relay_connect,
325 Uint32 connect_timeout_ms, Uint32 welcome_timeout_ms) {
326 join_clear_network_state();
327 g_join.relay_connect = relay_connect;
328 g_join.target_host = host;
329 g_join.target_port = port;
330 g_join.last_enet_event = -1;
331
332 // On multi-homed systems, the OS may pick an unexpected source address for
333 // outgoing UDP if we bind to ENET_HOST_ANY. We can probe the route and bind
334 // ENet to that local interface, but do this only when it is expected to help
335 // (see should_bind_local_interface_for_enet()).
336 ENetAddress local_bind_addr;
337 ENetAddress *local_bind_ptr = nullptr;
338 std::string local_bind_ip;
339 if (should_bind_local_interface_for_enet(host)) {
340 if (probe_local_bind_ipv4_for_remote(host, port, local_bind_ip)) {
341 if (enet_address_set_host(&local_bind_addr, local_bind_ip.c_str()) == 0) {
342 local_bind_addr.port = 0; // ephemeral
343 local_bind_ptr = &local_bind_addr;
344 if (debug_enabled())
345 debug_log("mp client: bind %s for connect to %s:%u", local_bind_ip.c_str(),
346 host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(port));
347 }
348 }
349 }
350
351 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(local_bind_ptr, 1,
352#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
353 2 /* channels */,
354#endif
355 0, 0);
356 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
357 return false;
358 log_enet_socket_address("client: enet socket", g_session.host_handle);
359
360 ENetAddress addr;
361 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
362 if (debug_enabled())
363 debug_log("mp client: invalid host '%s'", host.c_str());
364 join_clear_network_state();
365 return false;
366 }
367 addr.port = port;
368 g_session.server_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.host_handle, &addr, 2
369#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
370 ,
371 0 /* data */
372#endif
373 );
374 if (g_session.server_peer == nullptr) {
375 join_clear_network_state();
376 return false;
377 }
378
379 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
380 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::CONNECTING;
381 g_join.connect_deadline = now + connect_timeout_ms;
382 g_join.welcome_deadline = now + welcome_timeout_ms;
383 return true;
384}
385
386bool join_begin_tcp_relay_attempt(const std::string &host, Uint16 port) {
387 join_clear_network_state();
388 g_join.relay_connect = false;
389 g_join.target_host = host;
390 g_join.target_port = port;
391
392 if (host.empty() || port == 0)
393 return false;
394
395 addrinfo hints;
396 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
397 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
398 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
399
400 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
401 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
402 if (getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
403 return false;
404 g_join.tcp_addrs = res;
405 g_join.tcp_next = res;
406
407 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
408 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
409 g_join.connect_deadline = now + 3000;
410 g_join.welcome_deadline = now + kJoinTimeoutMs;
411
412 // Start the first address attempt.
413 while (g_join.tcp_next) {
414 addrinfo *ai = g_join.tcp_next;
415 g_join.tcp_next = g_join.tcp_next->ai_next;
416
417 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
418 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
419 continue;
420 if (!tcp_set_nonblocking(s)) {
421 tcp_close(s);
422 continue;
423 }
424 int rc = ::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen));
425#ifdef WIN32
426 if (rc == 0) {
427 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
428 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
429 } else {
430 int err = WSAGetLastError();
431 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK && err != WSAEINPROGRESS) {
432 tcp_close(s);
433 continue;
434 }
435 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
436 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
437 }
438#else
439 if (rc == 0) {
440 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
441 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
442 } else {
443 if (errno != EINPROGRESS) {
444 tcp_close(s);
445 continue;
446 }
447 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
448 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
449 }
450#endif
451
452 // If we're already connected, send the HELLO immediately.
453 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
454 ecl::Buffer hello;
455 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
456 if (!tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size())) {
457 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
458 continue;
459 }
460 }
461 return true;
462 }
463
464 join_clear_network_state();
465 return false;
466}
467
468bool join_begin_next_attempt() {
469 auto direct_connect_timeout_ms_for_host = [](const std::string &host) -> Uint32 {
470 auto ends_with = [](const std::string &s, const char *suffix) -> bool {
471 size_t n = std::strlen(suffix);
472 if (s.size() < n)
473 return false;
474 return s.compare(s.size() - n, n, suffix) == 0;
475 };
476
477 if (host == "localhost" || ends_with(host, ".local") || ends_with(host, ".localdomain"))
478 return kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan;
479
480 // If the host is a numeric IPv4, treat public addresses as "Internet" and
481 // use a short timeout so we fall back to relays quickly when NAT blocks.
482 unsigned a = 0, b = 0, c = 0, d = 0;
483 if (std::sscanf(host.c_str(), "%u.%u.%u.%u", &a, &b, &c, &d) == 4 && a <= 255 && b <= 255 &&
484 c <= 255 && d <= 255) {
485 const bool is_private =
486 (a == 10) ||
487 (a == 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
488 (a == 192 && b == 168) ||
489 (a == 127) ||
490 (a == 169 && b == 254);
491 return is_private ? kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan : kDirectConnectTimeoutMsInternet;
492 }
493
494 return kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan;
495 };
496
497 while (g_join.strategy_index < g_join.strategies.size()) {
498 TransportKind kind = g_join.strategies[g_join.strategy_index];
499 g_join.attempt_kind = kind;
500
501 if (kind == TransportKind::DIRECT) {
502 while (g_join.direct_host_index < g_join.host_ips.size()) {
503 const std::string &host = g_join.host_ips[g_join.direct_host_index++];
504 if (host.empty())
505 continue;
506 if (debug_enabled())
507 debug_log("mp client: connect %s:%u relay=0", host.c_str(),
508 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.start.host_port));
509 Uint32 connect_timeout_ms = direct_connect_timeout_ms_for_host(host);
510 // If we have multiple host IP candidates (multi-homed/VPN/VM),
511 // cycle through them quickly. A long ENet connect timeout on a
512 // single unreachable interface makes LAN joins feel stuck.
513 if (g_join.host_ips.size() > 1 &&
514 connect_timeout_ms == kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan &&
515 is_numeric_private_ipv4(host)) {
516 connect_timeout_ms = 5000;
517 }
518 if (join_begin_enet_attempt(host, g_join.start.host_port, false,
519 connect_timeout_ms,
520 kJoinTimeoutMs)) {
521 return true;
522 }
523 }
524 g_join.strategy_index++;
525 continue;
526 }
527 if (kind == TransportKind::UDP_RELAY) {
528 g_join.strategy_index++;
529 if (g_relay_server.empty())
530 continue;
531 if (debug_enabled())
532 debug_log("mp client: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
533 std::string relay_host;
534 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
535 if (!parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
536 continue;
537 if (join_begin_enet_attempt(relay_host, relay_port, true, 2000, kJoinTimeoutMs)) {
538 return true;
539 }
540 continue;
541 }
542 if (kind == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) {
543 g_join.strategy_index++;
544 if (g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
545 continue;
546 if (debug_enabled())
547 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
548 std::string relay_host;
549 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
550 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
551 continue;
552 if (join_begin_tcp_relay_attempt(relay_host, relay_port)) {
553 return true;
554 }
555 continue;
556 }
557 }
558 return false;
559}
560
561void join_build_strategy_list() {
562 g_join.strategies.clear();
563 const bool enable_direct = g_join.cfg.enable_direct;
564 const bool enable_udp_relay = g_join.cfg.enable_udp_relay;
565 const bool enable_tcp_relay = g_join.cfg.enable_tcp_relay;
566 const bool force_relay = g_join.cfg.force_relay;
567
568 if (enable_direct && !force_relay && !g_join.host_ips.empty())
569 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::DIRECT);
570 if (enable_udp_relay)
571 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::UDP_RELAY);
572 if (enable_tcp_relay)
573 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::TCP_RELAY);
574
575 if (debug_enabled()) {
576 if (!enable_direct)
577 debug_log("mp client: direct connect disabled");
578 else if (force_relay)
579 debug_log("mp client: force relay enabled");
580 if (!enable_udp_relay)
581 debug_log("mp client: udp relay disabled");
582 if (!enable_tcp_relay)
583 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay disabled");
584 }
585}
586
587// Session startup helpers keep SessionStartHost/SessionStartClient short by isolating
588// transport-specific bootstrapping/handshake code paths.
589void reset_session_bootstrap(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, unsigned expected_players,
590 bool is_host, bool local_player_known, unsigned local_player) {
591 if (g_session.host_handle) {
592 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
593 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
594 }
595 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
596 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
597 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
598 }
599 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
600 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
601 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
602
603 g_session = SessionState();
604 g_session.active = true;
605 g_session.host = is_host;
606 g_session.local_player_known = local_player_known;
607 g_session.local_player = local_player;
608 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
609 g_session.session_id = start.session_id;
610 g_session.seed = start.seed;
611 g_session.level_pack_name = start.pack_name;
612 g_session.level_id = start.level_id;
613 g_session.tick_ms = read_tick_ms_override();
614 g_session.menu_open.assign(expected_players, false);
615 g_session.player_in_use.assign(expected_players, false);
616 if (is_host && expected_players > 0)
617 g_session.player_in_use[0] = true;
618
619 enigma::Randomize(start.seed, true);
620 configure_input_session(expected_players);
621
622 // READY/START must be keyed to a nonzero load_id so clients can never signal
623 // readiness while still on an arbitrary previously-loaded level.
624 if (is_host && !start.level_id.empty()) {
625 g_session.load_id = 1;
626 }
627}
628
629bool host_open_direct_listener(Uint16 port, unsigned expected_players) {
630 ENetAddress address;
631 address.host = ENET_HOST_ANY;
632 address.port = port;
633 unsigned peer_capacity = 0;
634 if (expected_players > 1) {
635 // Allow a few extra peers so clients can retry with alternate host IPs
636 // without the host getting "stuck" on a half-connected attempt.
637 peer_capacity = std::max<unsigned>(expected_players - 1, 8);
638 }
639 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(&address, peer_capacity,
640#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
641 2 /* channels */,
642#endif
643 0, 0);
644 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr) {
645 if (debug_enabled())
646 debug_log("mp host: failed to open direct listener port=%u",
647 static_cast<unsigned>(port));
648 return false;
649 }
650 if (debug_enabled())
651 debug_log("mp host: direct listener port=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(port));
652 log_enet_socket_address("host: direct listener", g_session.host_handle);
653 // Do not tweak ENet-managed sockets. ENet already configures non-blocking
654 // mode and buffering; overriding this can break connect/handshake on some
655 // platform builds.
656 return true;
657}
658
659void host_try_connect_udp_relay() {
660 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
661 if (!cfg.enable_udp_relay || g_relay_server.empty())
662 return;
663 if (debug_enabled())
664 debug_log("mp host: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
665
666 std::string relay_host;
667 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
668 if (!parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
669 return;
670
671 if (g_session.relay_handle)
672 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
673 g_session.relay_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
674#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
675 2 /* channels */,
676#endif
677 0, 0);
678 if (!g_session.relay_handle)
679 return;
680
681 ENetAddress relay_addr;
682 enet_address_set_host(&relay_addr, relay_host.c_str());
683 relay_addr.port = relay_port;
684 g_session.relay_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.relay_handle, &relay_addr, 2
685#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
686 ,
687 0 /* data */
688#endif
689 );
690 if (!g_session.relay_peer) {
691 debug_log("mp host: relay connect failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
692 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
693 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
694 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
695 return;
696 }
697
698 ENetEvent event;
699 if (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 3000) > 0 &&
700 event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT) {
701 g_session.relay_peer = event.peer;
702#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
703 enet_peer_timeout(g_session.relay_peer, ENET_PEER_TIMEOUT_LIMIT,
704 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs),
705 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs));
706#endif
707 ecl::Buffer buf;
708 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
709 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
710 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
711 enet_peer_send(g_session.relay_peer, 0, packet);
712 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
713 debug_log("mp host: connected to relay %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
714 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
715 return;
716 }
717
718 debug_log("mp host: relay connect timeout %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
719 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
720 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
721 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
722 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
723}
724
725void host_try_connect_tcp_relay() {
726 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
727 if (!cfg.enable_tcp_relay || g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
728 return;
729 if (debug_enabled())
730 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
731
732 std::string relay_host;
733 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
734 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
735 return;
736
737 TcpSocket sock;
738 if (!tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
739 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay connect failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
740 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
741 return;
742 }
743
744 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
745 ecl::Buffer buf;
746 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
747 if (tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size())) {
748 debug_log("mp host: connected to tcp relay %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
749 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
750 return;
751 }
752
753 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay hello failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
754 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
755 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
756}
757
758bool client_connect_and_wait_enet(const std::string &target_host, Uint16 target_port,
759 bool relay_connect, Uint32 connect_timeout_ms,
760 Uint32 welcome_timeout_ms, Uint32 session_id) {
761 if (debug_enabled())
762 debug_log("mp client: connect %s:%u relay=%d", target_host.c_str(),
763 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port), relay_connect ? 1 : 0);
764 if (g_session.host_handle) {
765 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
766 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
767 }
768 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
769 ENetAddress local_bind_addr;
770 ENetAddress *local_bind_ptr = nullptr;
771 std::string local_bind_ip;
772 if (probe_local_bind_ipv4_for_remote(target_host, target_port, local_bind_ip)) {
773 if (enet_address_set_host(&local_bind_addr, local_bind_ip.c_str()) == 0) {
774 local_bind_addr.port = 0; // ephemeral
775 local_bind_ptr = &local_bind_addr;
776 if (debug_enabled())
777 debug_log("mp client: bind %s for connect to %s:%u", local_bind_ip.c_str(),
778 target_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
779 }
780 }
781
782 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(local_bind_ptr, 1,
783#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
784 2 /* channels */,
785#endif
786 0, 0);
787 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
788 return false;
789 log_enet_socket_address("client: enet socket", g_session.host_handle);
790
791 ENetAddress addr;
792 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, target_host.c_str()) != 0) {
793 if (debug_enabled())
794 debug_log("mp client: invalid host '%s'", target_host.c_str());
795 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
796 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
797 return false;
798 }
799 addr.port = target_port;
800 g_session.server_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.host_handle, &addr, 2
801#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
802 ,
803 0 /* data */
804#endif
805 );
806 if (g_session.server_peer == nullptr)
807 return false;
808
809 ENetEvent event;
810 const int serviced = enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, connect_timeout_ms);
811 if (!(serviced > 0 && event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT)) {
812 if (debug_enabled())
813 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u service=%d event=%d", target_host.c_str(),
814 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port), serviced,
815 serviced > 0 ? static_cast<int>(event.type) : -1);
816 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
817 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
818 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
819 return false;
820 }
821 g_session.server_peer = event.peer;
822#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
823 enet_peer_timeout(g_session.server_peer, ENET_PEER_TIMEOUT_LIMIT,
824 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs),
825 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs));
826#endif
827 if (relay_connect) {
828 ecl::Buffer buf;
829 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, session_id, 0);
830 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
831 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
832 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
833 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
834 }
835
836 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
837 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < welcome_timeout_ms) {
838 int res = enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 100);
839 if (res <= 0)
840 continue;
841 if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE) {
842 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
843 ecl::Buffer buf;
844 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), event.packet->dataLength);
845 Uint8 player_id = 0;
846 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
847 Uint32 seed = 0;
848 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
849 if (debug_enabled())
850 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
851 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
852 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
853 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
854 g_session.local_player = player_id;
855 g_session.local_player_known = true;
856 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
857 g_session.seed = seed;
858 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
859 g_session.active_transport =
860 relay_connect ? TransportKind::UDP_RELAY : TransportKind::DIRECT;
861 if (debug_enabled())
862 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
863 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
864 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
865 return true;
866 }
867 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
868 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT) {
869 break;
870 }
871 }
872
873 if (debug_enabled())
874 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u", target_host.c_str(),
875 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
876 if (g_session.server_peer) {
877 enet_peer_reset(g_session.server_peer);
878 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
879 }
880 if (g_session.host_handle) {
881 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
882 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
883 }
884 return false;
885}
886
887bool client_try_connect_direct(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
888 // Keep the actual connect timeout short, but allow a longer welcome window
889 // in case the host is still loading/binding when the client attempts to join.
890 Uint32 connect_timeout_ms = kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan;
891 unsigned a = 0, b = 0, c = 0, d = 0;
892 if (std::sscanf(host_ip.c_str(), "%u.%u.%u.%u", &a, &b, &c, &d) == 4 && a <= 255 && b <= 255 &&
893 c <= 255 && d <= 255) {
894 const bool is_private =
895 (a == 10) ||
896 (a == 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
897 (a == 192 && b == 168) ||
898 (a == 127) ||
899 (a == 169 && b == 254);
900 connect_timeout_ms = is_private ? kDirectConnectTimeoutMsLan : kDirectConnectTimeoutMsInternet;
901 }
902 return client_connect_and_wait_enet(host_ip, start.host_port, false, connect_timeout_ms,
903 kJoinTimeoutMs, start.session_id);
904}

906bool client_try_connect_udp_relay(Uint32 session_id) {
907 if (!g_relay_server.empty()) {
908 if (debug_enabled())
909 debug_log("mp client: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
910 std::string relay_host;
911 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
912 if (parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
913 if (client_connect_and_wait_enet(relay_host, relay_port, true, 2000, kJoinTimeoutMs,
914 session_id)) {
915 return true;
916 }
917 }
918 }
919 return false;
920}

922bool client_try_connect_udp_relay(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
923 static_cast<void>(host_ip);
924 return client_try_connect_udp_relay(start.session_id);
925}
926
927bool client_try_connect_tcp_relay(Uint32 session_id) {
928 if (g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
929 return false;
930 if (debug_enabled())
931 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
932
933 // Ensure stale ENet state from previous attempts does not interfere with
934 // TCP relay operation (client_send_payload prefers server_peer if set).
935 if (g_session.host_handle) {
936 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
937 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
938 }
939 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
940
941 std::string relay_host;
942 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
943 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
944 return false;
945
946 TcpSocket sock;
947 if (!tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
948 if (debug_enabled())
949 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u (tcp relay)", relay_host.c_str(),
950 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
951 return false;
952 }
953 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
954
955 ecl::Buffer hello;
956 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, session_id, 0);
957 if (!tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size())) {
958 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
959 return false;
960 }
961
962 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
963 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
964 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < kJoinTimeoutMs) {
965 fd_set rfds;
966 FD_ZERO(&rfds);
967 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &rfds);
968 timeval tv;
969 tv.tv_sec = 0;
970 tv.tv_usec = 100 * 1000;
971#ifdef WIN32
972 int sel = ::select(0, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
973#else
974 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
975#endif
976 if (sel <= 0)
977 continue;
978 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
979 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
980 break;
981 }
982 while (tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx, g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len,
983 frame)) {
984 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
985 ecl::Buffer buf;
986 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), frame.size());
987 Uint8 player_id = 0;
988 Uint8 expected = 0;
989 Uint32 seed = 0;
990 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected, seed)) {
991 if (debug_enabled())
992 debug_log("mp client: welcome (tcp relay) player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
993 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id), static_cast<unsigned>(expected),
994 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
995 g_session.local_player = player_id;
996 g_session.local_player_known = true;
997 g_session.expected_players = expected;
998 g_session.seed = seed;
999 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected);
1000 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::TCP_RELAY;
1001 if (debug_enabled())
1002 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
1003 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
1004 return true;
1005 }
1006 }
1007 }
1008
1009 if (debug_enabled())
1010 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u (tcp relay)", relay_host.c_str(),
1011 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
1012 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
1013 return false;
1014}
1015
1016bool client_try_connect_tcp_relay(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
1017 static_cast<void>(host_ip);

1029 if (expected_players < 1)
1030 return false;
1031 reset_session_bootstrap(start, expected_players, true, true, 0);

1042bool SessionStartClient(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
1043 if (g_session.active)
1044 return false;
1045 if (debug_enabled())
1046 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
1047 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
1048 if (expected_players < 1)
1049 return false;
1050 reset_session_bootstrap(start, expected_players, false, false, 1);
1051 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
1052 const bool enable_direct = cfg.enable_direct;
1053 const bool enable_udp_relay = cfg.enable_udp_relay;
1054 const bool enable_tcp_relay = cfg.enable_tcp_relay;
1055 const bool force_relay = cfg.force_relay;
1056 const char *direct_disabled_log =
1057 !enable_direct ? "mp client: direct connect disabled"
1058 : (force_relay ? "mp client: force relay enabled" : nullptr);
1059
1060 const ConnectStrategy strategies[] = {
1061 {enable_direct && !force_relay, direct_disabled_log, client_try_connect_direct},
1062 {enable_udp_relay, "mp client: udp relay disabled",
1063 static_cast<bool (*)(const protocol::LobbyStart &, const std::string &)>(
1064 client_try_connect_udp_relay)},
1065 {enable_tcp_relay, "mp client: tcp relay disabled",
1066 static_cast<bool (*)(const protocol::LobbyStart &, const std::string &)>(
1067 client_try_connect_tcp_relay)},
1068 };
1069
1070 auto try_strategies = [&](const ConnectStrategy *begin,
1071 const ConnectStrategy *end) -> bool {
1072 for (const ConnectStrategy *it = begin; it != end; ++it) {
1073 if (!it->enabled) {
1074 if (debug_enabled() && it->disabled_log)
1075 debug_log("%s", it->disabled_log);
1076 continue;
1077 }
1078 if (it->attempt(start, host_ip))
1079 return true;
1080 }
1081 return false;
1082 };
1083
1084 if (try_strategies(std::begin(strategies), std::end(strategies)))
1085 return true;
1086
1087 SessionShutdown();
1088 return false;
1089}

1098bool SessionBeginClientJoin(const protocol::LobbyStart &start,
1099 const std::vector<std::string> &host_ips) {
1100 if (g_session.active || g_join.active)
1101 return false;
1102 if (debug_enabled())
1103 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
1104 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
1105 if (expected_players < 1)
1106 return false;
1107

1109
1110 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1111 g_join.active = true;
1112 g_join.start = start;
1113 g_join.host_ips = host_ips;
1114 g_join.cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
1115 if (debug_enabled()) {
1116 std::string hosts;
1117 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_join.host_ips.size(); ++i) {
1118 if (i)
1119 hosts += ",";
1120 hosts += g_join.host_ips[i];
1121 }
1122 debug_log("mp client: join begin session=%u port=%u hosts=%s",
1123 static_cast<unsigned>(start.session_id),
1124 static_cast<unsigned>(start.host_port),
1125 hosts.c_str());
1126 }
1127 join_build_strategy_list();
1128 g_join.strategy_index = 0;
1129 g_join.direct_host_index = 0;
1130
1131 if (!join_begin_next_attempt()) {
1132 SessionShutdown();
1133 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1134 return false;
1135 }
1136 return true;
1137}

1139multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus SessionPollClientJoin() {
1140 if (!g_join.active)
1141 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::IDLE;
1142
1143 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
1144
1145 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING || g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
1146 if (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
1147 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING) {
1148 fd_set wfds;
1149 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
1150 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &wfds);
1151 timeval tv;
1152 tv.tv_sec = 0;
1153 tv.tv_usec = 0;
1154#ifdef WIN32
1155 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
1156#else
1157 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
1158#endif
1159 if (sel > 0) {
1160 int err = 0;
1161#ifdef WIN32
1162 int errlen = sizeof(err);
1163#else
1164 socklen_t errlen = sizeof(err);
1165#endif
1166 if (::getsockopt(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR,
1167 reinterpret_cast<char *>(&err), &errlen) == 0 &&
1168 err == 0) {
1169 ecl::Buffer hello;
1170 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
1171 if (tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size()))
1172 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
1173 else
1174 join_fail_current_attempt();
1175 } else {
1176 join_fail_current_attempt();
1177 }
1178 }
1179 }
1180
1181 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
1182 fd_set rfds;
1183 FD_ZERO(&rfds);
1184 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &rfds);
1185 timeval tv;
1186 tv.tv_sec = 0;
1187 tv.tv_usec = 0;
1188#ifdef WIN32
1189 int sel = ::select(0, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
1190#else
1191 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
1192#endif
1193 if (sel > 0) {
1194 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
1195 join_fail_current_attempt();
1196 } else {
1197 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
1198 while (tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx,
1199 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len, frame)) {
1200 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
1201 ecl::Buffer buf;
1202 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), frame.size());
1203 Uint8 player_id = 0;
1204 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
1205 Uint32 seed = 0;
1206 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
1207 if (debug_enabled())
1208 debug_log("mp client: welcome (tcp relay) player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
1209 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
1210 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
1211 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
1212 g_session.local_player = player_id;
1213 g_session.local_player_known = true;
1214 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
1215 g_session.seed = seed;
1216 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
1217 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::TCP_RELAY;
1218 if (debug_enabled())
1219 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
1220 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
1221 g_join.active = false;
1222 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED;
1223 }
1224 }
1225 }
1226 }
1227 }
1228 }
1229
1230 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING && now > g_join.connect_deadline) {
1231 if (debug_enabled())
1232 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u (tcp relay)", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1233 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
1234 join_fail_current_attempt();
1235 } else if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME && now > g_join.welcome_deadline) {
1236 if (debug_enabled())
1237 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u (tcp relay)", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1238 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
1239 join_fail_current_attempt();
1240 }
1241
1242 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::IDLE) {
1243 if (join_begin_next_attempt())
1244 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1245 SessionShutdown();
1246 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1247 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED;
1248 }
1249
1250 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1251 }
1252
1253 ENetEvent event;
1254 while (g_session.host_handle && enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
1255 g_join.last_enet_event = static_cast<int>(event.type);
1256 if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT) {
1257 g_session.server_peer = event.peer;
1258#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
1259 enet_peer_timeout(g_session.server_peer, ENET_PEER_TIMEOUT_LIMIT,
1260 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs),
1261 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs));
1262#endif
1263 if (debug_enabled())
1264 {
1265 char rip[64];
1266 rip[0] = '\0';
1267 std::string remote_ip = address_to_ip_string(event.peer->address);
1268 if (remote_ip.empty())
1269 std::snprintf(rip, sizeof(rip), "<unknown>");
1270 else
1271 std::snprintf(rip, sizeof(rip), "%s", remote_ip.c_str());
1272 debug_log("mp client: connected target=%s:%u remote=%s:%u relay=%d",
1273 g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1274 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port),
1275 rip,
1276 static_cast<unsigned>(event.peer->address.port),
1277 g_join.relay_connect ? 1 : 0);
1278 }
1279 if (g_join.relay_connect) {
1280 ecl::Buffer buf;
1281 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
1282 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
1283 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
1284 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
1285 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
1286 }
1287 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::WAIT_WELCOME;
1288 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE) {
1289 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
1290 ecl::Buffer buf;
1291 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), event.packet->dataLength);
1292 Uint8 player_id = 0;
1293 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
1294 Uint32 seed = 0;
1295 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
1296 if (seed != g_join.start.seed) {
1297 if (debug_enabled())
1298 debug_log("mp client: welcome ignored (seed mismatch remote=%u local=%u)",
1299 static_cast<unsigned>(seed),
1300 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.start.seed));
1301 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
1302 continue;
1303 }
1304 if (debug_enabled())
1305 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
1306 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
1307 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
1308 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
1309 g_session.local_player = player_id;
1310 g_session.local_player_known = true;
1311 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
1312 g_session.seed = seed;
1313 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
1314 g_session.active_transport =
1315 g_join.relay_connect ? TransportKind::UDP_RELAY : TransportKind::DIRECT;
1316 if (debug_enabled())
1317 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
1318 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
1319
1320 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
1321 g_join.active = false;
1322 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED;
1323 }
1324 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
1325 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT) {
1326 break;
1327 }
1328 }
1329
1330 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::CONNECTING && now > g_join.connect_deadline) {
1331 if (debug_enabled())
1332 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u last_event=%d", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1333 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port), g_join.last_enet_event);
1334 join_fail_current_attempt();
1335 } else if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::WAIT_WELCOME && now > g_join.welcome_deadline) {
1336 if (debug_enabled())
1337 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1338 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
1339 join_fail_current_attempt();
1340 }
1341
1342 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::IDLE) {
1343 if (join_begin_next_attempt())
1344 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1345 SessionShutdown();
1346 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1347 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED;
1348 }
1349
1350 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1351}

A src/multiplayer_session_sync.cc

Description
  • Per-tick input synchronization and periodic world checksum verification/resync.
Where it is used
  • Called from session tick while a level is running.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Adds deterministic lockstep input exchange and divergence detection with soft resync.
  • Extends drift recovery by requesting and applying host-authoritative world-grid snapshots when world checksums diverge.
  • Encodes stable template-backed kinds for schema-incomplete objects (notably puzzle stones) so world-state snapshots can converge without repeated kill/recreate loops.
  • Sends READY/START with an additional `load_id` so readiness and start signals are scoped to the currently loading level.

82int64_t quantize_for_dump(double v) {
83 return static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(v * 100.0));
84}
85
86uint32_t stable_name_hash(Actor *actor) {
87 if (!actor)
88 return 0;
89 Value name = actor->getAttr("name");
90 if (name.getType() != Value::STRING)
91 return 0;
92 const std::string &s = name.get_string();
93 if (s.empty())
94 return 0;
95 // FNV-1a 32-bit.
96 uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
97 for (unsigned char c : s) {
98 h ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(c);
99 h *= 16777619u;
100 }
101 return h ? h : 1u;
102}

104Actor *sync_reference_actor(unsigned player, uint32_t tick);

106struct ActorSortKey {
107 uint32_t name_hash = 0;
108 std::string kind;
109 Uint32 object_id = 0;
110};
111
112ActorSortKey actor_sort_key(Actor *a) {
113 ActorSortKey k;
114 k.name_hash = stable_name_hash(a);
115 k.kind = a ? a->getKind() : std::string();
116 k.object_id = a ? static_cast<Uint32>(a->getId()) : 0u;
117 return k;
118}
119
120bool actor_key_less(const ActorSortKey &a, const ActorSortKey &b) {
121 // Prefer actors with a stable authored name (e.g. meditation pearls: pearl%N).
122 // Unnamed actors sort after named ones.
123 uint32_t an = a.name_hash ? a.name_hash : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
124 uint32_t bn = b.name_hash ? b.name_hash : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
125 if (an != bn)
126 return an < bn;
127 if (a.kind != b.kind)
128 return a.kind < b.kind;
129 return a.object_id < b.object_id;
130}

205 struct Digest {
206 uint32_t kind_id = 0;
207 std::string kind;
208 uint32_t object_id = 0;
209 int owner = -1;
210 int controllers = 0;
211 int color = -1;
212 int64_t x = 0;
213 int64_t y = 0;
214 int64_t vx = 0;
215 int64_t vy = 0;
216 std::string name;
217 };
218 std::vector<Digest> digs;
219 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
220 GetActors(actors);
221 digs.reserve(actors.size());
222 for (Actor *a : actors) {
223 if (!a)
224 continue;
225 Digest d;
226 d.kind_id = static_cast<uint32_t>(get_id(a));
227 d.kind = a->getKind();
228 d.object_id = static_cast<uint32_t>(a->getId());
229 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
230 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
231 d.owner = static_cast<int>(owner);
232 d.controllers = a->get_controllers();
233 Value color = a->getAttr("color");
234 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
235 d.color = static_cast<int>(color);
236 Value name = a->getAttr("name");
237 if (name.getType() == Value::STRING)
238 d.name = name.get_string();
239 const ecl::V2 &pos = a->get_pos();
240 const ecl::V2 &vel = a->get_vel();
241 d.x = quantize_for_dump(pos[0]);
242 d.y = quantize_for_dump(pos[1]);
243 d.vx = quantize_for_dump(vel[0]);
244 d.vy = quantize_for_dump(vel[1]);
245 digs.push_back(d);
246 }
247 std::sort(digs.begin(), digs.end(), [](const Digest &a, const Digest &b) {
248 if (a.kind_id != b.kind_id)
249 return a.kind_id < b.kind_id;
250 if (a.owner != b.owner)
251 return a.owner < b.owner;
252 if (a.controllers != b.controllers)
253 return a.controllers < b.controllers;
254 if (a.color != b.color)
255 return a.color < b.color;
256 if (a.x != b.x)
257 return a.x < b.x;
258 if (a.y != b.y)
259 return a.y < b.y;
260 if (a.vx != b.vx)
261 return a.vx < b.vx;
262 if (a.vy != b.vy)
263 return a.vy < b.vy;
264 if (a.name != b.name)
265 return a.name < b.name;
266 if (a.kind != b.kind)
267 return a.kind < b.kind;
268 return a.object_id < b.object_id;
269 });
270
271 debug_log("mp dump: actors=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(digs.size()));
272 for (const auto &d : digs) {
273 debug_log("mp dump: actor kind_id=%u kind=%s obj=%u owner=%d ctrl=%d color=%d name=%s pos=%lld,%lld vel=%lld,%lld",
274 static_cast<unsigned>(d.kind_id),
275 d.kind.c_str(),
276 static_cast<unsigned>(d.object_id),
277 d.owner,
278 d.controllers,
279 d.color,
280 d.name.c_str(),
281 static_cast<long long>(d.x),
282 static_cast<long long>(d.y),
283 static_cast<long long>(d.vx),
284 static_cast<long long>(d.vy));
285 }
286}
287
288uint32_t sync_probe_stride_ticks() {
289 const double step = input::TickTimestep();
290 if (step <= 0.0)
291 return 1u;
292 uint32_t stride = static_cast<uint32_t>(kSyncInterval / step + 0.5);
293 if (stride == 0)
294 stride = 1u;
295 return stride;
296}
297
298Actor *sync_reference_actor(unsigned player, uint32_t tick) {
299 // The legacy engine defines "main actor" as the first actor in the player's
300 // actor list. For authored multi-ball levels (e.g. meditation pearls) that
301 // ordering can differ across peers even when the physical state matches,
302 // which would cause spurious position mismatches in sync packets.
303 //
304 // Pick a deterministic steerable actor controlled by this player instead.
305 //
306 // IMPORTANT: Do not use position-based ordering. When a player controls
307 // multiple marbles that can cross, "top-left" can flip between peers (or
308 // across ticks) while still being physically consistent, causing endless
309 // false "pos mismatch" reports and soft-resync churn.
310 //
311 // Also, do not always pick the same controlled actor. If the chosen probe
312 // happens to be in a "stable sink" (e.g. trapped in a hole), its position
313 // can stay identical while other controlled marbles diverge. Cycle the
314 // probe deterministically so all controlled actors eventually get sampled.
315 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
316 GetActors(actors);
317 std::vector<Actor *> candidates;
318 std::vector<ActorSortKey> keys;
319 for (Actor *a : actors) {
320 if (!a || !a->isSteerable())
321 continue;
322 if (!a->controlled_by(static_cast<int>(player)))
323 continue;
324 candidates.push_back(a);
325 keys.push_back(actor_sort_key(a));
326 }
327
328 if (!candidates.empty()) {
329 std::vector<size_t> order(candidates.size());
330 for (size_t i = 0; i < order.size(); ++i)
331 order[i] = i;
332 std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](size_t ia, size_t ib) {
333 return actor_key_less(keys[ia], keys[ib]);
334 });
335 uint32_t stride = sync_probe_stride_ticks();
336 size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>((tick / stride) % static_cast<uint32_t>(order.size()));
337 return candidates[order[idx]];
338 }
339
340 return player::GetMainActor(player);
341}

361void send_sync_to_peers() {
362 if (!g_session.host || !has_remote_peers())
363 return;
364 protocol::SyncPacket sync;
365 sync.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
366 sync.tick = input::CurrentTick();
367 sync.random_state = server::RandomState;
368 Actor *p0 = sync_reference_actor(0, sync.tick);
369 Actor *p1 = sync_reference_actor(1, sync.tick);
370 sync.p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
371 sync.p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
372 sync.p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
373 sync.p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
374 // Include movable-stone layout (puzzle stones, doors) in the "world" checksum,
375 // otherwise swapping identical movable stones can evade checksum detection.
376 const uint64_t kind_cs = WorldGridKindChecksum();
377 const uint64_t state_cs = WorldGridStateChecksum();
378 const uint64_t movable_cs = WorldGridMovableStoneChecksum();
379 sync.world_checksum = CombineWorldGridChecksums(kind_cs, state_cs, movable_cs);
380 sync.actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
381 sync.grid_kind_checksum = kind_cs;
382 sync.grid_state_checksum = state_cs;
383 g_session.last_world_checksum = sync.world_checksum;
384
385 ecl::Buffer buf;
386 protocol::encode_sync(buf, sync);
387 g_transport.HostBroadcast(buf);
388}

403namespace {
404std::string stable_world_kind(Object *obj) {
405 if (!obj)
406 return std::string();
407 // Object::getKind() uses the XML validator schema, which does not cover all runtime
408 // variants (notably puzzle stone connections / color). For world-state resync we need
409 // a kind string that is stable and maps to an actual template name for Make*().
410 if (PuzzleStone *ps = dynamic_cast<PuzzleStone *>(obj)) {
411 const int color = static_cast<int>(ps->getAttr("color"));
412 const std::string con = ps->getAttr("connections").to_string();
413 int bits = 0;
414 if (con.find('w') != std::string::npos)
415 bits |= 1;
416 if (con.find('s') != std::string::npos)
417 bits |= 2;
418 if (con.find('e') != std::string::npos)
419 bits |= 4;
420 if (con.find('n') != std::string::npos)
421 bits |= 8;
422 static const char *kSuffix[16] = {"", "w", "s", "sw", "e", "ew", "es", "esw",
423 "n", "nw", "ns", "nsw", "ne", "new", "nes", "nesw"};
424 const char *base = "st_puzzle";
425 if (color == BLUE)
426 base = "st_puzzle_blue";
427 else if (color == YELLOW)
428 base = "st_puzzle_yellow";
429 const bool hollow = ps->getAttr("hollow").to_bool();
430 if (hollow && color == YELLOW && bits == 15)
431 return "st_puzzle_yellow_nesw_hollow";
432 const char *suffix = kSuffix[bits & 15];
433 if (!suffix || !*suffix)
434 return base;
435 return std::string(base) + "_" + suffix;
436 }
437 return obj->getKind();
438}
439
440void broadcast_world_state_snapshot(bool reliable) {
441 if (!g_session.host || !has_remote_peers())
442 return;
443 // World-state snapshots require a fully initialized world; clients can send
444 // late packets (e.g. during lobby / start handshake) that must not crash us.
445 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING || !server::WorldInitialized)
446 return;
447 const int w = Width();
448 const int h = Height();
449 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
450 return;
451 protocol::WorldStatePacket pkt;
452 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
453 pkt.tick = input::CurrentTick();
454 pkt.width = static_cast<Uint16>(w);
455 pkt.height = static_cast<Uint16>(h);
456 const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(w) * static_cast<size_t>(h);
457 pkt.floor_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
458 pkt.stone_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
459 pkt.item_state.assign(count, 0xFFFF);
460 pkt.oxyd_colors.clear();
461 pkt.kind_dict.clear();
462 pkt.floor_kind.assign(count, 0);
463 pkt.stone_kind.assign(count, 0);
464 pkt.item_kind.assign(count, 0);
465
466 auto encode_state = [](Object *obj) -> Uint16 {
467 if (!obj)
468 return 0xFFFF;
469 Value v = obj->getAttr("state");
470 if (!v)
471 return 0;
472 int s = static_cast<int>(v);
473 if (s < 0)
474 s = 0;
475 if (s > 0xFFFE)
476 s = 0xFFFE;
477 return static_cast<Uint16>(s);
478 };
479
480 std::unordered_map<std::string, Uint16> kind_index;
481 kind_index.reserve(128);
482 auto kind_id = [&](Object *obj) -> Uint16 {
483 if (!obj)
484 return 0;
485 const std::string kind = stable_world_kind(obj);
486 if (kind.empty())
487 return 0;
488 auto it = kind_index.find(kind);
489 if (it != kind_index.end())
490 return it->second;
491 const size_t next = pkt.kind_dict.size() + 1;
492 if (next > 0xFFFF)
493 return 0;
494 const Uint16 id = static_cast<Uint16>(next);
495 kind_index.emplace(kind, id);
496 pkt.kind_dict.push_back(kind);
497 return id;
498 };
499
500 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
501 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
502 const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(w) + static_cast<size_t>(x);
503 GridPos p(x, y);
504 Object *fl = GetFloor(p);
505 Object *st = GetStone(p);
506 Object *it = GetItem(p);
507 pkt.floor_state[idx] = encode_state(fl);
508 pkt.stone_state[idx] = encode_state(st);
509 pkt.item_state[idx] = encode_state(it);
510 pkt.floor_kind[idx] = kind_id(fl);
511 pkt.stone_kind[idx] = kind_id(st);
512 pkt.item_kind[idx] = kind_id(it);
513 if (OxydStone *ox = dynamic_cast<OxydStone *>(st)) {
514 const int c = static_cast<int>(ox->getAttr("oxydcolor"));
515 const int16_t cs = static_cast<int16_t>(c);
516 protocol::WorldStatePacket::OxydColor e;
517 e.x = static_cast<Uint16>(x);
518 e.y = static_cast<Uint16>(y);
519 e.color_raw = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<uint16_t>(cs));
520 pkt.oxyd_colors.push_back(e);
521 }
522 }
523 }
524
525 pkt.movable_stones.clear();
526 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
527 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
528 GridPos p(x, y);
529 Stone *st = GetStone(p);
530 if (!st)
531 continue;
532 if (!st->is_movable())
533 continue;
534 protocol::WorldStatePacket::MovableStone entry;
535 entry.object_id = static_cast<Uint32>(st->getId());
536 entry.x = static_cast<Uint16>(x);
537 entry.y = static_cast<Uint16>(y);
538 pkt.movable_stones.push_back(entry);
539 }
540 }
541
542 ecl::Buffer buf;
543 protocol::encode_world_state(buf, pkt);
544 if (reliable)
545 g_transport.HostBroadcast(buf);
546 else
547 g_transport.HostBroadcastUnreliable(buf);
548}
549} // namespace

587protocol::ResyncState build_resync_state_snapshot() {
588 protocol::ResyncState state;
589 state.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
590 state.tick = input::CurrentTick();
591 state.random_state = server::RandomState;
592 state.actors.clear();
593 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
594 GetActors(actors);
595 state.actors.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(actors.size()));
596 for (Actor *actor : actors) {
597 protocol::ResyncActorState entry;
598 entry.object_id = static_cast<Uint32>(actor->getId());
599 entry.actor_id = static_cast<Uint16>(get_id(actor));
600 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
601 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
602 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<int>(owner));
603 else
604 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(0xFFFF);
605 entry.controllers = static_cast<Uint32>(actor->get_controllers());
606 Value color = actor->getAttr("color");
607 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
608 entry.color = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<int>(color));
609 else
610 entry.color = static_cast<Uint16>(0xFFFF);
611 entry.name_hash = stable_name_hash(actor);
612 entry.x = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[0]);
613 entry.y = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[1]);
614 entry.vx = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[0]);
615 entry.vy = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[1]);
616 state.actors.push_back(entry);
617 }
618 return state;
619}
