665
666void apply_resync_state(const protocol::ResyncState &state) {
667 if (!g_session.active)
668 return;
669 if (state.epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
670 return;
671 g_session.telemetry.resync_responses_recv += 1;
672 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
673 uint32_t delta_ticks = (local_tick > state.tick) ? (local_tick - state.tick) : 0;
674 // Resync snapshots can arrive a few ticks late, but velocity projection is
675 // unreliable in high-acceleration physics (rubberbands, collisions) and
676 // tends to amplify post-resync divergence. Apply snapshots as-is.
677 float dt = 0.0f;
678 if (debug_enabled())
679 debug_log("mp resync recv: state tick=%u local tick=%u delta=%u actors=%u", state.tick,
680 local_tick, delta_ticks, static_cast<unsigned>(state.actors.size()));
681 server::RandomState = state.random_state;
682
683 std::unordered_map<Uint32, Actor *> by_object_id;
684 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
685 GetActors(actors);
686 by_object_id.reserve(actors.size());
687 for (Actor *actor : actors)
688 by_object_id[static_cast<Uint32>(actor->getId())] = actor;
689 std::unordered_map<Actor *, bool> used;
690 used.reserve(actors.size());
691
692 // Applying a resync snapshot must not trigger gameplay side-effects like
693 // floor/item enter/leave callbacks (which can diverge further across peers).
694 // We only update physics state and the spatial index via DidMoveActor().
695 auto resync_teleport = [](Actor *actor, float x, float y, float vx, float vy) {
696 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
697 ai->pos = ecl::V2(x, y);
698 DidMoveActor(actor);
699 ai->last_gridpos = ai->gridpos;
700 ai->vel = ecl::V2(vx, vy);
701 ai->pos_force = ai->pos;
702 ai->forceacc = ecl::V2();
703 ai->force = ecl::V2();
704 ai->collforce = ecl::V2();
705 ai->friction = 0.0;
706 ai->contacts = ai->contacts_a;
707 ai->last_contacts = ai->contacts_b;
708 ai->contacts_count = 0;
709 ai->last_contacts_count = 0;
710 };
711
712 auto should_skip_actor = [](Actor *actor) -> bool {
713 if (!actor)
714 return false;
715 // In remote-control mode we *want* the local actor to be overwritten by the host.
716 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall"))
717 return false;
718 if (!options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugSkipLocalResync"))
719 return false;
720 if (!g_session.local_player_known)
721 return false;
722 if (g_session.local_player >= g_session.expected_players)
723 return false;
724 return actor->controlled_by(static_cast<int>(g_session.local_player));
725 };
726
727 unsigned applied = 0;
728 unsigned object_id_matches = 0;
729 float max_pos_delta = 0.0f;
730 // First, apply by object_id when possible (best fidelity).
731 for (const auto &entry : state.actors) {
732 auto it = by_object_id.find(entry.object_id);
733 if (it == by_object_id.end())
734 continue;
735 Actor *actor = it->second;
736 if (!actor || used[actor])
737 continue;
738 float x = entry.x + entry.vx * dt;
739 float y = entry.y + entry.vy * dt;
740 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
741 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
742 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
743 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
744 if (d > max_pos_delta)
745 max_pos_delta = d;
746 if (!should_skip_actor(actor))
747 resync_teleport(actor, x, y, entry.vx, entry.vy);
748 apply_resync_metadata(actor, entry.owner, entry.controllers, entry.color);
749 used[actor] = true;
750 applied += 1;
751 object_id_matches += 1;
752 }
753
754 // For the remaining entries, match by (kind, owner, position) instead of
755 // object_id. This avoids fragile resync mapping in levels with multiple
756 // identical marbles (e.g. meditation) where object ids can diverge across
757 // peers due to non-deterministic scripting/creation order.
758 std::vector<uint8_t> snap_used(state.actors.size(), 0);
759 std::vector<size_t> remaining_snaps;
760 remaining_snaps.reserve(state.actors.size());
761 for (size_t i = 0; i < state.actors.size(); ++i) {
762 const auto &entry = state.actors[i];
763 auto it = by_object_id.find(entry.object_id);
764 if (it != by_object_id.end()) {
765 Actor *actor = it->second;
766 if (actor && used[actor]) {
767 snap_used[i] = 1;
768 continue;
769 }
770 }
771 remaining_snaps.push_back(i);
772 }
773
774 // Pass 0: match by stable name hash when available (best effort for scripted
775 // multi-ball levels where object ids can differ across peers).
776 if (!remaining_snaps.empty()) {
777 std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<Actor *>> local_by_name;
778 local_by_name.reserve(actors.size());
779 for (Actor *a : actors) {
780 if (!a || used[a])
781 continue;
782 uint32_t nh = stable_name_hash(a);
783 if (!nh)
784 continue;
785 uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(a));
786 uint64_t key = (static_cast<uint64_t>(kind) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(nh);
787 local_by_name[key].push_back(a);
788 }
789
790 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
791 if (snap_used[idx])
792 continue;
793 const auto &s = state.actors[idx];
794 if (!s.name_hash)
795 continue;
796 uint64_t key = (static_cast<uint64_t>(s.actor_id) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(s.name_hash);
797 auto it = local_by_name.find(key);
798 if (it == local_by_name.end() || it->second.empty())
799 continue;
800
801 // Choose the closest remaining actor to the snapshot position.
802 Actor *best = nullptr;
803 double best_d2 = 0.0;
804 for (Actor *cand : it->second) {
805 if (!cand || used[cand])
806 continue;
807 const ecl::V2 &p = cand->get_pos();
808 double dx = static_cast<double>(p[0]) - static_cast<double>(s.x);
809 double dy = static_cast<double>(p[1]) - static_cast<double>(s.y);
810 double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
811 if (!best || d2 < best_d2) {
812 best = cand;
813 best_d2 = d2;
814 }
815 }
816 if (!best)
817 continue;
818 float x = s.x + s.vx * dt;
819 float y = s.y + s.vy * dt;
820 ActorInfo *ai = best->get_actorinfo();
821 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
822 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
823 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
824 if (d > max_pos_delta)
825 max_pos_delta = d;
826 if (!should_skip_actor(best))
827 resync_teleport(best, x, y, s.vx, s.vy);
828 apply_resync_metadata(best, s.owner, s.controllers, s.color);
829 used[best] = true;
830 snap_used[idx] = 1;
831 applied += 1;
832 }
833
834 // Rebuild remaining_snaps to exclude those already matched by name.
835 std::vector<size_t> tmp;
836 tmp.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
837 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
838 if (!snap_used[idx])
839 tmp.push_back(idx);
840 }
841 remaining_snaps.swap(tmp);
842 }
843
844 auto local_owner = [](Actor *a) -> int {
845 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
846 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
847 return static_cast<int>(owner);
848 return -1;
849 };
850
851 auto match_groups = [&](bool include_owner) -> unsigned {
852 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<size_t>> snap_groups;
853 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<Actor *>> local_groups;
854 snap_groups.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
855 local_groups.reserve(actors.size());
856
857 auto make_key = [&](Uint16 kind, int owner) -> uint32_t {
858 if (!include_owner)
859 return static_cast<uint32_t>(kind);
860 uint32_t o = static_cast<uint32_t>(owner + 1);
861 if (o > 0xFFFFu)
862 o = 0xFFFFu;
863 return (static_cast<uint32_t>(kind) << 16) | o;
864 };
865
866 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
867 if (snap_used[idx])
868 continue;
869 const auto &s = state.actors[idx];
870 int owner = (s.owner == 0xFFFF) ? -1 : static_cast<int>(s.owner);
871 snap_groups[make_key(s.actor_id, owner)].push_back(idx);
872 }
873 for (Actor *a : actors) {
874 if (!a || used[a])
875 continue;
876 int owner = local_owner(a);
877 uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(a));
878 local_groups[make_key(kind, owner)].push_back(a);
879 }
880
881 auto sort_snap = [&](size_t ai, size_t bi) {
882 const auto &a = state.actors[ai];
883 const auto &b = state.actors[bi];
884 if (a.x != b.x)
885 return a.x < b.x;
886 return a.y < b.y;
887 };
888 auto sort_local = [&](const Actor *a, const Actor *b) {
889 const ecl::V2 &pa = a->get_pos();
890 const ecl::V2 &pb = b->get_pos();
891 if (pa[0] != pb[0])
892 return pa[0] < pb[0];
893 return pa[1] < pb[1];
894 };
895
896 unsigned matched = 0;
897 for (auto &kv : snap_groups) {
898 auto it_local = local_groups.find(kv.first);
899 if (it_local == local_groups.end())
900 continue;
901 auto &snap_list = kv.second;
902 auto &local_list = it_local->second;
903 if (snap_list.empty() || local_list.empty())
904 continue;
905 std::sort(snap_list.begin(), snap_list.end(), sort_snap);
906 std::sort(local_list.begin(), local_list.end(), sort_local);
907 size_t n = std::min(snap_list.size(), local_list.size());
908 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
909 size_t snap_idx = snap_list[i];
910 Actor *actor = local_list[i];
911 if (!actor || used[actor] || snap_used[snap_idx])
912 continue;
913 const auto &s = state.actors[snap_idx];
914 float x = s.x + s.vx * dt;
915 float y = s.y + s.vy * dt;
916 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
917 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
918 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
919 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
920 if (d > max_pos_delta)
921 max_pos_delta = d;
922 if (!should_skip_actor(actor))
923 resync_teleport(actor, x, y, s.vx, s.vy);
924 apply_resync_metadata(actor, s.owner, s.controllers, s.color);
925 used[actor] = true;
926 snap_used[snap_idx] = 1;
927 applied += 1;
928 matched += 1;
929 }
930 }
931 return matched;
932 };
933
934 unsigned matched_by_group = 0;
935 // Pass 1: match by (kind, owner) when possible.
936 matched_by_group += match_groups(true);
937 // Pass 2: match by kind only for remaining (ownerless / ambiguous) actors.
938 // Rebuild remaining_snaps to exclude those already matched.
939 if (!remaining_snaps.empty()) {
940 std::vector<size_t> tmp;
941 tmp.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
942 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
943 if (!snap_used[idx])
944 tmp.push_back(idx);
945 }
946 remaining_snaps.swap(tmp);
947 }
948 if (!remaining_snaps.empty())
949 matched_by_group += match_groups(false);
950 // Rubberband "violation" flags can diverge across peers and then keep
951 // applying different forces even after actor positions are snapped. After
952 // teleporting, recompute these flags from the current anchor positions to
953 // reduce persistent post-resync drift in meditation levels.
954 std::vector<Rubberband *> rubbers;
955 GetRubberbands(rubbers);
956 for (Rubberband *rb : rubbers) {
957 if (!rb)
958 continue;
959 SendMessage(rb, "_mp_resync_flags");
960 }
961 if (debug_enabled())
962 debug_log("mp resync applied: actors=%u (obj_id=%u group=%u) max_pos_delta=%.3f",
963 applied, object_id_matches, matched_by_group,
964 static_cast<double>(max_pos_delta));
965 g_session.telemetry.resync_applied += 1;
966
967 // Mark the resync response as received. Do NOT reset attempts here: if the
968 // resync does not actually fix the divergence, resetting attempts would
969 // cause endless "jumpy" re-resync loops and prevent reaching the "failed
970 // resync" user-facing warning.
971 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
972 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
973 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
974 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
975 record_checksum_sample();
976}

1051bool host_ready_to_start() {
1052 if (!g_session.host)
1053 return false;
1054 if (g_session.expected_players <= 1)
1055 return true;
1056 if (g_session.peer_players.size() + g_session.relay_players.size() +
1057 g_session.tcp_relay_players.size() + 1 <
1058 g_session.expected_players) {
1059 return false;
1060 }
1061 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
1062 auto it = g_session.peer_ready.find(entry.first);
1063 if (it == g_session.peer_ready.end() || !it->second)
1064 return false;
1065 }
1066 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
1067 auto it = g_session.relay_ready.find(entry.first);
1068 if (it == g_session.relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
1069 return false;
1070 }
1071 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
1072 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_ready.find(entry.first);
1073 if (it == g_session.tcp_relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
1074 return false;
1075 }
1076 if (g_session.expected_players > g_session.level_players && g_session.level_players > 0) {
1077 if (g_session.placement_received.size() < g_session.expected_players)
1078 return false;
1079 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players;
1080 ++player) {
1081 if (!g_session.placement_received[player])
1082 return false;
1083 }
1084 }
1085 return true;
1086}

1093 }

1098void handle_sync_current(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync) {
1099 if (g_session.abort_pending)
1100 return;
1101 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1102 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u", sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1103 return;
1104 }
1105 g_session.telemetry.sync_current_total += 1;
1106 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
1107 if (sync.tick != local_tick) {
1108 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u", sync.tick, local_tick);
1109 return;
1110 }
1111 const uint64_t local_kind_checksum = WorldGridKindChecksum();
1112 const uint64_t local_state_checksum = WorldGridStateChecksum();
1113 const uint64_t local_movable_checksum = WorldGridMovableStoneChecksum();
1114 const uint64_t local_checksum =
1115 CombineWorldGridChecksums(local_kind_checksum, local_state_checksum, local_movable_checksum);
1116 update_checksum_sample_world(local_tick, local_checksum, local_kind_checksum, local_state_checksum);
1117 g_session.last_world_checksum = local_checksum;
1118 bool checksum_mismatch =
1119 (sync.world_checksum != 0 && sync.world_checksum != local_checksum);
1120 if (checksum_mismatch) {
1121 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu", sync.tick,
1122 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_checksum),
1123 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
1124 }
1125 bool kind_mismatch =
1126 (sync.grid_kind_checksum != 0 && sync.grid_kind_checksum != local_kind_checksum);
1127 bool state_mismatch =
1128 (sync.grid_state_checksum != 0 && sync.grid_state_checksum != local_state_checksum);
1129 if (kind_mismatch || state_mismatch) {
1130 debug_log("mp grid mismatch: tick=%u kind(local=%llu remote=%llu) state(local=%llu remote=%llu)",
1131 sync.tick,
1132 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_kind_checksum),
1133 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.grid_kind_checksum),
1134 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_state_checksum),
1135 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.grid_state_checksum));
1136 }
1137 uint64_t local_actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
1138 bool actor_mismatch =
1139 (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != local_actor_checksum);
1140 if (actor_mismatch) {
1141 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu", sync.tick,
1142 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_actor_checksum),
1143 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
1144 }
1145 Actor *p0 = sync_reference_actor(0, sync.tick);
1146 Actor *p1 = sync_reference_actor(1, sync.tick);
1147 float p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1148 float p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1149 float p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1150 float p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1151
1152 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
1153 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != server::RandomState;
1154 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1155 diff(sync.p0_y, p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1156 diff(sync.p1_x, p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1157 diff(sync.p1_y, p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
1158 if (pos_mismatch)
1159 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_pos += 1;
1160 if (rand_mismatch)
1161 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rand += 1;
1162 if (actor_mismatch)
1163 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_actor += 1;
1164 if (checksum_mismatch)
1165 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_world += 1;
1166
1167 const bool rng_only =
1168 (!pos_mismatch && rand_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1169 const bool diagnostic_only =
1170 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch));
1171 const bool soft_resync_candidate = (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch);
1172 const bool actor_resync_candidate =
1173 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && actor_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch);
1174 const bool world_only_mismatch =
1175 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1176 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
1177 if (rng_only)
1178 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rng_only += 1;
1179 if (diagnostic_only)
1180 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_diagnostic_only += 1;
1181 if (soft_resync_candidate)
1182 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate += 1;
1183
1184 const char *action =
1185 rng_only ? "rng-fix"
1186 : soft_resync_candidate ? "soft-resync"
1187 : actor_resync_candidate ? "actor-resync"
1188 : diagnostic_only ? "diagnostic-only"
1189 : "none";
1190 debug_log("mp desync: tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
1191 "flags(pos=%d rand=%d actor=%d world=%d) action=%s "
1192 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
1193 sync.tick, static_cast<unsigned>(server::RandomState),
1194 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
1195 pos_mismatch ? 1 : 0, rand_mismatch ? 1 : 0, actor_mismatch ? 1 : 0,
1196 checksum_mismatch ? 1 : 0, action,
1197 p0_x, p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
1198 p1_x, p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
1199 if (actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch)
1200 dump_actor_digest_once("sync_current_mismatch", sync.tick, &sync);
1201 if (rng_only) {
1202 server::RandomState = sync.random_state;
1203 g_session.telemetry.rng_resync_applied += 1;
1204 debug_log("mp rng resynced to %u", static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state));
1205 return;
1206 }
1207 }
1208
1209 // Actor/world checksums can diverge due to harmless platform floating-point
1210 // drift in physics-heavy levels. Drive recovery from position/RNG mismatch,
1211 // and keep checksums for diagnostics only.
1212 if (checksum_mismatch || kind_mismatch || state_mismatch) {
1213 g_session.world_only_desync_streak += 1;
1214 if (!g_session.host && g_session.world_state_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1215 send_world_state_request();
1216 g_session.world_state_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1217 }
1218 if (g_session.world_only_desync_streak >= 3 && !g_session.desync_reported) {
1219 g_session.desync_reported = true;
1220 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Syncing from host...", true, 4.0);
1221 }
1222 } else {
1223 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1224 }
1225 if (soft_resync_candidate) {
1226 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1227 g_session.desync_streak += 1;
1228 if (g_session.desync_streak < kDesyncStreakForResync)
1229 return;
1230 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1231 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1232 send_resync_request();
1233 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1234 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1235 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1236 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1237 }
1238 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1239 // Resync did not quickly converge. Keep running without prompting a restart:
1240 // most of these cases are physics drift that can self-heal or improve over time.
1241 // Throttle further requests instead of permanently giving up.
1242 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1243 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1244 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1245 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1246 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1247 }
1248 } else if (actor_resync_candidate) {
1249 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1250 g_session.actor_desync_streak += 1;
1251 if (g_session.actor_desync_streak < kActorDesyncStreakForResync)
1252 return;
1253 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1254 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1255 send_resync_request();
1256 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1257 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1258 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1259 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1260 }
1261 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1262 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1263 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1264 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1265 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1266 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1267 }
1268 } else {
1269 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1270 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1271 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1272 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1273 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1274 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1275 }
1276}
1277
1278void handle_sync_sample(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync,
1279 const SessionState::ChecksumSample &sample) {
1280 if (g_session.abort_pending)
1281 return;
1282 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1283 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u", sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1284 return;
1285 }
1286 g_session.telemetry.sync_sample_total += 1;
1287 bool checksum_mismatch = false;
1288 if (sample.world_valid && sync.world_checksum != 0)
1289 checksum_mismatch = sync.world_checksum != sample.world_checksum;
1290 bool kind_mismatch = false;
1291 bool state_mismatch = false;
1292 if (sample.world_valid) {
1293 if (sync.grid_kind_checksum != 0)
1294 kind_mismatch = sync.grid_kind_checksum != sample.grid_kind_checksum;
1295 if (sync.grid_state_checksum != 0)
1296 state_mismatch = sync.grid_state_checksum != sample.grid_state_checksum;
1297 }
1298 bool actor_mismatch = (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != sample.actor_checksum);
1299 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != sample.random_state;
1300 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
1301 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, sample.p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1302 diff(sync.p0_y, sample.p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1303 diff(sync.p1_x, sample.p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1304 diff(sync.p1_y, sample.p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
1305 if (pos_mismatch)
1306 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_pos += 1;
1307 if (rand_mismatch)
1308 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rand += 1;
1309 if (actor_mismatch)
1310 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_actor += 1;
1311 if (checksum_mismatch)
1312 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_world += 1;
1313
1314 const bool rng_only =
1315 (!pos_mismatch && rand_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1316 const bool diagnostic_only =
1317 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch));
1318 const bool soft_resync_candidate = (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch);
1319 const bool actor_resync_candidate =
1320 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && actor_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch);
1321 const bool world_only_mismatch =
1322 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1323
1324 if (checksum_mismatch) {
1325 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1326 sync.tick,
1327 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.world_checksum),
1328 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
1329 }
1330 if (kind_mismatch || state_mismatch) {
1331 debug_log("mp grid mismatch (late): tick=%u kind(local=%llu remote=%llu) state(local=%llu remote=%llu)",
1332 sync.tick,
1333 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.grid_kind_checksum),
1334 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.grid_kind_checksum),
1335 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.grid_state_checksum),
1336 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.grid_state_checksum));
1337 }
1338 if (actor_mismatch) {
1339 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1340 sync.tick,
1341 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.actor_checksum),
1342 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
1343 }
1344 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
1345 if (rng_only)
1346 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rng_only += 1;
1347 if (diagnostic_only)
1348 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_diagnostic_only += 1;
1349 if (soft_resync_candidate)
1350 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate += 1;
1351
1352 const char *action =
1353 rng_only ? "rng-fix"
1354 : soft_resync_candidate ? "soft-resync"
1355 : actor_resync_candidate ? "actor-resync"
1356 : diagnostic_only ? "diagnostic-only"
1357 : "none";
1358 debug_log("mp desync (late): tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
1359 "flags(pos=%d rand=%d actor=%d world=%d) action=%s "
1360 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
1361 sync.tick,
1362 static_cast<unsigned>(sample.random_state),
1363 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
1364 pos_mismatch ? 1 : 0, rand_mismatch ? 1 : 0, actor_mismatch ? 1 : 0,
1365 checksum_mismatch ? 1 : 0, action,
1366 sample.p0_x, sample.p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
1367 sample.p1_x, sample.p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
1368 if (actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch)
1369 dump_actor_digest_once("sync_sample_mismatch", sync.tick, &sync);
1370 }
1371
1372 // Actor checksums are useful diagnostics but too sensitive to drive recovery
1373 // on their own, especially in physics-heavy scenes.
1374 if (checksum_mismatch || kind_mismatch || state_mismatch) {
1375 g_session.world_only_desync_streak += 1;
1376 if (!g_session.host && g_session.world_state_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1377 send_world_state_request();
1378 g_session.world_state_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1379 }
1380 if (g_session.world_only_desync_streak >= 3 && !g_session.desync_reported) {
1381 g_session.desync_reported = true;
1382 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Syncing from host...", true, 4.0);
1383 }
1384 } else {
1385 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1386 }
1387 if (soft_resync_candidate) {
1388 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1389 g_session.desync_streak += 1;
1390 if (g_session.desync_streak < kDesyncStreakForResync)
1391 return;
1392 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1393 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1394 send_resync_request();
1395 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1396 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1397 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1398 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1399 }
1400 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1401 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1402 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1403 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1404 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1405 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1406 }
1407 } else if (actor_resync_candidate) {
1408 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1409 g_session.actor_desync_streak += 1;
1410 if (g_session.actor_desync_streak < kActorDesyncStreakForResync)
1411 return;
1412 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1413 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1414 send_resync_request();
1415 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1416 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1417 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1418 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1419 }
1420 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1421 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1422 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1423 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1424 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1425 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1426 }
1427 } else {
1428 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1429 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1430 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1431 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1432 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1433 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1434 }
1435}

1437void record_checksum_sample() {
1438 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
1439 g_session.last_checksum_tick = tick;
1440 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
1441 sample.tick = tick;
1442 sample.actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
1443 sample.world_checksum = 0;
1444 sample.grid_kind_checksum = 0;
1445 sample.grid_state_checksum = 0;
1446 sample.world_valid = false;
1447 sample.random_state = server::RandomState;
1448 Actor *p0 = sync_reference_actor(0, tick);
1449 Actor *p1 = sync_reference_actor(1, tick);
1450 sample.p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1451 sample.p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1452 sample.p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1453 sample.p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1454 if (!g_session.checksum_history.empty() && g_session.checksum_history.back().tick == tick) {
1455 bool preserve_world = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid;
1456 uint64_t preserved_checksum = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum;
1457 g_session.checksum_history.back() = sample;
1458 if (preserve_world) {
1459 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid = true;
1460 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum = preserved_checksum;
1461 }
1462 return;
1463 }
1464 g_session.checksum_history.push_back(sample);
1465 while (g_session.checksum_history.size() > kChecksumHistory)
1466 g_session.checksum_history.pop_front();
1467}

A src/multiplayer_session_transport.cc

Description
  • Session transport plumbing: packet IO, polling, and shutdown behavior.
Where it is used
  • Used by session tick to exchange per-tick input and control messages.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Ensures abort/shutdown stops transport polling immediately to avoid use-after-free and UI stalls.
  • Validates READY/START against the current `session_id`, `epoch`, and per-level `load_id` so late packets cannot unblock the wrong level start.
  • Implements host-driven level transitions by handling `NET_LOAD_LEVEL` (switch pack + load level by normalized path).
  • Improves world-state snapshot application: reorder movable stones before applying per-tile kinds/states to preserve object identity and reduce visible morphing.
  • Uses ENet-version-compatible address formatting in debug logs (works with vendored ENet 1.0 and ENet 1.3).
  • When ENet >= 1.3 is available, configures peer timeout on accept so temporary network stalls can recover without immediate disconnect.

66std::string stable_world_kind(Object *obj) {
67 if (!obj)
68 return std::string();
69 // Must match the encoding side (multiplayer_session_sync.cc): use template-backed
70 // kind strings for objects where Object::getKind() is schema-incomplete.
71 if (PuzzleStone *ps = dynamic_cast<PuzzleStone *>(obj)) {
72 const int color = static_cast<int>(ps->getAttr("color"));
73 const std::string con = ps->getAttr("connections").to_string();
74 int bits = 0;
75 if (con.find('w') != std::string::npos)
76 bits |= 1;
77 if (con.find('s') != std::string::npos)
78 bits |= 2;
79 if (con.find('e') != std::string::npos)
80 bits |= 4;
81 if (con.find('n') != std::string::npos)
82 bits |= 8;
83 static const char *kSuffix[16] = {"", "w", "s", "sw", "e", "ew", "es", "esw",
84 "n", "nw", "ns", "nsw", "ne", "new", "nes", "nesw"};
85 const char *base = "st_puzzle";
86 if (color == BLUE)
87 base = "st_puzzle_blue";
88 else if (color == YELLOW)
89 base = "st_puzzle_yellow";
90 const bool hollow = ps->getAttr("hollow").to_bool();
91 if (hollow && color == YELLOW && bits == 15)
92 return "st_puzzle_yellow_nesw_hollow";
93 const char *suffix = kSuffix[bits & 15];
94 if (!suffix || !*suffix)
95 return base;
96 return std::string(base) + "_" + suffix;
97 }
98 return obj->getKind();
99}

182protocol::DebugOptionsPacket build_debug_options_from_prefs() {
183 protocol::DebugOptionsPacket msg;
184 msg.version = 1;
185 msg.tick_ms = g_session.tick_ms;
186
187 Uint32 mask = 0;
188 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugLogging"))
189 mask |= DBG_LOGGING;
190 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugDumpState"))
191 mask |= DBG_DUMP_STATE;
192 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugTraceWorldInit"))
193 mask |= DBG_TRACE_INIT;
194 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugSmoothRender"))
195 mask |= DBG_SMOOTH_RENDER;
196 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugSkipLocalResync"))
197 mask |= DBG_SKIP_LOCAL_RESYNC;
198 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugForceRelay"))
199 mask |= DBG_FORCE_RELAY;
200 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugBindLocal"))
201 mask |= DBG_BIND_LOCAL;
202 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugZeroFillInputs"))
203 mask |= DBG_ZEROFILL;
204 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRollbackEnabled"))
205 mask |= DBG_ROLLBACK;
206 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall"))
207 mask |= DBG_REMOTE_LOCAL_BALL;
208 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugNetSimEnabled"))
209 mask |= DBG_NETSIM;
210 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugNetSimAll"))
211 mask |= DBG_NETSIM_ALL;
212
213 msg.bool_mask = mask;
214 msg.predict_missing_mouse_ticks =
215 static_cast<Uint16>(std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugPredictMissingMouseTicks")));
216 msg.input_delay_legacy_ticks =
217 static_cast<Uint16>(std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugInputDelayTicks")));
218 msg.host_resync_stride_legacy_ticks = static_cast<Uint16>(
219 std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastResyncStrideTicks")));
220 msg.host_world_stride_legacy_ticks = static_cast<Uint16>(
221 std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugHostBroadcastWorldStateStrideTicks")));
222 msg.rollback_keep_ticks =
223 static_cast<Uint16>(std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugRollbackKeepTicks")));
224 msg.netsim_delay_ms =
225 static_cast<Uint16>(std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDelayMs")));
226 msg.netsim_jitter_ms =
227 static_cast<Uint16>(std::max(0, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimJitterMs")));
228 msg.netsim_drop_pct = static_cast<Uint8>(
229 std::max(0, std::min(100, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDropPct"))));
230 msg.netsim_dup_pct = static_cast<Uint8>(
231 std::max(0, std::min(100, options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDupPct"))));
232 return msg;
233}

262 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugRollbackKeepTicks", static_cast<double>(msg.rollback_keep_ticks));
263 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDelayMs", static_cast<double>(msg.netsim_delay_ms));
264 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugNetSimJitterMs", static_cast<double>(msg.netsim_jitter_ms));
265 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDropPct", static_cast<double>(msg.netsim_drop_pct));
266 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDupPct", static_cast<double>(msg.netsim_dup_pct));
267 // Keep the Debug UI consistent with the negotiated tick length.
268 options::SetOption("MultiplayerDebugTickLengthMs", static_cast<double>(msg.tick_ms));

281void host_send_current_load_to_remote(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, Uint32 relay_client_id) {
282 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.host)
283 return;
284 if (g_session.load_id == 0 || g_session.level_id.empty())
285 return;
286
287 protocol::LoadLevelPacket msg;
288 msg.load_id = g_session.load_id;
289 msg.pack_name = g_session.level_pack_name;
290 msg.level_id = g_session.level_id;
291 ecl::Buffer buf;
292 protocol::encode_load_level(buf, msg);
293
294 switch (source) {
295 case HostSource::DIRECT:
296 g_transport.HostSendDirect(peer, buf);
297 break;
298 case HostSource::UDP_RELAY:
299 g_transport.HostSendUdpRelay(relay_client_id, buf);
300 break;
301 case HostSource::TCP_RELAY:
302 g_transport.HostSendTcpRelay(relay_client_id, buf);
303 break;
304 default:
305 break;
306 }
307 g_transport.Flush();
308}

310bool should_apply_late_mouse_sample(unsigned player_id, uint32_t current_tick, uint32_t src_tick) {
311 if (player_id >= input::kMaxPlayers)
312 return false;
313 // Never overwrite an on-time sample for the current tick with a late one.
314 if (!g_session.late_mouse_valid[player_id] || g_session.late_mouse_applied_tick[player_id] != current_tick) {
315 if (input::HasInput(current_tick, player_id))
316 return false;
317 g_session.late_mouse_valid[player_id] = true;
318 g_session.late_mouse_applied_tick[player_id] = current_tick;
319 g_session.late_mouse_src_tick[player_id] = 0;
320 }
321 if (src_tick <= g_session.late_mouse_src_tick[player_id])
322 return false;
323 g_session.late_mouse_src_tick[player_id] = src_tick;
324 return true;
325}

427void broadcast_input(const protocol::InputPacket &pkt, ENetPeer *exclude, Uint32 exclude_udp_relay,
428 Uint32 exclude_tcp_relay) {
429 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
430 if (entry.first == exclude)
431 continue;
432 send_input_to_peer(entry.first, pkt);
433 }
434 ecl::Buffer buf;
435 protocol::encode_input(buf, pkt);
436 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
437 g_transport.HostBroadcastUdpRelay(buf, exclude_udp_relay);
438 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
439 g_transport.HostBroadcastTcpRelay(buf, exclude_tcp_relay);
440}
441
442void broadcast_input_bundle(const protocol::InputBundlePacket &pkt, ENetPeer *exclude,
443 Uint32 exclude_udp_relay, Uint32 exclude_tcp_relay) {
444 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
445 if (entry.first == exclude)
446 continue;
447 send_input_bundle_to_peer(entry.first, pkt);
448 }
449 ecl::Buffer buf;
450 protocol::encode_input_bundle(buf, pkt);
451 // Relay forwarding is currently reliable on the host->relay hop; payload redundancy still helps.
452 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
453 g_transport.HostBroadcastUdpRelay(buf, exclude_udp_relay);
454 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
455 g_transport.HostBroadcastTcpRelay(buf, exclude_tcp_relay);
456}
457
458bool handle_host_input_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
459 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
460 ecl::Buffer buf;
461 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
462 protocol::InputPacket input_msg;
463 if (!protocol::decode_input(buf, input_msg))
464 return false;
465 if (input_msg.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
466 debug_log("mp drop input: tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u", input_msg.tick, input_msg.epoch,
467 g_session.input_epoch);
468 return true;
469 }
470 if (input_msg.tick < 20) {
471 debug_log("mp recv input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
472 input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y,
473 static_cast<int>(input_msg.rotate_steps),
474 static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.activate_count));
475 }
476 const uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
477 const uint32_t src_tick = input_msg.tick;
478 const bool late = (input_msg.tick < current_tick);
479 if (late) {
480 if (!input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled())
481 return true;
482 // Monotonic processing: late inputs are applied at the current tick (best-effort).
483 // This avoids requiring rollback/replay and prevents unbounded growth of past-tick
484 // inputs that can never be consumed again.
485 input_msg.tick = current_tick;
486 }
487 unsigned player_id = 0;
488 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id)) {
489 // Fallback: if transport-side peer->player mapping is temporarily missing
490 // (e.g. relay race/replace edge-cases), accept the claimed player id as a
491 // best-effort input source. This keeps gameplay responsive and is limited
492 // to cases where we already failed to attribute the packet to a known peer.
493 const unsigned claimed = static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.player);
494 if (claimed < g_session.expected_players && claimed != g_session.local_player) {
495 player_id = claimed;
496 if (debug_enabled()) {
497 debug_log("mp host: input fallback claim=%u (source=%d relay_id=%u peer=%p)",
498 claimed, static_cast<int>(source),
499 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_client_id),
500 static_cast<void *>(peer));
501 }
502 } else {
503 return true;
504 }
505 }
506 if (late) {
507 if (!should_apply_late_mouse_sample(player_id, current_tick, src_tick)) {
508 input_msg.mouse_x = 0.0f;
509 input_msg.mouse_y = 0.0f;
510 }
511 }
512 input::PlayerInput pi;
513 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y);
514 pi.rotate_steps = input_msg.rotate_steps;
515 pi.activate_count = input_msg.activate_count;
516 input::EnqueueInput(input_msg.tick, player_id, pi);
517 rollback::RecordInput(input_msg.tick, player_id, pi);
518 protocol::InputPacket forward = input_msg;
519 forward.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player_id);
520 broadcast_input(forward, source == HostSource::DIRECT ? peer : nullptr,
521 source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0,
522 source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0);
523 return true;
524}
525
526bool handle_host_input_bundle_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
527 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
528 ecl::Buffer buf;
529 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
530 protocol::InputBundlePacket bundle;
531 if (!protocol::decode_input_bundle(buf, bundle))
532 return false;
533 if (bundle.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
534 debug_log("mp drop input bundle: first tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
535 bundle.first_tick, bundle.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
536 return true;
537 }
538 if (bundle.first_tick < 20) {
539 debug_log("mp recv input bundle: first tick=%u player=%u count=%u", bundle.first_tick,
540 bundle.player, static_cast<unsigned>(bundle.entries.size()));
541 }
542 unsigned player_id = 0;
543 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id)) {
544 // Same rationale as handle_host_input_packet(): preserve playability when
545 // peer->player attribution is missing.
546 const unsigned claimed = static_cast<unsigned>(bundle.player);
547 if (claimed < g_session.expected_players && claimed != g_session.local_player) {
548 player_id = claimed;
549 if (debug_enabled()) {
550 debug_log("mp host: input bundle fallback claim=%u (source=%d relay_id=%u peer=%p)",
551 claimed, static_cast<int>(source),
552 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_client_id),
553 static_cast<void *>(peer));
554 }
555 } else {
556 return true;
557 }
558 }
559 const uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
560 // If we receive a whole bundle "too late" to apply at its intended ticks (common under
561 // high latency when zerofill keeps the sim running), clamping every entry to
562 // `current_tick` will overwrite earlier non-zero samples with later zero samples.
563 // Instead, aggregate the late entries and apply at most one sample at `current_tick`.
564 input::PlayerInput late_agg;
565 bool late_mouse_set = false;
566 uint32_t late_mouse_src_tick = 0;
567 bool have_late = false;
568 for (size_t i = 0; i < bundle.entries.size(); ++i) {
569 uint32_t tick = bundle.first_tick + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);
570 const auto &e = bundle.entries[i];
571 input::PlayerInput pi;
572 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(e.mouse_x, e.mouse_y);
573 pi.rotate_steps = e.rotate_steps;
574 pi.activate_count = e.activate_count;
575 if (tick < current_tick) {
576 if (!input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled())
577 continue;
578 // Otherwise, best-effort apply at `current_tick` once.
579 have_late = true;
580 late_agg.rotate_steps += pi.rotate_steps;
581 late_agg.activate_count += pi.activate_count;
582 // Mouse input is an impulse. If packets arrive out of order, applying an
583 // older impulse after a newer one causes visible "kicks". Keep only the
584 // newest non-zero impulse and ignore stale ones.
585 if (pi.mouse_force[0] != 0.0f || pi.mouse_force[1] != 0.0f) {
586 late_mouse_set = true;
587 if (!late_mouse_src_tick || tick > late_mouse_src_tick) {
588 late_mouse_src_tick = tick;
589 late_agg.mouse_force = pi.mouse_force;
590 }
591 }
592 continue;
593 }
594 input::EnqueueInput(tick, player_id, pi);
595 rollback::RecordInput(tick, player_id, pi);
596 }
597 if (have_late) {
598 if (late_mouse_set) {
599 if (!should_apply_late_mouse_sample(player_id, current_tick, late_mouse_src_tick))
600 late_agg.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0.0f, 0.0f);
601 } else {
602 late_agg.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0.0f, 0.0f);
603 }
604 const bool already_late =
605 (player_id < input::kMaxPlayers && g_session.late_mouse_valid[player_id] &&
606 g_session.late_mouse_applied_tick[player_id] == current_tick);
607 if (!late_agg.empty() && (!input::HasInput(current_tick, player_id) || already_late)) {
608 input::EnqueueInput(current_tick, player_id, late_agg);
609 rollback::RecordInput(current_tick, player_id, late_agg);
610 }
611 }
612 protocol::InputBundlePacket forward = bundle;
613 forward.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player_id);
614 broadcast_input_bundle(forward, source == HostSource::DIRECT ? peer : nullptr,
615 source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0,
616 source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0);
617 return true;
618}
619
620bool handle_host_resync_request_packet(const char *data, size_t len, HostSource source,
621 Uint32 relay_client_id, ENetPeer *peer) {
622 ecl::Buffer buf;
623 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
624 protocol::ResyncRequest req;
625 if (!protocol::decode_resync_request(buf, req))
626 return false;
627 if (req.epoch == g_session.input_epoch) {
628 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY)
629 send_resync_state_to_relay(relay_client_id);
630 else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY)
631 send_resync_state_to_tcp_relay(relay_client_id);
632 else
633 send_resync_state(peer);
634 }
635 return true;
636}

638bool handle_host_world_state_request_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
639 ecl::Buffer buf;
640 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
641 protocol::WorldStateRequest req;
642 if (!protocol::decode_world_state_request(buf, req))
643 return false;
644 if (req.epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
645 return true;
646 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING || !server::WorldInitialized) {
647 if (debug_enabled())
648 debug_log("mp host: drop world-state request (not running / world not initialized)");
649 return true;
650 }
651 // For now broadcast to all peers. This keeps everyone converging even if only
652 // one client noticed the mismatch.
653 if (debug_enabled())
654 debug_log("mp host: world-state request recv: tick=%u", req.tick);
655 broadcast_world_state_reliable();
656 return true;
657}
658
659bool handle_host_ready_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
660 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
661 ecl::Buffer buf;
662 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
663 Uint32 session_id = 0;
664 Uint32 epoch = 0;
665 Uint32 load_id = 0;
666 if (!protocol::decode_ready(buf, session_id, epoch, load_id))
667 return false;
668 if (session_id != g_session.session_id) {
669 if (debug_enabled())
670 debug_log("mp host: drop ready (session mismatch remote=%u local=%u)",
671 static_cast<unsigned>(session_id),
672 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.session_id));
673 return true;
674 }
675 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
676 if (debug_enabled())
677 debug_log("mp host: drop ready (epoch mismatch remote=%u local=%u)",
678 static_cast<unsigned>(epoch),
679 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.input_epoch));
680 return true;
681 }
682 if (load_id != g_session.load_id) {
683 if (debug_enabled())
684 debug_log("mp host: drop ready (load mismatch remote=%u local=%u)",
685 static_cast<unsigned>(load_id),
686 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.load_id));
687 // Help clients recover if they sent READY before observing NET_LOAD_LEVEL,
688 // or if a load packet was lost. Re-announce the current load to that peer.
689 host_send_current_load_to_remote(source, peer, relay_client_id);
690 return true;
691 }
692 unsigned player_id = 0;
693 if (lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id)) {
694 bool already_ready = false;
695 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
696 auto it = g_session.relay_ready.find(relay_client_id);
697 already_ready = (it != g_session.relay_ready.end() && it->second);
698 } else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
699 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_ready.find(relay_client_id);
700 already_ready = (it != g_session.tcp_relay_ready.end() && it->second);
701 } else {
702 auto it = g_session.peer_ready.find(peer);
703 already_ready = (it != g_session.peer_ready.end() && it->second);
704 }
705 if (!already_ready) {
706 debug_log("mp host: ready player=%u source=%s", player_id, host_source_name(source));
707 mark_remote_ready(source, peer, relay_client_id);
708 debug_log("mp host: peer ready");
709 }
710 }
711 return true;
712}

714bool handle_host_pause_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
715 ecl::Buffer buf;
716 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
717 Uint32 epoch = 0;
718 bool paused = false;
719 if (!protocol::decode_pause(buf, epoch, paused))
720 return false;
721 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
722 return true;
723 SessionRequestPause(paused);
724 return true;
725}
726
727bool handle_host_menu_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
728 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
729 ecl::Buffer buf;
730 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
731 Uint32 epoch = 0;
732 Uint8 ignored_player = 0;
733 bool open = false;
734 if (!protocol::decode_menu(buf, epoch, ignored_player, open))
735 return false;
736 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
737 return true;
738 unsigned player_id = 0;
739 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id))
740 return true;
741 if (player_id >= g_session.menu_open.size())
742 return true;
743 if (g_session.menu_open[player_id] == open)
744 return true;
745 g_session.menu_open[player_id] = open;
746
747 bool want_pause = false;
748 for (bool any : g_session.menu_open) {
749 if (any) {
750 want_pause = true;
751 break;
752 }
753 }
754 SessionRequestPause(want_pause);
755 return true;
756}

758bool handle_host_abort_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
759 ecl::Buffer buf;
760 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
761 Uint32 epoch = 0;
762 if (!protocol::decode_abort(buf, epoch))
763 return false;
764 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
765 return true;
766 // Abort is global: one player aborts => end the session for all.
767 send_abort_to_peers();
768 begin_abort_after_grace("Game aborted. Ending session.");
769 return true;
770}
771
772bool handle_host_placement_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
773 ecl::Buffer buf;
774 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
775 protocol::PlacementPacket place;
776 if (!protocol::decode_place(buf, place))
777 return false;
778 if (place.restart_id == g_session.restart_id && place.player < g_session.expected_players) {
779 GridPos pos(static_cast<int>(place.x), static_cast<int>(place.y));
780 if (placement_required_for_player(place.player) && is_valid_placement(pos, place.player)) {
781 apply_placement(place.player, pos);
782 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > place.player)
783 g_session.placement_received[place.player] = true;
784 broadcast_placement(place);
785 }
786 }
787 return true;
788}
789
790bool handle_host_pong_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
791 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
792 ecl::Buffer buf;
793 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
794 protocol::PongPacket pong;
795 if (!protocol::decode_pong(buf, pong))
796 return false;
797 if (!g_session.host || !g_session.auto_detect_active)
798 return true;
799 unsigned player_id = 0;
800 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id))
801 return true;
802 if (player_id >= g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms.size())
803 return true;
804 auto &inflight = g_session.auto_detect_inflight_ms[player_id];
805 auto it = inflight.find(pong.ping_id);
806 if (it == inflight.end())
807 return true;
808 const Uint32 sent_ms = it->second;
809 inflight.erase(it);
810 const Uint32 now_ms = SDL_GetTicks();
811 const Uint32 rtt_ms = (now_ms >= sent_ms) ? (now_ms - sent_ms) : 0;
812 if (player_id < g_session.auto_detect_recv.size())
813 g_session.auto_detect_recv[player_id] += 1;
814 if (player_id < g_session.auto_detect_rtts_ms.size())
815 g_session.auto_detect_rtts_ms[player_id].push_back(rtt_ms);
816 return true;
817}
818
819bool handle_host_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
820 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
821 if (handle_host_pong_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
822 return true;
823 if (handle_host_input_bundle_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
824 return true;
825 if (handle_host_input_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
826 return true;
827 if (handle_host_resync_request_packet(data, len, source, relay_client_id, peer))
828 return true;
829 if (handle_host_world_state_request_packet(data, len))
830 return true;
831 if (handle_host_ready_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
832 return true;
833 if (handle_host_menu_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
834 return true;
835 if (handle_host_pause_packet(data, len))
836 return true;
837 if (handle_host_abort_packet(data, len))
838 return true;
839 if (handle_host_placement_packet(data, len))
840 return true;
841 return false;
842}

844bool handle_client_input_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
845 ecl::Buffer buf;
846 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
847 protocol::InputPacket input_msg;
848 if (!protocol::decode_input(buf, input_msg))
849 return false;
850 if (input_msg.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
851 debug_log("mp drop input: tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u", input_msg.tick, input_msg.epoch,
852 g_session.input_epoch);
853 return true;
854 }
855 if (input_msg.tick < 20) {
856 debug_log("mp recv input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
857 input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y,
858 static_cast<int>(input_msg.rotate_steps),
859 static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.activate_count));
860 }
861 const uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
862 const uint32_t src_tick = input_msg.tick;
863 if (input_msg.tick < current_tick) {
864 if (!input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled())
865 return true;
866 // Monotonic processing: late inputs are applied at the current tick.
867 input_msg.tick = current_tick;
868 if (!should_apply_late_mouse_sample(static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.player), current_tick, src_tick)) {
869 input_msg.mouse_x = 0.0f;
870 input_msg.mouse_y = 0.0f;
871 }
872 }
873 input::PlayerInput pi;
874 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y);
875 pi.rotate_steps = input_msg.rotate_steps;
876 pi.activate_count = input_msg.activate_count;
877 input::EnqueueInput(input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, pi);
878 rollback::RecordInput(input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, pi);
879 return true;
880}

882bool handle_client_input_bundle_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
883 ecl::Buffer buf;
884 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
885 protocol::InputBundlePacket bundle;
886 if (!protocol::decode_input_bundle(buf, bundle))
887 return false;
888 if (bundle.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
889 debug_log("mp drop input bundle: first tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
890 bundle.first_tick, bundle.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
891 return true;
892 }
893 if (bundle.first_tick < 20) {
894 debug_log("mp recv input bundle: first tick=%u player=%u count=%u", bundle.first_tick,
895 bundle.player, static_cast<unsigned>(bundle.entries.size()));
896 }
897 const uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
898 input::PlayerInput late_agg;
899 bool late_mouse_set = false;
900 uint32_t late_mouse_src_tick = 0;
901 bool have_late = false;
902 for (size_t i = 0; i < bundle.entries.size(); ++i) {
903 uint32_t tick = bundle.first_tick + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);
904 const auto &e = bundle.entries[i];
905 input::PlayerInput pi;
906 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(e.mouse_x, e.mouse_y);
907 pi.rotate_steps = e.rotate_steps;
908 pi.activate_count = e.activate_count;
909 if (tick < current_tick) {
910 if (!input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled())
911 continue;
912 have_late = true;
913 late_agg.rotate_steps += pi.rotate_steps;
914 late_agg.activate_count += pi.activate_count;
915 if (pi.mouse_force[0] != 0.0f || pi.mouse_force[1] != 0.0f) {
916 late_mouse_set = true;
917 if (!late_mouse_src_tick || tick > late_mouse_src_tick) {
918 late_mouse_src_tick = tick;
919 late_agg.mouse_force = pi.mouse_force;
920 }
921 }
922 continue;
923 }
924 input::EnqueueInput(tick, bundle.player, pi);
925 rollback::RecordInput(tick, bundle.player, pi);
926 }
927 if (have_late) {
928 const unsigned player_id = static_cast<unsigned>(bundle.player);
929 if (late_mouse_set) {
930 if (!should_apply_late_mouse_sample(player_id, current_tick, late_mouse_src_tick))
931 late_agg.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0.0f, 0.0f);
932 } else {
933 late_agg.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0.0f, 0.0f);
934 }
935 const bool already_late =
936 (player_id < input::kMaxPlayers && g_session.late_mouse_valid[player_id] &&
937 g_session.late_mouse_applied_tick[player_id] == current_tick);
938 if (!late_agg.empty() && (!input::HasInput(current_tick, player_id) || already_late)) {
939 input::EnqueueInput(current_tick, bundle.player, late_agg);
940 rollback::RecordInput(current_tick, bundle.player, late_agg);
941 }
942 }
943 return true;
944}

946bool handle_client_welcome_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
947 ecl::Buffer buf;
948 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
949 Uint8 player_id = 0;
950 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
951 Uint32 seed = 0;
952 Uint16 tick_ms = 0;
953 if (!protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed, &tick_ms))
954 return false;
955 g_session.local_player = player_id;
956 g_session.local_player_known = true;
957 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
958 g_session.seed = seed;
959 if (tick_ms != 0)
960 g_session.tick_ms = tick_ms;
961 input::SetTickTimestep(static_cast<double>(g_session.tick_ms) / 1000.0);
962 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
963 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u tick_ms=%u",
964 player_id, expected_players, seed, static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.tick_ms));
965 if (debug_enabled())
966 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s", transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
967 // Do not send READY here.
968 //
969 // READY must mean "level pack switched + level loaded, waiting for NET_START".
970 // If we send READY immediately after WELCOME, the host can start running while
971 // the client is still switching packs (or even failing to load the level).
972 return true;
973}
974
975bool handle_client_debug_options_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
976 ecl::Buffer buf;
977 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
978 protocol::DebugOptionsPacket msg;
979 if (!protocol::decode_debug_options(buf, msg))
980 return false;
981 // Apply host-provided session settings before NET_START. Avoid mutating
982 // simulation-affecting settings while the world is already running.
983 const bool allow_sim_mutation = (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING);
984 apply_debug_options_to_options(msg, allow_sim_mutation);
985 if (allow_sim_mutation && msg.tick_ms != 0) {
986 g_session.tick_ms = msg.tick_ms;
987 input::SetTickTimestep(static_cast<double>(g_session.tick_ms) / 1000.0);
988 }
989 if (debug_enabled()) {
990 debug_log("mp client: debug options applied tick_ms=%u sim_mut=%d",
991 static_cast<unsigned>(msg.tick_ms),
992 allow_sim_mutation ? 1 : 0);
993 }
994 return true;
995}
996
997bool handle_client_ping_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
998 ecl::Buffer buf;
999 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1000 protocol::PingPacket ping;
1001 if (!protocol::decode_ping(buf, ping))
1002 return false;
1003 if (g_session.host)
1004 return true;
1005 protocol::PongPacket pong;
1006 pong.ping_id = ping.ping_id;
1007 ecl::Buffer out;
1008 protocol::encode_pong(out, pong);
1009 g_transport.ClientSendUnreliable(out);
1010 return true;
1011}
1012
1013bool handle_client_sync_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1014 if (g_session.abort_pending)
1015 return true;
1016 ecl::Buffer buf;
1017 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1018 protocol::SyncPacket sync;
1019 if (!protocol::decode_sync(buf, sync))
1020 return false;
1021 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
1022 if (local_tick < sync.tick) {
1023 g_session.pending_sync = sync;
1024 g_session.has_pending_sync = true;
1025 } else if (local_tick == sync.tick) {
1026 handle_sync_current(sync);
1027 } else {
1028 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
1029 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample)) {
1030 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
1031 } else {
1032 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u (no history)", sync.tick,
1033 local_tick);
1034 }
1035 }
1036 return true;
1037}
1038
1039bool handle_client_resync_state_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1040 ecl::Buffer buf;
1041 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1042 protocol::ResyncState state;
1043 if (!protocol::decode_resync_state(buf, state))
1044 return false;
1045 if (g_session.active && state.epoch == g_session.input_epoch) {
1046 // NET_RESYNC_STATE can be sent via unreliable broadcast (debug/remote-control mode).
1047 // That path can reorder packets. Applying an older snapshot after a newer one
1048 // causes visible "backwards" zickzack motion.
1049 if (!g_session.host && state.tick <= g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick) {
1050 if (debug_enabled())
1051 debug_log("mp drop resync state: stale tick=%u last=%u", state.tick,
1052 g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick);
1053 return true;
1054 }
1055 }
1056 // If we treat the local ball as remote-controlled, apply authoritative snapshots
1057 // immediately; rollback/replay adds latency and is not useful when we suppress
1058 // local simulation inputs.
1059 if (!g_session.host && options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall")) {
1060 apply_resync_state(state);
1061 if (g_session.active && state.epoch == g_session.input_epoch)
1062 g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick = state.tick;
1063 return true;
1064 }
1065 // If rollback is enabled, prefer reconciling via rollback/replay instead of
1066 // teleporting immediately. This reduces visible zig-zagging under packet loss.
1067 if (rollback::TryQueueReconcileResyncState(state)) {
1068 if (g_session.active && state.epoch == g_session.input_epoch)
1069 g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick = state.tick;
1070 return true;
1071 }
1072 apply_resync_state(state);
1073 if (g_session.active && state.epoch == g_session.input_epoch)
1074 g_session.last_accepted_resync_tick = state.tick;
1075 return true;
1076}
1077
1078bool handle_client_world_state_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1079 ecl::Buffer buf;
1080 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1081 protocol::WorldStatePacket pkt;
1082 if (!protocol::decode_world_state(buf, pkt))
1083 return false;
1084 if (!g_session.active)
1085 return true;
1086 if (pkt.epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
1087 return true;
1088 const int w = Width();
1089 const int h = Height();
1090 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
1091 return true;
1092 if (static_cast<Uint16>(w) != pkt.width || static_cast<Uint16>(h) != pkt.height)
1093 return true;
1094 const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(w) * static_cast<size_t>(h);
1095 if (pkt.floor_state.size() != count || pkt.stone_state.size() != count || pkt.item_state.size() != count)
1096 return true;
1097
1098 const bool have_kinds =
1099 (pkt.floor_kind.size() == count && pkt.stone_kind.size() == count && pkt.item_kind.size() == count &&
1100 !pkt.kind_dict.empty());
1101 if (debug_enabled()) {
1102 debug_log("mp world-state recv: tick=%u kinds=%d movable=%u", pkt.tick, have_kinds ? 1 : 0,
1103 static_cast<unsigned>(pkt.movable_stones.size()));
1104 }
1105
1106 auto kind_lookup = [&pkt](Uint16 id) -> const std::string * {
1107 if (id == 0)
1108 return nullptr;
1109 const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(id - 1);
1110 if (idx >= pkt.kind_dict.size())
1111 return nullptr;
1112 return &pkt.kind_dict[idx];
1113 };
1114
1115 // Reconcile positions of movable stones (puzzle stones, doors, etc) before applying
1116 // per-tile kind/state. This avoids destructive kill/recreate moves for movable stones.
1117 if (!pkt.movable_stones.empty()) {
1118 auto key = [](int x, int y) -> uint32_t {
1119 return (static_cast<uint32_t>(x) << 16) | static_cast<uint32_t>(y);
1120 };
1121 auto key_to_pos = [](uint32_t k) -> GridPos {
1122 int x = static_cast<int>((k >> 16) & 0xFFFFu);
1123 int y = static_cast<int>(k & 0xFFFFu);
1124 return GridPos(x, y);
1125 };
1126
1127 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> current_pos_by_id;
1128 current_pos_by_id.reserve(pkt.movable_stones.size() * 2);
1129 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
1130 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
1131 GridPos p(x, y);
1132 Stone *st = GetStone(p);
1133 if (!st || !st->is_movable())
1134 continue;
1135 current_pos_by_id[static_cast<uint32_t>(st->getId())] = key(x, y);
1136 }
1137 }
1138
1139 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> src_to_dst;
1140 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> src_by_dst;
1141 src_to_dst.reserve(pkt.movable_stones.size());
1142 src_by_dst.reserve(pkt.movable_stones.size());
1143 for (const auto &e : pkt.movable_stones) {
1144 auto it = current_pos_by_id.find(static_cast<uint32_t>(e.object_id));
1145 if (it == current_pos_by_id.end())
1146 continue;
1147 const uint32_t src = it->second;
1148 const uint32_t dst = key(static_cast<int>(e.x), static_cast<int>(e.y));
1149 if (src == dst)
1150 continue;
1151 src_to_dst[src] = dst;
1152 src_by_dst[dst] = src;
1153 }
1154
1155 // Resolve simple chains first: whenever a destination is empty, move into it.
1156 bool progressed = true;
1157 while (progressed) {
1158 progressed = false;
1159 for (auto it = src_to_dst.begin(); it != src_to_dst.end(); ++it) {
1160 const uint32_t src = it->first;
1161 const uint32_t dst = it->second;
1162 GridPos dst_pos = key_to_pos(dst);
1163 if (GetStone(dst_pos) != nullptr)
1164 continue;
1165 MoveStone(key_to_pos(src), dst_pos);
1166 src_by_dst.erase(dst);
1167 src_to_dst.erase(it);
1168 progressed = true;
1169 break;
1170 }
1171 }
1172
1173 // Remaining moves are cycles. Break cycles by temporarily yielding one stone into memory.
1174 while (!src_to_dst.empty()) {
1175 const uint32_t start_src = src_to_dst.begin()->first;
1176 const uint32_t start_dst = src_to_dst.begin()->second;
1177 GridPos start_src_pos = key_to_pos(start_src);
1178 Stone *held = YieldStone(start_src_pos);
1179 if (!held) {
1180 src_by_dst.erase(start_dst);
1181 src_to_dst.erase(start_src);
1182 continue;
1183 }
1184
1185 uint32_t empty = start_src;
1186 while (empty != start_dst) {
1187 auto it_prev = src_by_dst.find(empty);
1188 if (it_prev == src_by_dst.end()) {
1189 SetStone(start_src_pos, held);
1190 held = nullptr;
1191 src_to_dst.clear();
1192 src_by_dst.clear();
1193 break;
1194 }
1195 const uint32_t prev_src = it_prev->second;
1196 MoveStone(key_to_pos(prev_src), key_to_pos(empty));
1197 auto it_dst = src_to_dst.find(prev_src);
1198 if (it_dst != src_to_dst.end())
1199 src_to_dst.erase(it_dst);
1200 src_by_dst.erase(it_prev);
1201 empty = prev_src;
1202 }
1203 if (held) {
1204 SetStone(key_to_pos(start_dst), held);
1205 src_by_dst.erase(start_dst);
1206 src_to_dst.erase(start_src);
1207 }
1208 }
1209 }
1210
1211 // If we have authoritative kinds, rebuild the grid from them first. This forces
1212 // convergence for objects whose kind depends on non-"state" attributes.
1213 if (have_kinds) {
1214 int changed = 0;
1215 int logged = 0;
1216 const int kMaxLogged = 32;
1217 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
1218 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
1219 const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(w) + static_cast<size_t>(x);
1220 GridPos p(x, y);
1221
1222 const std::string floor_kind = stable_world_kind(GetFloor(p));
1223 const std::string stone_kind = stable_world_kind(GetStone(p));
1224 const std::string item_kind = stable_world_kind(GetItem(p));
1225
1226 const std::string *want_floor = kind_lookup(pkt.floor_kind[idx]);
1227 const std::string *want_stone = kind_lookup(pkt.stone_kind[idx]);
1228 const std::string *want_item = kind_lookup(pkt.item_kind[idx]);
1229
1230 const std::string want_floor_str = (want_floor ? *want_floor : std::string());
1231 const std::string want_stone_str = (want_stone ? *want_stone : std::string());
1232 const std::string want_item_str = (want_item ? *want_item : std::string());
1233
1234 if (want_floor_str != floor_kind) {
1235 if (debug_enabled() && logged < kMaxLogged) {
1236 debug_log("mp world-state kind fix: pos=(%d,%d) layer=floor cur=%s want=%s", x, y,
1237 floor_kind.empty() ? "(none)" : floor_kind.c_str(),
1238 want_floor_str.empty() ? "(none)" : want_floor_str.c_str());
1239 logged += 1;
1240 }
1241 if (!want_floor)
1242 KillFloor(p);
1243 else
1244 SetFloor(p, MakeFloor(want_floor->c_str()));
1245 changed += 1;
1246 }
1247 if (want_stone_str != stone_kind) {
1248 if (debug_enabled() && logged < kMaxLogged) {
1249 debug_log("mp world-state kind fix: pos=(%d,%d) layer=stone cur=%s want=%s", x, y,
1250 stone_kind.empty() ? "(none)" : stone_kind.c_str(),
1251 want_stone_str.empty() ? "(none)" : want_stone_str.c_str());
1252 logged += 1;
1253 }
1254 if (!want_stone)
1255 KillStone(p);
1256 else
1257 SetStone(p, MakeStone(want_stone->c_str()));
1258 changed += 1;
1259 }
1260 if (want_item_str != item_kind) {
1261 if (debug_enabled() && logged < kMaxLogged) {
1262 debug_log("mp world-state kind fix: pos=(%d,%d) layer=item cur=%s want=%s", x, y,
1263 item_kind.empty() ? "(none)" : item_kind.c_str(),
1264 want_item_str.empty() ? "(none)" : want_item_str.c_str());
1265 logged += 1;
1266 }
1267 if (!want_item)
1268 KillItem(p);
1269 else
1270 SetItem(p, MakeItem(want_item->c_str()));
1271 changed += 1;
1272 }
1273 }
1274 }
1275 if (debug_enabled())
1276 debug_log("mp world-state apply kinds: changed=%d", changed);
1277 }
1278
1279 // Apply authoritative oxyd colors before per-tile state so subsequent MpForceExternalState
1280 // uses the right model variant.
1281 if (!pkt.oxyd_colors.empty()) {
1282 int changed = 0;
1283 for (const auto &e : pkt.oxyd_colors) {
1284 const int x = static_cast<int>(e.x);
1285 const int y = static_cast<int>(e.y);
1286 if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= w || y >= h)
1287 continue;
1288 GridPos p(x, y);
1289 if (OxydStone *ox = dynamic_cast<OxydStone *>(GetStone(p))) {
1290 const int color = static_cast<int>(static_cast<int16_t>(e.color_raw));
1291 if (static_cast<int>(ox->getAttr("oxydcolor")) != color) {
1292 ox->MpForceOxydColor(color);
1293 changed += 1;
1294 }
1295 }
1296 }
1297 if (debug_enabled() && changed > 0)
1298 debug_log("mp world-state apply oxydcolor: changed=%d", changed);
1299 }
1300
1301 auto apply_state = [](Object *obj, Uint16 s) {
1302 if (!obj || s == 0xFFFF)
1303 return;
1304 // Some StateObject subclasses (notably OxydStone) implement "state" as gameplay
1305 // operations (tryOpen/close) that are not idempotent and can refuse to close
1306 // (OPEN_PAIR). World-state reconciliation must be able to override them.
1307 if (Stone *st = dynamic_cast<Stone *>(obj)) {
1308 if (OxydStone *ox = dynamic_cast<OxydStone *>(st)) {
1309 ox->MpForceExternalState(static_cast<int>(s));
1310 return;
1311 }
1312 }
1313 obj->setAttr("state", Value(static_cast<int>(s)));
1314 };
1315
1316 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
1317 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
1318 const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(w) + static_cast<size_t>(x);
1319 GridPos p(x, y);
1320 apply_state(GetFloor(p), pkt.floor_state[idx]);
1321 apply_state(GetStone(p), pkt.stone_state[idx]);
1322 apply_state(GetItem(p), pkt.item_state[idx]);
1323 }
1324 }
1325 if (debug_enabled()) {
1326 debug_log("mp world-state applied: world=%llu kind=%llu state=%llu movable=%llu",
1327 static_cast<unsigned long long>(WorldGridChecksum()),
1328 static_cast<unsigned long long>(WorldGridKindChecksum()),
1329 static_cast<unsigned long long>(WorldGridStateChecksum()),
1330 static_cast<unsigned long long>(WorldGridMovableStoneChecksum()));
1331 }
1332 return true;
1333}

1335bool handle_client_start_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1336 ecl::Buffer buf;
1337 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1338 Uint32 epoch = 0;
1339 Uint32 load_id = 0;
1340 if (!protocol::decode_start(buf, epoch, load_id))
1341 return false;
1342 if (load_id != g_session.last_load_id) {
1343 if (debug_enabled())
1344 debug_log("mp client: drop start (load mismatch remote=%u local=%u)",
1345 static_cast<unsigned>(load_id),
1346 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.last_load_id));
1347 return true;
1348 }
1349 g_session.input_epoch = epoch;
1350 g_session.debug_state_dumped = false;
1351 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
1352 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START;
1353 debug_log("mp client: start allowed");
1354 return true;
1355}
1356
1357bool handle_client_pause_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1358 ecl::Buffer buf;
1359 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1360 Uint32 epoch = 0;
1361 bool paused = false;
1362 if (!protocol::decode_pause(buf, epoch, paused))
1363 return false;
1364 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
1365 return true;
1366 if (g_session.paused == paused)
1367 return true;
1368 g_session.paused = paused;
1369 server::Msg_Pause(paused);
1370 return true;
1371}
1372
1373bool handle_client_abort_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1374 ecl::Buffer buf;
1375 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1376 Uint32 epoch = 0;
1377 if (!protocol::decode_abort(buf, epoch))
1378 return false;
1379 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
1380 return true;
1381 return abort_session_with_message("Game aborted. Ending session.");
1382}
1383
1384bool handle_client_restart_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1385 ecl::Buffer buf;
1386 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1387 protocol::RestartPacket restart;
1388 if (!protocol::decode_restart(buf, restart))
1389 return false;
1390 if (restart.restart_id > g_session.last_restart_id) {
1391 g_session.last_restart_id = restart.restart_id;
1392 g_session.restart_id = restart.restart_id;
1393 if (restart.level_restart)
1394 server::RestartLevelFromNetwork();
1395 else
1396 server::Msg_RestartGameFromNetwork();
1397 }
1398 return true;
1399}
1400
1401bool handle_client_load_level_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1402 if (g_session.abort_pending)
1403 return true;
1404 ecl::Buffer buf;
1405 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1406 protocol::LoadLevelPacket msg;
1407 if (!protocol::decode_load_level(buf, msg))
1408 return false;
1409 if (msg.load_id <= g_session.last_load_id)
1410 return true;
1411 g_session.last_load_id = msg.load_id;
1412 debug_log("mp client: load level id=%u pack=%s level_id=%s",
1413 static_cast<unsigned>(msg.load_id),
1414 msg.pack_name.c_str(),
1415 msg.level_id.c_str());
1416
1417 if (!msg.pack_name.empty())
1418 server::Msg_SetLevelPack(msg.pack_name);
1419
1420 lev::Proxy *proxy = find_level_proxy_in_current_index(msg.level_id);
1421 if (!proxy)
1422 proxy = find_level_proxy_anywhere(msg.level_id);
1423 if (!proxy)
1424 return abort_session_with_message("Selected level not available. Ending session.");
1425
1426 server::Msg_LoadLevel(proxy, false);
1427 return true;
1428}
1429
1430bool handle_client_placement_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
1431 ecl::Buffer buf;
1432 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1433 protocol::PlacementPacket place;
1434 if (!protocol::decode_place(buf, place))
1435 return false;
1436 if (place.restart_id == g_session.restart_id && place.player < g_session.expected_players) {
1437 GridPos pos(static_cast<int>(place.x), static_cast<int>(place.y));
1438 apply_placement(place.player, pos);
1439 }
1440 return true;
1441}
1442
1443void handle_client_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
1444 if (handle_client_input_bundle_packet(data, len))
1445 return;
1446 if (handle_client_input_packet(data, len))
1447 return;
1448 if (handle_client_debug_options_packet(data, len))
1449 return;
1450 if (handle_client_ping_packet(data, len))
1451 return;
1452 if (handle_client_welcome_packet(data, len))
1453 return;
1454 if (handle_client_load_level_packet(data, len))
1455 return;
1456 if (handle_client_sync_packet(data, len))
1457 return;
1458 if (handle_client_resync_state_packet(data, len))
1459 return;
1460 if (handle_client_world_state_packet(data, len))
1461 return;
1462 if (handle_client_start_packet(data, len))
1463 return;
1464 if (handle_client_pause_packet(data, len))
1465 return;
1466 if (handle_client_abort_packet(data, len))
1467 return;
1468 if (handle_client_restart_packet(data, len))
1469 return;
1470 handle_client_placement_packet(data, len);
1471}
