1491
1492bool host_register_relay_client(Uint32 client_id, HostSource source) {
1493 if (!can_accept_more_remote_players())
1494 return false;
1495
1496 unsigned player_id = 0;
1497 if (!allocate_remote_player_id(player_id))
1498 return false;
1499 ecl::Buffer welcome;
1500 protocol::encode_welcome(welcome, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
1501 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players), g_session.seed,
1502 static_cast<Uint16>(g_session.tick_ms));
1503
1504 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1505 g_session.relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
1506 g_session.relay_ready[client_id] = false;
1507 debug_log("mp host: relay client -> player %u", player_id);
1508 g_transport.HostSendUdpRelay(client_id, welcome);
1509 host_broadcast_debug_options();
1510 send_existing_placements_to_relay(client_id);
1511 host_send_current_load_to_remote(HostSource::UDP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id);
1512 return true;
1513 }
1514
1515 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1516 g_session.tcp_relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
1517 g_session.tcp_relay_ready[client_id] = false;
1518 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay client -> player %u", player_id);
1519 g_transport.HostSendTcpRelay(client_id, welcome);
1520 host_broadcast_debug_options();
1521 send_existing_placements_to_tcp_relay(client_id);
1522 host_send_current_load_to_remote(HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id);
1523 return true;
1524 }
1525
1526 return false;
1527}
1528
1529bool host_unregister_relay_client(Uint32 client_id, HostSource source) {
1530 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1531 auto it = g_session.relay_players.find(client_id);
1532 if (it != g_session.relay_players.end())
1533 release_remote_player_id(it->second);
1534 g_session.relay_players.erase(client_id);
1535 g_session.relay_ready.erase(client_id);
1536 } else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1537 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_players.find(client_id);
1538 if (it != g_session.tcp_relay_players.end())
1539 release_remote_player_id(it->second);
1540 g_session.tcp_relay_players.erase(client_id);
1541 g_session.tcp_relay_ready.erase(client_id);
1542 } else {
1543 return true;
1544 }
1545 if (g_session.active)
1546 return abort_session_with_message("Player disconnected. Ending session.");
1547 return true;
1548}
1549
1550bool handle_direct_connect_event(ENetPeer *peer) {
1551 if (!g_session.host)
1552 return true;
1553 if (!can_accept_more_remote_players()) {
1554 // During pre-start, allow retries: if an existing direct peer has not
1555 // reached READY yet, drop it and accept the new connection attempt.
1556 // This prevents LAN sessions getting stuck forever on a half-connected
1557 // peer (common with VM/NAT/multi-homing quirks).
1558 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING) {
1559 ENetPeer *replace = nullptr;
1560 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_ready) {
1561 if (!entry.second) {
1562 replace = entry.first;
1563 break;
1564 }
1565 }
1566 if (replace) {
1567 unsigned old_id = 0;
1568 auto it = g_session.peer_players.find(replace);
1569 if (it != g_session.peer_players.end())
1570 old_id = it->second;
1571 if (debug_enabled()) {
1572 char rip[64];
1573 rip[0] = '\0';
1574 std::string replace_ip = address_to_ip_string(replace->address);
1575 if (replace_ip.empty())
1576 std::snprintf(rip, sizeof(rip), "<unknown>");
1577 else
1578 std::snprintf(rip, sizeof(rip), "%s", replace_ip.c_str());
1579 debug_log("mp host: dropping unready peer player=%u ip=%s:%u (retry connect)",
1580 old_id, rip, static_cast<unsigned>(replace->address.port));
1581 }
1582 g_session.peer_players.erase(replace);
1583 g_session.peer_ready.erase(replace);
1584 release_remote_player_id(old_id);
1585 enet_peer_reset(replace);
1586 }
1587 }
1588 if (!can_accept_more_remote_players()) {
1589 enet_peer_disconnect(peer, 0);
1590 return true;
1591 }
1592 }
1593
1594 char host_ip[64];
1595 host_ip[0] = '\0';
1596 std::string peer_ip = address_to_ip_string(peer->address);
1597 if (peer_ip.empty())
1598 std::snprintf(host_ip, sizeof(host_ip), "<unknown>");
1599 else
1600 std::snprintf(host_ip, sizeof(host_ip), "%s", peer_ip.c_str());
1601
1602 unsigned player_id = 0;
1603 if (!allocate_remote_player_id(player_id)) {
1604 enet_peer_disconnect(peer, 0);
1605 return true;
1606 }
1607 g_session.peer_players[peer] = player_id;
1608 g_session.peer_ready[peer] = false;
1609 peer->data = reinterpret_cast<void *>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(player_id));
1610#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
1611 enet_peer_timeout(peer, ENET_PEER_TIMEOUT_LIMIT,
1612 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs),
1613 static_cast<enet_uint32>(multiplayer::wait::kEnetPeerTimeoutMs));
1614#endif
1615 debug_log("mp host: peer connected -> player %u ip=%s:%u", player_id, host_ip,
1616 static_cast<unsigned>(peer->address.port));
1617
1618 ecl::Buffer buf;
1619 protocol::encode_welcome(buf, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
1620 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players), g_session.seed,
1621 static_cast<Uint16>(g_session.tick_ms));
1622 g_transport.HostSendDirect(peer, buf);
1623 host_broadcast_debug_options();
1624 send_existing_placements_to_peer(peer);
1625 host_send_current_load_to_remote(HostSource::DIRECT, peer, 0);
1626 g_transport.Flush();
1627 return true;
1628}

1630bool handle_relay_payload_as_host(const char *data, size_t len, HostSource source,
1631 bool close_on_decode_error, bool (*on_connect)(Uint32),
1632 bool (*on_disconnect)(Uint32)) {
1633 RelayMessageType type = RELAY_ERROR;
1634 Uint32 session_id = 0;
1635 Uint32 client_id = 0;
1636 const char *payload = nullptr;
1637 size_t payload_len = 0;
1638 if (!decode_relay_header(data, len, type, session_id, client_id, payload, payload_len)) {
1639 if (close_on_decode_error)
1640 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
1641 return true;
1642 }
1643 if (session_id != g_session.session_id)
1644 return true;
1645 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT) {
1646 return on_connect(client_id);
1647 }
1648 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT)
1649 return on_disconnect(client_id);
1650 if (type == RELAY_DATA) {
1651 // Propagate abort/disconnect requests back to the poll loop.
1652 if (!handle_host_packet(payload, payload_len, nullptr, source, client_id))
1653 return false;
1654 }
1655 return true;
1656}
1657
1658bool handle_udp_relay_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
1659 return handle_relay_payload_as_host(data, len, HostSource::UDP_RELAY, false,
1660 host_register_udp_relay_client,
1661 host_unregister_udp_relay_client);
1662}
1663
1664bool handle_tcp_relay_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
1665 if (!g_session.host) {
1666 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
1667 handle_client_payload(data, len);
1668 // The client can receive a session-ending message (e.g. NET_ABORT) via relay.
1669 // If that happens, stop polling immediately because SessionShutdown may have
1670 // destroyed sockets/ENet hosts still being serviced by the transport loop.
1671 if (!g_session.active)
1672 return false;
1673 return true;
1674 }
1675 return handle_relay_payload_as_host(data, len, HostSource::TCP_RELAY, true,
1676 host_register_tcp_relay_client,
1677 host_unregister_tcp_relay_client);
1678}

1682void process_network_events() {
1683 if (!g_session.active)
1684 return;
1685 // Poll all active transports via one facade.
1686 class Sink : public ITransportSink {
1687 public:
1688 bool OnConnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) override {
1689 if (source != HostSource::DIRECT)
1690 return true;
1691 return handle_direct_connect_event(peer);
1692 }
1693 bool OnDisconnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) override {
1694 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1695 if (g_session.relay_peer == peer) {
1696 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
1697 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
1698 return abort_session_with_message("Relay disconnected. Ending session.");
1699 }
1700 return true;
1701 }
1702 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1703 if (g_session.host) {
1704 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
1705 return abort_session_with_message("TCP relay disconnected. Ending session.");
1706 return true;
1707 }
1708 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
1709 return abort_session_with_message("Disconnected from TCP relay.");
1710 return true;
1711 }
1712 return handle_direct_disconnect_event(peer);
1713 }
1714 bool OnPayload(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) override {
1715 // Any packet counts as progress (avoid false "host disconnected" aborts).
1716 g_session.no_payload_timer = 0.0;
1717 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1718 return handle_udp_relay_payload(data, len);
1719 }
1720 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1721 return handle_tcp_relay_payload(data, len);
1722 }
1723 return handle_direct_payload(peer, data, len);
1724 }
1725 private:
1726 bool handle_direct_payload(ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) {
1727 if (g_session.host)
1728 return handle_host_packet(data, len, peer, HostSource::DIRECT, 0);
1729 if (g_session.active_transport != TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
1730 handle_client_payload(data, len);
1731 if (!g_session.active)
1732 return false;
1733 return true;
1734 }
1735 bool handle_direct_disconnect_event(ENetPeer *peer) {
1736 return handle_direct_disconnect_event_impl(peer);
1737 }
1738 static bool handle_direct_disconnect_event_impl(ENetPeer *peer) {
1739 if (g_session.host) {
1740 auto it = g_session.peer_players.find(peer);
1741 if (it == g_session.peer_players.end()) {
1742 // Ignore disconnects for peers we already replaced/dropped.
1743 return true;
1744 }
1745 release_remote_player_id(it->second);
1746 g_session.peer_players.erase(it);
1747 g_session.peer_ready.erase(peer);
1748 if (g_session.active)
1749 return abort_session_with_message("Player disconnected. Ending session.");
1750 return true;
1751 }
1752 if (g_session.server_peer == peer)
1753 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
1754 return abort_session_with_message("Disconnected from host.");
1755 }
1756 };
1757
1758 Sink sink;
1759 g_transport.Poll(sink);
1760}
1761
1762void send_local_inputs() {
1763 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.local_player_known)
1764 return;
1765 const bool remote_control_local_ball =
1766 (!g_session.host && options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugRemoteControlLocalBall"));
1767 uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
1768 uint32_t delay = g_session.input_delay ? g_session.input_delay : kInputDelay;
1769 uint32_t target_tick = current_tick + delay;
1770 if (g_session.input_clock_tick > current_tick) {
1771 uint32_t extra = g_session.input_clock_tick - current_tick;
1772 if (extra > kMaxInputLead)
1773 extra = kMaxInputLead;
1774 target_tick += extra;
1775 }
1776 const uint32_t ticks_to_fill =
1777 (g_session.next_local_tick <= target_tick) ? (target_tick - g_session.next_local_tick + 1) : 0;
1778 // IMPORTANT: `send_local_inputs()` runs every frame, but ticks advance at
1779 // the simulation tick rate. When we already filled inputs up to `target_tick`,
1780 // we must not drain (and thus drop) local pending input. Otherwise large
1781 // tick lengths (e.g. 50ms) feel unresponsive because most mouse deltas get
1782 // discarded between ticks.
1783 input::PlayerInput pending;
1784 if (ticks_to_fill)
1785 pending = input::DrainLocalPending(g_session.local_player);
1786 // Local pending inputs are accumulated across frames. If we need to fill
1787 // multiple ticks at once (e.g. after a stall), distribute the accumulated
1788 // mouse-force impulse across those ticks so physics stays consistent.
1789 const float inv_ticks = ticks_to_fill ? (1.0f / static_cast<float>(ticks_to_fill)) : 0.0f;
1790 const ecl::V2 per_tick_force = pending.mouse_force * inv_ticks;
1791 bool applied_actions = false;
1792 bool sent_packets = false;
1793
1794 while (g_session.next_local_tick <= target_tick) {
1795 input::PlayerInput send;
1796 send.mouse_force = per_tick_force;
1797 if (!applied_actions) {
1798 send.rotate_steps = pending.rotate_steps;
1799 send.activate_count = pending.activate_count;
1800 } else {
1801 send.rotate_steps = 0;
1802 send.activate_count = 0;
1803 }
1804 if (!send.empty()) {
1805 float fx = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
1806 float fy = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
1807 send.mouse_force = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
1808 }
1809 protocol::InputPacket pkt;
1810 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
1811 pkt.tick = g_session.next_local_tick;
1812 pkt.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
1813 pkt.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
1814 pkt.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
1815 pkt.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(send.rotate_steps);
1816 pkt.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(send.activate_count);
1817
1818 // Experiment: let the host be authoritative for the locally controlled ball.
1819 // Suppress continuous mouse force locally, but keep discrete actions (rotate/activate)
1820 // so inventory/world interactions remain responsive and deterministic.
1821 input::PlayerInput local_sim = send;
1822 if (remote_control_local_ball)
1823 local_sim.mouse_force = ecl::V2(0.0f, 0.0f);
1824 input::EnqueueInput(pkt.tick, g_session.local_player, local_sim);
1825 rollback::RecordInput(pkt.tick, g_session.local_player, local_sim);
1826 g_session.local_history[pkt.tick] = send;
1827 applied_actions = true;
1828 ++g_session.next_local_tick;
1829 }
1830
1831 // Keep a small history so we can resend a few ticks for redundancy.
1832 if (current_tick > kInputHistoryKeepTicks) {
1833 const uint32_t prune_before = current_tick - kInputHistoryKeepTicks;
1834 for (auto it = g_session.local_history.begin(); it != g_session.local_history.end(); ) {
1835 if (it->first < prune_before)
1836 it = g_session.local_history.erase(it);
1837 else
1838 ++it;
1839 }
1840 }
1841
1842 if (g_session.host) {
1843 if (!has_remote_peers())
1844 return;
1845 } else if (!g_session.server_peer) {
1846 if (!(g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
1847 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))) {
1848 return;
1849 }
1850 }
1851
1852 auto bundle_back_ticks = []() -> uint32_t {
1853 switch (g_session.active_transport) {
1854 case TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
1855 return kInputBundleBackTicksUdpRelay;
1856 case TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
1857 return kInputBundleBackTicksTcpRelay;
1858 case TransportKind::DIRECT:
1859 default:
1860 return kInputBundleBackTicksDirect;
1861 }
1862 };
1863 auto bundle_max_count = []() -> uint32_t {
1864 switch (g_session.active_transport) {
1865 case TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
1866 return kInputBundleMaxCountUdpRelay;
1867 case TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
1868 return kInputBundleMaxCountTcpRelay;
1869 case TransportKind::DIRECT:
1870 default:
1871 return kInputBundleMaxCountDirect;
1872 }
1873 };
1874 const uint32_t back_ticks = bundle_back_ticks();
1875 const uint32_t max_count = bundle_max_count();
1876
1877 uint32_t send_base = g_session.next_send_tick;
1878 uint32_t min_send_tick = current_tick;
1879 if (send_base < min_send_tick)
1880 send_base = min_send_tick;
1881 uint32_t bundle_start = 0;
1882 if (send_base > back_ticks)
1883 bundle_start = send_base - back_ticks;
1884 if (bundle_start < min_send_tick)
1885 bundle_start = min_send_tick;
1886 uint32_t bundle_end = g_session.next_local_tick;
1887 if (bundle_end > bundle_start + max_count)
1888 bundle_end = bundle_start + max_count;
1889
1890 if (bundle_start < bundle_end) {
1891 protocol::InputBundlePacket bundle;
1892 bundle.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
1893 bundle.first_tick = bundle_start;
1894 bundle.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
1895 const uint32_t count = bundle_end - bundle_start;
1896 bundle.entries.clear();
1897 bundle.entries.reserve(count);
1898 for (uint32_t tick = bundle_start; tick < bundle_end; ++tick) {
1899 protocol::InputBundleEntry e;
1900 auto it = g_session.local_history.find(tick);
1901 if (it != g_session.local_history.end()) {
1902 const input::PlayerInput &queued = it->second;
1903 e.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[0]);
1904 e.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[1]);
1905 e.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(queued.rotate_steps);
1906 e.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(queued.activate_count);
1907 } else {
1908 e.mouse_x = 0.0f;
1909 e.mouse_y = 0.0f;
1910 e.rotate_steps = 0;
1911 e.activate_count = 0;
1912 }
1913 bundle.entries.push_back(e);
1914 }
1915 if (bundle.first_tick < 20) {
1916 debug_log("mp send input bundle: first tick=%u player=%u count=%u",
1917 bundle.first_tick, bundle.player,
1918 static_cast<unsigned>(bundle.entries.size()));
1919 }
1920 if (g_session.host)
1921 broadcast_input_bundle(bundle, nullptr, 0, 0);
1922 else {
1923 ecl::Buffer payload;
1924 protocol::encode_input_bundle(payload, bundle);
1925 g_transport.ClientSendUnreliable(payload);
1926 }
1927 sent_packets = true;
1928 g_session.next_send_tick = bundle_end;
1929 }
1930
1931 if (sent_packets)
1932 g_transport.Flush();
1933}

A src/multiplayer_sim_snapshot.cc

Description
  • Snapshot/restore implementation.
Where it is used
  • Used by rollback/replay when capturing and restoring recent simulation ticks.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Implements snapshot capture/restore for actors, world grid state, timers, and pending secure actions.
diff --git a/src/multiplayer_sim_snapshot.cc b/src/multiplayer_sim_snapshot.cc
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/multiplayer_sim_snapshot.cc
@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@
1/*
2 * Multiplayer rollback/replay snapshot utilities.
3 *
4 * This snapshot is intentionally limited to "simulation tick state" that is
5 * needed for client prediction experiments:
6 * - input tick + queued inputs
7 * - RNG seed/state
8 * - active GameTimer alarms
9 * - pending secure delayed actions
10 * - actor physics state
11 * - positions of movable stones (puzzle stones, doors, etc.)
12 *
13 * It does not attempt to serialize/restore the full world object graph (grid
14 * composition, arbitrary Lua state, etc.). That is a separate, larger engine
15 * project.
16 */
17

100void restore_movable_stone_positions(const std::vector<Snapshot::MovableStone> &wanted) {
101 if (wanted.empty())
102 return;
103 const int w = Width();
104 const int h = Height();
105 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
106 return;
107
108 auto key = [](int x, int y) -> uint32_t {
109 return (static_cast<uint32_t>(x) << 16) | static_cast<uint32_t>(y);
110 };
111 auto key_to_pos = [](uint32_t k) -> GridPos {
112 int x = static_cast<int>((k >> 16) & 0xFFFFu);
113 int y = static_cast<int>(k & 0xFFFFu);
114 return GridPos(x, y);
115 };
116
117 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> current_pos_by_id;
118 current_pos_by_id.reserve(wanted.size() * 2);
119 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
120 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
121 GridPos p(x, y);
122 Stone *st = GetStone(p);
123 if (!st || !st->is_movable())
124 continue;
125 current_pos_by_id[static_cast<uint32_t>(st->getId())] = key(x, y);
126 }
127 }
128
129 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> src_to_dst;
130 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> src_by_dst;
131 src_to_dst.reserve(wanted.size());
132 src_by_dst.reserve(wanted.size());
133 for (const auto &e : wanted) {
134 if (e.object_id < 0)
135 continue;
136 auto it = current_pos_by_id.find(static_cast<uint32_t>(e.object_id));
137 if (it == current_pos_by_id.end())
138 continue;
139 const uint32_t src = it->second;
140 const uint32_t dst = key(static_cast<int>(e.x), static_cast<int>(e.y));
141 if (src == dst)
142 continue;
143 src_to_dst[src] = dst;
144 src_by_dst[dst] = src;
145 }
146
147 // Resolve moves into empty destination cells first.
148 bool progressed = true;
149 while (progressed) {
150 progressed = false;
151 for (auto it = src_to_dst.begin(); it != src_to_dst.end(); ++it) {
152 const uint32_t src = it->first;
153 const uint32_t dst = it->second;
154 GridPos dst_pos = key_to_pos(dst);
155 if (GetStone(dst_pos) != nullptr)
156 continue;
157 MoveStone(key_to_pos(src), dst_pos);
158 src_by_dst.erase(dst);
159 src_to_dst.erase(it);
160 progressed = true;
161 break;
162 }
163 }
164
165 // Remaining moves are cycles. Break them by holding one stone in memory.
166 while (!src_to_dst.empty()) {
167 const uint32_t start_src = src_to_dst.begin()->first;
168 const uint32_t start_dst = src_to_dst.begin()->second;
169 GridPos start_src_pos = key_to_pos(start_src);
170 Stone *held = YieldStone(start_src_pos);
171 if (!held) {
172 src_by_dst.erase(start_dst);
173 src_to_dst.erase(start_src);
174 continue;
175 }
176
177 uint32_t empty = start_src;
178 while (empty != start_dst) {
179 auto it_prev = src_by_dst.find(empty);
180 if (it_prev == src_by_dst.end()) {
181 // Unexpected permutation shape; restore what we can and abort.
182 SetStone(start_src_pos, held);
183 held = nullptr;
184 src_to_dst.clear();
185 src_by_dst.clear();
186 break;
187 }
188 const uint32_t prev_src = it_prev->second;
189 MoveStone(key_to_pos(prev_src), key_to_pos(empty));
190 auto it_dst = src_to_dst.find(prev_src);
191 if (it_dst != src_to_dst.end())
192 src_to_dst.erase(it_dst);
193 src_by_dst.erase(it_prev);
194 empty = prev_src;
195 }
196 if (held) {
197 SetStone(key_to_pos(start_dst), held);
198 src_by_dst.erase(start_dst);
199 src_to_dst.erase(start_src);
200 }
201 }
202}
203
204} // namespace
205
206Snapshot Capture() {
207 Snapshot snap;
208 snap.input = input::CaptureSnapshot();
209 snap.random_state = server::RandomState;
210 snap.level_time = server::LevelTime;
211 snap.game_timer = GameTimer.snapshot();
212 snap.pending_actions = CapturePendingActions();
213 CaptureObjectStates(snap.object_state_ids, snap.object_state_values);
214
215 // Capture movable-stone layout for rollback correctness.
216 {
217 const int w = Width();
218 const int h = Height();
219 if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
220 snap.movable_stones.clear();
221 snap.movable_stones.reserve(64);
222 for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
223 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
224 GridPos p(x, y);
225 Stone *st = GetStone(p);
226 if (!st || !st->is_movable())
227 continue;
228 Snapshot::MovableStone ms;
229 ms.object_id = st->getId();
230 ms.x = static_cast<uint16_t>(x);
231 ms.y = static_cast<uint16_t>(y);
232 snap.movable_stones.push_back(ms);
233 }
234 }
235 }
236 }
237
238 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
239 GetActors(actors);
240 snap.actors.reserve(actors.size());
241 for (Actor *a : actors) {
242 if (!a)
243 continue;
244 ActorSnapshot as;
245 as.object_id = a->getId();
246 as.internal_state = a->snapshot_internal_state();
247 as.info = capture_actorinfo(*a->get_actorinfo());
248 snap.actors.push_back(as);
249 }
250 return snap;
251}
252
253void Restore(const Snapshot &snap) {
254 input::RestoreSnapshot(snap.input);
255 server::RandomState = snap.random_state;
256 server::LevelTime = snap.level_time;
257 GameTimer.restore(snap.game_timer);
258 RestorePendingActions(snap.pending_actions);
259 RestoreObjectStates(snap.object_state_ids, snap.object_state_values);
260 restore_movable_stone_positions(snap.movable_stones);
261
262 std::unordered_map<int, ActorSnapshot> by_id;
263 by_id.reserve(snap.actors.size());
264 for (const auto &a : snap.actors)
265 by_id[a.object_id] = a;
266
267 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
268 GetActors(actors);
269 for (Actor *a : actors) {
270 if (!a)
271 continue;
272 auto it = by_id.find(a->getId());
273 if (it == by_id.end())
274 continue;
275 a->restore_internal_state(it->second.internal_state);
276 restore_actorinfo(*a, it->second.info);
277 if (BasicBall *ball = dynamic_cast<BasicBall *>(a)) {
278 ball->MpFinishAppearingAfterSnapshotRestore();
279 }
280 }
281}

37/* -------------------- Multiplayer TCP socket -------------------- */
38/*
39 * Small TCP socket helpers used by the TCP relay transport.
40 *
41 * Isolated from session code to avoid platform socket ifdef noise elsewhere.
42 */
43
44namespace enigma {
45namespace multiplayer {
46namespace internal {
47
48bool tcp_socket_valid(TcpSocket s) {
49#ifdef WIN32
50 return s != INVALID_SOCKET;
51#else
52 return s >= 0;
53#endif
54}
55
56void tcp_close(TcpSocket &s) {
57 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
58 return;
59#ifdef WIN32
60 closesocket(s);
61 s = INVALID_SOCKET;
62#else
63 close(s);
64 s = -1;
65#endif
66}
67
68bool tcp_set_nonblocking(TcpSocket s) {
69#ifdef WIN32
70 u_long mode = 1;
71 return ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &mode) == 0;
72#else
73 int flags = fcntl(s, F_GETFL, 0);
74 if (flags < 0)
75 return false;
76 return fcntl(s, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK) == 0;
77#endif
78}
79
80static bool tcp_send_all(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
81 const uint8_t *p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
82 size_t sent = 0;
83 while (sent < len) {
84#ifdef WIN32
85 int n = ::send(s, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(p + sent),
86 static_cast<int>(len - sent), 0);
87#else
88 ssize_t n = ::send(s, p + sent, len - sent, 0);
89#endif
90 if (n <= 0) {
91#ifdef WIN32
92 int err = WSAGetLastError();
93 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK) {
94 if (debug_enabled())
95 debug_log("mp tcp send failed err=%d", err);
96 return false;
97 }
98#else
99 if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK) {
100 if (debug_enabled())
101 debug_log("mp tcp send failed errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
102 return false;
103 }
104#endif
105 fd_set wfds;
106 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
107 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
108 timeval tv;
109 tv.tv_sec = 0;
110 tv.tv_usec = 200 * 1000;
111#ifdef WIN32
112 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
113#else
114 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
115#endif
116 if (sel <= 0) {
117 if (debug_enabled())
118 debug_log("mp tcp send wait timeout/err sel=%d", sel);
119 return false;
120 }
121 continue;
122 }
123 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
124 }
125 return true;
126}
127
128bool tcp_send_frame(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
129 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
130 return false;
131 if (len > (1u << 20))
132 return false;
133 uint8_t prefix[4];
134 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
135 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
136 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
137 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
138 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
139 return tcp_send_all(s, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && tcp_send_all(s, data, len);
140}
141
142bool tcp_pump_recv(TcpSocket s, std::vector<uint8_t> &rx) {
143 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
144 return false;
145 uint8_t buf[4096];
146 while (true) {
147#ifdef WIN32
148 int n = ::recv(s, reinterpret_cast<char *>(buf), static_cast<int>(sizeof(buf)), 0);
149 if (n == 0)
150 return false;
151 if (n < 0) {
152 int err = WSAGetLastError();
153 if (err == WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
154 break;
155 return false;
156 }
157#else
158 ssize_t n = ::recv(s, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
159 if (n == 0)
160 return false;
161 if (n < 0) {
162 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
163 break;
164 return false;
165 }
166#endif
167 rx.insert(rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
168 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
169 break;
170 }
171 return true;
172}
173
174bool tcp_try_extract_frame(std::vector<uint8_t> &rx, uint32_t &pending_len,
175 std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
176 out.clear();
177 if (pending_len == 0) {
178 if (rx.size() < 4)
179 return false;
180 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[0]) |
181 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[1]) << 8) |
182 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[2]) << 16) |
183 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[3]) << 24);
184 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + 4);
185 if (v == 0 || v > (1u << 20)) {
186 pending_len = 0;
187 rx.clear();
188 return false;
189 }
190 pending_len = v;
191 }
192 if (rx.size() < pending_len)
193 return false;
194 out.assign(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
195 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
196 pending_len = 0;
197 return true;
198}
199
200bool tcp_connect_timeout(const std::string &host, Uint16 port, Uint32 timeout_ms,
201 TcpSocket &out) {
202 out = kInvalidTcpSocket;
203 if (host.empty() || port == 0)
204 return false;
205 addrinfo hints;
206 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
207 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
208 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
209
210 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
211 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
212 if (getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
213 return false;
214
215 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
216 for (addrinfo *ai = res; ai != nullptr; ai = ai->ai_next) {
217 if (SDL_GetTicks() - start > timeout_ms)
218 break;
219 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
220 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
221 continue;
222 if (!tcp_set_nonblocking(s)) {
223 tcp_close(s);
224 continue;
225 }
226 int rc = ::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen));
227#ifdef WIN32
228 if (rc == 0) {
229 out = s;
230 freeaddrinfo(res);
231 return true;
232 }
233 int err = WSAGetLastError();
234 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK && err != WSAEINPROGRESS) {
235 tcp_close(s);
236 continue;
237 }
238#else
239 if (rc == 0) {
240 out = s;
241 freeaddrinfo(res);
242 return true;
243 }
244 if (errno != EINPROGRESS) {
245 tcp_close(s);
246 continue;
247 }
248#endif
249 fd_set wfds;
250 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
251 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
252 timeval tv;
253 tv.tv_sec = static_cast<long>(timeout_ms / 1000);
254 tv.tv_usec = static_cast<long>((timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000);
255#ifdef WIN32
256 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
257#else
258 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
259#endif
260 if (sel > 0) {
261 out = s;
262 freeaddrinfo(res);
263 return true;
264 }
265 tcp_close(s);
266 }
267
268 freeaddrinfo(res);
269 return false;
270}

272} // namespace internal
273} // namespace multiplayer
274} // namespace enigma

82static std::string trim(const std::string &s) {
83 size_t b = 0;
84 while (b < s.size() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[b])))
85 ++b;
86 size_t e = s.size();
87 while (e > b && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[e - 1])))
88 --e;
89 return s.substr(b, e - b);
90}
91
92static std::vector<std::string> split_ws(const std::string &s) {
93 std::vector<std::string> out;
94 std::string cur;
95 for (char ch : s) {
96 if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))) {
97 if (!cur.empty()) {
98 out.push_back(cur);
99 cur.clear();
100 }
101 } else {
102 cur.push_back(ch);
103 }
104 }
105 if (!cur.empty())
106 out.push_back(cur);
107 return out;
108}
109
110static std::map<std::string, std::string> parse_kv(const std::vector<std::string> &tokens,
111 size_t start) {
112 std::map<std::string, std::string> out;
113 for (size_t i = start; i < tokens.size(); ++i) {
114 const std::string &t = tokens[i];
115 std::string::size_type pos = t.find('=');
116 if (pos == std::string::npos)
117 continue;
118 std::string k = t.substr(0, pos);
119 std::string v = t.substr(pos + 1);
120 if (!k.empty())
121 out[k] = v;
122 }
123 return out;
124}
125
126static bool parse_u32(const std::map<std::string, std::string> &kv, const char *key, uint32_t &out) {
127 auto it = kv.find(key);
128 if (it == kv.end())
129 return false;
130 char *end = nullptr;
131 unsigned long v = std::strtoul(it->second.c_str(), &end, 10);
132 if (!end || *end != '\0')
133 return false;
134 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(v);
135 return true;
136}
137
138static bool parse_i32(const std::map<std::string, std::string> &kv, const char *key, int &out) {
139 auto it = kv.find(key);
140 if (it == kv.end())
141 return false;
142 char *end = nullptr;
143 long v = std::strtol(it->second.c_str(), &end, 10);
144 if (!end || *end != '\0')
145 return false;
146 out = static_cast<int>(v);
147 return true;
148}
149
150static bool parse_u16(const std::map<std::string, std::string> &kv, const char *key, Uint16 &out) {
151 uint32_t v = 0;
152 if (!parse_u32(kv, key, v))
153 return false;
154 if (v == 0 || v > 65535)
155 return false;
156 out = static_cast<Uint16>(v);
157 return true;
158}
159
160static bool parse_u8(const std::map<std::string, std::string> &kv, const char *key, Uint8 &out) {
161 uint32_t v = 0;
162 if (!parse_u32(kv, key, v))
163 return false;
164 if (v > 255)
165 return false;
166 out = static_cast<Uint8>(v);
167 return true;
168}
169
170static bool parse_f32(const std::map<std::string, std::string> &kv, const char *key, float &out) {
171 auto it = kv.find(key);
172 if (it == kv.end())
173 return false;
174 char *end = nullptr;
175 float v = std::strtof(it->second.c_str(), &end);
176 if (!end || *end != '\0')
177 return false;
178 out = v;
179 return true;
180}

182static void send_frame(const std::string &msg) {

184 return;

186 return;

190static void send_ok(const char *cmd, const std::string &extra = std::string()) {
191 std::string line = "OK";

193 line += std::string(" cmd=") + cmd;
194 if (!extra.empty())
195 line += std::string(" ") + extra;
196 send_frame(line);

199static void send_err(const char *cmd, const std::string &msg) {
200 std::string line = "ERR";

202 line += std::string(" cmd=") + cmd;
203 if (!msg.empty())
204 line += std::string(" msg=") + msg;
205 send_frame(line);

208static void send_evt(const std::string &name, const std::string &extra = std::string()) {
209 std::string line = "EVT name=" + name;
210 if (!extra.empty())
211 line += std::string(" ") + extra;
212 send_frame(line);
213}

215static lev::Proxy *find_proxy_by_norm(const std::string &norm_level_path) {
216 if (norm_level_path.empty())
217 return nullptr;
218 for (lev::Proxy *proxy : lev::Proxy::getProxies()) {
219 if (!proxy)
220 continue;
221 if (proxy->getNormLevelPath() == norm_level_path)
222 return proxy;
223 }
224 return nullptr;
225}

227static void emit_steerable_actors() {
228 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
229 GetActors(actors);
230 unsigned idx = 0;
231 for (Actor *a : actors) {
232 if (!a || !a->isSteerable())
233 continue;
234 const ecl::V2 &p = a->get_pos();
235 const ecl::V2 &v = a->get_vel();
236 std::ostringstream os;
237 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
238 os.precision(3);
239 os << "idx=" << idx
240 << " kind=" << a->getKind()
241 << " obj=" << a->getId()
242 << " ctrl=" << a->get_controllers()
243 << " mf=" << a->get_mouseforce()
244 << " x=" << p[0] << " y=" << p[1]
245 << " vx=" << v[0] << " vy=" << v[1];
246 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
247 if (owner)
248 os << " owner=" << static_cast<int>(owner);
249 Value color = a->getAttr("color");
250 if (color)
251 os << " color=" << static_cast<int>(color);
252 send_evt("STEERABLE", os.str());
253 idx += 1;
254 }
255 send_ok("LIST_STEERABLE", "count=" + std::to_string(idx));
256}

258static void append_actor(std::ostringstream &os, const char *prefix, unsigned player) {
259 Actor *a = player::GetMainActor(player);
260 if (!a) {
261 os << " " << prefix << "valid=0";
262 return;
263 }
264 const ecl::V2 &p = a->get_pos();
265 const ecl::V2 &v = a->get_vel();
266 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
267 os.precision(3);
268 const ActorInfo *ai = a->get_actorinfo();
269 os << " " << prefix << "valid=1"
270 << " " << prefix << "kind=" << a->getKind()
271 << " " << prefix << "obj=" << a->getId()
272 << " " << prefix << "ctrl=" << a->get_controllers()
273 << " " << prefix << "mf=" << a->get_mouseforce()
274 << " " << prefix << "grab=" << (ai && ai->grabbed ? 1 : 0)
275 << " " << prefix << "mov=" << (a->is_movable() ? 1 : 0)
276 << " " << prefix << "dead=" << (a->is_dead() ? 1 : 0)
277 << " " << prefix << "fly=" << (a->is_flying() ? 1 : 0)
278 << " " << prefix << "x=" << p[0]
279 << " " << prefix << "y=" << p[1]
280 << " " << prefix << "vx=" << v[0]
281 << " " << prefix << "vy=" << v[1];
282}

284static void maybe_apply_input_override() {
285 if (!g_drv.enabled || !g_drv.input_override_enabled)
286 return;
287 if (g_drv.input_override_ticks_left <= 0) {
288 g_drv.input_override_enabled = false;
289 send_evt("INPUT_OVERRIDE_DONE");
290 return;
291 }
292 const uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
293 // Always (re-)enqueue the override for the current tick so it wins even if
294 // transport code enqueues a later value for the same (tick, player).
295 input::EnqueueInput(tick, g_drv.input_override_player, g_drv.input_override_value);
296 rollback::RecordInput(tick, g_drv.input_override_player, g_drv.input_override_value);
297
298 if (tick != g_drv.input_override_last_tick) {
299 g_drv.input_override_last_tick = tick;
300 g_drv.input_override_ticks_left -= 1;
301 }
302}
303
304static void maybe_apply_hold_mouse_force() {
305 if (!g_drv.enabled || !g_drv.hold_mouse_force_enabled)
306 return;
307 if (g_drv.hold_mouse_force_ticks_left <= 0) {
308 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_enabled = false;
309 send_evt("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE_DONE");
310 return;
311 }
312 const uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
313 if (tick == g_drv.hold_mouse_force_last_tick)
314 return;
315 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_last_tick = tick;
316 input::SubmitMouseForce(g_drv.hold_mouse_force_player, g_drv.hold_mouse_force_value);
317 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_ticks_left -= 1;
318}

320static void emit_state_snapshot() {
321 if (!g_drv.enabled)
322 return;
323 const uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
324 const internal::SessionState &s = internal::g_session;
325 unsigned direct_ready = 0;
326 for (const auto &kv : s.peer_ready) {
327 if (kv.second)
328 direct_ready += 1;
329 }
330 unsigned udp_ready = 0;
331 for (const auto &kv : s.relay_ready) {
332 if (kv.second)
333 udp_ready += 1;
334 }
335 unsigned tcp_ready = 0;
336 for (const auto &kv : s.tcp_relay_ready) {
337 if (kv.second)
338 tcp_ready += 1;
339 }
340 std::ostringstream os;
341 os << "tick=" << tick
342 << " mp_active=" << (multiplayer::IsActive() ? 1 : 0)
343 << " mp_host=" << (multiplayer::IsHost() ? 1 : 0)
344 << " expected=" << multiplayer::ExpectedPlayers()
345 << " local=" << multiplayer::LocalPlayer()
346 << " mp_defer=" << (multiplayer::ShouldDeferStart() ? 1 : 0)
347 << " mp_phase=" << static_cast<int>(s.phase)
348 << " mp_epoch=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.input_epoch)
349 << " mp_load=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.load_id)
350 << " mp_last_load=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.last_load_id)
351 << " mp_direct=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.peer_players.size())
352 << " mp_direct_ready=" << direct_ready
353 << " mp_udp=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.relay_players.size())
354 << " mp_udp_ready=" << udp_ready
355 << " mp_tcp=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.tcp_relay_players.size())
356 << " mp_tcp_ready=" << tcp_ready
357 << " mp_local_ready_sent=" << (s.local_ready_sent ? 1 : 0)
358 << " mp_paused=" << (s.paused ? 1 : 0)
359 << " sv_world_init=" << (server::WorldInitialized ? 1 : 0)
360 << " net=" << (input::IsNetworked() ? 1 : 0)
361 << " zerofill=" << (input::ZerofillMissingInputsEnabled() ? 1 : 0)
362 << " rb=" << (rollback::Enabled() ? 1 : 0)
363 << " rb_replay=" << (rollback::IsReplaying() ? 1 : 0)
364 << " ovr=" << (g_drv.input_override_enabled ? 1 : 0)
365 << " ovr_p=" << static_cast<unsigned>(g_drv.input_override_player)
366 << " ovr_left=" << static_cast<int>(g_drv.input_override_ticks_left)
367 << " hold=" << (g_drv.hold_mouse_force_enabled ? 1 : 0)
368 << " hold_p=" << static_cast<unsigned>(g_drv.hold_mouse_force_player)
369 << " hold_left=" << static_cast<int>(g_drv.hold_mouse_force_ticks_left);
370
371 // Input diagnostics for the current tick (first two players).
372 for (unsigned p = 0; p < 2; ++p) {
373 input::PlayerInput pi;
374 const bool present = input::PeekInput(tick, p, pi);
375 os << " in" << p << "_present=" << (present ? 1 : 0);
376 if (present) {
377 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
378 os.precision(3);
379 os << " in" << p << "_fx=" << static_cast<double>(pi.mouse_force[0])
380 << " in" << p << "_fy=" << static_cast<double>(pi.mouse_force[1])
381 << " in" << p << "_rot=" << static_cast<int>(pi.rotate_steps)
382 << " in" << p << "_act=" << static_cast<unsigned>(pi.activate_count);
383 }
384 }
385
386 // Also report the last consumed input per player. This is often more useful
387 // than peeking the current tick because the sim may have just advanced and
388 // cleared the queue for the tick that applied movement.
389 for (unsigned p = 0; p < 2; ++p) {
390 input::PlayerInput last;
391 const bool ok = input::GetLastConsumed(p, last);
392 os << " lc" << p << "_present=" << (ok ? 1 : 0);
393 if (ok) {
394 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
395 os.precision(3);
396 os << " lc" << p << "_fx=" << static_cast<double>(last.mouse_force[0])
397 << " lc" << p << "_fy=" << static_cast<double>(last.mouse_force[1])
398 << " lc" << p << "_rot=" << static_cast<int>(last.rotate_steps)
399 << " lc" << p << "_act=" << static_cast<unsigned>(last.activate_count);
400 }
401 }
402
403 os << " mp_clock_tick=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.input_clock_tick)
404 << " mp_input_delay=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.input_delay)
405 << " mp_tick_ms=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.tick_ms)
406 << " mp_world_cs=" << static_cast<unsigned long long>(s.last_world_checksum)
407 << " mp_last_resync=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.last_accepted_resync_tick)
408 << " mp_next_local_tick=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.next_local_tick)
409 << " mp_next_send_tick=" << static_cast<unsigned>(s.next_send_tick);
410 // Always report the first two players for convenience.
411 append_actor(os, "p0_", 0);
412 append_actor(os, "p1_", 1);
413 send_evt("STATE", os.str());
414}

416static bool handle_command(const std::string &line) {
417 const std::string s = trim(line);
418 if (s.empty())
419 return true;
420 std::vector<std::string> toks = split_ws(s);
421 if (toks.empty())
422 return true;
423 const std::string cmd = toks[0];
424 std::map<std::string, std::string> kv = parse_kv(toks, 1);
425
426 if (cmd == "PING") {
427 send_ok("PING", "pong=1");
428 return true;
429 }
430
431 if (cmd == "LIST_STEERABLE") {
432 emit_steerable_actors();
433 return true;
434 }
435
436 if (cmd == "GET_ACTOR_GRID") {
437 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
438 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
439 send_err("GET_ACTOR_GRID", "missing_player");
440 return true;
441 }
442 Actor *a = player::GetMainActor(static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32));
443 if (!a) {
444 send_err("GET_ACTOR_GRID", "no_actor");
445 return true;
446 }
447 GridPos p(a->get_pos());
448 std::ostringstream os;
449 os << "player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
450 << " gx=" << static_cast<int>(p.x)
451 << " gy=" << static_cast<int>(p.y);
452 send_ok("GET_ACTOR_GRID", os.str());
453 return true;
454 }
455
456 if (cmd == "GET_CELL") {
457 int x = 0;
458 int y = 0;
459 if (!parse_i32(kv, "x", x) || !parse_i32(kv, "y", y)) {
460 send_err("GET_CELL", "missing_xy");
461 return true;
462 }
463 GridPos p(x, y);
464 Object *fl = GetFloor(p);
465 Object *st = GetStone(p);
466 Object *it = GetItem(p);
467 auto kind_or_dash = [](Object *obj) -> std::string {
468 return obj ? obj->getKind() : std::string("-");
469 };
470 auto state_or_dash = [](Object *obj) -> std::string {
471 if (!obj)
472 return std::string("-");
473 Value v = obj->getAttr("state");
474 if (!v)
475 return std::string("-");
476 return std::to_string(static_cast<int>(v));
477 };
478 std::ostringstream os;
479 os << "x=" << x << " y=" << y
480 << " fl=" << kind_or_dash(fl)
481 << " st=" << kind_or_dash(st)
482 << " it=" << kind_or_dash(it)
483 << " fl_state=" << state_or_dash(fl)
484 << " st_state=" << state_or_dash(st)
485 << " it_state=" << state_or_dash(it);
486 send_ok("GET_CELL", os.str());
487 return true;
488 }
489
490 if (cmd == "GET_UNDER_PLAYER") {
491 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
492 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
493 send_err("GET_UNDER_PLAYER", "missing_player");
494 return true;
495 }
496 Actor *a = player::GetMainActor(static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32));
497 if (!a) {
498 send_err("GET_UNDER_PLAYER", "no_actor");
499 return true;
500 }
501 GridPos gp(a->get_pos());
502 Object *fl = GetFloor(gp);
503 Object *st = GetStone(gp);
504 Object *it = GetItem(gp);
505 auto kind_or_dash = [](Object *obj) -> std::string {
506 return obj ? obj->getKind() : std::string("-");
507 };
508 std::ostringstream os;
509 os << "player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
510 << " gx=" << static_cast<int>(gp.x)
511 << " gy=" << static_cast<int>(gp.y)
512 << " fl=" << kind_or_dash(fl)
513 << " st=" << kind_or_dash(st)
514 << " it=" << kind_or_dash(it);
515 send_ok("GET_UNDER_PLAYER", os.str());
516 return true;
517 }
518
519 if (cmd == "GET_INV") {
520 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
521 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
522 send_err("GET_INV", "missing_player");
523 return true;
524 }
525 Inventory *inv = player::GetInventory(static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32));
526 if (!inv) {
527 send_err("GET_INV", "no_inventory");
528 return true;
529 }
530 std::ostringstream os;
531 os << "player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
532 << " size=" << static_cast<unsigned>(inv->size());
533 if (inv->size() > 0 && inv->get_item(0)) {
534 os << " first=" << inv->get_item(0)->getKind();
535 } else {
536 os << " first=-";
537 }
538 send_ok("GET_INV", os.str());
539 return true;
540 }
541
542 if (cmd == "SUBMIT_LOCAL") {
543 const unsigned local_player = multiplayer::LocalPlayer();
544 float fx = 0.0f, fy = 0.0f;
545 int rot = 0;
546 int act = 0;
547 parse_f32(kv, "fx", fx);
548 parse_f32(kv, "fy", fy);
549 parse_i32(kv, "rot", rot);
550 parse_i32(kv, "act", act);
551 if (fx != 0.0f || fy != 0.0f)
552 input::SubmitMouseForce(local_player, ecl::V2(fx, fy));
553 if (rot != 0)
554 input::SubmitRotateInventory(local_player, rot);
555 for (int i = 0; i < act; ++i)
556 input::SubmitActivateItem(local_player);
557 std::ostringstream os;
558 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
559 os.precision(3);
560 os << "player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(local_player)
561 << " fx=" << static_cast<double>(fx)
562 << " fy=" << static_cast<double>(fy)
563 << " rot=" << rot
564 << " act=" << act;
565 send_ok("SUBMIT_LOCAL", os.str());
566 return true;
567 }
568
569 if (cmd == "INJECT_INPUT") {
570 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
571 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
572 send_err("INJECT_INPUT", "missing_player");
573 return true;
574 }
575 float fx = 0.0f, fy = 0.0f;
576 if (!parse_f32(kv, "fx", fx) || !parse_f32(kv, "fy", fy)) {
577 send_err("INJECT_INPUT", "missing_force");
578 return true;
579 }
580 int rot = 0;
581 int act = 0;
582 parse_i32(kv, "rot", rot);
583 parse_i32(kv, "act", act);
584 input::PlayerInput pi;
585 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
586 pi.rotate_steps = rot;
587 pi.activate_count = act > 0 ? act : 0;
588 const uint32_t t = input::CurrentTick();
589 input::EnqueueInput(t, static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32), pi);
590 rollback::RecordInput(t, static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32), pi);
591 input::PlayerInput chk;
592 const bool present = input::PeekInput(t, static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32), chk);
593 std::ostringstream os;
594 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
595 os.precision(3);
596 os << "tick=" << static_cast<unsigned>(t)
597 << " player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
598 << " present=" << (present ? 1 : 0);
599 if (present) {
600 os << " fx=" << static_cast<double>(chk.mouse_force[0])
601 << " fy=" << static_cast<double>(chk.mouse_force[1])
602 << " rot=" << static_cast<int>(chk.rotate_steps)
603 << " act=" << static_cast<unsigned>(chk.activate_count);
604 }
605 send_ok("INJECT_INPUT", os.str());
606 return true;
607 }
608
609 if (cmd == "OVERRIDE_INPUT") {
610 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
611 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
612 send_err("OVERRIDE_INPUT", "missing_player");
613 return true;
614 }
615 int ticks = 0;
616 if (!parse_i32(kv, "ticks", ticks)) {
617 send_err("OVERRIDE_INPUT", "missing_ticks");
618 return true;
619 }
620 if (ticks <= 0) {
621 g_drv.input_override_enabled = false;
622 g_drv.input_override_ticks_left = 0;
623 send_ok("OVERRIDE_INPUT", "enabled=0");
624 return true;
625 }
626 float fx = 0.0f, fy = 0.0f;
627 if (!parse_f32(kv, "fx", fx) || !parse_f32(kv, "fy", fy)) {
628 send_err("OVERRIDE_INPUT", "missing_force");
629 return true;
630 }
631 int rot = 0;
632 int act = 0;
633 parse_i32(kv, "rot", rot);
634 parse_i32(kv, "act", act);
635
636 g_drv.input_override_player = static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32);
637 g_drv.input_override_value = input::PlayerInput();
638 g_drv.input_override_value.mouse_force = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
639 g_drv.input_override_value.rotate_steps = rot;
640 g_drv.input_override_value.activate_count = act > 0 ? act : 0;
641 g_drv.input_override_ticks_left = ticks;
642 g_drv.input_override_last_tick = UINT32_MAX;
643 g_drv.input_override_enabled = true;
644 // Apply once immediately so a script can query STATE right after.
645 maybe_apply_input_override();
646
647 std::ostringstream os;
648 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
649 os.precision(3);
650 os << "enabled=1"
651 << " player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
652 << " ticks=" << ticks
653 << " fx=" << static_cast<double>(fx)
654 << " fy=" << static_cast<double>(fy);
655 send_ok("OVERRIDE_INPUT", os.str());
656 return true;
657 }
658
659 if (cmd == "QUIT") {
660 send_ok("QUIT");
661 client::Msg_Command("abort");
662 return true;
663 }
664
665 if (cmd == "START_HOST") {
666 protocol::LobbyStart start;
667 start.host_id = "mptest-host";
668 start.filter_optimized = 0;
669
670 uint32_t session_id = 0;
671 uint32_t seed = 0;
672 Uint8 expected = 0;
673 Uint16 port = 0;
674 if (!parse_u32(kv, "session", session_id) ||
675 !parse_u32(kv, "seed", seed) ||
676 !parse_u8(kv, "expected", expected) ||
677 !parse_u16(kv, "port", port)) {
678 send_err("START_HOST", "missing_fields");
679 return true;
680 }
681 start.session_id = session_id;
682 start.seed = seed;
683 start.expected_players = expected;
684 start.host_port = port;
685 {
686 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("host_id");
687 if (it != kv.end())
688 start.host_id = it->second;
689 }
690 {
691 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("filter");
692 if (it != kv.end())
693 start.filter_optimized = static_cast<Uint8>(std::atoi(it->second.c_str()) ? 1 : 0);
694 }
695 {
696 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("level_id");
697 if (it != kv.end())
698 start.level_id = it->second;
699 }
700 {
701 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("pack");
702 if (it != kv.end())
703 start.pack_name = it->second;
704 }
705
706 bool ok = multiplayer::StartHostSession(start);
707 if (!ok) {
708 send_err("START_HOST", "start_failed");
709 return true;
710 }
711 send_ok("START_HOST");
712 return true;
713 }
714
715 if (cmd == "START_CLIENT") {
716 protocol::LobbyStart start;
717 start.host_id = "mptest-host";
718 start.filter_optimized = 0;
719
720 uint32_t session_id = 0;
721 uint32_t seed = 0;
722 Uint8 expected = 0;
723 Uint16 port = 0;
724 if (!parse_u32(kv, "session", session_id) ||
725 !parse_u32(kv, "seed", seed) ||
726 !parse_u8(kv, "expected", expected) ||
727 !parse_u16(kv, "port", port)) {
728 send_err("START_CLIENT", "missing_fields");
729 return true;
730 }
731 std::string host_ip;
732 {
733 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("host_ip");
734 if (it != kv.end())
735 host_ip = it->second;
736 }
737 if (host_ip.empty()) {
738 send_err("START_CLIENT", "missing_host_ip");
739 return true;
740 }
741 start.session_id = session_id;
742 start.seed = seed;
743 start.expected_players = expected;
744 start.host_port = port;
745 {
746 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("host_id");
747 if (it != kv.end())
748 start.host_id = it->second;
749 }
750 {
751 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("filter");
752 if (it != kv.end())
753 start.filter_optimized = static_cast<Uint8>(std::atoi(it->second.c_str()) ? 1 : 0);
754 }
755 {
756 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("level_id");
757 if (it != kv.end())
758 start.level_id = it->second;
759 }
760 {
761 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("pack");
762 if (it != kv.end())
763 start.pack_name = it->second;
764 }
765
766 bool ok = multiplayer::BeginClientJoin(start, host_ip);
767 if (!ok) {
768 send_err("START_CLIENT", "join_begin_failed");
769 return true;
770 }
771 g_drv.join_active = true;
772 send_ok("START_CLIENT");
773 return true;
774 }
775
776 if (cmd == "LOAD_LEVEL") {
777 std::string pack;
778 std::string level_id;
779 {
780 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("pack");
781 if (it != kv.end())
782 pack = it->second;
783 }
784 {
785 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("level_id");
786 if (it != kv.end())
787 level_id = it->second;
788 }
789 if (level_id.empty()) {
790 send_err("LOAD_LEVEL", "missing_level_id");
791 return true;
792 }
793 if (!pack.empty())
794 server::Msg_SetLevelPack(pack);
795 lev::Proxy *proxy = find_proxy_by_norm(level_id);
796 if (!proxy) {
797 send_err("LOAD_LEVEL", "level_not_found");
798 return true;
799 }
800 if (multiplayer::IsActive() && multiplayer::IsHost()) {
801 // Mirror lobby behavior: tell peers what to load.
802 multiplayer::NotifyLoadLevel(pack, level_id);
803 }
804 server::Msg_LoadLevel(proxy, false);
805 send_ok("LOAD_LEVEL");
806 return true;
807 }
808
809 if (cmd == "START_GAME") {
810 server::Msg_StartGame();
811 send_ok("START_GAME");
812 return true;
813 }
814
815 if (cmd == "ABORT_MP") {
816 multiplayer::RequestAbort();
817 send_ok("ABORT_MP");
818 return true;
819 }
820
821 if (cmd == "MOUSE_FORCE") {
822 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
823 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
824 send_err("MOUSE_FORCE", "missing_player");
825 return true;
826 }
827 float fx = 0.0f, fy = 0.0f;
828 if (!parse_f32(kv, "fx", fx) || !parse_f32(kv, "fy", fy)) {
829 send_err("MOUSE_FORCE", "missing_force");
830 return true;
831 }
832 input::SubmitMouseForce(static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32), ecl::V2(fx, fy));
833 send_ok("MOUSE_FORCE");
834 return true;
835 }
836
837 if (cmd == "HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE") {
838 uint32_t player_u32 = 0;
839 if (!parse_u32(kv, "player", player_u32)) {
840 send_err("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE", "missing_player");
841 return true;
842 }
843 int ticks = 0;
844 if (!parse_i32(kv, "ticks", ticks)) {
845 send_err("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE", "missing_ticks");
846 return true;
847 }
848 if (ticks <= 0) {
849 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_enabled = false;
850 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_ticks_left = 0;
851 send_ok("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE", "enabled=0");
852 return true;
853 }
854 float fx = 0.0f, fy = 0.0f;
855 if (!parse_f32(kv, "fx", fx) || !parse_f32(kv, "fy", fy)) {
856 send_err("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE", "missing_force");
857 return true;
858 }
859 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_player = static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32);
860 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_value = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
861 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_ticks_left = ticks;
862 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_last_tick = UINT32_MAX;
863 g_drv.hold_mouse_force_enabled = true;
864 // Apply once immediately so a script can query STATE right after.
865 maybe_apply_hold_mouse_force();
866
867 std::ostringstream os;
868 os.setf(std::ios::fixed);
869 os.precision(3);
870 os << "enabled=1"
871 << " player=" << static_cast<unsigned>(player_u32)
872 << " ticks=" << ticks
873 << " fx=" << static_cast<double>(fx)
874 << " fy=" << static_cast<double>(fy);
875 send_ok("HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE", os.str());
876 return true;
877 }
878
879 if (cmd == "SET_INT") {
880 std::string key;
881 int value = 0;
882 {
883 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("key");
884 if (it != kv.end())
885 key = it->second;
886 }
887 if (key.empty() || !parse_i32(kv, "value", value)) {
888 send_err("SET_INT", "missing_fields");
889 return true;
890 }
891 options::SetOption(key.c_str(), static_cast<double>(value));
892 send_ok("SET_INT");
893 return true;
894 }
895
896 if (cmd == "SET_BOOL") {
897 std::string key;
898 int value = 0;
899 {
900 std::map<std::string, std::string>::const_iterator it = kv.find("key");
901 if (it != kv.end())
902 key = it->second;
903 }
904 if (key.empty() || !parse_i32(kv, "value", value)) {
905 send_err("SET_BOOL", "missing_fields");
906 return true;
907 }
908 options::SetOption(key.c_str(), value ? 1.0 : 0.0);
909 send_ok("SET_BOOL");
910 return true;
911 }
912
913 if (cmd == "STATE") {
914 emit_state_snapshot();
915 send_ok("STATE");
916 return true;
917 }
918
919 if (cmd == "STREAM_STATE") {
920 int interval = 0;
921 if (!parse_i32(kv, "interval_ms", interval) || interval < 0) {
922 send_err("STREAM_STATE", "invalid_interval");
923 return true;
924 }
925 g_drv.stream_state_interval_ms = interval;
926 g_drv.next_stream_state_ms = SDL_GetTicks() + static_cast<Uint32>(interval);
927 send_ok("STREAM_STATE");
928 return true;
929 }
930
931 send_err(cmd.c_str(), "unknown_command");
932 return true;
933}

935static void maybe_connect() {
936 if (!g_drv.enabled)
937 return;
938 if (internal::tcp_socket_valid(g_drv.sock))
939 return;
940 const Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
941 if (now < g_drv.next_connect_attempt_ms)
942 return;
943 g_drv.next_connect_attempt_ms = now + 250;
944
945 if (g_drv.controller_host.empty() || g_drv.controller_port == 0)
946 return;
947 internal::TcpSocket s = internal::kInvalidTcpSocket;
948 if (!internal::tcp_connect_timeout(g_drv.controller_host, g_drv.controller_port, 25, s))
949 return;
950 g_drv.sock = s;
951 g_drv.hello_sent = false;
952 g_drv.rx.clear();
953 g_drv.pending_len = 0;
954 send_evt("CONNECTED");
955}
956
957static void send_hello_once() {
958 if (!g_drv.enabled)
959 return;
960 if (!internal::tcp_socket_valid(g_drv.sock))
961 return;
962 if (g_drv.hello_sent)
963 return;
964 g_drv.hello_sent = true;
965 std::ostringstream os;
966 os << "EVT name=HELLO"
967 << " role=" << g_drv.role
968 << " pid="
969#ifdef WIN32
970 << static_cast<unsigned long>(::GetCurrentProcessId())
971#else
972 << static_cast<unsigned long>(::getpid())
973#endif
974 << " rev=" << ENIGMA_GIT_REV;
975 send_frame(os.str());
976}
977
978static void pump_rx() {
979 if (!g_drv.enabled)
980 return;
981 if (!internal::tcp_socket_valid(g_drv.sock))
982 return;
983 if (!internal::tcp_pump_recv(g_drv.sock, g_drv.rx)) {
984 internal::tcp_close(g_drv.sock);
985 g_drv.hello_sent = false;
986 g_drv.join_active = false;
987 send_evt("DISCONNECTED");
988 return;
989 }
990 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
991 while (internal::tcp_try_extract_frame(g_drv.rx, g_drv.pending_len, frame)) {
992 std::string line(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data()), frame.size());
993 handle_command(line);
994 }
995}
996
997static void poll_join() {
998 if (!g_drv.enabled || !g_drv.join_active)
999 return;
1000 ClientJoinStatus st = multiplayer::PollClientJoin();
1001 if (st == ClientJoinStatus::JOINED) {
1002 g_drv.join_active = false;
1003 send_evt("JOINED");
1004 } else if (st == ClientJoinStatus::FAILED) {
1005 g_drv.join_active = false;
1006 send_evt("JOIN_FAILED");
1007 }
1008}

1031void Tick(double dtime) {
1032 (void)dtime;
1033 if (!g_drv.enabled)
1034 return;
1035 maybe_connect();
1036 if (!internal::tcp_socket_valid(g_drv.sock))
1037 return;
1038 send_hello_once();
1039 pump_rx();
1040 poll_join();
1041
1042 // Apply any input override before the next simulation tick consumes inputs.
1043 maybe_apply_hold_mouse_force();
1044 maybe_apply_input_override();
1045
1046 if (g_drv.stream_state_interval_ms > 0) {
1047 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
1048 if (now >= g_drv.next_stream_state_ms) {
1049 emit_state_snapshot();
1050 g_drv.next_stream_state_ms = now + static_cast<Uint32>(g_drv.stream_state_interval_ms);
1051 }
1052 }
1053}
1054
1055void Run() {
1056 // Minimal deterministic-ish tick loop. We intentionally mirror the game loop
1057 // ordering used in `game::StartGame()`.
1058 Uint32 last_tick_time = SDL_GetTicks();
1059 double dtime = 0.0;
1060
1061 while (!client::AbortGameP() && !app.bossKeyPressed) {
1062 Tick(dtime);
1063 multiplayer::Tick(dtime);
1064 client::Tick(dtime);
1065 // Ensure override wins even if multiplayer transport enqueued after Tick().
1066 maybe_apply_input_override();
1067 server::Tick(dtime);
1068
1069 int sleeptime = 10 - (SDL_GetTicks() - last_tick_time);
1070 if (sleeptime >= 3)
1071 SDL_Delay(sleeptime);
1072
1073 Uint32 current_tick_time = SDL_GetTicks();
1074 dtime = (current_tick_time - last_tick_time) / 1000.0;
1075 if (std::abs(1 - dtime / 0.01) < 0.2) {
1076 dtime = 0.01;
1077 last_tick_time += 10;
1078 } else {
1079 last_tick_time = current_tick_time;
1080 }
1081 if (dtime > 500.0)
1082 dtime = 0.0;
1083 }
1084 multiplayer::Shutdown();
1085}

49struct NetSimConfig {
50 bool enabled = false;
51 bool all_packets = false;
52 int delay_ms = 0;
53 int jitter_ms = 0;
54 int drop_pct = 0;
55 int dup_pct = 0;

58bool env_bool(const char *name) {
59 const char *v = std::getenv(name);
60 return v && *v;
61}
62
63int env_int(const char *name, int def, int minv, int maxv) {
64 const char *v = std::getenv(name);
65 if (!v || !*v)
66 return def;
67 int x = std::atoi(v);
68 if (x < minv)
69 x = minv;
70 if (x > maxv)
71 x = maxv;
72 return x;

75const NetSimConfig &netsim_config() {
76 static NetSimConfig cfg;
77 cfg.enabled = env_bool("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM") || options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugNetSimEnabled");
78 cfg.all_packets = env_bool("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM_ALL") || options::GetBool("MultiplayerDebugNetSimAll");
79 cfg.delay_ms = env_int("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM_DELAY_MS", options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDelayMs"), 0, 60000);
80 cfg.jitter_ms = env_int("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM_JITTER_MS", options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimJitterMs"), 0, 60000);
81 cfg.drop_pct = env_int("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM_DROP_PCT", options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDropPct"), 0, 100);
82 cfg.dup_pct = env_int("ENIGMA_MP_NETSIM_DUP_PCT", options::GetInt("MultiplayerDebugNetSimDupPct"), 0, 100);
83 return cfg;
84}
85
86bool netsim_drop_eligible_type(Uint8 type) {
87 // Only drop packets that are intended to be lossy at the application layer.
88 // Dropping reliable control-plane packets here is unrealistic: ENet/TCP would
89 // normally retransmit them, but dropping after encoding bypasses that layer.
90 switch (type) {
91 case protocol::NET_INPUT_BUNDLE:
92 case protocol::NET_INPUT:
93 return true;
94 default:
95 return false;
96 }
97}
98
99bool netsim_should_apply(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
100 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
101 if (!cfg.enabled)
102 return false;
103 if (cfg.all_packets)
104 return true;
105 if (payload.size() == 0)
106 return false;
107 const Uint8 type = static_cast<Uint8>(payload.data()[0]);
108 switch (type) {
109 case protocol::NET_INPUT:
110 case protocol::NET_INPUT_BUNDLE:
111 case protocol::NET_SYNC:
112 case protocol::NET_RESYNC_REQUEST:
113 case protocol::NET_RESYNC_STATE:
114 return true;
115 default:
116 return false;
117 }
118}
119
120int netsim_pick_delay_ms(std::mt19937 &rng) {
121 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
122 int delay = cfg.delay_ms;
123 if (cfg.jitter_ms > 0) {
124 std::uniform_int_distribution<int> dist(-cfg.jitter_ms, cfg.jitter_ms);
125 delay += dist(rng);
126 }
127 if (delay < 0)
128 delay = 0;
129 return delay;
130}
131
132bool netsim_roll_pct(std::mt19937 &rng, int pct) {
133 if (pct <= 0)
134 return false;
135 if (pct >= 100)
136 return true;
137 std::uniform_int_distribution<int> dist(1, 100);
138 return dist(rng) <= pct;
139}

141enum class PendingKind {
142 CLIENT_ENET = 0,
143 CLIENT_TCP = 1,
144 HOST_DIRECT = 2,
145 HOST_UDP_RELAY = 3,
146 HOST_TCP_RELAY = 4,
147 HOST_BROADCAST = 5
148};

150struct PendingSend {

153 ENetPeer *peer = nullptr;

159std::vector<PendingSend> g_pending_sends;

168std::vector<PendingRecv> g_pending_recvs;

175void enet_send_peer(ENetPeer *peer, const std::vector<uint8_t> &payload, bool reliable) {
176 if (!peer || payload.empty())
177 return;
178 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(),
179 reliable ? ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE : 0);
180 enet_peer_send(peer, 0, packet);
181}
182
183void enet_broadcast_host(ENetHost *host, const std::vector<uint8_t> &payload, bool reliable) {
184 if (!host || payload.empty())
185 return;
186 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(),
187 reliable ? ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE : 0);
188 enet_host_broadcast(host, 0, packet);
189}
190
191void deliver_pending_send(const PendingSend &p, bool &need_flush_host, bool &need_flush_relay) {
192 switch (p.kind) {
193 case PendingKind::CLIENT_ENET:
194 if (g_session.server_peer && g_session.server_peer == p.peer) {
195 enet_send_peer(g_session.server_peer, p.payload, p.reliable);
196 need_flush_host = true;
197 }
198 break;
199 case PendingKind::CLIENT_TCP:
200 if (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket) && !p.payload.empty())
201 tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, p.payload.data(), p.payload.size());
202 break;
203 case PendingKind::HOST_DIRECT:
204 if (p.peer && g_session.peer_players.find(p.peer) != g_session.peer_players.end()) {
205 enet_send_peer(p.peer, p.payload, p.reliable);
206 need_flush_host = true;
207 }
208 break;
209 case PendingKind::HOST_UDP_RELAY:
210 if (g_session.relay_peer && !p.payload.empty()) {
211 ecl::Buffer buf;
212 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, p.client_id);
213 buf.write(p.payload.data(), p.payload.size());
214 std::vector<uint8_t> frame(buf.data(), buf.data() + buf.size());
215 enet_send_peer(g_session.relay_peer, frame, true);
216 need_flush_relay = true;
217 }
218 break;
219 case PendingKind::HOST_TCP_RELAY:
220 if (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket) && !p.payload.empty()) {
221 ecl::Buffer buf;
222 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, p.client_id);
223 buf.write(p.payload.data(), p.payload.size());
224 tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size());
225 }
226 break;
227 case PendingKind::HOST_BROADCAST:
228 if (g_session.host_handle) {
229 enet_broadcast_host(g_session.host_handle, p.payload, p.reliable);
230 need_flush_host = true;
231 }
232 break;
233 }
234}
235
236void netsim_pump_due_sends() {
237 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
238 if (!cfg.enabled || g_pending_sends.empty())
239 return;
240 const Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
241 bool need_flush_host = false;
242 bool need_flush_relay = false;
243 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pending_sends.size(); ) {
244 if (g_pending_sends[i].due_ms > now) {
245 i += 1;
246 continue;
247 }
248 deliver_pending_send(g_pending_sends[i], need_flush_host, need_flush_relay);
249 g_pending_sends[i] = g_pending_sends.back();
250 g_pending_sends.pop_back();
251 }
252 if (need_flush_host && g_session.host_handle)
253 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
254 if (need_flush_relay && g_session.relay_handle)
255 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
256}
257
258bool netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind kind, ENetPeer *peer, Uint32 client_id,
259 const ecl::Buffer &payload, bool reliable) {
260 if (!netsim_should_apply(payload))
261 return false;
262 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
263 std::mt19937 &rng = netsim_rng();
264 // Only drop packets that are meant to be lossy. For reliable packets, we
265 // still apply delay/jitter/dup, but avoid drop to preserve ENet's reliability.
266 bool allow_drop = false;
267 if (!reliable && payload.size() > 0) {
268 const Uint8 type = static_cast<Uint8>(payload.data()[0]);
269 allow_drop = netsim_drop_eligible_type(type);
270 }
271 if (allow_drop && netsim_roll_pct(rng, cfg.drop_pct))
272 return true; // dropped
273
274 int delay_ms = netsim_pick_delay_ms(rng);
275 auto queue_one = [&](int extra_delay_ms) {
276 PendingSend p;
277 p.due_ms = SDL_GetTicks() + static_cast<Uint32>(extra_delay_ms);
278 p.kind = kind;
279 p.peer = peer;
280 p.client_id = client_id;
281 p.reliable = reliable;
282 p.payload.assign(payload.data(), payload.data() + payload.size());
283 g_pending_sends.push_back(std::move(p));
284 };
285
286 if (delay_ms <= 0) {
287 // Deliver immediately (but still allow drop/dup simulation).
288 bool need_flush_host = false;
289 bool need_flush_relay = false;
290 PendingSend p;
291 p.kind = kind;
292 p.peer = peer;
293 p.client_id = client_id;
294 p.reliable = reliable;
295 p.payload.assign(payload.data(), payload.data() + payload.size());
296 deliver_pending_send(p, need_flush_host, need_flush_relay);
297 if (need_flush_host && g_session.host_handle)
298 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
299 if (need_flush_relay && g_session.relay_handle)
300 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
301 } else {
302 queue_one(delay_ms);
303 }
304
305 if (netsim_roll_pct(rng, cfg.dup_pct)) {
306 int dup_delay = delay_ms;
307 if (cfg.jitter_ms > 0)
308 dup_delay = netsim_pick_delay_ms(rng);
309 if (dup_delay <= 0)
310 dup_delay = 1;
311 queue_one(dup_delay);
312 }
313 return true;
314}
315
316bool netsim_should_apply_bytes(const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
317 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
318 if (!cfg.enabled)
319 return false;
320 if (cfg.all_packets)
321 return true;
322 if (!data || len == 0)
323 return false;
324 const Uint8 type = static_cast<Uint8>(data[0]);
325 switch (type) {
326 case protocol::NET_INPUT:
327 case protocol::NET_INPUT_BUNDLE:
328 case protocol::NET_SYNC:
329 case protocol::NET_RESYNC_REQUEST:
330 case protocol::NET_RESYNC_STATE:
331 return true;
332 default:
333 return false;
334 }
335}
336
337bool netsim_deliver_due_recvs(ITransportSink &sink, HostSource source_filter) {
338 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
339 if (!cfg.enabled || g_pending_recvs.empty())
340 return true;
341 const Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
342 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pending_recvs.size(); ) {
343 const PendingRecv &r = g_pending_recvs[i];
344 if (r.source != source_filter || r.due_ms > now) {
345 i += 1;
346 continue;
347 }
348 const char *data = r.payload.empty() ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<const char *>(r.payload.data());
349 const size_t len = r.payload.size();
350 bool ok = sink.OnPayload(r.source, r.peer, data, len);
351 g_pending_recvs[i] = g_pending_recvs.back();
352 g_pending_recvs.pop_back();
353 if (!ok)
354 return false;
355 }
356 return true;
357}
358
359bool netsim_maybe_delay_recv(ITransportSink &sink, HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer,
360 const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
361 if (!netsim_should_apply_bytes(data, len))
362 return sink.OnPayload(source, peer, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data), len);
363 const NetSimConfig &cfg = netsim_config();
364 std::mt19937 &rng = netsim_rng();
365 // Same rationale as send side: only drop payload types that are expected to
366 // be lossy at the application layer.
367 bool allow_drop = false;
368 if (data && len > 0)
369 allow_drop = netsim_drop_eligible_type(static_cast<Uint8>(data[0]));
370 if (allow_drop && netsim_roll_pct(rng, cfg.drop_pct))
371 return true;
372 int delay_ms = netsim_pick_delay_ms(rng);
373 if (delay_ms <= 0)
374 return sink.OnPayload(source, peer, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data), len);
375 PendingRecv r;
376 r.due_ms = SDL_GetTicks() + static_cast<Uint32>(delay_ms);
377 r.source = source;
378 r.peer = peer;
379 r.payload.assign(data, data + len);
380 g_pending_recvs.push_back(std::move(r));
381 if (netsim_roll_pct(rng, cfg.dup_pct)) {
382 PendingRecv r2 = g_pending_recvs.back();
383 int dup_delay = delay_ms;
384 if (cfg.jitter_ms > 0)
385 dup_delay = netsim_pick_delay_ms(rng);
386 if (dup_delay <= 0)
387 dup_delay = 1;
388 r2.due_ms = SDL_GetTicks() + static_cast<Uint32>(dup_delay);
389 g_pending_recvs.push_back(std::move(r2));
390 }
391 return true;
392}
393
394bool poll_direct_enet(ITransportSink &sink) {
395 // Direct ENet sessions (host or client). TCP-relay-only clients don't have a host_handle.
396 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
397 return true;
398
399 if (!netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::DIRECT))
400 return false;
401
402 ENetEvent event;
403 while (enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
404 switch (event.type) {
405 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT:
406 if (!sink.OnConnect(HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer))
407 return false;
408 break;
409 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
410 const uint8_t *data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(event.packet->data);
411 bool ok = netsim_maybe_delay_recv(sink, HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer, data,
412 event.packet->dataLength);
413 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
414 if (!ok)
415 return false;
416 break;
417 }
418 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
419 if (!sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer))
420 return false;
421 break;
422 default:
423 break;
424 }
425 }
426 return netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::DIRECT);
427}
428
429bool poll_udp_relay(ITransportSink &sink) {
430 // Only the host polls a dedicated ENet host for relay connection. Clients use host_handle.
431 if (!g_session.host || g_session.relay_handle == nullptr)
432 return true;
433
434 if (!netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::UDP_RELAY))
435 return false;
436
437 ENetEvent event;
438 while (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
439 switch (event.type) {
440 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
441 const uint8_t *data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(event.packet->data);
442 bool ok = netsim_maybe_delay_recv(sink, HostSource::UDP_RELAY, event.peer, data,
443 event.packet->dataLength);
444 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
445 if (!ok)
446 return false;
447 break;
448 }
449 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
450 if (!sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::UDP_RELAY, event.peer))
451 return false;
452 break;
453 default:
454 break;
455 }
456 }
457 return netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::UDP_RELAY);
458}
459
460bool poll_tcp_relay(ITransportSink &sink) {
461 if (!tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))
462 return true;
463
464 if (!netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::TCP_RELAY))
465 return false;
466
467 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
468 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
469 return sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr);
470 }
471
472 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
473 while (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket) &&
474 tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx, g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len, frame)) {
475 const uint8_t *data = frame.empty() ? nullptr : frame.data();
476 if (!netsim_maybe_delay_recv(sink, HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr, data, frame.size()))
477 return false;
478 }
479 return netsim_deliver_due_recvs(sink, HostSource::TCP_RELAY);
480}
481
482} // namespace
483
484bool Transport::Poll(ITransportSink &sink) {
485 netsim_pump_due_sends();
486 if (!poll_direct_enet(sink))
487 return false;
488 if (!poll_udp_relay(sink))
489 return false;
490 return poll_tcp_relay(sink);
491}
492
493bool Transport::ClientSend(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
494 if (g_session.host)
495 return false;
496 if (g_session.server_peer) {
497 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::CLIENT_ENET, g_session.server_peer, 0, payload, true))
498 return true;
499 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(),
500 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
501 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
502 Flush();
503 return true;
504 }
505 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
506 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
507 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::CLIENT_TCP, nullptr, 0, payload, true))
508 return true;
509 bool ok = tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, payload.data(), payload.size());
510 if (!ok && debug_enabled())
511 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay send failed (len=%u)", (unsigned)payload.size());
512 return ok;
513 }
514 return false;
515}
516
517bool Transport::ClientSendUnreliable(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
518 if (g_session.host)
519 return false;
520 if (g_session.server_peer) {
521 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::CLIENT_ENET, g_session.server_peer, 0, payload, false))
522 return true;
523 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(), 0);
524 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
525 Flush();
526 return true;
527 }
528 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
529 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
530 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::CLIENT_TCP, nullptr, 0, payload, true))
531 return true;
532 // TCP relay is inherently reliable; still accept the call for API symmetry.
533 bool ok = tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, payload.data(), payload.size());
534 if (!ok && debug_enabled())
535 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay send failed (len=%u)", (unsigned)payload.size());
536 return ok;
537 }
538 return false;
539}

543 return;

545 return;

559void Transport::HostSendUdpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
560 if (!g_session.relay_peer)
561 return;
562 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::HOST_UDP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id, payload, true))
563 return;
564 ecl::Buffer buf;
565 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, client_id);
566 buf.write(payload.data(), payload.size());
567 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
568 enet_peer_send(g_session.relay_peer, 0, packet);
569 if (g_session.relay_handle)
570 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
571}
572
573void Transport::HostSendTcpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
574 if (!tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))
575 return;
576 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::HOST_TCP_RELAY, nullptr, client_id, payload, true))
577 return;
578 ecl::Buffer buf;
579 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, client_id);
580 buf.write(payload.data(), payload.size());
581 tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size());
582}

584void Transport::HostBroadcastUdpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id) {
585 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
586 if (entry.first == exclude_client_id)
587 continue;
588 HostSendUdpRelay(entry.first, payload);
589 }
590}
591
592void Transport::HostBroadcastTcpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id) {
593 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
594 if (entry.first == exclude_client_id)
595 continue;
596 HostSendTcpRelay(entry.first, payload);
597 }
598}
599
600void Transport::HostBroadcast(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
601 if (!g_session.host)
602 return;
603 if (g_session.peer_players.empty() && g_session.relay_players.empty() &&
604 g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty()) {
605 return;
606 }
607 if (!g_session.peer_players.empty()) {
608 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::HOST_BROADCAST, nullptr, 0, payload, true))
609 return;
610 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
611 enet_host_broadcast(g_session.host_handle, 0, packet);
612 }
613 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
614 HostBroadcastUdpRelay(payload, 0);
615 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
616 HostBroadcastTcpRelay(payload, 0);
617}
618
619void Transport::HostBroadcastUnreliable(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
620 if (!g_session.host)
621 return;
622 if (g_session.peer_players.empty() && g_session.relay_players.empty() &&
623 g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty()) {
624 return;
625 }
626 if (!g_session.peer_players.empty()) {
627 if (netsim_send_or_queue(PendingKind::HOST_BROADCAST, nullptr, 0, payload, false))
628 return;
629 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(), 0);
630 enet_host_broadcast(g_session.host_handle, 0, packet);
631 }
632 // Relay forwarding currently uses ENet/TCP on the host side. For simplicity,
633 // keep relayed broadcasts reliable (the redundancy in the payload still helps).
634 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
635 HostBroadcastUdpRelay(payload, 0);
636 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
637 HostBroadcastTcpRelay(payload, 0);
638}
639
640void Transport::Flush() {
641 netsim_pump_due_sends();
642 if (g_session.host_handle)
643 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
644}
