22/* -------------------- Multiplayer transport -------------------- */
23/*
24 * Transport abstraction for multiplayer sessions.
25 *
26 * The session engine interacts with one send/recv/poll surface regardless of
27 * whether peers connect directly or via relays.
28 */
29
30#include "multiplayer_internal.hh"
31
32namespace enigma {
33namespace multiplayer {
34namespace internal {
35
36class ITransportSink {
37public:
38 virtual ~ITransportSink() = default;
39
40 virtual bool OnConnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) = 0;
41 virtual bool OnDisconnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) = 0;
42 virtual bool OnPayload(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) = 0;
43};
44
45// Session transport facade.
46//
47// This centralizes polling/sending across:
48// - direct ENet client<->host (LAN)
49// - UDP ENet relay host<->relay and client<->relay
50// - TCP relay framing for both host and clients
51//
52// Session logic provides an ITransportSink and stays agnostic to the underlying transport.
53class Transport {
54public:
55 bool Poll(ITransportSink &sink);
56
57 // Client side: sends raw game payload to the currently active host link.
58 bool ClientSend(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
59 bool ClientSendUnreliable(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
60
61 // Host side: sends raw game payload to a specific remote.
62 void HostSendDirect(ENetPeer *peer, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
63 void HostSendDirectUnreliable(ENetPeer *peer, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
64 void HostSendUdpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
65 void HostSendTcpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
66
67 // Host side: broadcast raw game payload to all remotes.
68 void HostBroadcast(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
69 void HostBroadcastUnreliable(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
70 void HostBroadcastUdpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id);
71 void HostBroadcastTcpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id);
72
73 // Flush ENet outbound queues (safe to call even if not connected).
74 void Flush();
75};
76
77extern Transport g_transport;
78
79} // namespace internal
80} // namespace multiplayer
81} // namespace enigma
82
83#endif

32bool parse_host_port(const std::string &value, std::string &host, Uint16 &port,
33 Uint16 default_port) {
34 host.clear();
35 port = default_port;
36 if (value.empty())
37 return false;
38 std::string::size_type pos = value.rfind(':');
39 if (pos == std::string::npos) {
40 host = value;
41 } else {
42 host = value.substr(0, pos);
43 std::string port_str = value.substr(pos + 1);
44 if (!port_str.empty()) {
45 char *end = nullptr;
46 long parsed = std::strtol(port_str.c_str(), &end, 10);
47 if (end && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 && parsed <= 65535)
48 port = static_cast<Uint16>(parsed);
49 }
50 }
51
52 if (host == "localhost" || host == "::1")
53 host = "127.0.0.1";
54 return !host.empty();
55}

M src/server.cc

Description
  • Local server simulation used by single-player and by host instances.
Where it is used
  • Hosts authoritative world tick and message distribution.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Integrates deterministic lockstep input consumption (`input::CanAdvanceTick()` gates world ticks; `apply_inputs_for_tick()` applies synchronized inputs).
  • Hooks multiplayer lifecycle into level load: extra-actor spawning and post-`WorldInitLevel()` controller rebalance/placement for extra players.
  • Makes restarts and next-level transitions host-authoritative (clients wait for host control messages instead of advancing locally).

165void SimulateOneTick(double timestep) {
166 LevelTime += timestep;
167 const uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
168 unsigned players = input::IsNetworked() ? input::ExpectedPlayers() : player::PlayerCount();
169 if (players == 0)
170 players = 1;
171 std::array<input::PlayerInput, input::kMaxPlayers> inputs;
172 collect_inputs_for_tick(tick, inputs, players);
173
174 // Apply discrete actions once per tick; distribute continuous mouse force
175 // across smaller physics steps for stable, controllable motion at large tick sizes.
176 for (unsigned player = 0; player < players; ++player) {
177 const input::PlayerInput &pi = inputs[player];
178 if (pi.rotate_steps != 0) {
179 int dir = (pi.rotate_steps > 0) ? 1 : -1;
180 int steps = (pi.rotate_steps > 0) ? pi.rotate_steps : -pi.rotate_steps;
181 for (int i = 0; i < steps; ++i)
182 player::RotateInventory(player, dir);
183 }
184 if (pi.activate_count > 0) {
185 for (int i = 0; i < pi.activate_count; ++i)
186 Msg_ActivateItem(player);
187 }
188 }
189
190 constexpr double kMaxPhysicsStep = 0.01; // original engine tick (10ms)
191 int substeps = 1;
192 if (timestep > kMaxPhysicsStep)
193 substeps = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(timestep / kMaxPhysicsStep));
194 if (substeps < 1)
195 substeps = 1;
196 const double sub_dt = timestep / static_cast<double>(substeps);
197 const double inv_substeps = 1.0 / static_cast<double>(substeps);
198 for (int step = 0; step < substeps; ++step) {
199 for (unsigned player = 0; player < players; ++player) {
200 const input::PlayerInput &pi = inputs[player];
201 if (pi.mouse_force[0] != 0.0 || pi.mouse_force[1] != 0.0) {
202 Msg_MouseForce(player, pi.mouse_force * inv_substeps);
203 }
204 }
205 WorldTick(sub_dt);
206 }
207 input::AdvanceTick();
208}

144Timer::Snapshot Timer::snapshot() const {

148 AlarmSnapshot a;
149 a.interval = alarm.interval;

151 a.repeatp = alarm.repeatp;
152 a.alarmnr = alarm.alarmnr;
153 const Object *obj = dynamic_cast<const Object *>(alarm.handler);

160void Timer::restore(const Snapshot &snap) {
161 // Rollback/replay cares about alarms only. Activated tick-handlers are not
162 // used by Enigma gameplay code (and would be harder to restore safely).
163 self->alarms.clear();
164 for (const auto &a : snap.alarms) {
165 if (a.handler_object_id < 0)
166 continue;
167 Object *obj = Object::getObject(a.handler_object_id);
168 if (!obj)
169 continue;
170 TimeHandler *th = dynamic_cast<TimeHandler *>(obj);
171 if (!th)
172 continue;
173 self->alarms.push_back(Alarm(th, a.interval, a.repeatp, a.alarmnr));
174 self->alarms.back().timeleft = a.timeleft;
175 }
176}

2375void hash_bytes(uint64_t &h, const void *data, size_t len) {
2376 const unsigned char *ptr = static_cast<const unsigned char *>(data);
2377 for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
2378 h ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(ptr[i]);
2379 h *= kChecksumPrime;
2380 }
2381}
2382
2383void hash_u64(uint64_t &h, uint64_t v) {
2384 hash_bytes(h, &v, sizeof(v));
2385}
2386
2387void hash_i64(uint64_t &h, int64_t v) {
2388 hash_bytes(h, &v, sizeof(v));
2389}
2390
2391void hash_string(uint64_t &h, const std::string &s) {
2392 if (!s.empty())
2393 hash_bytes(h, s.data(), s.size());
2394 unsigned char sep = 0;
2395 hash_bytes(h, &sep, 1);
2396}

2398int64_t quantize(double v) {
2399 // Multiplayer uses WorldChecksum/ActorChecksum for desync detection. Keep
2400 // quantization coarse enough to avoid false positives due to tiny platform-
2401 // dependent floating point drift, but fine enough to catch real divergence.
2402 // 0.05 tiles ~= 1/20th of a cell.
2403 return static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(v * 20.0));
2404}

2406void hash_object_state(uint64_t &h, Object *obj) {
2407 if (!obj) {
2408 hash_u64(h, 0);
2409 return;
2410 }
2411 hash_string(h, obj->getKind());
2412 Value state = obj->getAttr("state");
2413 if (!state.isDefault()) {
2414 int state_value = static_cast<int>(state);
2415 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(state_value));
2416 } else {
2417 hash_u64(h, 0);
2418 }
2419}
2420

2423uint64_t WorldChecksum() {
2424 if (!level)

2427 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->w));
2428 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->h));
2429
2430 for (int y = 0; y < level->h; ++y) {
2431 for (int x = 0; x < level->w; ++x) {
2432 GridPos p(x, y);
2433 hash_object_state(h, level->fl_layer.get(p));
2434 hash_object_state(h, level->st_layer.get(p));
2435 hash_object_state(h, level->it_layer.get(p));

2439 struct ActorDigest {
2440 uint32_t kind = 0;
2441 uint32_t id = 0;
2442 int owner = -1;
2443 int controllers = 0;
2444 int64_t x = 0;
2445 int64_t y = 0;
2446 int64_t vx = 0;
2447 int64_t vy = 0;
2448 };
2449 std::vector<ActorDigest> actors;
2450 actors.reserve(level->actorlist.size());
2451 for (Actor *actor : level->actorlist) {
2452 ActorDigest d;
2453 d.kind = static_cast<uint32_t>(get_id(actor));
2454 d.id = static_cast<uint32_t>(actor->getId());
2455 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
2456 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
2457 d.owner = static_cast<int>(owner);
2458 d.controllers = actor->get_controllers();
2459 const ecl::V2 &pos = actor->get_pos();
2460 const ecl::V2 &vel = actor->get_vel();
2461 d.x = quantize(pos[0]);
2462 d.y = quantize(pos[1]);
2463 d.vx = quantize(vel[0]);
2464 d.vy = quantize(vel[1]);
2465 actors.push_back(d);
2466 }
2467 std::sort(actors.begin(), actors.end(), [](const ActorDigest &a, const ActorDigest &b) {
2468 if (a.kind != b.kind)
2469 return a.kind < b.kind;
2470 if (a.id != b.id)
2471 return a.id < b.id;
2472 if (a.owner != b.owner)
2473 return a.owner < b.owner;
2474 if (a.controllers != b.controllers)
2475 return a.controllers < b.controllers;
2476 if (a.x != b.x)
2477 return a.x < b.x;
2478 if (a.y != b.y)
2479 return a.y < b.y;
2480 if (a.vx != b.vx)
2481 return a.vx < b.vx;
2482 return a.vy < b.vy;
2483 });
2484 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(actors.size()));
2485 for (const auto &d : actors) {
2486 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.kind));
2487 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.id));
2488 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.owner));
2489 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.controllers));
2490 hash_i64(h, d.x);
2491 hash_i64(h, d.y);
2492 hash_i64(h, d.vx);
2493 hash_i64(h, d.vy);
2494 }
2495
2496 std::vector<Other *> others(level->others.begin(), level->others.end());
2497 std::sort(others.begin(), others.end(),
2498 [](const Other *a, const Other *b) { return a->getId() < b->getId(); });
2499 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(others.size()));
2500 for (Other *other : others) {
2501 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(other->getId()));
2502 hash_string(h, other->getKind());
2503 }
2504
2505 return h;
2506}

2508uint64_t WorldGridKindChecksum() {

2512 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->w));
2513 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->h));
2514 for (int y = 0; y < level->h; ++y) {
2515 for (int x = 0; x < level->w; ++x) {
2516 GridPos p(x, y);
2517 Object *fl = level->fl_layer.get(p);
2518 Object *st = level->st_layer.get(p);
2519 Object *it = level->it_layer.get(p);
2520 if (fl)
2521 hash_string(h, fl->getKind());
2522 else
2523 hash_u64(h, 0);
2524 if (st)
2525 hash_string(h, st->getKind());
2526 else
2527 hash_u64(h, 0);
2528 if (it)
2529 hash_string(h, it->getKind());
2530 else
2531 hash_u64(h, 0);
2532 }
2533 }
2534 return h;
2535}

2537uint64_t WorldGridStateChecksum() {
2538 if (!level)
2539 return 0;
2540 uint64_t h = kChecksumOffset;
2541 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->w));
2542 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->h));
2543 auto hash_external_state = [&h](Object *obj) {
2544 if (!obj) {
2545 hash_u64(h, 0);
2546 return;
2547 }
2548 Value state = obj->getAttr("state");
2549 if (!state.isDefault()) {
2550 int state_value = static_cast<int>(state);
2551 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(state_value));
2552 } else {
2553 hash_u64(h, 0);
2554 }
2555 // Oxyd stones have an additional gameplay-relevant attribute that affects their
2556 // visible identity (and matching logic). Include it so multiplayer detects and
2557 // repairs oxyd color divergence too.
2558 if (obj->getClass() == "st_oxyd") {
2559 Value c = obj->getAttr("oxydcolor");
2560 if (!c.isDefault()) {
2561 int c_value = static_cast<int>(c);
2562 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(c_value));
2563 } else {
2564 hash_u64(h, 0);
2565 }
2566 }
2567 };
2568 for (int y = 0; y < level->h; ++y) {
2569 for (int x = 0; x < level->w; ++x) {
2570 GridPos p(x, y);
2571 hash_external_state(level->fl_layer.get(p));
2572 hash_external_state(level->st_layer.get(p));
2573 hash_external_state(level->it_layer.get(p));
2574 }
2575 }
2576 return h;
2577}
2578
2579uint64_t WorldGridMovableStoneChecksum() {
2580 if (!level)
2581 return 0;
2582 uint64_t h = kChecksumOffset;
2583 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->w));
2584 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->h));
2585
2586 // IMPORTANT: do not use runtime object IDs here.
2587 // Multiplayer resync can rebuild stones (and different instances can also allocate objects
2588 // in different orders), so IDs are not stable across peers even if the visible grid matches.
2589 // Keep this checksum purely based on the grid layout.
2590 for (int y = 0; y < level->h; ++y) {
2591 for (int x = 0; x < level->w; ++x) {
2592 GridPos p(x, y);
2593 Stone *st = dynamic_cast<Stone *>(level->st_layer.get(p));
2594 if (st && st->is_movable())
2595 hash_string(h, st->getKind());
2596 else
2597 hash_u64(h, 0);
2598 }
2599 }
2600 return h;
2601}

2603uint64_t CombineWorldGridChecksums(uint64_t kind_checksum, uint64_t state_checksum, uint64_t movable_checksum) {
2604 uint64_t h = kChecksumOffset;
2605 hash_u64(h, kind_checksum);
2606 hash_u64(h, state_checksum);
2607 // Movable stones are already covered by kind/state (per-cell), and their runtime IDs are
2608 // not stable across peers once we allow world-state resync that rebuilds stones.
2609 // Keeping this out of the combined checksum prevents persistent false mismatches.
2610 (void)movable_checksum;
2611 return h;
2612}

2614uint64_t WorldGridChecksum() {

2616 return 0;

2623uint64_t ActorChecksum() {
2624 if (!level)
2625 return 0;
2626 uint64_t h = kChecksumOffset;
2627 struct ActorDigest {
2628 uint32_t kind = 0;
2629 uint32_t id = 0;
2630 int owner = -1;
2631 int controllers = 0;
2632 int64_t x = 0;
2633 int64_t y = 0;
2634 int64_t vx = 0;
2635 int64_t vy = 0;
2636 };
2637 std::vector<ActorDigest> actors;
2638 actors.reserve(level->actorlist.size());
2639 for (Actor *actor : level->actorlist) {
2640 ActorDigest d;
2641 d.kind = static_cast<uint32_t>(get_id(actor));
2642 d.id = static_cast<uint32_t>(actor->getId());
2643 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
2644 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
2645 d.owner = static_cast<int>(owner);
2646 d.controllers = actor->get_controllers();
2647 const ecl::V2 &pos = actor->get_pos();
2648 const ecl::V2 &vel = actor->get_vel();
2649 d.x = quantize(pos[0]);
2650 d.y = quantize(pos[1]);
2651 d.vx = quantize(vel[0]);
2652 d.vy = quantize(vel[1]);
2653 actors.push_back(d);
2654 }
2655 std::sort(actors.begin(), actors.end(), [](const ActorDigest &a, const ActorDigest &b) {
2656 if (a.kind != b.kind)
2657 return a.kind < b.kind;
2658 if (a.id != b.id)
2659 return a.id < b.id;
2660 if (a.owner != b.owner)
2661 return a.owner < b.owner;
2662 if (a.controllers != b.controllers)
2663 return a.controllers < b.controllers;
2664 if (a.x != b.x)
2665 return a.x < b.x;
2666 if (a.y != b.y)
2667 return a.y < b.y;
2668 if (a.vx != b.vx)
2669 return a.vx < b.vx;
2670 return a.vy < b.vy;
2671 });
2672 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(actors.size()));
2673 for (const auto &d : actors) {
2674 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.kind));
2675 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.id));
2676 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.owner));
2677 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.controllers));
2678 hash_i64(h, d.x);
2679 hash_i64(h, d.y);
2680 hash_i64(h, d.vx);
2681 hash_i64(h, d.vy);
2682 }
2683 return h;
2684}

2689 return;
2690 out.insert(out.end(), level->actorlist.begin(), level->actorlist.end());
2691}

1#!/usr/bin/env bash
2set -euo pipefail
3
4LOBBY_HOST="${LOBBY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
5LOBBY_PORT="${LOBBY_PORT:-12347}"
6RELAY_HOST="${RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
7RELAY_PORT="${RELAY_PORT:-12348}"
8TCP_RELAY_HOST="${TCP_RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
9TCP_RELAY_PORT="${TCP_RELAY_PORT:-12349}"
10
11echo "Starting lobby server on ${LOBBY_HOST}:${LOBBY_PORT}"
12python3 -u /opt/enigma/tools/internet_lobby_server.py --host "$LOBBY_HOST" --port "$LOBBY_PORT" &
13lobby_pid=$!
14
15echo "Starting relay server on ${RELAY_HOST}:${RELAY_PORT}"
16/usr/local/bin/enigma-relay "$RELAY_HOST" "$RELAY_PORT" &
17relay_pid=$!
18
19echo "Starting TCP relay server on ${TCP_RELAY_HOST}:${TCP_RELAY_PORT}"
20/usr/local/bin/enigma-tcp-relay "$TCP_RELAY_HOST" "$TCP_RELAY_PORT" &
21tcp_relay_pid=$!
22
23trap 'kill $lobby_pid $relay_pid $tcp_relay_pid' SIGINT SIGTERM
24
25wait -n "$lobby_pid" "$relay_pid" "$tcp_relay_pid"

A tools/internet_lobby_server.py

Description
  • Internet lobby service (custom UDP protocol) used for room creation/joining and for distributing session metadata.
  • This server coordinates who is in a room; it is not on the per-tick gameplay data path.
Where it is used
  • Clients in Internet mode talk to this service to create/join/leave rooms and discover peers/transport options.
  • Deployed alongside the relays for Internet play.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New optional Internet coordination service for multiplayer.
  • Tracks room members as id/name pairs, returns member lists in JOIN/POLL responses, and closes the room immediately when the host leaves so stale rooms do not linger.

23def read_u8(data, offset):
24 if offset + 1 > len(data):
25 raise ValueError("short buffer")
26 return data[offset], offset + 1
27
28
29def read_u16(data, offset):
30 if offset + 2 > len(data):
31 raise ValueError("short buffer")
32 return struct.unpack_from("<H", data, offset)[0], offset + 2
33
34
35def read_u32(data, offset):
36 if offset + 4 > len(data):
37 raise ValueError("short buffer")
38 return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0], offset + 4
39
40
41def read_str(data, offset):
42 length, offset = read_u16(data, offset)
43 if offset + length > len(data):
44 raise ValueError("short buffer")
45 value = data[offset:offset + length].decode("utf-8", "ignore")
46 return value, offset + length
47
48
49def write_u8(value):
50 return struct.pack("<B", value)
51
52
53def write_u16(value):
54 return struct.pack("<H", value)
55
56
57def write_u32(value):
58 return struct.pack("<I", value)
59
60
61def write_str(value):
62 raw = value.encode("utf-8")
63 return write_u16(len(raw)) + raw

66def make_code():
67 alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
68 return "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(4))

71class Room:
72 def __init__(self, code, host_ip, host_port, start, host_id, host_name):
73 self.code = code
74 self.host_ip = host_ip
75 self.host_port = host_port
76 self.start = start
77 self.created_at = time.time()
78 self.last_seen = self.created_at
79 self.members = {host_id: host_name}
80 self.started = False
81
82 def expired(self, ttl):
83 return (time.time() - self.last_seen) > ttl
84

86def parse_start(payload):
87 # Layout A: session_id, seed, expected, host_port, filter, level_id, host_id
88 offset = 0
89 try:
90 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
91 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
92 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
93 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
94 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
95 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
96 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
97 pack_name = ""
98 if offset < len(payload):
99 pack_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
100 host_name = None
101 if offset < len(payload):
102 host_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
103 return {
104 "session_id": session_id,
105 "seed": seed,
106 "expected_players": expected_players,
107 "host_port": host_port,
108 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
109 "level_id": level_id,
110 "host_id": host_id,
111 "pack_name": pack_name,
112 "host_name": host_name,
113 }
114 except Exception:
115 pass
116
117 # Layout B: optional lobby magic + session_id, level_id, seed, expected, host_port, host_id, filter
118 offset = 0
119 magic, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
120 if magic == 0x454E4C42: # "ENLB"
121 _version, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
122 _type, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
123 else:
124 offset = 0
125 magic = None
126
127 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
128 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
129 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
130 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
131 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
132 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
133 filter_optimized = 1
134 if offset < len(payload):
135 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
136 pack_name = ""
137 if offset < len(payload):
138 pack_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
139 host_name = None
140 if offset < len(payload):
141 host_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
142 return {
143 "session_id": session_id,
144 "seed": seed,
145 "expected_players": expected_players,
146 "host_port": host_port,
147 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
148 "level_id": level_id,
149 "host_id": host_id,
150 "pack_name": pack_name,
151 "host_name": host_name,
152 }
153
154
155def build_start(start):
156 return (
157 write_u32(start["session_id"])
158 + write_str(start["level_id"])
159 + write_u32(start["seed"])
160 + write_u8(start["expected_players"])
161 + write_u16(start["host_port"])
162 + write_str(start["host_id"])
163 + write_u8(start["filter_optimized"])
164 )
165
166
167def normalize_member_name(name):
168 if not name:
169 return "Player"
170 return name
171
172
173def ordered_members(room):
174 members = []
175 host_id = room.start.get("host_id", "")
176 if host_id in room.members:
177 members.append((host_id, normalize_member_name(room.members[host_id])))
178 for member_id in sorted(room.members.keys()):
179 if member_id == host_id:
180 continue
181 members.append((member_id, normalize_member_name(room.members[member_id])))
182 return members
183
184
185def encode_members(room):
186 members = ordered_members(room)
187 if len(members) > 255:
188 members = members[:255]
189 payload = write_u8(len(members))
190 for member_id, name in members:
191 payload += write_str(member_id)
192 payload += write_str(name)
193 return payload
194
195
196def handle_request(data, addr, rooms, ttl):
197 offset = 0
198 magic, offset = read_u32(data, offset)
199 version, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
200 msg_type, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
201 if magic != MAGIC or version != VERSION:
202 return None
203
204 if msg_type == INET_CREATE:
205 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
206 if not code:
207 return (
208 write_u32(MAGIC)
209 + write_u8(VERSION)
210 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
211 + write_str("please choose room code")
212 )
213 if code in rooms and not rooms[code].expired(ttl):
214 return (
215 write_u32(MAGIC)
216 + write_u8(VERSION)
217 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
218 + write_str("room code is already used")
219 )
220 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
221 host_name = normalize_member_name(start.get("host_name"))
222 rooms[code] = Room(code, addr[0], start["host_port"], start, start["host_id"], host_name)
223 resp = (
224 write_u32(MAGIC)
225 + write_u8(VERSION)
226 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
227 + write_str(code)
228 + write_str(addr[0])
229 )
230 return resp
231
232 if msg_type == INET_JOIN:
233 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
234 _client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
235 client_name = "Player"
236 if offset < len(data):
237 client_name, offset = read_str(data, offset)
238 room = rooms.get(code)
239 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
240 rooms.pop(code, None)
241 return (
242 write_u32(MAGIC)
243 + write_u8(VERSION)
244 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
245 + write_str("Room not found.")
246 )
247 room.members[_client_id] = normalize_member_name(client_name)
248 room.last_seen = time.time()
249 resp = (
250 write_u32(MAGIC)
251 + write_u8(VERSION)
252 + write_u8(INET_JOIN_OK)
253 + build_start(room.start)
254 + write_str(room.host_ip)
255 + write_u8(len(room.members))
256 + write_str(room.start.get("pack_name", ""))
257 + encode_members(room)
258 )
259 return resp
260
261 if msg_type == INET_START:
262 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
263 room = rooms.get(code)
264 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
265 rooms.pop(code, None)
266 return (
267 write_u32(MAGIC)
268 + write_u8(VERSION)
269 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
270 + write_str("Room not found.")
271 )
272 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
273 room.start = start
274 host_name = start.get("host_name")
275 if host_name is not None:
276 room.members[start["host_id"]] = normalize_member_name(host_name)
277 elif start["host_id"] not in room.members:
278 room.members[start["host_id"]] = "Player"
279 room.host_ip = addr[0]
280 room.host_port = start["host_port"]
281 room.started = True
282 room.last_seen = time.time()
283 return (
284 write_u32(MAGIC)
285 + write_u8(VERSION)
286 + write_u8(INET_START_OK)
287 )
288
289 if msg_type == INET_POLL:
290 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
291 room = rooms.get(code)
292 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
293 rooms.pop(code, None)
294 return (
295 write_u32(MAGIC)
296 + write_u8(VERSION)
297 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
298 + write_str("Room not found.")
299 )
300 room.last_seen = time.time()
301 if not room.started:
302 return (
303 write_u32(MAGIC)
304 + write_u8(VERSION)
305 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
306 + write_u8(0)
307 + write_u8(len(room.members))
308 + encode_members(room)
309 )
310 return (
311 write_u32(MAGIC)
312 + write_u8(VERSION)
313 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
314 + write_u8(1)
315 + write_u8(len(room.members))
316 + build_start(room.start)
317 + write_str(room.host_ip)
318 + write_str(room.start.get("pack_name", ""))
319 + encode_members(room)
320 )
321
322 if msg_type == INET_LEAVE:
323 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
324 client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
325 room = rooms.get(code)
326 if room:
327 host_id = room.start.get("host_id", "")
328 if client_id == host_id:
329 # Host owns the room. If host leaves, close the room for everyone
330 # so the code can be reused immediately and no one remains in a
331 # stale, unstartable room.
332 rooms.pop(code, None)
333 else:
334 room.members.pop(client_id, None)
335 room.last_seen = time.time()
336 if not room.members:
337 rooms.pop(code, None)
338 return (
339 write_u32(MAGIC)
340 + write_u8(VERSION)
341 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
342 + write_str(code)
343 + write_str("")
344 )
345
346 return None
347
348
349def main():
350 parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
351 parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
352 parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=12347)
353 parser.add_argument("--ttl", type=int, default=1800, help="room TTL in seconds")
354 args = parser.parse_args()
355
356 sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
357 sock.bind((args.host, args.port))
358 sock.settimeout(1.0)
359
360 rooms = {}
361 print(f"Lobby server listening on {args.host}:{args.port}")
362 while True:
363 try:
364 data, addr = sock.recvfrom(2048)
365 except socket.timeout:
366 # cleanup
367 expired = [code for code, room in rooms.items() if room.expired(args.ttl)]
368 for code in expired:
369 rooms.pop(code, None)
370 continue
371 try:
372 response = handle_request(data, addr, rooms, args.ttl)
373 except Exception:
374 response = (
375 write_u32(MAGIC)
376 + write_u8(VERSION)
377 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
378 + write_str("Bad request.")
379 )
380 if response:
381 sock.sendto(response, addr)
382
383
384if __name__ == "__main__":
385 main()

A tools/mp_test_env.py

Description
  • Integration test runner that spawns two Enigma instances (host/client) and drives them via a script.
Where it is used
  • Developer tool used to reproduce multiplayer bugs deterministically and to validate fixes.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New test harness for multiplayer behavior regression checks (window positioning, scripted input, structured logs).

1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2#
3# Multiplayer test environment runner:
4# - starts a local TCP controller
5# - spawns two Enigma instances (host/client) in --mp-test-* mode
6# - drives them via a simple script and collects EVT/OK/ERR frames
7#
8# Protocol framing matches src/multiplayer_tcp_socket.cc: 4-byte little-endian length prefix.
9
10from __future__ import annotations
11
12import argparse
13import os
14import selectors
15import shlex
16import signal
17import socket
18import struct
19import subprocess
20import sys
21import tempfile
22import time
23from dataclasses import dataclass, field
24from collections import deque
25from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
26
27
28def _now_ms() -> int:
29 return int(time.time() * 1000)
30
31
32def _frame_encode(payload: str) -> bytes:
33 b = payload.encode("utf-8", errors="strict")
34 if len(b) == 0 or len(b) > (1 << 20):
35 raise ValueError(f"invalid frame size: {len(b)}")
36 return struct.pack("<I", len(b)) + b
37
38
39def _frame_try_decode(buf: bytearray) -> Optional[str]:
40 if len(buf) < 4:
41 return None
42 (n,) = struct.unpack("<I", bytes(buf[:4]))
43 if n == 0 or n > (1 << 20):
44 raise ValueError(f"invalid frame length prefix: {n}")
45 if len(buf) < 4 + n:
46 return None
47 payload = bytes(buf[4 : 4 + n])
48 del buf[: 4 + n]
49 return payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
50
51
52def _parse_kv(tokens: List[str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
53 out: Dict[str, str] = {}
54 for t in tokens:
55 if "=" not in t:
56 continue
57 k, v = t.split("=", 1)
58 if k:
59 out[k] = v
60 return out
61
62
63def _try_parse_float(s: str) -> Optional[float]:
64 try:
65 return float(s)
66 except Exception:
67 return None
68
69
70def _try_parse_int(s: str) -> Optional[int]:
71 try:
72 return int(s, 10)
73 except Exception:
74 return None
75
76
77def _parse_evt_line(line: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
78 if not line.startswith("EVT "):
79 return None
80 toks = line.split()
81 kv = _parse_kv(toks[1:])
82 if "name" not in kv:
83 return None
84 return kv
85
86
87def _parse_state_evt(line: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
88 kv = _parse_evt_line(line)
89 if not kv or kv.get("name") != "STATE":
90 return None
91 out: Dict[str, Any] = {"name": "STATE"}
92 for k, v in kv.items():
93 if k == "name":
94 continue
95 # Try int, then float, else string.
96 iv = _try_parse_int(v)
97 if iv is not None:
98 out[k] = iv
99 continue
100 fv = _try_parse_float(v)
101 if fv is not None:
102 out[k] = fv
103 continue
104 out[k] = v
105 return out

108@dataclass
109class PeerConn:
110 sock: socket.socket
111 addr: Tuple[str, int]
112 rx: bytearray = field(default_factory=bytearray)
113 role: Optional[str] = None # "host"/"client"
114 pid: Optional[str] = None
115
116 def send_line(self, line: str) -> None:
117 self.sock.sendall(_frame_encode(line))
118
119
120class Controller:
121 def __init__(self, expected: int, controller_log: Optional[object] = None) -> None:
122 self.expected = expected
123 self.sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
124 self.listener: Optional[socket.socket] = None
125 self.conns: List[PeerConn] = []
126 self.by_role: Dict[str, PeerConn] = {}
127 self.events: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = [] # (ts_ms, role, line)
128 self.last_state: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
129 self.state_lines: Dict[str, deque[str]] = {}
130 self.controller_log = controller_log
131
132 def listen(self, host: str, port: int) -> int:
133 s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
134 s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
135 s.bind((host, port))
136 s.listen()
137 s.setblocking(False)
138 self.listener = s
139 self.sel.register(s, selectors.EVENT_READ, data=("listen", None))
140 return s.getsockname()[1]
141
142 def close(self) -> None:
143 for c in list(self.conns):
144 try:
145 self.sel.unregister(c.sock)
146 except Exception:
147 pass
148 try:
149 c.sock.close()
150 except Exception:
151 pass
152 self.conns.clear()
153 self.by_role.clear()
154 if self.listener:
155 try:
156 self.sel.unregister(self.listener)
157 except Exception:
158 pass
159 try:
160 self.listener.close()
161 except Exception:
162 pass
163 self.listener = None
164
165 def _accept_ready(self) -> None:
166 assert self.listener is not None
167 while True:
168 try:
169 conn, addr = self.listener.accept()
170 except BlockingIOError:
171 return
172 conn.setblocking(False)
173 pc = PeerConn(sock=conn, addr=(addr[0], addr[1]))
174 self.conns.append(pc)
175 self.sel.register(conn, selectors.EVENT_READ, data=("conn", pc))
176
177 def pump(self, timeout_s: float) -> None:
178 for key, _mask in self.sel.select(timeout=timeout_s):
179 kind, pc = key.data
180 if kind == "listen":
181 self._accept_ready()
182 continue
183 assert kind == "conn" and pc is not None
184 try:
185 data = pc.sock.recv(4096)
186 except BlockingIOError:
187 continue
188 if not data:
189 # peer closed
190 try:
191 self.sel.unregister(pc.sock)
192 except Exception:
193 pass
194 try:
195 pc.sock.close()
196 except Exception:
197 pass
198 if pc in self.conns:
199 self.conns.remove(pc)
200 if pc.role and self.by_role.get(pc.role) is pc:
201 del self.by_role[pc.role]
202 continue
203 pc.rx.extend(data)
204 while True:
205 line = _frame_try_decode(pc.rx)
206 if line is None:
207 break
208 role = pc.role or "unknown"
209 ts = _now_ms()
210 self.events.append((ts, role, line))
211 out_line = f"[{ts}] {role}: {line}"
212 print(out_line, flush=True)
213 if self.controller_log is not None:
214 try:
215 self.controller_log.write(out_line + "\n")
216 self.controller_log.flush()
217 except Exception:
218 pass
219
220 # Auto-learn role from HELLO.
221 if pc.role is None and line.startswith("EVT "):
222 toks = line.split()
223 kv = _parse_kv(toks[1:])
224 if kv.get("name") == "HELLO":
225 r = kv.get("role")
226 if r:
227 pc.role = r
228 pc.pid = kv.get("pid")
229 self.by_role[r] = pc
230 role = r
231
232 st = _parse_state_evt(line)
233 if st is not None and role != "unknown":
234 self.last_state[role] = st
235 if role not in self.state_lines:
236 self.state_lines[role] = deque(maxlen=30)
237 self.state_lines[role].append(line)
238
239 def wait_for_roles(self, timeout_s: float) -> None:
240 deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
241 while time.time() < deadline:
242 self.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
243 if "host" in self.by_role and "client" in self.by_role:
244 return
245 raise RuntimeError("timeout waiting for host+client HELLO")
246
247 def send(self, role: str, cmdline: str) -> None:
248 pc = self.by_role.get(role)
249 if not pc:
250 raise RuntimeError(f"no peer with role={role}")
251 pc.send_line(cmdline)
252
253 def send_both(self, cmdline: str) -> None:
254 self.send("host", cmdline)
255 self.send("client", cmdline)
256
257 def wait_line_contains(self, role: str, needle: str, timeout_s: float) -> str:
258 deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
259 idx = 0
260 while time.time() < deadline:
261 # Search any newly appended events first.
262 while idx < len(self.events):
263 _ts, r, line = self.events[idx]
264 idx += 1
265 if role != "any" and r != role:
266 continue
267 if needle in line:
268 return line
269 self.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
270 raise RuntimeError(f"timeout waiting for role={role} contains={needle!r}")
271

273def _tail_text(path: str, max_bytes: int = 16 * 1024) -> str:
274 try:
275 with open(path, "rb") as f:
276 f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
277 size = f.tell()
278 start = max(0, size - max_bytes)
279 f.seek(start, os.SEEK_SET)
280 b = f.read()
281 return b.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
282 except Exception as e:
283 return f"<unable to read {path}: {e}>"

291 parts.append(f"----- {role} STATE (last {len(lines)}) -----")
292 parts.extend(list(lines))
293 return "\n".join(parts)

347
348def _run_script(ctrl: Controller, script_path: str) -> None:
349 with open(script_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
350 for lineno, raw in enumerate(f, start=1):
351 line = raw.strip()
352 if not line or line.startswith("#"):
353 continue
354 toks = shlex.split(line, comments=False, posix=True)
355 if not toks:
356 continue
357 op = toks[0].lower()
358
359 if op in ("host", "client"):
360 cmdline = " ".join(toks[1:])
361 if not cmdline:
362 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: missing command after {op}")
363 ctrl.send(op, cmdline)
364 continue
365
366 if op == "both":
367 cmdline = " ".join(toks[1:])
368 if not cmdline:
369 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: missing command after both")
370 ctrl.send_both(cmdline)
371 continue
372
373 if op == "sleep":
374 if len(toks) == 2 and toks[1].isdigit():
375 ms = int(toks[1])
376 else:
377 kv = _parse_kv(toks[1:])
378 ms = int(kv.get("ms", "0"))
379 time.sleep(ms / 1000.0)
380 ctrl.pump(timeout_s=0.01)
381 continue
382
383 if op == "wait":
384 kv = _parse_kv(toks[1:])
385 role = kv.get("role", "any").lower()
386 needle = kv.get("contains")
387 timeout_ms = int(kv.get("timeout_ms", "5000"))
388 if not needle:
389 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: wait requires contains=...")
390 ctrl.wait_line_contains(role=role, needle=needle, timeout_s=timeout_ms / 1000.0)
391 continue
392
393 if op == "wait_state_change":
394 kv = _parse_kv(toks[1:])
395 role = kv.get("role", "").lower()
396 field = kv.get("field", "")
397 min_abs_delta = float(kv.get("min_abs_delta", "0"))
398 timeout_ms = int(kv.get("timeout_ms", "5000"))
399 if role not in ("host", "client"):
400 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: wait_state_change role=host|client required")
401 if not field:
402 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: wait_state_change field=... required")
403 if min_abs_delta <= 0:
404 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: wait_state_change min_abs_delta>0 required")
405
406 # Ensure we have a baseline state.
407 deadline = time.time() + (timeout_ms / 1000.0)
408 while time.time() < deadline and role not in ctrl.last_state:
409 ctrl.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
410 baseline = ctrl.last_state.get(role)
411 if not baseline or field not in baseline:
412 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: no baseline STATE for {role} (missing {field})")
413 base_val = baseline[field]
414 if not isinstance(base_val, (int, float)):
415 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: field {field} not numeric in baseline")
416
417 while time.time() < deadline:
418 ctrl.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
419 cur = ctrl.last_state.get(role)
420 if not cur:
421 continue
422 cur_val = cur.get(field)
423 if not isinstance(cur_val, (int, float)):
424 continue
425 if abs(float(cur_val) - float(base_val)) >= min_abs_delta:
426 break
427 else:
428 raise RuntimeError(
429 f"{script_path}:{lineno}: timeout waiting for {role} {field} change >= {min_abs_delta}"
430 )
431 continue
432
433 raise RuntimeError(f"{script_path}:{lineno}: unknown op {op!r}")
434
435
436def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
437 ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
438 ap.add_argument("--enigma", default=_find_default_enigma_bin(), help="Path to enigma binary")
439 ap.add_argument("--script", required=True, help="Script file to execute")
440 ap.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1", help="Controller listen host")
441 ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0, help="Controller listen port (0=auto)")
442 ap.add_argument("--timeout-ms", type=int, default=15000, help="HELLO wait timeout")
443 ap.add_argument("--extra-arg", action="append", default=[], help="Extra arg passed to both instances")
444 ap.add_argument(
445 "--data-dir",
446 default="",
447 help="Enigma data directory (default: auto-detect repo ./data; use 'none' to skip)",
448 )
449 ap.add_argument(
450 "--side-by-side",
451 action="store_true",
452 help="Position host/client windows side-by-side (best-effort via SDL env vars)",
453 )
454 ap.add_argument("--window-x0", type=int, default=40, help="Left window X when --side-by-side")
455 ap.add_argument("--window-y0", type=int, default=40, help="Window Y when --side-by-side")
456 ap.add_argument("--window-dx", type=int, default=820, help="Delta X between windows when --side-by-side")
457 ap.add_argument(
458 "--workdir",
459 default="",
460 help="Directory for prefs/logs (default: create a temp dir and keep it)",
461 )
462 ns = ap.parse_args(argv)
463
464 if not (os.path.isfile(ns.enigma) and os.access(ns.enigma, os.X_OK)):
465 raise SystemExit(f"enigma binary not found/executable: {ns.enigma}")
466
467 if ns.data_dir.lower() == "none":
468 data_dir = ""
469 else:
470 data_dir = ns.data_dir or os.path.join(_find_repo_root_from_script(), "data")
471 if data_dir and not os.path.isdir(data_dir):
472 raise SystemExit(f"data dir not found: {data_dir} (use --data-dir to override)")
473
474 # Separate preference roots so two processes don't fight over config files.
475 tmp_root = ns.workdir or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="enigma-mptest-")
476 os.makedirs(tmp_root, exist_ok=True)
477 pref_host = os.path.join(tmp_root, "pref-host")
478 pref_client = os.path.join(tmp_root, "pref-client")
479 os.makedirs(pref_host, exist_ok=True)
480 os.makedirs(pref_client, exist_ok=True)
481 log_host = os.path.join(tmp_root, "host.log")
482 log_client = os.path.join(tmp_root, "client.log")
483 ctrl_log_path = os.path.join(tmp_root, "controller.log")
484 ctrl_logf: Optional[object] = open(ctrl_log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
485 ctrl = Controller(expected=2, controller_log=ctrl_logf)
486 port = ctrl.listen(ns.host, ns.port)
487 connect = f"{ns.host}:{port}"
488
489 procs: List[subprocess.Popen] = []
490 logs: List[object] = []
491 try:
492 print(f"mp test workdir: {tmp_root}", flush=True)
493 host_pos = None
494 client_pos = None
495 if ns.side_by_side:
496 host_pos = (ns.window_x0, ns.window_y0)
497 client_pos = (ns.window_x0 + ns.window_dx, ns.window_y0)
498 ph, lfh = _spawn_enigma(
499 ns.enigma, "host", connect, pref_host, data_dir, ns.extra_arg, log_host, host_pos
500 )
501 pc, lfc = _spawn_enigma(
502 ns.enigma, "client", connect, pref_client, data_dir, ns.extra_arg, log_client, client_pos
503 )
504 procs.extend([ph, pc])
505 logs.extend([lfh, lfc])
506
507 hello_deadline = time.time() + (ns.timeout_ms / 1000.0)
508 while time.time() < hello_deadline:
509 ctrl.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
510 if "host" in ctrl.by_role and "client" in ctrl.by_role:
511 break
512 if ph.poll() is not None or pc.poll() is not None:
513 raise RuntimeError("child process exited before sending HELLO")
514 if "host" not in ctrl.by_role or "client" not in ctrl.by_role:
515 raise RuntimeError("timeout waiting for host+client HELLO")
516
517 _run_script(ctrl, ns.script)
518 return 0
519 except Exception as e:
520 # Helpful diagnostics: show logs if something prevented startup/HELLO.
521 try:
522 print(f"mp test error: {e}", flush=True)
523 dump = _dump_last_states(ctrl)
524 if dump:
525 print(dump, flush=True)
526 if os.path.exists(log_host):
527 print("----- host.log (tail) -----", flush=True)
528 print(_tail_text(log_host), flush=True)
529 if os.path.exists(log_client):
530 print("----- client.log (tail) -----", flush=True)
531 print(_tail_text(log_client), flush=True)
532 except Exception:
533 pass
534 raise
535 finally:
536 # Best-effort: request clean shutdown via protocol, then kill.
537 try:
538 if "host" in ctrl.by_role:
539 ctrl.send("host", "QUIT")
540 if "client" in ctrl.by_role:
541 ctrl.send("client", "QUIT")
542 end = time.time() + 1.0
543 while time.time() < end:
544 ctrl.pump(timeout_s=0.05)
545 except Exception:
546 pass
547
548 for p in procs:
549 if p.poll() is None:
550 try:
551 p.terminate()
552 except Exception:
553 pass
554 for p in procs:
555 try:
556 p.wait(timeout=2.0)
557 except Exception:
558 pass
559 for p in procs:
560 if p.poll() is None:
561 try:
562 p.kill()
563 except Exception:
564 pass
565
566 for lf in logs:
567 try:
568 lf.close()
569 except Exception:
570 pass
571 if ctrl_logf is not None:
572 try:
573 ctrl_logf.close()
574 except Exception:
575 pass
576
577 ctrl.close()
578
579
580if __name__ == "__main__":
581 # Don't crash on Ctrl+C while leaving children running.
582 signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_DFL)
583 raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

A tools/mp_test_scripts/README.md

Description
  • Documentation for the multiplayer integration test scripts.
Where it is used
  • Read alongside `tools/mp_test_env.py` when adding new regression scripts.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New README describing the mp test script format and common patterns.
diff --git a/tools/mp_test_scripts/README.md b/tools/mp_test_scripts/README.md
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..441d465d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/mp_test_scripts/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
1# Multiplayer Test Scripts
2
3These scripts are consumed by `tools/mp_test_env.py` to drive two Enigma instances started with the in-engine multiplayer test driver (`--mp-test-*`).
4
5## Usage
6
7```sh
8./tools/mp_test_env.py --script tools/mp_test_scripts/basic_join_and_move.txt
9```
10
11Per-level scripts live in `tools/mp_test_scripts/` and are meant to be small,
12focused reproducers (for both failures and fixed regressions).
13
14## Script Format
15
16- Empty lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
17- Lines are parsed with shell-style quoting (Python `shlex`).
18
19Supported operations:
20
21- `host <CMD...>`: send a command to the host instance.
22- `client <CMD...>`: send a command to the client instance.
23- `both <CMD...>`: send a command to both instances.
24- `sleep <ms>` or `sleep ms=<ms>`: wait.
25- `wait role=<host|client|any> contains="<substring>" timeout_ms=<ms>`: wait until a received frame contains the substring.
26- `wait_state_change role=<host|client> field=<key> min_abs_delta=<float> timeout_ms=<ms>`: wait until the latest `EVT name=STATE` changes by at least the given delta compared to the current baseline.
27
28Enigma emits framed lines like `EVT ...`, `OK ...`, `ERR ...` back to the controller; `mp_test_env.py` prints them with timestamps.
29
30## Handy Driver Commands
31
32These are sent via `host ...` / `client ...` / `both ...` lines in scripts:
33
34- `STATE` / `STREAM_STATE interval_ms=<n>`: fetch or periodically emit `EVT name=STATE`.
35- `LIST_STEERABLE`: dump steerable actors (controllers/ownership hints).
36- `MOUSE_FORCE player=<p> fx=<f> fy=<f>`: add a one-shot local pending mouse force.
37- `HOLD_MOUSE_FORCE player=<p> ticks=<n> fx=<f> fy=<f>`: submit a fixed mouse-force delta once per simulation tick for the next `n` ticks.
38- `INJECT_INPUT player=<p> fx=<f> fy=<f> [rot=<i>] [act=<i>]`: enqueue an input sample for the current tick.
39- `OVERRIDE_INPUT player=<p> ticks=<n> fx=<f> fy=<f> [rot=<i>] [act=<i>]`: force an input sample for the next `n` simulation ticks.

1# Confirms the host-controlled ball actually moves on the host instance.
2#
3# This is intended to catch the regression where balls only move on the client
4# simulation and then get snapped back to the host state.
5
6host START_HOST session=1 seed=1 expected=2 port=23456 host_id=mptest-host
7client START_CLIENT session=1 seed=1 expected=2 port=23456 host_ip=127.0.0.1 host_id=mptest-host

9

12sleep 800
13both START_GAME
14

16host STREAM_STATE interval_ms=50
17host STATE
18wait role=host contains="EVT name=STATE" timeout_ms=2000
19sleep 100
20
21# Log steerable actors once for debugging (controllers/owners).
22host LIST_STEERABLE
23sleep 200
24

27

32wait role=host contains="lc0_fx=300.000" timeout_ms=2000
33
34# The host should observe its own p0_x changing.
35wait_state_change role=host field=p0_x min_abs_delta=0.05 timeout_ms=5000

37both QUIT

1# Ensures the host advertises the selected level via NET_LOAD_LEVEL early enough
2# that the client cannot send READY while still on an arbitrary previously loaded
3# level (fixes "host/client loaded different levels" regressions).
4
5# Start a session with an explicit level_id so SessionStartHost seeds mp_load=1 and
6# the host sends a NET_LOAD_LEVEL to newly connected peers.
7host START_HOST session=1 seed=1 expected=2 port=23456 host_id=mptest-host level_id="enigma_peroxyd/peroxyd04_2"
8client START_CLIENT session=1 seed=1 expected=2 port=23456 host_ip=127.0.0.1 host_id=mptest-host level_id="enigma_peroxyd/peroxyd04_2"
9wait role=client contains="EVT name=JOINED" timeout_ms=15000
10
11# The client must have observed a load notification (mp_last_load=1) before it is
12# allowed to send READY.
13host STREAM_STATE interval_ms=100
14client STREAM_STATE interval_ms=100
15host STATE
16client STATE
17wait role=host contains="mp_load=1" timeout_ms=2000
18wait role=client contains="mp_last_load=1" timeout_ms=5000
19
20# Continue with a normal scripted level load + start.
21host LOAD_LEVEL level_id="enigma_peroxyd/peroxyd04_2"
22sleep 1200
23both START_GAME
24
25# Sanity: simulation should advance on the host.
26host STREAM_STATE interval_ms=50
27wait_state_change role=host field=tick min_abs_delta=1 timeout_ms=5000
28
29both QUIT

A tools/relay_server.cc

Description
  • UDP relay server used as a fallback gameplay transport when direct UDP connectivity fails.
Where it is used
  • Used in Internet mode when direct connect fails or is disabled.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New backend component: UDP relay for gameplay packets.
diff --git a/tools/relay_server.cc b/tools/relay_server.cc
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..ffcf0dbc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/relay_server.cc
@@ -0,0 +1,288 @@
1#include <enet/enet.h>
2
3#include <cstdint>
4#include <cstdlib>
5#include <cstdio>
6#include <string>
7#include <unordered_map>
8#include <vector>
9
10namespace {
11
12#ifdef ENET_VERSION
13#if ENET_VERSION >= ENET_VERSION_CREATE(1, 3, 0)
14#define ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
15#endif
16#endif
17
18constexpr uint32_t kRelayMagic = 0x4C524E45; // "ENRL"
19constexpr uint8_t kRelayVersion = 1;
20constexpr size_t kRelayHeaderSize = 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4;
21
22enum RelayType : uint8_t {
23 RELAY_HELLO_HOST = 1,
24 RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT = 2,
25 RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT = 3,
26 RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT = 4,
27 RELAY_SEND = 5,
28 RELAY_DATA = 6,
29 RELAY_ERROR = 7
30};
31
32struct RelayHeader {
33 uint8_t type = 0;
34 uint32_t session_id = 0;
35 uint32_t client_id = 0;
36};
37
38struct PeerInfo {
39 enum Role { UNKNOWN, HOST, CLIENT } role = UNKNOWN;
40 uint32_t session_id = 0;
41 uint32_t client_id = 0;
42};
43
44struct RelaySession {
45 ENetPeer *host = nullptr;
46 uint32_t next_client_id = 1;
47 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, ENetPeer *> clients;
48};
49
50bool read_u8(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint8_t &out) {
51 if (offset + 1 > size)
52 return false;
53 out = data[offset++];
54 return true;
55}
56
57bool read_u32(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint32_t &out) {
58 if (offset + 4 > size)
59 return false;
60 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset]) |
61 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
62 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
63 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
64 offset += 4;
65 return true;
66}
67
68void write_u32(std::vector<uint8_t> &out, uint32_t value) {
69 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value & 0xFF));
70 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
71 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
72 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
73}
74
75bool parse_relay_header(const ENetPacket *packet, RelayHeader &out,
76 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
77 const auto *data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(packet->data);
78 size_t size = packet->dataLength;
79 size_t offset = 0;
80 uint32_t magic = 0;
81 uint8_t version = 0;
82 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
83 return false;
84 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
85 return false;
86 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
87 return false;
88 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
89 return false;
90 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
91 return false;
92 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
93 return false;
94 if (payload) {
95 *payload = data + offset;
96 }
97 if (payload_len) {
98 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
99 }
100 return true;
101}
102
103ENetPacket *make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
104 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
105 enet_uint32 flags) {
106 std::vector<uint8_t> data;
107 data.reserve(kRelayHeaderSize + payload_len);
108 write_u32(data, kRelayMagic);
109 data.push_back(kRelayVersion);
110 data.push_back(type);
111 write_u32(data, session_id);
112 write_u32(data, client_id);
113 if (payload && payload_len > 0) {
114 data.insert(data.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
115 }
116 return enet_packet_create(data.data(), data.size(), flags);
117}
118
119} // namespace
120
121int main(int argc, char **argv) {
122 if (enet_initialize() != 0) {
123 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize ENet\n");
124 return 1;
125 }
126 atexit(enet_deinitialize);
127 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
128 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
129
130 const char *host_str = "0.0.0.0";
131 uint16_t port = 12348;
132 if (argc > 1)
133 host_str = argv[1];
134 if (argc > 2)
135 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
136
137 ENetAddress address;
138 enet_address_set_host(&address, host_str);
139 address.port = port;
140 ENetHost *server = enet_host_create(&address, 64,
141#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
142 2 /* channels */,
143#endif
144 0, 0);
145 if (!server) {
146 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create relay server on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
147 return 1;
148 }
149
150 std::unordered_map<ENetPeer *, PeerInfo> peers;
151 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, RelaySession> sessions;
152
153 std::printf("Relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
154
155 while (true) {
156 ENetEvent event;
157 while (enet_host_service(server, &event, 1) > 0) {
158 switch (event.type) {
159 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT: {
160 peers[event.peer] = PeerInfo();
161 break;
162 }
163 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
164 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
165 if (info_it == peers.end()) {
166 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
167 break;
168 }
169 PeerInfo &info = info_it->second;
170 if (info.role == PeerInfo::UNKNOWN) {
171 RelayHeader header;
172 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, nullptr, nullptr)) {
173 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
174 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
175 break;
176 }
177 if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
178 info.role = PeerInfo::HOST;
179 info.session_id = header.session_id;
180 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
181 if (session.host && session.host != event.peer)
182 enet_peer_disconnect(session.host, 0);
183 session.host = event.peer;
184 for (const auto &entry : session.clients) {
185 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
186 header.session_id,
187 entry.first, nullptr, 0,
188 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
189 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
190 }
191 } else if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
192 info.role = PeerInfo::CLIENT;
193 info.session_id = header.session_id;
194 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
195 uint32_t client_id = session.next_client_id++;
196 info.client_id = client_id;
197 session.clients[client_id] = event.peer;
198 if (session.host) {
199 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
200 header.session_id,
201 client_id, nullptr, 0,
202 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
203 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
204 }
205 } else {
206 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
207 }
208 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
209 break;
210 }
211 if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
212 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
213 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host) {
214 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA,
215 info.session_id,
216 info.client_id,
217 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(event.packet->data),
218 event.packet->dataLength,
219 event.packet->flags);
220 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
221 }
222 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
223 break;
224 }
225 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
226 RelayHeader header;
227 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
228 size_t payload_len = 0;
229 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, &payload, &payload_len)) {
230 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
231 break;
232 }
233 if (header.type == RELAY_SEND) {
234 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
235 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
236 auto client_it = session_it->second.clients.find(header.client_id);
237 if (client_it != session_it->second.clients.end()) {
238 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload, payload_len,
239 event.packet->flags);
240 enet_peer_send(client_it->second, 0, packet);
241 }
242 }
243 }
244 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
245 break;
246 }
247 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
248 break;
249 }
250 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT: {
251 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
252 if (info_it == peers.end())
253 break;
254 PeerInfo info = info_it->second;
255 peers.erase(info_it);
256 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
257 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
258 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host == event.peer) {
259 for (const auto &entry : session_it->second.clients)
260 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.second, 0);
261 sessions.erase(session_it);
262 }
263 } else if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
264 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
265 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
266 session_it->second.clients.erase(info.client_id);
267 if (session_it->second.host) {
268 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT,
269 info.session_id,
270 info.client_id, nullptr, 0,
271 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
272 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
273 }
274 if (!session_it->second.host && session_it->second.clients.empty())
275 sessions.erase(session_it);
276 }
277 }
278 break;
279 }
280 default:
281 break;
282 }
283 }
284 }
285
286 enet_host_destroy(server);
287 return 0;
288}

A tools/tcp_relay_server.cc

Description
  • TCP relay server used as a last-resort gameplay transport for networks that block UDP.
Where it is used
  • Used in Internet mode when both direct connect and UDP relay fail/are disabled.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New backend component: TCP relay fallback for restrictive networks.

35/* -------------------- TCP relay server -------------------- */
36/*
37 * Simple TCP relay server for Enigma multiplayer.
38 *
39 * Provides a fallback transport for networks that block UDP or relayed UDP.
40 */
41
42namespace {
43constexpr uint32_t kRelayMagic = 0x4C524E45; // "ENRL"
44constexpr uint8_t kRelayVersion = 1;
45constexpr uint32_t kMaxFrame = 1u << 20;
46
47enum RelayType : uint8_t {
48 RELAY_HELLO_HOST = 1,
49 RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT = 2,
50 RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT = 3,
51 RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT = 4,
52 RELAY_SEND = 5,
53 RELAY_DATA = 6,
54 RELAY_ERROR = 7
55};
56
57struct RelayHeader {
58 uint8_t type = 0;
59 uint32_t session_id = 0;
60 uint32_t client_id = 0;
61};
62
63struct Conn {
64 int fd = -1;
65 enum Role { UNKNOWN, HOST, CLIENT } role = UNKNOWN;
66 uint32_t session_id = 0;
67 uint32_t client_id = 0;
68 std::vector<uint8_t> rx;
69 uint32_t pending_len = 0;
70};
71
72struct Session {
73 int host_fd = -1;
74 uint32_t next_client_id = 1;
75 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, int> clients;
76};
77
78void set_nonblocking(int fd) {
79 int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0);
80 if (flags >= 0)
81 fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
82}
83
84bool send_all(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
85 size_t sent = 0;
86 while (sent < len) {
87 ssize_t n = ::send(fd, data + sent, len - sent, 0);
88 if (n > 0) {
89 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
90 continue;
91 }
92 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) {
93 pollfd pfd;
94 pfd.fd = fd;
95 pfd.events = POLLOUT;
96 pfd.revents = 0;
97 int rc = ::poll(&pfd, 1, 250);
98 if (rc <= 0)
99 return false;
100 continue;
101 }
102 return false;
103 }
104 return true;
105}
106
107bool send_frame(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
108 if (len == 0 || len > kMaxFrame)
109 return false;
110 uint8_t prefix[4];
111 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
112 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
113 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
114 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
115 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
116 return send_all(fd, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && send_all(fd, data, len);
117}
118
119void write_u32(std::vector<uint8_t> &out, uint32_t value) {
120 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value & 0xFF));
121 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
122 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
123 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
124}
125
126bool read_u8(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint8_t &out) {
127 if (offset + 1 > size)
128 return false;
129 out = data[offset++];
130 return true;
131}
132
133bool read_u32(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint32_t &out) {
134 if (offset + 4 > size)
135 return false;
136 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset]) |
137 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
138 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
139 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
140 offset += 4;
141 return true;
142}
143
144bool parse_relay_header(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, RelayHeader &out,
145 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
146 size_t offset = 0;
147 uint32_t magic = 0;
148 uint8_t version = 0;
149 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
150 return false;
151 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
152 return false;
153 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
154 return false;
155 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
156 return false;
157 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
158 return false;
159 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
160 return false;
161 if (payload)
162 *payload = data + offset;
163 if (payload_len)
164 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
165 return true;
166}
167
168std::vector<uint8_t> make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
169 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len) {
170 std::vector<uint8_t> out;
171 out.reserve(4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4 + payload_len);
172 write_u32(out, kRelayMagic);
173 out.push_back(kRelayVersion);
174 out.push_back(type);
175 write_u32(out, session_id);
176 write_u32(out, client_id);
177 if (payload && payload_len)
178 out.insert(out.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
179 return out;
180}
181
182bool pump_recv(Conn &c) {
183 uint8_t buf[4096];
184 while (true) {
185 ssize_t n = ::recv(c.fd, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
186 if (n == 0)
187 return false;
188 if (n < 0) {
189 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
190 break;
191 return false;
192 }
193 c.rx.insert(c.rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
194 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
195 break;
196 }
197 return true;
198}
199
200bool try_extract_frame(Conn &c, std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
201 out.clear();
202 if (c.pending_len == 0) {
203 if (c.rx.size() < 4)
204 return false;
205 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[0]) |
206 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[1]) << 8) |
207 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[2]) << 16) |
208 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[3]) << 24);
209 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + 4);
210 if (v == 0 || v > kMaxFrame) {
211 c.rx.clear();
212 c.pending_len = 0;
213 return false;
214 }
215 c.pending_len = v;
216 }
217 if (c.rx.size() < c.pending_len)
218 return false;
219 out.assign(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
220 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
221 c.pending_len = 0;
222 return true;
223}
224
225} // namespace
226
227int main(int argc, char **argv) {
228 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
229 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
230
231 const char *host = "0.0.0.0";
232 uint16_t port = 12349;
233 if (argc > 1)
234 host = argv[1];
235 if (argc > 2)
236 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
237
238 addrinfo hints;
239 std::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
240 hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
241 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
242 hints.ai_flags = AI_PASSIVE;
243
244 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
245 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
246 if (getaddrinfo(host, port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0) {
247 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to resolve bind address\n");
248 return 1;
249 }
250
251 int listen_fd = ::socket(res->ai_family, res->ai_socktype, res->ai_protocol);
252 if (listen_fd < 0) {
253 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create socket\n");
254 freeaddrinfo(res);
255 return 1;
256 }
257
258 int opt = 1;
259 setsockopt(listen_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
260
261 if (::bind(listen_fd, res->ai_addr, static_cast<socklen_t>(res->ai_addrlen)) != 0) {
262 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to bind %s:%u\n", host, port);
263 freeaddrinfo(res);
264 close(listen_fd);
265 return 1;
266 }
267 freeaddrinfo(res);
268
269 if (::listen(listen_fd, 64) != 0) {
270 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to listen\n");
271 close(listen_fd);
272 return 1;
273 }
274
275 set_nonblocking(listen_fd);
276
277 std::printf("TCP relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host, port);
278
279 std::unordered_map<int, Conn> conns;
280 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Session> sessions;
281
282 while (true) {
283 std::vector<pollfd> fds;
284 fds.reserve(conns.size() + 1);
285 fds.push_back({listen_fd, POLLIN, 0});
286 for (const auto &kv : conns)
287 fds.push_back({kv.first, POLLIN, 0});
288
289 int rc = ::poll(fds.data(), fds.size(), 10);
290 if (rc < 0)
291 continue;
292
293 if (fds[0].revents & POLLIN) {
294 while (true) {
295 sockaddr_in addr;
296 socklen_t alen = sizeof(addr);
297 int fd = ::accept(listen_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&addr), &alen);
298 if (fd < 0) {
299 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
300 break;
301 break;
302 }
303 set_nonblocking(fd);
304 conns[fd] = Conn{fd};
305 }
306 }
307
308 std::vector<int> to_close;
309 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
310
311 for (size_t i = 1; i < fds.size(); ++i) {
312 int fd = fds[i].fd;
313 if ((fds[i].revents & (POLLIN | POLLERR | POLLHUP)) == 0)
314 continue;
315 auto it = conns.find(fd);
316 if (it == conns.end())
317 continue;
318 Conn &c = it->second;
319
320 if (!pump_recv(c)) {
321 to_close.push_back(fd);
322 continue;
323 }
324
325 while (try_extract_frame(c, frame)) {
326 if (c.role == Conn::UNKNOWN) {
327 RelayHeader hdr;
328 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
329 size_t payload_len = 0;
330 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len)) {
331 to_close.push_back(fd);
332 break;
333 }
334 if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
335 c.role = Conn::HOST;
336 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
337 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
338 s.host_fd = fd;
339 // Notify host about already connected clients.
340 for (const auto &entry : s.clients) {
341 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
342 entry.first, nullptr, 0);
343 send_frame(fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
344 }
345 } else if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
346 c.role = Conn::CLIENT;
347 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
348 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
349 c.client_id = s.next_client_id++;
350 s.clients[c.client_id] = fd;
351 if (s.host_fd >= 0) {
352 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
353 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
354 send_frame(s.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
355 }
356 } else {
357 to_close.push_back(fd);
358 break;
359 }
360 continue;
361 }
362
363 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
364 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
365 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
366 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA, c.session_id, c.client_id,
367 frame.data(), frame.size());
368 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
369 }
370 continue;
371 }
372
373 if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
374 RelayHeader hdr;
375 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
376 size_t payload_len = 0;
377 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len))
378 continue;
379 if (hdr.type != RELAY_SEND)
380 continue;
381 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
382 if (sit == sessions.end())
383 continue;
384 auto cit = sit->second.clients.find(hdr.client_id);
385 if (cit == sit->second.clients.end())
386 continue;
387 send_frame(cit->second, payload, payload_len);
388 continue;
389 }
390 }
391 }
392
393 // Apply queued disconnects (and send control notifications).
394 for (int fd : to_close) {
395 auto it = conns.find(fd);
396 if (it == conns.end())
397 continue;
398 Conn c = it->second;
399 conns.erase(it);
400 close(fd);
401
402 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
403 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
404 if (sit != sessions.end()) {
405 sit->second.clients.erase(c.client_id);
406 if (sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
407 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT, c.session_id,
408 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
409 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
410 }
411 if (sit->second.host_fd < 0 && sit->second.clients.empty())
412 sessions.erase(sit);
413 }
414 } else if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
415 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
416 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd == fd) {
417 // Close all clients when the host goes away.
418 for (const auto &entry : sit->second.clients) {
419 int cfd = entry.second;
420 auto cit = conns.find(cfd);
421 if (cit != conns.end()) {
422 conns.erase(cit);
423 close(cfd);
424 }
425 }
426 sessions.erase(sit);
427 }
428 }
429 }
430 }
431}
